title: 0 BC: Before Crisis
description: Come join one of Edinburgh's most exciting new comedians for an extended set of laughter! Liam Jackson brings a hilarious show to this year's Fringe, documenting his precarious experiences in the increasingly dire world of work and being broke in cost-of-living crisis times. Expect biting observations from unemployment to Scottish culture, and personal anecdotes on travel and relationships, that are in equal parts sincere and hysterical! Liam regularly performs stand-up around Scotland. 'Jokes, material and great delivery. Big laughs throughout. Also. Funny!' (The Stand Comedy Club). 'Definitely a comedian I'd like to see more of' (One4Review.co.uk).
venue_name: Flight Club at Laughing Horse @ West Port Oracle

title: 0% British – Afternoons: An Irish Stand-Up Comedy Show
description: Three Irish headliners. Zero Brits. All the craic. Join us for an afternoon of sharp, witty stand-up comedy straight from Ireland.
content_warnings: Audience participation, Contains distressing or potentially triggering themes, Strong language/swearing

title: 0% British – Evenings: An Irish Stand-Up Comedy Show
description: Warning: absolutely no British comedians were involved in this show. Three Irish headliners take to the late-night stage for an unmissable evening of no-holds-barred stand-up.
content_warnings: Audience participation, Contains distressing or potentially triggering themes, Strong language/swearing

title: 0% British – Mornings: An Irish Stand-Up Comedy Show
description: Three Irish headliners bring their A-game for a morning of stand-up comedy that's 100% Irish and 100% brilliant. Not a single British comedian in sight.
content_warnings: Audience participation, Contains distressing or potentially triggering themes, Strong language/swearing

title: 0% Faithful: Can You Solve The Traitors Murders?
description: The ultimate game of Betrayers and Innocents has been pulled off-air after a real-life murder... YOU are the detective in this high-tech immersive murder mystery! Use your phone to guide the investigation, and choose which suspects and clues to follow up. Inspired by choose your own adventures and escape rooms, made for fans of The Traitors and Agatha Christie, this is a show unlike anything you've seen before! Bring a smartphone. Praise for previous shows: 'Hilarious gags' ***** (ThreeWeeks). ***** (BroadwayBaby.com), ***** (InformedEdinburgh.co.uk), ***** (GeekChocolate.co.uk), ***** (TheSphinx.co.uk).

title: 0 Plans: A Crowd Work Comedy Show
description: A crowd-work and improvised stand-up comedy show with zero plans. Northern Irish comedian Reece Kidd and friends will entertain you and make you laugh. Reece has over 150 million views on Instagram. 0 Plans had a sold-out run at the Edinburgh Fringe in 2023, 2024 and 2025 with 50+ five-star audience reviews.
content_warnings: Audience participation, Contains distressing or potentially triggering themes, Strong language/swearing

title: 0% Shame, 100% Irish!
description: Irish comedian James Downey blends pun-tastic wit, sharp crowd work and a splash of musical comedy in a high-energy performance exploring working-class Belfast, Irish music and his chaotic family. Fast, fearless and brutally honest, James explores growing up loud and trying to fix himself without breaking the bank.

title: 0% Shame: A Late Night Comedy Show at Lunchtime
description: A dark and dirty comedy show at lunchtime for people who like their comedy obscene but their evenings free. Perfect for current and reformed hedonists and anyone who wants their depravity served before sunset so they can make even worse decisions later. Come laugh with three professional headliners and reach moral decay before 5pm.
content_warnings: Audience participation, Contains distressing or potentially triggering themes, Scenes of a sexual nature, Strong language/swearing

title: 0 to 2 mph In Under 60 Minutes
description: Zoom zoom zoom! The boys are back! Last year was their first sell out run, now they're taking it for granted. With new accolades: Chortle Student Finalist and Hastings Comedian of the Year Oliver Moore is back with Ricky Gervais' Dutch Barn Spirit of Comedy Finalist and BBC New Comedy Award-shortlisted Ridwan Hussain for another split bill of stand-up. It's better than the rest, find out why we did so well last year with this new hour of comedy. If we sell out again, it's really gonna go to my head.

title: 00:30 Cabaret O'Clock: Magic vs Burlesque
presented_by: Arron Jones & Fou Fou Kaboom / PBH's Free Fringe
description: The perfect show to end your night! Burlesque or Magic: which is better? You decide! Pick a side and face off in this interactive party game show cabaret where it isn’t just the gloves that come off! Join genuine cabaret power couple, Rockstar Magician and Fou Fou Kaboom, to paint pictures with your pelvis or fight for your life in a high stakes thumb war to the death! Only one team can win – will it be tits or tricks?

title: 007 Tons of Laughs – World Comedy from Japan, Europe and Beyond
description: James Bond has a license to kill. Our international comedians want their license to kill on stage. Armed with nothing but a microphone and a lethal wit, each comedian will debrief you on her/his treacherous journey of crossing borders and living deep undercover in other cultures, dodging near-death mishaps and surviving culture shocks with their sharp observations, deadly tongues and pure luck. Your mission, should you choose to accept it, is to break out in laughter and award the best killer on stage.
venue_name: Just The Tonic at The Caves

title: #1 All-Time Best Comedy Champion: War of the Flags
description: Who are the funniest comedians? The Americans? The English... eh... probably the Scottish, but maybe it's the Arabs? The Asians? Canadians? No, it's your Irish cousin... or is it your Indian dad? Can’t forget about the Jews! The time to wonder has passed! Comics from every nation, culture and background go head-to-head and answer the age-old question: who are the funniest people? Records won't lie – there will be ONE champion! Wear your country's colours, paint your face, show us your nips and let's get ready to rumble. Sold out 2024/2025!
content_warnings: Audience participation, distressing or potentially triggering themes, Scenes of a sexual nature, Strong language/swearing

title: 1 Astonishment 2 Many: Chris Dugdale
description: Best Magic Show, HELLO! Magazine 2022 and 2024. The only act ever to win the Edfest Bouquet five times! A dynamic blend of mentalism and magic. 'You blew my mind' (Gerard Butler). 14 Royal Family performances including a Royal Command Performance for Her Late Majesty Queen Elizabeth II. 'Beyond a shadow of a doubt masterful magic' (Metro). 'Beyond belief' (Herald). 'The closest thing to mind reading we will ever get' **** (List).

title: 1 Big Aussie Showcase
description: 1 Big Aussie Showcase is a fast-paced hour of power hosted by Australian comedian Kurt Sterling (25+ million views online). A Fringe tasting platter with Aussie flair, the show features a rotating lineup of the best stand-up and variety acts from across the festival, all anchored by Sterling's sharp, offbeat and quietly unhinged comedy.
content_warnings: Audience participation, Strong language/swearing, Buy a ticket in advance to guarantee entry or Pay What You Want at the venue
venue_name: Just The Tonic at The Mash House

title: 1 Big Oops
description: Top comedians act out your most embarrassing confessions live on stage – and the biggest oops wins a prize! Hosted by Australian comedian Kurt Sterling (25+ million views online) and featuring a rotating cast of top improvisers, this interactive comedy extravaganza takes your anonymous confessions and turns them into comedy gold. Here's how it works: audience members share their biggest oops anonymously – whether it's a dating disaster, a workplace whoopsie or a travel blunder – and our top-notch comedians will have to act them out on stage.
venue_name: Just The Tonic at The Mash House

title: 1 Dazzling Cabaret
description: "Life is a cabaret old chum, come join the cabaret!" (Liza Minnelli). Back by heavy demand for its 8th glorious sell out year, this crowd-pleasing night mixes circus thrills, jaw-dropping magic, riotous comedy and sparkling burlesque all into one irresistible celebration. Expect fearless acts, slick sleight-of-hand, cheeky striptease and punchlines that land like confetti cannons. Bring your mates, your cheers and whoops, dress up (or don’t), and settle in for a glittering evening of splendour, surprises and standing-ovation energy. One Edinburgh Fringe show you don't want to miss.

title: #1 Ethnic Comedy Breakfast
description: The perfect start to your day in Edinburgh! Hilarious ethnic stories of cricket, Hindu gods, Bollywood movies, accents and more. With only mild coarse language, this show is perfect for the whole family. Featuring award-winning Indian Australian comic Aditya Gautam. 'Sure to leave you feeling positive inside' (Chortle.co.uk). 'Master of toying with the fourth wall' ***** (ArtsHub.com.au). 'Comedy so spicy that your cheeks will be in constant pain' **** (FringeFeed.com.au). 'Will have you laughing out of shock!' **** (Advertiser, Adelaide). After getting rave reviews around the world, Aditya Gautam is now touring his spicy ethnic show.

title: 1 Funny Fecker: Havin' the Craic with Wes Dalton
description: Ireland’s cheekiest comic, Wes Dalton, brings a sharp, high-energy hour of stand-up packed with stories, quick-fire crowd work and off-the-cuff moments that make every show unique. A seasoned performer with over a decade on the circuit, Wes is known for sell-out Fringe runs and international appearances across the UK, Europe, Australia and Asia. Expect big laughs, warmth, mischief and plenty of craic as he turns everyday life, relationships and cultural clashes into comedy gold. No two shows are the same – just one funny fecker having the craic with you.

title: #1 Greatest Hit Rock'n'Roll Magic Show
description: Arron Jones was on Britain's Got Talent... now he wants revenge. Join rock'n'roll's greatest magician as he sticks it to Simon by performing a trick so face-meltingly good that it soars to #1 in the official UK singles chart. Is it possible? Not with that attitude. 'Amazing' (Ronan Keating). ***** (StageToPage.co.uk). ***** (MyLovelyAssistant.com). ***** (WorldMagicReview.com).

title: 1 Hour of Clean Comedy
description: This is stand-up comedy with the naughty bits scrubbed out. Think Dry-Bar Comedy or Friday night on Radio 4. Following a fully sold-out run in 2025, Clean Comedy is back to show off even more of Edinburgh's funniest family-friendly faces. Callum Mackenzie presents a joke-heavy show of pure, wholehearted, laugh-constant happiness that you can listen to while sitting next to your nan.
content_warnings: Buy a ticket in advance to guarantee entry or Pay What You Want at the venue.
venue_name: Just The Tonic at The Hive

title: 1 Hour of Headline Comedy
description: A rare chance to see four headline acts in a single show. Hosted by the brilliant Amy Matthews, this powerhouse line-up brings together Josh Glanc, Gareth Waugh and Max Fulham for a night of full-throttle, headline-worthy comedy. Expect big laughs, bold ideas and performers at the very top of their game. No warm-ups, no padding and no compromises – just four headliners doing what they do best! Late, loud and unmissable at this year's Fringe!

title: 1 Hour of Insane Magic
description: Cameron Gibson, Elliot Bibby and Luke Osey return for their fourth year as Insane Magic, bigger and more spectacular than ever before! Following multiple sell-out seasons, the trio present a fun-filled hour of jaw-dropping magic for everyone! Now in a larger venue; expect incredible new illusions, high-energy performances and plenty of moments of wonder. With international acclaim and five-star reviews, Insane Magic has been hailed as 'truly a global phenomenon' ***** (WorldMagicReview.com). This is world-class magic that will leave the entire family amazed, laughing and believing in the impossible.

title: 1 Hour of Insanity
description: Back for its second year, 1 Hour of Insanity returns with brand-new performers alongside a couple of favourites from last year. This fast-paced, family-friendly show delivers non-stop chaos, jaw-dropping skills and laugh-out-loud comedy from start to finish. Blending circus, comedy and magic, this show is led by the exciting Joel Fenton and features an all-star cast of international acts, including Tom Bolton, Miss Lily Phoenix and Jeromaia Detto. Expect the unexpected in this hour of energetic entertainment. The perfect show for the whole family. 'A family-friendly version of La Clique' **** (WorldMagicReview,com).

title: 1 Hour Of LAFS
description: 1 Hour of LAFS is a mixed-bill showcase hosted by The London Arts Facilitation Society, a charitable organisation helping working-class people in the arts. Come see the contenders for the first ever LAFS comedy award at the mixed-bill comedy showcase that makes a difference.

title: 1 Irish 1 English: A Stand-up Comedy Show
description: Join us at 15:40 for a stand-up comedy show featuring English comedian James Mileham and Irish comedian Reece Kidd. They have over 100 million views online and a UK Roast Battle championship.
content_warnings: Audience participation, Contains distressing or potentially triggering themes, Strong language/swearing

title: 1 Irishman: A Stand-up Comedy Show
description: 1 Irishman is a stand-up comedy show from Irish comedian Reece Kidd. This show has sold out for the last three years. Reece has over 150 million views online. Come see his new jokes.
content_warnings: Audience participation, Contains distressing or potentially triggering themes, Strong language/swearing

title: 1 King, 2 Princes and Shakespeare's Lie
description: Sold out in 2025. Back by popular demand. A king. A traitor. A villain. Or was he? Richard III returns to confront the myths that condemned him, challenging Shakespeare’s version of events and putting history itself on trial. In this gripping one-man performance, fact clashes with legend as Richard defends his reign and questions who gets to decide the truth. Provocative, compelling and darkly entertaining, this show asks whether history judged the wrong man. As power, propaganda, legacy and reputation collide on stage, you must decide whether history lied.
content_warnings: At the end of the show the audience will vote using voting cards to determine how the show ends

title: 1 MC and 3 Absolute Killers (of Comedy!)
description: A rotating line-up of the sharpest stand-ups on the Fringe. Absolute Killers is your nightly dose of guaranteed laughs; no flab, no fillers, just three great comics and a top-tier MC delivering a power hour of comedy carnage. Handpicked by the Scottish Comedy Festival, the acts range from award-winning stars to the next big thing, all killing it on one bill. Whether you're after a late-afternoon warm-up or your main comedy fix, this show delivers. Fast-paced, fun and full of surprises. It's 1 MC and 3 stand-ups that will absolutely kill it.
venue_name: Scottish Comedy Festival @ The Beehive Inn

title: 1 Missed Call
description: A missed call. A quick call back. 'I’m fine'. This one-man musical unfolds entirely through phone calls that become songs, charting one ordinary evening as the cracks begin to show. An ex who has moved on. A father he cannot impress. A friend he has drifted from. Each conversation peels back another layer of pressure, expectation and self-doubt. The music shifts as the mask slips, blending sharp humour with raw honesty. At its heart, this is a story about masculinity, silence, fatherhood and the quiet weight many men carry, even when they insist they are coping.
content_warnings: Contains distressing or potentially triggering themes

title: 1 Moment in Time
description: Back for a third consecutive year at the Edinburgh Fringe, magician and mind illusionist Sean Alexander returns with his five-star show, 1 Moment in Time. This is not a standard magic show. Through jaw-dropping illusion and sharp mind-reading, Sean explores the defining moments that shape our lives. Personal stories unfold live on stage, placing the audience at the heart of the experience. Praised as a 'must-see' (BritishTheatreGuide.info) and named 'one of the standout performances at the Fringe' (NorthWestEnd.co.uk), this acclaimed production continues to captivate audiences year after year.

title: #1 Son: The Story of Sammer's Father's Son
description: Ricky Gervais award finalist Ridwan Hussain teams up with Iraqi Sammer Elzubaidi in this brand new show. A conservative dad clashes with his son's alternative lifestyle in a stand-up comedy narrative. Observational comedy meets anti-humour, props and chaos in this sharp, heart-warming father-son show about generational divide, immigration and a shared love of stand-up. BBC New Comedy Awards shortlist, Hoots Fringe Act of the Year, Crack Comedy Comedian of the Year.

title: #1 Worst Comedian in Edinburgh
description: Join Peter as he searches for the worst comedian in Edinburgh. Comedians from around the world take the stage but the rules are upside down. The audience boos if someone’s too funny, cheers if it’s going badly and votes to decide who survives – all chasing the shameful glory of being crowned Edinburgh’s worst comedian. By the end, one act will claim the title: #1 Worst Comedian. Host: Peter Bazely: ISH Edinburgh Comedy Awards nominee for Best Newcomer 2024.
venue_name: Flight Club at Laughing Horse @ West Port Oracle

title: 100% Badgers 2: Badgers vs Hedgehogs with Matt Hobs
description: 100% Badgers 2: Badgers vs hedgehogs is a stand-up comedy show about the worlds of badgers, hedgehogs, and being one of the country's premier badger comedians. Following his critically acclaimed and sold out 2025 Edinburgh Fringe show 100% Badgers ('hilarious and heartfelt' ****½, Edinburgh-Reviews.co.uk), Matt has trained to be a badger rescuer, been asked to help in the fight for badger rights, and has had a badger move in to his garden. Matt will also address the eternal question: What are better, badgers or hedgehogs?

title: 100% Badgers with Matt Hobs
description: 100% Badgers returns to the Edinburgh Fringe after a sell-out 2025 run. This is a stand-up comedy show about how the worlds of humans and badgers collide. Matt takes us on his journey from a passing interest in badgers to an obsession that led to him standing in a field looking at a caged, frightened badger caught up in the misinformation of the bovine TB debate. 'His storytelling is gripping, his facts are fascinating and his punchlines are perfectly timed' ****½ (Edinburgh-Reviews.co.uk). 'Belly laughs' **** (BroadwayBaby.com).

title: 100% Full Blown Redacted
description: 2025 proved to be a particularly dramatic Edinburgh Fringe for Mark. His sell-out show Diddy Party was cancelled after just ten days, thanks to an online TikTok mob who hated the poster, but never actually saw the show. But like a phoenix rising from the ashes, Mark is back to set the record straight and let the people know who’s really been redacted. Expect good old-fashioned, high-powered, semi-offensive stand-up from one of the busiest comics consistently overlooked by the industry and for good reason. Mark is here to make you laugh before you think.

title: 100% Funny Feckers
description: The craic is back for a sixth sell-out year! 100% Funny Feckers is a Fringe favourite Irish stand-up showcase bringing together top comedians from Ireland and beyond. Hosted by international Irish comic Wes Dalton, this fast-paced hour delivers razor-sharp stand-up, fearless crowd work and a buzzing festival atmosphere. With a reputation for packed rooms, big laughs and unforgettable energy, it’s the perfect way to fuel your Fringe day. Whether you’re a long-time fan or discovering us for the first time, come once and you’ll understand why audiences keep coming back year after year.

title: 100 Million Fish in the Aquarium
description: A few years ago Shannon was diagnosed with OCD after a lifetime of performing ridiculous compulsions (Yes! She’s a performer!). This show is about that, amongst other things. After a very successful 2025 debut show A Horseless Rodeo, Shannon Brooke is back and she still is NOT talking about horses! 'Tonally, she walks a tightrope... absurd, honest, dark, heartfelt... and never loses her balance' (One4Review.co.uk). 'A working dichotomy between sunniness and edge' (Edinburgh Laughter Bulletin, Substack).

title: 100% Scouse Comedy
description: What's happenin' Fringe? Edinburgh's two favourite Scousers are back! Join Kyle Legacy (regular at Hot Water Comedy Club, record for most gigs at Edinburgh Fringe) and Dean Coughlin (Have a Word podcast, Chortle Hotshot of 2025) for a show where you decide what the lads talk about with nothing off-limits. It's 100% Scouse and 100% funny. You'll never laugh alone! Sold out Edinburgh Fringe 2025.

title: 100 Things You Are Overthinking – An Improv Stand-up Comedy Game Show!
description: Seventh year on the Fringe! Join our comics as they battle it out, creating comedy from any thought you have. Just write them anonymously on pieces of paper we provide and watch the comics create a set on the spot, just for you! Entry without tickets is not guaranteed, as we have regulars that religiously come back every evening for a completely different show. 'Very funny but also thought-provoking' (Scotsman).
content_warnings: Audience participation, Contains distressing or potentially triggering themes

title: 101 Comedy Club
presented_by: Ian Miller / MW Productions / Free Festival
description: 'Fast Funny' **** (ThreeWeeks). 'Picture BBC's Live at the Apollo' **** (DeadlineNews.co.uk). Since 2012 101 Comedy Club has been a Fringe favourite, and now in its 14th year, it is easy to see why audiences keep coming back. A carefully curated line-up of experienced comedians brings you some of the best stand-up comedy at the festival every single show. Whether you are a Fringe regular or a first-timer looking for a great time out, this is the show not to miss. Book a ticket to secure your seat or take your chances at the door.

title: 101 Impressions in One Hour
description: Cal Halbert is one of the UK's top all-round entertainers, and the top comedy impressionist working the UK comedy circuit. As one half of The Mimic Men, he appeared on Britain's Got Talent in 2016, receiving a standing ovation and four yeses. He has since gone on to appear on The Gadget Show, BBC, ITV and Channel 5. 'Uncanny imitations’ (Sun). 'Something for everyone' (Scotsman). 'Hard to beat' (Comedy.co.uk). 'You blew my mind' (Michael McIntyre). 'Hilarious' (Daily Mail). 'Excellent' (Daily Mirror).

title: 101 Naughty Jokes in 30 Minutes
description: Award-winning gag merchant and three-time Joke of the Fringe winner Masai Graham delivers over 100 naughty jokes in half an hour. Expect punchy puns, outstanding one-liners and wizardly wordplay in this 3.3 laughs-per-minute bonanza. 'Annoyingly good' (Gary Delaney).
content_warnings: Contains distressing or potentially triggering themes, Strong language/swearing

title: 101 Rules for a Better World (by Comedians)
description: The hit panel show and podcast returns! A surprise sell-out hit last year, host Leslie Gold (as seen at the Comedy Store) and Producer Nick welcome a roster of the finest guest comedians, tasked with proposing ideas to make the world a better place. Whether their rules are adopted is down to an audience vote. Previous guests include Mark Thomas, Alasdair Beckett-King, Bec Hill, Ignacio Lopez, Rosie Holt. You never know who’ll turn up! 'Seasoned mischief-makers ensure that even the most hare-brained rule gets a fair (and funny) trial' **** (One4Review).

title: 101 Ways to Annoy Your Parents... and Other Really Old People!
description: Title says it all! *Evil laugh*. Don’t worry, I’ll also teach the parents how to annoy their kids as well. From multi award-winning kids comedian Matty Grey. Laugh your guts out of your butthole as he brings the chaos of his mind to the Edinburgh Festival Fringe. ‘Matty Grey is the master of children’s entertainment and he knocks it out of the park’ ***** (Advertiser, Adelaide). ‘Matty Grey is loud, enthusiastic, and will (mildly) insult your children!’ ***** (PlayAndGo.com.au).

title: 11:30am Show Live with Adam Morrison Jones
description: Adam Morrison Jones has been lighting up the stand-up comedy scene for over a decade, captivating audiences with his high-energy, laugh-out-loud performances. From the charm of classic working men's clubs to the electrifying atmosphere of major rock festivals, Adam’s comedy knows no bounds. With entertainment in his blood, he delivers sharp wit and infectious energy that leave audiences craving more.

title: 11 O'Clock Comedy Cabaret: Spin the Bottle!
description: The 11 O'Clock Comedy Cabaret: Spin the Bottle! is a joyful, chaotic late-night musical comedy hosted by Briony Price - a cheeky Londoner turned New York storyteller. This interactive 50-minute game show blends big vocals, sharp comedy and real-life tales of culture shock, dating disasters and identity. The twist? The audience spins to decide the order, so every performance is different. Briony has performed at Carnegie Hall, the Royal Festival Hall, and on BBC One and HBO - but this unpredictable cabaret is her favourite place to play... Spin to win!

presented_by: Pretty Gross Productions and Jamais Vu Productions Ltd
description: No name. No memory. No identity. Where to begin? 49 has been in the room for as long as they can remember. 64 is in the room next door. They can never see each other, but the two can talk and they can pass notes. Who are they? Where are they? And why are they being watched by someone called J. Doe? 113 is a thriller that asks if memory is what makes our identity, and if we were able to see ourselves objectively, could we change?
content_warnings: Contains distressing or potentially triggering themes, Scenes of a sexual nature, Strong language/swearing

title: 116 Grams: A Play to Lose Weight
description: Gorda has a precise objective: to lose 116 grams. Each performance becomes a peculiar training session where theatre meets workout. She runs, calculates, improvises and revisits fragments of memory and theory. What begins as a physical task slowly unfolds into a performative experiment about discipline, control and the absurd demands placed on bodies – especially women's bodies. As the audience watches the body pushed to its limits, the question shifts: is she trying to lose weight or trying to understand what it means to perform? The show is part of São Paulo Showcase.
content_warnings: Contains distressing or potentially triggering themes, Nudity, Strobe lighting

title: 11pm Live at the Big Cave
description: Join the party at the iconic Big Cave for 90 minutes of electric late-night comedy, jam-packed with some of the finest acts at the Fringe, with surprise guests at every show. No two shows the same, but each presenting a mix of TV names, Netflix stars, festival veterans and social media superstars at this unmissable showcase of the very best in stand-up talent, against the backdrop of one of Edinburgh's most beloved and unique spaces: The Big Cave. End your day at the Fringe in fits of laughter!
venue_name: Just The Tonic at The Caves

title: 123movies.com
description: A chaotic, chronically online, sketch comedy version of the Oscars. You'll meet all the usual award ceremony characters – hosts, winners, fashion correspondents and Stephen Graham. We explore this year's best documentaries, celebrate the celebrities we lost in 2025 (and predict those we'll lose in 2026) and even enjoy some lovely adverts. A statement on behalf of Chuck'n'Jeck: Whilst surprised, Chuck'n'Jeck are honoured to have been asked to host this year's Oscars. Please respect our privacy at this time whilst we learn, listen and digest this information and listen and learn with our families. x

title: 12th Annual Haters' Ball
description: Winner of the 2026 Chortle Award for Best Format Show at the Edinburgh Fringe. The Haters' Ball returns for its 12th riotous year, pitting four comedians head to head in a battle of wits, ruthlessly roasting whatever the audience throws their way. From A-list celebrities, breaking news, to the poor souls in the audience... nothing is sacred. You name it, we roast it. International sell-out from Perth Fringe to London's Top Secret Comedy Club, and rumoured favourite of Gerard Butler, no two shows are ever the same.

title: 14th Year! John Hunt Four O'Clock Afternoon Blues and Swing
description: 'Fantastic!' (Jools Holland). 'Boogie-woogie slide-guitar master' **** (Scotsman). 'The Fringe's most unique, inventive and soulful blues performer, a fantastic gig' **** (BroadwayBaby.com). Hunt's 14th Fringe following thirteen years of full-house performances. 'Blues legend built his own cannibalised recycled guitars from a B&Q shelf and papier-mâché' **** (Herald). 'Instantly evocative of the deep south blues. Unique R&B take on Sinatra alongside a James Bond mash-up. Whatever Hunt plays, it feels refreshingly authentic' **** (List). 'Ingenious 21st-century blues' **** (ThreeWeeks). 'A storming set. Like Seasick Steve in a science lab' (Ian Rankin).

title: 15 Minutes of Shame
description: Plunge into the desperate world of a young London couple facing the brutal reality of financial struggle. Tired of watching others’ curated success online and frustrated by their own limited social media reach, they decide to chase the elusive dream of fame and fortune by launching an OnlyFans account. But as subscribers grow, their connection in reality drops. Balancing biting comedy with raw drama, this provocative and unflinching mirror to our times tracks the high costs of monetising intimacy.
content_warnings: Contains distressing or potentially triggering themes, Scenes of a sexual nature, Strong language/swearing

title: 162nd Edinburgh International Photography Exhibition 2026
description: Edinburgh Photographic Society is delighted to present their prestigious annual print exhibition. The very best photographic prints are selected from thousands received from around the world. Celebrating creativity, technique and vision, we showcase every genre from documentary to abstract with portraits, street photography, creative art, nature and landscapes. Entry fee includes another two exhibitions and a printed catalogue. Our premises are a beautiful Georgian townhouse in the New Town which is a 20 minute walk from High Street or a 10-minute bus ride.
content_warnings: Audience will be standing throughout, Some photographs may contain 'art nude' content.Open from 10:00 to 17:00. Last entry at 16:00 to give enough time to see all exhibitions.

title: 18+ Magic – The Magic Show Your Mum Shouldn't See
description: After a completely sold-out debut run, Ivor Harden is back at the Edinburgh Fringe with the X-rated magic show your mum definitely should not see. Expect jaw-dropping illusions, graphic adult comedy and a dangerously inappropriate German magician who still thinks it is 1979. Nothing is sacred. Not relationships. Not religion. Not you. If you are easily offended and like to complain, then don't f*cking cum. You have been warned! If you like your magic filthy, fearless and wildly funny, welcome to 18+ Magic.
content_warnings: Audience participation, Nudity, Scenes of a sexual nature, Strong language/swearing

title: 1918: The Final Salomé
description: London, 1918. When wartime hysteria pillories Oscar Wilde's Salomé for corrupting the nation with homosexuality, Robert Ross – the late author’s literary executor, devoted friend, and "first boy" (or so he believes) – is once again made to defend the legacy he sacrificed his life to protect. As courtroom circus shatters the memories he has spent decades curating, the line between devotion and delusion begins to blur. This is a story about saints who are canonised by love and fools who sacrificed themselves for it. Oxford New Writing Festival runner-up: Best Play.
content_warnings: Contains distressing or potentially triggering themes, Scenes of a sexual nature, Strong language/swearing, References to Victorian homophobia, misogyny, war, death, bereavement, grooming, mental illness and unhealthy relationships.

title: 1954: Ella, Etta, Eartha
description: Official Fringe sell-out 2024 and 2025. It's the year 1954. Ella Fitzgerald, Etta James and Eartha Kitt are at the dizzy heights of their careers. With swinging jazz, powerful soul and cheeky kitsch, these women broke new ground for all who followed. Award-winning singer/actor Melissa Western and her musicians pay tribute to this magnificent era in music and inspiring trio of pioneering singers. 50s style abounds. 'Western is a force of nature... Great storyteller, feisty, highly enjoyable' ***** (BroadwayBaby.com). 'Absolutely brilliant... Her aptitude for music is vast and versatile' ***** (ThreeWeeks). 'Oozes with charisma' ***** (Edinburgh-Reviews.co.uk).

title: 199 Jokes Before Lunchtime: Danny Matinee!
description: Sell-out show, Edinburgh Fringe 2025! As featured in The Times and Telegraph Best Jokes of Edinburgh Fringe 2025! An insect joke? Tick. A tartan joke? Check. Join Danny Matinee for at least another 197 one-liners including props, pictures, 'guess the punchline', bonus jokes and more. Includes a farmer joke that's corny, and an optician joke that's cornea. Suitable for all ages and for fans of Olaf Falafel, Masai Graham, Milton Jones, Mark Simmons and Tim Vine. 'Finely crafted... slick wordplay... near-faultless timing' ***** (TheEdinburghReporter.co.uk). 'A brilliant way to set up your day' ***** (UKTW.co.uk).

title: 2%: A Play About Privilege (And Also, Milk)
description: What does milk have to do with growing up privileged and Asian in America? In his Edinburgh Fringe debut, Kevin Qian shares stories about tasting flesh, private schools, and how his family’s love language is primarily milk. You'll meet the voices in his head and watch him drink so much milk.
content_warnings: Contains distressing or potentially triggering themes

title: 2 Dad, or Not 2 Dad
description: 2 Dad, Or Not 2 Dad connects childhood pain to parenting chaos. At just eight, his father left. Now, a dad himself, Jim Bob finally gets it in the funniest way possible! Looking back at childhood confusion, Father's Day dread and learning life lessons from late-night TV instead of "the talk". Fast forward to the present, with his own child he's facing food battles, bedtime hostage negotiations and the realisation that parenting is HARD!

title: 2 for the Price of Song
description: Two Edinburgh-based singer-songwriters combine intricate guitar-playing with soulful harmonies in music drawing on pop, folk, blues, rock, jazz and soul. Their Fringe show debuted to exclusively five-star audience reviews in 2025: 'Great banter with the audience and the show was just incredible...coming together in a way that leaves you wishing you had another hour or two more'. 'Exceptionally talented singer-songwriters... engaging banter, clever lyrics, and standout collaborative pieces made their performance the best thing I saw at the Fringe'. 'My favourite show at the Fringe. Authentic, talented and fun with wonderful original songs'.

title: 2 Guys, 3 Drams: The Ultimate Live Blues and Whisky Experience
description: 2022, 2023 and 2024 Fringe sell-out show. Join duo The Rhythm and Booze Project as they play some stomping blues music and serve you three superb Scotch whiskies. In a whirlwind hour, get ready to learn how to sound clever about whisky, appreciate top-quality drams and enjoy some raucous tunes. 'A truly brilliant show' (EdinburghLive.co.uk). 'If you like blues and you like whisky then you’ve got to see this show' **** (BroadwayBaby.com). 'This provided the most euphoric experience I have ever had at the Fringe' ***** (MumbleMusic.net).

title: 2 Muslim 2 Furious 3: Sharia? I Hardly Know Her!
presented_by: 2 Muslim 2 Furious (Aisha Amanduri and Hasan Al-Habib)
description: Tired of being called terrorists, Aisha and Hasan became something worse: comedians! After back-to-back sell-out runs, featuring on STV News and BBC R4, and raising over £8000 for Medical Aid for Palestinians, the Islamic double-act return with a brand-new show! Join Aisha Amanduri and Hasan Al-Habib for gameshows, leaked footage of their Riyadh Comedy Festival audition and answering the question: did the Queen REALLY convert to Islam on her deathbed?! 10% of all proceeds donated to Medical Aid for Palestinians. 'Slick delivery with stereotype-crushing material' (Rolling Stone). 'Deliciously funny' (Guardian).
content_warnings: Audience participation, Contains distressing or potentially triggering themes, Strong language/swearing

title: 2 Queers in Tears?
description: A fast-paced, funny and tender two-hander following queer drama school students navigating identity, friendship, cultural wounds and the journey to becoming their authentic selves. Set inside the heightened, performative world of drama school, where everyone is acting even when they’re trying not to. As Billy and Elliot stumble through relationships, therapy, family trauma and their own defences, the play explores what happens when you stop performing for approval and start telling the truth. It’s a love story about chosen family, the masks we wear to survive and the courage it takes to finally take them off.
content_warnings: Contains distressing or potentially triggering themes, Scenes of a sexual nature, Strong language/swearing, Buy a ticket in advance to guarantee entry or Pay What You Want at the venue

title: 2 Slut Drops and a Chicken Burger
description: Kirsty overshares about her sexy times, nights out, and magnificent meltdowns. 'She created an atmosphere where everyone let loose and enjoyed the wild ride. Munro's candid storytelling had everyone in stitches' ***** (BroadwayBaby.com). 'Loveable, loud and bloody hilarious' (TheFunnyFirm.co.uk). As seen on BBC Scotland's Situationships. Someantics Comedy Slam finalist 2023.

title: 2 Truths, 1 Lie
description: Funny, but is it true? Three headline comedians step on stage. Two are telling the truth, one is a big fat liar. Can you tell who...? The award-winning interactive comedy compilation sell-out show returns to an air-conditioned venue on the Grassmarket! The perfect show for fans of BBC's Would I Lie To You? Total sell-out 2023, 2024 and 2025, so book early! Over 2 million views on social media this year!

title: 2 Wongs and a White
description: Get ready to laugh with 2 Wongs and A White: a stand-up comedy show featuring Australia's funniest comedians. Each night, He Huang, Nick Schuller and a mystery guest bring you the best of Australian humour. They've been on TV, toured internationally, sold out festival runs and written for telly.

title: 200 Puns in 1 Hour with Roger Swift
description: The twice sold-out show returns. The comedic prop pun lunatic, Roger Swift shoots out his updated infamous 200 puns in one hour! So come and enjoy more of his trademark crazy homemade props, audio cues and PowerPoint slides. Expect corny jokes and silliness with no theme besides wordplay and some new material. Do not expect someone taking himself seriously. Dave's Joke of the Fringe list 2016, 2023 and 2024.

title: 2026 and the Shit Hits the Fan for Vladimir McTavish
description: A world on life support. A man on borrowed time. A scathing attack on global politics. Greenland under threat, climate change rampant, war in the Middle East, the rise of Reform UK. 2026 started badly for the planet. And for Scottish Comedy Award-winner McTavish. A camera stuck up his nose led to three months of chemotherapy. But there’s more to the story. Relax, this is not another  f*cking show about cancer. Sell-out 2021, 2022, 2023, 2025. 'A comedian very much in his prime' **** (OnTheMic.co.uk).

title: (2026 Greek Comedian of the Year) George Zacharopoulos: The Meaning of Life (Maybe)
description: 'George remains of the best comedians you'll see at the Fringe' ***** (TheQR.co.uk). Masterful storytelling, Jim Jefferies' support. Best International Comedian: Comic's Lounge Melbourne, Comedy Festival Season 2023. Best European Performer 2024: European Comedy Awards. Best Comedian, Laugh Mob Laughies 2026. In 2025, George was nailing life. He performed to 12,000 at London's O2 Arena, got engaged and toured seven countries. Then it all went sh*t. How does joy and optimism survive when your world collapses?
content_warnings: Scenes of a sexual nature, Strong language/swearing, Buy a ticket in advance to guarantee entry or Pay What You Want at the venue.
venue_name: Just The Tonic at The Hive

title: 2026 Pick of the Fringe
description: Hoots Comedy official Pick of the Fringe showcase returns for 2026 with another hand-picked selection of our favourite acts from across the Fringe. We present an ever-changing lineup of some of the best comics the Fringe has to offer, all crammed into one amazing show. 'A must–see for Scottish comedy lovers' **** (BroadwayBaby.com). 'Rick Molland is perfect for the role of compere' (ThreeWeeks). 'Stand-out stand-up' (Rip It Up). Perth Fringe Comedy Award nominated.
space_name: Nic 2 (The Main Hall, Nicolson Square Venues)

title: 2026 Scottish Comedy Festival's Pick of the Fringe
description: SCF's official Pick of the Fringe showcase returns for a 14th hilarious year with another hand-picked selection of our favorite acts from across the Fringe. Rick Molland, resident compere of Edinburgh’s late-night Comedy Attic, presents an ever-changing line-up of some of the best comics the Fringe has to offer, all crammed into one amazing show. 'A must–see for Scottish comedy lovers' **** (BroadwayBaby.com). 'Rick Molland is perfect for the role of compere' (ThreeWeeks). 'Stand-out stand-up' (Rip It Up). Perth Fringe Comedy Award nominee. This show sells out, grab your tickets now.

title: 27 Club
description: Winner of the Best Music Award at Adelaide Fringe and featuring music and lore from Joplin, Winehouse, Cobain, Morrison and Hendrix, this must-see live rockumentary will get you praying to the rock gods for more. Saluting the members of the 27 Club are some of Australia's top rock icons and musicians. Come as you are to this 'electrifying and magnetic' (GlamAdelaide.com.au) celebration of the legends who will forever be 27 and their legacy left behind. 'I have never been more entertained' ***** (InDaily.com.au). 'Nothing short of mesmerising' ***** (Radio Adelaide).

title: 28.06.1980 (or How A Fake Version of Deep Purple Brought Rock Music to Mexico)
description: Riots! Chaos! Karate! Based on an unbelievable true story of five musicians pretending to be Deep Purple.
venue_name: PBH's Free Fringe @ Slow Progress Cafe and Records

title: 2FLAMENCO
description: A unique and unforgettable Flamenco experience. After three years of fantastic reception, Jara Perez and Danielo Olivera return with a fresh reinvention of their acclaimed show – preserving its essence of passion, fun and love for the art. Edinburgh Fringe regulars, they present an intimate journey through Flamenco’s origins and future, blending powerful dance, soulful singing and masterful guitar. With elegance, humour and spontaneous complicity, this uplifting and highly entertaining performance guarantees an inspiring celebration of Flamenco. Produced by TuFlamenco, expect a great night where you’ll get transported by their Duende straight away to Cadiz, in Andalucia, y Ole!

title: 2ShoulderPads: Galaxy Train
description: Sold out for its entire run at the Edinburgh Fringe 2025. Winner of the Spirit of the Fringe Award. A poetic musical inspired by Japanese classical literature. The male performers wear only two shoulder pads as their costume – playful, never sexual. What begins as laughter at wriggling bottoms soon releases the audience's imagination, revealing countless costumes and worlds. By the final scene, many are moved to tears. Overflowing with the joy and power of theatre, it explores life and death, parting, and human connection through humour, songs and Kabuki-inspired physical expression.

title: 3.2.1. Hold Me on Stage
description: Hello, I’m Daphne Bell. From my left profile I’m shy; from my right, I’m remarkable. I can sing – sometimes I even feel like a soprano. I’ve been trapped inside a claw machine for a long time; perhaps I wanted it, too. From behind the glass, I wait to be chosen, to be noticed, to be valued. Would you choose me? I think I need to hold me on stage. This play portrays Daphne’s struggle with invisibility and inadequacy as she seeks recognition. Social pressure and past traumas become her greatest obstacles.
content_warnings: Contains distressing or potentially triggering themes

title: 3 out of 4 Twats
description: 3 out of 4 Twats are a dynamic collective who have had sell-out shows at GICF and Edinburgh Fringe since 2022. Led by Backbone Comedy’s Jimi Longmuir, the full run at West Port Oracle in 2026 will see the return of many favourite acts. Each show will contain Jimi as the host and three acts specific to that evening. Expect a healthy variety of voices, styles and backgrounds with an ability to make audiences laugh as the one common denominator. Our philosophy is to unite people of all backgrounds and cultures in daftness and laughter!
venue_name: Flight Club at Laughing Horse @ West Port Oracle

title: 3 Times I Killed
description: Ever faced impossible odds? Stomach in knots? Needing a miracle? Well, New York attorney Andrea Coleman has. Then she gets Divine communication (yay!) that somehow makes things scarier (no!). As she debates whether to trust these otherworldly instructions or protect her professional image, the courtroom becomes a playground for resilience, identity and digestive distress. Blending courtroom drama and humour, this show celebrates the joy and absurdity of being alive. At its heart, the play asks what happens when you push your fear to the side and let yourself be a "killer".

title: 33 Years Single
description: As seen on Britain's Got Talent! Australia’s most eligible bachelor Daniel Delby had his first girlfriend at 33... for six weeks. Come and see his awkward dating history turned into a night of non-stop laughter, relatable storytelling and need to see it to believe it improv freestyle songs. From brutal rejections to learning how to translate girlfriend speak, Delby shares the highs, lows and ridiculous in-betweens of love, dating and everything that went wrong. Fringe World Comedy Award Winner. 'Side-splitting genius, Jim Jefferies protégé' ***** (Fringefeed.com.au, 2025).

title: 360 ALLSTARS
description: Sold out on Broadway! Sold out at the Sydney Opera House! Seen by over 2 million people worldwide! BMX, basketball, breakdancing, beatboxing, acrobatics, drumming and more, 360 ALLSTARS connects the street with the elite to deliver a supercharged urban circus. Boasting a stellar cast of world champion and world record-holding artists and athletes, the international smash hit returns to Edinburgh as part of its 2026 world tour! 'Blindingly talented' ***** (BroadwayBaby.com). 'Destined to be a sell-out' ***** (TV Bomb). 'The most thrilling stage show ever' ***** (WeekendNotes.co.uk)

title: 4 Antipodeans Walk into a Bar
description: In true Australasian style, this show does exactly what it says on the tin: one microphone, one stage and four stand-ups from either side of the Tasman Sea. New Zealand Comedy Award Winner Sully O'Sullivan hosts a hand-picked, ever-changing lineup of some of the best comedic talent from the other end of the planet. 'Kiwi Sully O'Sullivan is our hilarious host' (ThreeWeeks) 'His timing and wit were impeccable!' (AustralianTimes.co.uk). *The producers of 4 Antipodeans Walk into a Bar are not liable for any Home Office raids that will probably take place.
venue_name: Scottish Comedy Festival @ The Beehive Inn

title: 4 Aussies, For Aussies
description: ... or anyone who thinks Aussies are funny. Every year, a ship-load of Aussie comedians make the pilgrimage over to the Edinburgh Festival Fringe to entice audiences into their shows. Here's your chance to see a snippet of some of the best. We'll tell you the truth behind drop-bears, convince you that Raygun really was just a practical joke and feed you a jar full of Vegemite. Unless you are Aussie. Then, you get it.

title: 4 Backpackers, For Backpackers
description: ... or anyone who has ever got mashed-up overseas. Have you ever been backpacking and made a weird friend? Or got drunk and lost your phone? Or got into trouble with the police and been deported? There's definitely levels to the madness when travelling the world on a shoe-string budget. Some of the best comedians from around the Fringe share their most unhinged travel stories. If you've got a more bizarre story, I'll buy you a beer.

title: 4 Teachers, For Teachers
description:
... or parents, or anyone who has ever been a student. Ever wondered what teachers get up to outside of school? Or what goes on in the staff room? Or what they really think of the students? Comedian and teacher Ty Gray is collecting the funniest teachers from around the Fringe to present stories and jokes from the classroom and beyond. Each show, he will be joined by a rotating cast of teacher-comedians! 
Sold out Edinburgh Fringe 2025. 'Happy to say what other teachers would only dare think in private.' 9/10 (XPressMag.com.au).

An inspiring and moving celebration of Katherina Radeva's 40 years as a woman, a migrant and an artist. Claiming space on a dance floor, she dances with joyous abundance and presents stories of her past, present and future. From the little girl dancing at her parents' student parties, to the teenage rhythm gymnast who was body-shamed, to the creative who refuses to be categorised we see a choreography of all the joys and sorrows of 40 years. Radeva is an irresistible performer whose authenticity and generosity shines in this life-affirming piece from award-winning Two Destination Language. MadeInScotlandShowcase.com

title: 48 Chicken Nuggets in a Sequin Dress
description: As he stares into hydrogenated, ultra-processed, non-brand-specific meat products bubbling away in a deep fat fryer for below minimum wage, award-winning comedian and runt-of-the-litter Charlie Ashton feels we’ve lost our way. For millennia, humanity lived in perfect harmony with nature, living in mud huts, taking mushrooms, squirming over each other in the filth. Then somewhere along the way some idiot put on a suit and ruined everything. A cathartic experience for anyone dreading Monday morning and Tuesday morning and Wednesday and every day until we die because they’ve upped retirement age to 120.

title: 5 Comedians Do Comedy and Karaoke
description: Do you like comedy? Do you like karaoke? If yes to both, then this is the show for you. Five comedians do their short comedy set followed by their favourite karaoke song. Feel free to sing along!

title: 5 Dates with Italian Jazz Affair
description: Iconic Italian and American classics burst to life with fiery rhythms, velvet melodies, and a story behind every song. Morricone’s magic, Mina’s fire, Sinatra’s swagger and much more – ignited with passion and drama. Born in Milan, based in Edinburgh – Anna Vanosi returns with her 2025 hit show, leading her trio with irresistible charm and bringing new stories and songs to life. 'Vanosi’s voice is nectar' (NorthWestEnd.com). 'Eccentric, adorable, enchanting: a real-life Italian diva' **** (BroadwayBaby.com). A heart-stealing audience favourite at Edinburgh’s top jazz venue.

title: 5 Headliners for £10
description: The smash hit sell-out 2023-2025 show returns! Five top-level circuit comedians perform their very best material, one after the other. No picking on the audience, no MC in between asking you where you're from – just non-stop laughs from headline-level comedy circuit professionals who know exactly how to bring the funny! There is still no better value-for-money way to spend £10 at the Fringe, so find out for yourself why 5 Headliners for £10 is on Fringe-goers must-see list year after year. Extra shows added due to popular demand, so early booking recommended.
content_warnings: Strong language/swearing. Patrons are allocated seats from the front of the venue with no gaps. Any accessibility requirements needing alternative seating arrangements, please alert the venue staff in good time before the start of the show.

title: 5 Lesbians Eating A Quiche
description: It's 1956 and The Susan B Anthony Society for the Sisters of Gertrude Stein is having their annual quiche breakfast. As the widows await the announcement of the society's prize-winning quiche, the atomic bomb sirens sound! Has the Communist threat come to pass? How will the widows respond as their idyllic town and lifestyle faces attacks? Secrets come out as they wrestle with hysteria, survival and a fate worse than death: a world without quiche! 2024 NJACT Perry Award-winner for Best Play. Written by Evan Linder and Andrew Hobgood. Featuring UK Olympian Sinead Kerr.

title: 5 Mistakes That Changed History
description: We all make mistakes, but rarely do they change the course of history. After sell-out seasons in 2023, 2024 and 2025, the smash-hit historical storytelling show by comedian and historian Paul Coulter returns with a new show about five people and how their mistakes (big and small!) changed the world. Penguin Random House published the best-selling book 10 Mistakes That Changed History based on the show in 2025. If you love history, don't let your mistake be missing out on this show! One of British Comedy Guide's best-reviewed shows. ***** (TheatreWeekly.com). ***** (BroadwayWorld.com). ***** (TheEdinburghReporter.co.uk).
content_warnings: Babes in Arms: Babies are not allowed in the venue - Children under 18 months

title: 5 Nights of Valery Ponomarev: The Jazz Messenger
description: An unmissable, exclusive performance from legendary Russian-American trumpeter and Jazz Messengers alumnus, Valery Ponomarev, who dramatically escaped 1970s USSR and toured the world with Art Blakey and The Jazz Messengers for four years, recording 11 albums! Joined by an all-star international band, this elite quintet celebrates one of jazz’s most influential institutions, recreating their timeless music once more for the 33rd year. This is the jazz event of the Fringe!

title: 55 Minutes of Adequately Amusing Jokes And Stories From An Irishman Who Recently Turned 67
description: Fifty-five minutes of adequately amusing jokes and stories from an Irishman who recently turned 67. Does what it says on the tin.
venue_name: PBH's Free Fringe @ BrewDog Lothian Rd

title: 5k Edinburgh Running Tour
description: Discover Edinburgh on the move - before the city awakes! Our expert-led running tours combine fitness with storytelling, guiding you around the city’s most iconic sights at a sociable pace. The perfect morning ritual to kickstart your festival experience!
content_warnings: Participants must have a basic level of fitness. The tour will be carried out at a sociable pace, but participants must be capable of running 5k in distance. Children under the age of 16 years must be accompanied by a parent/guardian during the tour.

title: 6-Minute NERDx Talks by Comedians
presented_by: David Benaim and Scott Redmond / Free Festival
description: Comedians deliver micro-presentations with a twist. Each PowerPoint has exactly 18 slides, and each slide advances automatically after 20 seconds. Every day, a fresh lineup gives talks on science, history, tapirs or whatever else their nerdy passion may be. Expect neurotransmitters, war heroes and Pokémon. The final talk is a mystery slideshow, where comedians improvise as "experts" (heavy quotation marks) on slides that they have never seen before. Follow on Instagram for updates on each day's topics and speakers. ‘Never before will you have learnt so much from a comedy show’ (TheMagdalen.com).

title: 70s Jukebox by The 60 Four
description: Australia's best tribute act, The 60 Four, make their Edinburgh debut with the ultimate 70s party. Dazzlingly popular on cruise ships around the world, this crowd-favourite show is a high-octane celebration of the decade that defined cool. From disco floor-fillers to rock anthems that ruled the airwaves, 70s Jukebox delivers wall-to-wall hits by The Bee Gees, ABBA, Queen, Fleetwood Mac, Rod Stewart, The Beatles, Leo Sayer and more. Powered by powerhouse vocals, slick choreography and full Las Vegas energy, it's a sing-along, dance-floor-ready celebration. Get ready for the party of the decade – reborn.

title: 8 Ways to Break a Glass (with an American Opera Singer)
description: Back by demand! American soprano Steph DePrez smashes expectations about opera with a riotous blend of Puccini and punchlines. It's an introduction to the fundamentals of opera with Berlin, boobs and Beethoven. Steph shares stories of auditions, corporate day jobs, online dating and being a Valkyrie... all delivered with the intimacy and excitement of a night out with friends. This show's 2025 run had a sold-out final week. 'A masterclass in blending genres' (BroadwayBaby.com). 'Immensely talented. She blends fast-paced comedy smoothly with a great selection of songs' (BroadwayWorld.com).

title: 9/11 Birds and the Bees
description: Where were you on 9/11? Sitting in school? Sitting on the toilet? Nowhere of note? Well, Sofia May was running – for her life – from the dust cloud and debris as the World Trade Center toppled next to her school in downtown Manhattan. Now, as an adult, she's processed a lot of that trauma, continues to grieve and is ready to get hilarious. In this award-winning, critically acclaimed stand-up solo hour, Sofia May takes the audience on a gruesome comedic journey of her experience as a tween survivor of history's most outrageous terrorist attack.
content_warnings: Contains distressing or potentially triggering themes, Strong language/swearing
venue_name: Flight Club at Laughing Horse @ West Port Oracle

title: 90s Magic Throwback
description: A feel good magic show about growing up in the 90s with VHS tapes, dial up internet and questionable fashion choices. Expect laughs, surprises and a few magical nostalgic throwbacks.
content_warnings: Audience participation, Buy a ticket in advance to guarantee entry or Pay What You Want at the venue

title: A Better Memory
description: Eleanor switches on an AI replica of her late husband for comfort, only to discover memories that don’t match her own. Mia is young, disillusioned with dating men and in love with an AI chatbot. When secrets surface and the past begins to unravel, both women are forced to question what they thought they knew. Lubna Kerr returns to the Fringe with an electrifying new play featuring a dynamic cast, after her five-star Tickbox trilogy, ***** (LondonTheatre.co.uk). A heartfelt, darkly comic exploration of memory, forgiveness and the human experience. ‘Warm and witty performer’ (Guardian).

title: A Brief History of Northumbria (WIP)
description: In this hour, award-winning comedian and North East history buff Raul Kohli attempts to summarize 10,000 years of Northumbrian history in 45 minutes, while arguing the case that the North East of England is one of the most historically underrated regions in the entire world. ***** (Guardian). 'Beautifully written and achingly funny' (AYoungishPerspective.co.uk). ISH Edinburgh Fringe Best Show Nominee 2025. Best Show Nominee – Leicester Comedy Festival 2024. As seen on Tyne Travel, The Adopted Geordies Podcast and We Are Newcastle United.

title: A Bunch of Characters – Hugo Hayes
description: Hugo has some new characters he wants to show you. With over 30 million views online and tens of thousands of followers, can he do it IRL? Come and find out. Featured in Chortle.co.uk's Edinburgh Fringe 10x10 Sketch Shows to watch 2025.

title: A Case for Magic: For Lovers of Magic and Their Ambivalent Friends
description: Upon overhearing: hey, a magician, the lowest form of entertainment, award-winning magician Robert Malissa took the insult as a challenge. Now, he’s pushing back. He will lie, cheat and charm his way into your heart with original sleight of hand and mentalism. Watch as he seamlessly transforms into Mindelagosi, the world's greatest fake psychic, a carnival conman and a slippery card shark while making the case for the art of deception. Malissa proves that being lied to has never been so much fun. 'A solidly joyful evening' (facebook.com/theatreiseasy).

title: A Cat in a Box
description: A deeply personal solo play that tells a story everyone can relate to. Through darkly humorous and dramatic monologues, Tom explores love, loss and hope growing up in an alcoholic, dysfunctional family, showing how trauma shapes our lives. Offering that no matter how dark the past, the present holds the possibility of light. 'Nemec avoids all of the flaws of the genre that make autobiographical solo plays cringeworthy' (Showtones.com). 'For a moment, we were united in our collective experience, and in our resolve to heal' (ArtsIndependent.com).

title: A Chorus Line
description: At a high-stakes Broadway audition, a director compels dancers to reveal the stories behind their steps. As love, loss and ambition surface, the finale forces each to choose between standing out or disappearing into the chorus. Friendship sparks, rivalries simmer, exposing fragile humanity behind each polished routine, turning the audition into raw, electric and deeply personal experiences. Edinburgh Little Theatre bring this legendary production to life as they dance for their lives and livelihoods. A great cast brings the best out of the script and confronts the audience with truth and stark choices.
venue_name: Grand Hall at Braw Venues @ Grand Lodge

title: A Clean Comedy Show
description: Full of laughs, free from swears. This is sharp, joke-heavy stand-up that's suitable for all. Back after a triumphant, sold-out run in 2025, Clean Comedy shows off some of the festival’s funniest feel-good gags. Callum Mackenzie and featured guests present an hour of non-stop laughs that you can listen to while sitting next to your nan.

title: A Clown's Lullaby
description: Tired of the news? Need a break? Become a clown! Just like SHE did. And SHE feels so much better now that everything is so silly... Until she gets a call from her clown friend Loo Krayina – Mr Bellicose has been mean to Loo again! Now SHE needs to find some playmates to help her cheer Loo up. Can SHE count on you? From the makers of The Rotting Hart: 'A staggering show' ***** (StarburstMagazine.com), 'Powerfully rich storytelling' ***** (BingeFringe.com), Fringe Sell-out Show 2023. Recommended for clowns aged 5 to 99.

title: A Comedian's Drinking Game
description: Four comedians try and make you laugh, but every time they fail, they have to do a shot of vodka! The sets usually start well, but four shots in five minutes mean they end all over the place! Come see the show regularly described at the Adelaide Fringe Festival as the most unhinged show at the Fringe! Either you laugh, or you watch an alcohol infused breakdown! 'Riotous' (EdFestMag.com). 'The audience laughed their socks off' (OnTheMic.co.uk). 'The worst comedy I have ever seen' (Audience Review).

title: A Comedy Magic Show for Kids
presented_by: Raul Kohli and Thomas De Bernede
description: Raul Kohli and Thomas De Bernede return with a brand-new family show that blends stand-up for kids, (playing the fool while educating them about the world and enquiring about all their favourites – Peppa Pig, Paw Patrol etc), bringing silliness and jaw-dropping magic into one brilliantly fun hour for kids and their grown-ups. Thomas has spent the past year refining his magic in Tokyo, while Raul has been doing kids shows in Australia. Now they return to Edinburgh! ***** (Guardian). 'The funniest member of our family except me' (Raul's nephew).

title: A Comedy World Cup
description: This World Cup year we are bringing you a revolving door of the Fringe's best comedians ready to represent their country in a tournament of laughs! Stand-ups go head to head in a comedic penalty shootout. Best part is, you get to decide who's funniest and who takes home the cup, so come and have a Messi night with us. Hosted and refereed by Kyle Legacy and Dean Coughlin. Sold Out Fringe shows 2025! From the lads that brought you An Aussie, African and Englishman Walk Into a Bar... (Sold Out Fringe 2022-24).

title: A Complete Idiot's Guide to New Zealand
description: In this insider’s guide to his eccentric homeland, award-winning comedian Sully O’Sullivan answers all the questions about New Zealand you never knew to ask… Why’d we almost change our national flag to a bird with lasers for eyes? Are kiwifruit just Chinese gooseberries in disguise? And where actually is New Zealand? Given we get left off so many maps. Find answers to these questions and more in an hour of 'quintessentially Kiwi comedy' (NZ Herald).  'Will have you laughing out loud' (VoiceMag.uk). ‘Outrageously funny’ ***** (One4Review.co.uk). ‘A huge comedic talent’ ***** (EdfringeReview.com).

title: A Dark Line Upstairs
description: Italy, autumn 1951. Heavy flooding causes the Po River to burst its banks, turning the Polesine area into a huge lake. People flee with no time to choose what to take with them, they flee so they can return, they return so they can start over. Autumn 2021. A woman is moving house for the umpteenth time. Searching through the rooms she decides to take EVERYTHING with her. Two tragedies intertwine in this monologue about deliberate and unintentional uprooting and the big and small events that change our lives, asking: could we ever really lose everything?

title: A Date with the Everly Brothers
description: Get ready for a musical journey back in time! Following a successful run at the Fringe in 2025, the boys are back with an evening of beautiful harmonies and acoustic music, featuring the greatest hits of the iconic duo. From Bye Bye Love to Cathy's Clown, A Date with the Everly Brothers brings the magic of the Everlys to life. Dive into the nostalgia and join us for this unforgettable tribute. Audience reviews: 'Brilliant – we loved every moment!', 'Fantastic show, wonderful harmonies – they did the Everly Brothers and themselves proud.'

title: A Desperate Remedy
description: May 1606. In the Tower of London, Father Henry Garnet awaits a traitor’s death in the morning. Through his last confession, we follow the Gunpowder Plotters’ doomed conspiracy as Garnet wrestles with his own conscience and the indefatigable will of charismatic ringleader Robert Catesby. As Catesby recruits a group of desperate men, including the enigmatic soldier Guy Fawkes, we are led to question just how far a man will go for his friends and his faith. This exciting new play offers an intense, fast-paced and moving portrayal of one of the most infamous events in our history.
content_warnings: Scenes of violence, Contains distressing or potentially triggering themes

title: A Different Kind of Heartbreak
description: A one-woman show that is hard to put into boxes. Athanasia Kontou, an award-winning composer, singer/songwriter and rising star in stand-up comedy, combines her diverse skills to tell the personal story of a life-changing heart surgery, with authenticity, wit and of course, humour. Things will get very personal as Athanasia will play music to accompany recordings of her diary entries, sing songs about being in pain and tell jokes about suffering from anxiety. Eventually this is a show about embracing the vulnerability all humans share and finding strength in it.
content_warnings: Contains distressing or potentially triggering themes, Buy a ticket in advance to guarantee entry or Pay What You Want at the venue.
venue_name: Just The Tonic at The Mash House

title: A Forgotten Woman: Mrs Oscar Wilde
description: Constance Lloyd is rarely remembered in literary history, overshadowed by her infamous husband. Feminist, writer and mother, her life is told through letter excerpts written in her own hand, revealing wit to rival Oscar’s, with dry humour and fierce selfhood. From a troubled childhood to society womanhood and quiet tragedy, this intimate solo performance restores a voice history diminished, inviting audiences to root for a brilliant, resilient heroine. Her story unfolds with grace, courage, humour and defiance. ‘Engaging... fascinating... flawless’ ***** (Open Door). ‘Gut-writhingly convincing’ **** (TheReviewsHub,com). ‘Wolfe excels’ **** (Fringe Guru).

title: A Ghost Among the Living
description: There are some secrets which refuse to remain hidden... Enter the uncanny world of Edgar Allan Poe, where reason spirals into madness and guilt has a heartbeat of its own. Critically acclaimed Box Tale Soup, creators of 2025 Fringe hit 1984, present five terrifying tales from the master of the macabre. An unknown scholar takes the stage to honour Poe's darkest masterpieces... but lines blur, and stories twist into a dangerous confession. Step closer, if you dare... 'Frightening' ***** (BritishTheatreGuide.info). 'Superb' ***** (BroadwayBaby.com). 'Astonishing' ***** (StarburstMagazine.com).
content_warnings: This show contains dark themes including the supernatural, murder, resurrection, being buried alive, and use of alcohol/opium.

title: A Good Time Charlie
description: Ciaran Franco grew up wanting to be the lad everyone had a pint with. Instead, he ended up with OCD, a head full of nonsense and the creeping fear that he's past his sell-by date. A Good Time Charlie is a funny look at bad brains, worse decisions and what happens when the craic runs out but your head won't shut up.
content_warnings: Buy a ticket in advance to guarantee entry or Pay What You Want at the venue
venue_name: Just The Tonic at The Caves

title: A Highly Suspect Murder Mystery: ABBAsolute Murder
description: It’s the Continental Song Contest 2026! But when competition royalty BABA are found garroted inside a portaloo, 'the name of the game' is catching the killer! Award-winning mystery maestros Highly Suspect return to the Fringe with a new hilarious interactive murder mystery for the audience to solve! Featuring a fiendish plot, evidence packs to examine and cryptic clues to crack, can you deduce whodunnit? Fun, frivolity and fatalities guaranteed! Sold-out show 2021-2025. ‘Prepare to have your funny bones and little grey cells equally tickled!’ (BroadwayWorld.com).

title: A Highly Suspect Murder Mystery: Knives In
description: A famous author. An impossible murder. Knives are out for renowned detective Beignet Blank, but can he peel back the layers before he wakes up a dead man? Award-winning mystery maestros Highly Suspect return to the Fringe with a brand-new hilarious interactive murder mystery for the audience to solve! Featuring a fiendish plot, evidence packs to examine and cryptic clues to crack, can you deduce whodunnit? Fun, frivolity and fatalities guaranteed! Sold-out show 2021-2025. ‘Prepare to have your funny bones and little grey cells equally tickled!’ (BroadwayWorld.com).

title: A History Comedy Show
description: Three comedians do stand-up as their favourite character from history or the time and place in history they’d want to time travel to! So if you've ever wanted to see stand-up comedy from Mahatma Gandhi, Marilyn Monroe or Adolf Hitler? Well now is your chance! Hosted by award-winning comedian and history buff Raul Kohli. ***** (Guardian). ***** (AYoungishPerspective.co.uk). ***** (TheWeeReview.com). ***** (FringeWorld.com.au/FringeFeed). Edinburgh ISH Awards Best Show Nominee 2024. 'The Bobby Thompson of our times' (Dan Jackson – The Rest is History). 'Funny, moving, powerful' (Mike Reiss, Producer/Writer – The Simpsons).

title: A Little Green Leaf
description: A Little Green Leaf is inspired by the life of Odette Hallowes (MBE, Legion d’Honneur, George Cross), Britain’s most highly decorated spy of the Second World War. This play tells the story of Odette’s service as an agent of the Special Operations Executive, resilience in the face of Gestapo brutality, survival of Ravensbruck concentration camp, and her remarkable ability to retain her light, humanity and compassion in the face of unimaginable suffering. A Little Green Leaf is a poignant and timely reminder of sacrifice, courage and how one achieves peace.
content_warnings: Contains distressing or potentially triggering themes

title: A Man Proposes to a Balloon, or Possibly Something Worse
description: Mikey's decided two things: he's ready to propose to his partner and he's going to practise his proposal speech on a balloon first. Coming to the same park bench every day, a strange relationship develops and soon, the balloon starts talking back to him. Written by stand-up comedian and So You Think You're Funny finalist, Mark Daniels, this ridiculous dark comedy is a story of love, loneliness and a gay man's relationship with his city. Oh, and it's also about a passive aggressive b*tch of a talking balloon.
content_warnings: Contains distressing or potentially triggering themes, Strong language/swearing

title: A Marriage of Inconvenience
description: Join best friends and rising comedy stars Abi Sharp and Harsh for a split bill that explores the intersection of Type-A ambition, queer identity and the chaotic search for love. United by their nerdy neuroses and a spectacular track record of romantic failures, the pair present A Marriage of Inconvenience: a show about the logistical nightmare of modern dating, and their pact to enter a sexless lavender marriage if they're still single by 40. Until then, they're saying 'I do' to the next best thing: awkwardly sharing the stage for half an hour each.
content_warnings: Scenes of a sexual nature, Strong language/swearing, Buy a ticket in advance to guarantee entry or Pay What You Want at the venue.
venue_name: Just The Tonic at The Caves

title: A Merchant’s Journey
description: Celebrating our 40th Edinburgh Festival Fringe exhibition, we bring you a stunning selection focusing on the magnificent crafts and textiles of the three main areas of the world that we have featured over these 40 years of exhibitions, Central Asia, West Africa and the Indian subcontinent. We present intricate textiles, beautiful hand carved masks, bronze sculptures, unique jewellery and timeless wood carvings.

title: A Microscopic Odyssey
description: Award nominated and a London sell-out, A Microscopic Odyssey comes to the Fringe following five-star reviews. Using real microscopic imagery, analogue projection and live sound, Mycelium Theatre Company transforms the invisible into vast cinematic landscapes. Blending science and handcrafted theatrical illusion, the show invites audiences to slow down, look closer and rediscover wonder in the smallest corners of existence. Beautiful, funny and awe-inspiring, this is an immersive experience that shifts your sense of scale and leaves you seeing the world differently.

title: A Murder Mystery Musical – The Detective's Demise
description: Sell-out murder mystery comedy musical returning to the Fringe! New songs. New Twists. New Turns. Detective Ben Stone is murdered at his own birthday party, snuffed out like candles on a cake. Five suspects have means, motive and opportunity, but with the detective lying "stone" dead, Ben's protege, sleuth Penelope Puck, must take on the investigation... With showstopping songs and devilish twists, Penelope attempts to solve the jaw-dropping murder, as ever more ridiculous motives are uncovered one by one – until the killer is finally revealed... Expect crimes, rhymes and good times!
venue_name: Just The Tonic at The Caves

title: A Nation Divided
description: A Nation Divided. 2026 or 1970? Dive into the world of 1970 Vietnam politics and the infamous May 4th shooting at Kent State University, an act of governmental violence perpetrated by a troop of National Guardsmen against peaceful protesters. Devised and performed by students from Kent State University, A Nation Divided explores the connections between the political and social tensions of the 1970s and our fraught and combative world of today. Can we learn from the past and, together, make change in today’s divisive world of 2026?
content_warnings: Contains distressing or potentially triggering themes, Buy a ticket in advance to guarantee entry or Pay What You Want at the venue

title: A Night at the Musicals
description: Exeter Spotlights presents A Night at the Musicals. Exeter University’s only performance choir are returning to the Edinburgh Fringe for another musical extravaganza filled with soaring harmonies, captivating choreography and a pitch-perfect live band! Prepare yourself for an action-filled spectacle featuring musical hits from your favourite shows alongside introductions to lesser known titles; there is truly something for everyone here! This musical theatre showcase will provide an hour full of energy, humour, fun and blossoming young talent. This is a performance you will not want to miss!

title: A One-Woman Titanic Parody in 59 Minutes or Less
description: It's been 84 years... or at least almost 30 since James Cameron's nautical masterpiece sailed into movie theatres! Now watch veteran performer (and actual Titanic historian) Katie Thayer perform the whole three hour and fourteen-minute movie... by herself... in 59 minutes... or less! With wigs, hats, finger puppets and a splash zone, it's sure to be a parody bigger than the Mauretania! Sold-out run at Orlando FestN4! Fringiest Show at KC Fringe! Best Parody at Tampa Fringe! You'll never let go of the laughs!
content_warnings: Audience participation, Strong language/swearing, More information, Buy a ticket in advance to guarantee entry or Pay What You Want at the venue
venue_name: Just The Tonic at The Caves

title: A Picture Book Musical: Milly's Musical Adventure
description: Original songs! Free stickers! Free colouring-in sheets! This interactive show based on a children's picture book is a delight from 0-99! Join Milly as she encounters feathered, furry and spiky friends who all have a song to share! Milly comes from a world without music, but when she discovers a magical book, she falls into a whole new world. Milly, with the help of her new animal (and kid) friends, must find four songs to bring back home. Experience magical illustrations and amazing new music as you help guide Milly's adventure!
venue_name: Just The Tonic at The Caves

title: A Pirate Adventure!
description: Join Captain Jellybones on a swashbuckling, laugh-out-loud pirate adventure as he races to rescue Christina-Anne from the wicked Captain Skullduggery! With the help of Scallywag Sam, Dame Saucy Sally and you. Will good triumph and evil walk the plank? Set sail to a topsy-turvy time when pirates ruled the seas and surprises lurked around every corner. Packed with great songs, big energy and barrels of fun, this brand-new family show is perfect for little pirates at the 2026 Edinburgh Fringe!

title: A Pirate's Bedtime
description: Ahoy land lubbers and deck scrubbers! Join Annie and her motley pirate crew as they set sail on a journey of discovery, meeting curious creatures, battling krakens and stormy seas along the way in this fast paced and funny adventure to discover that what’s treasured most isn’t always gold.
