The team behind last year’s sell out show ‘Wonderful World of Winnie-the-Pooh’ bring you this new, family-friendly play with dance, original song and live music that will capture the imagination of every child and every grown-up who still dreams of sailing beyond the horizon.

title: A Play on Words
description: 'Who's On First meets Waiting for Godot' (New York Times) in this ferociously witty play on, about and spilling over with language. Rusty and Max have been friends for most of their lives and they've been arguing almost the entire time. Today, they're scheming up something big. Fringe First winner Brian Dykstra's signature style crackles in this uproarious backyard comedy where two not-so-average average Americans spar in a relentlessly fanatical pursuit of what is said, what is intended, and what is. 'It goes great places!' (Variety). Directed by Fringe First winner Margarett Perry.

title: A Political Breakfast
presented_by: Jesters Dublin / Harun Musho'd / PBH's Free Fringe
description: Political comedy panel show chaired by Chris O’Neill or Harun Musho’d with up to four comedians and the audience. 'The comedians were on fire and Harun Musho’d hosted the discussion incredibly well' **** (National). 'Great way to start the day if you are even mildly into politics' (Kate Copstick, Scotsman). 'Recommended show. With O’Neill and Musho’d at the centre, it has a heart and core of comedy that makes it a very good way to start your day' (FringeReview.co.uk). 'A show worth returning to' (TheEdinburghReporter.co.uk).
venue_name: PBH's Free Fringe @ Greek Gyros Grill

title: A Pub Quiz for D**kheads
description: A strictly 18+ pub quiz for know-it-alls, written and hosted by comedians. Gather your most insufferable friends, bring a charged smartphone in case you want to cheat, and grab a pint to enjoy the most ludicrous quiz of your life. Questions range from the guessable: Q: Which two countries have the colour pink in their flag? A: Spain and Mexico. To the argument-starting: Q: Which of those two countries is the laziest? A: We'll hear arguments from both sides and take a vote. The total sell-out at Perth FRINGE WORLD makes its Edinburgh Fringe debut!

title: A Queen's Way
description: A kingdom built on murder, thievery and chaos. Can an unwilling and inexperienced teenage peasant really take over the throne? One stupid mistake may have altered Karalyne’s life forever, and changed the fate of her country. Now overcome with new responsibilities and threats, Karalyne wonders why so many aspire to rule the world and if fame is worth the stress. In this medieval satire, characters and audiences alike will ask the question: what is the value of power?

title: A Queer Little Murder
description: When a dead body is discovered in a small and incredibly queer town, the audience must decide who committed the murder. Every queer stereotype is a suspect in this whodunnit!

title: A Seance Spectacular with the Mystical Medium Wolf Sisters from the Great White North
description: An invitation to a proper Victorian seance in an appropriately eerie attic. Comedians Carly Anna Billings (The Second City Toronto) and Cecilia O'Grady will take you back in time as the Wolf Sisters, two founders of American Spiritualism, on the road, sharing their gifts of spirit and sisterhood when everything goes awry. Part comedy, part scare, this 60-minute show created and performed by these 'hilarious hosts' (Common Ground Arts, Edmonton) is sure to deliver you a spine-tinglingly silly spirit-filled story.
content_warnings: Audience participation, Contains distressing or potentially triggering themes, Strobe lighting
venue_name: Just The Tonic at The Mash House

title: A Silent Disco Dance Tour by Silent Adventures
description: Following the last few years of sell-out, five-star shows, the Silent Adventures team is back with even more madness and brand new adventures to boot. Don our magical Silent Disco headphones and feel your inhibitions evaporate as we lead you on a fun-filled silent disco tour of the Fringe. Expect song, dance, flash-mobs and surprises in the most feel-good hour of the summer. Suitable for all ages and abilities, this is without doubt the most fun you can have with your clothes on!
content_warnings: Audience participation, Audience required to walk or move around during the performance
venue_name: Meeting Point at Uplands Roast Coffee Shop

title: A Simply Beastly Murder
description: I say! There's been a murder! The Famous Five grew up and grew apart. When Dick, now a hardened PI, gets in over his head, he turns to his sister Anne for help. Do they have what it takes to solve the crime? A British film noir, full of gangsters, intrigue and lashings of tinned pineapple. Nominated for the Funny Women Awards. With additional voices by Alistair McGowan. Supported by Fenton Arts Trust and Barnsley Civic. Rachel E Thorn writes for BBC Radio (Dead Ringers, The Now Show). She's been nominated for the Kenneth Branagh Award.

title: A Slice of Elvis
description: Fancy a humorous glimpse behind the jumpsuit? Meet MIKELVIS in relentless pursuit of the King! A one-man celebration of Elvis Tribute Artist quirkiness: fearless hips, dirty tricks and serious vocal devotion. Enjoy a comedic homage to Elvis’ timeless music and unique performance abilities! With over 30 years of hands-on Elvis Tribute experience, as well as a background in award-winning comedy, Mike McAlpine marries best-in-class Elvis impersonation, fact-based storytelling and musical interludes with KOERPERKLAMAUK, his own brand of expressive physical comedy. Mike is a master mimic, with a skill for pathos and audience interaction.

title: A Story of Love and Loss
presented_by: Duo Lamorniana: Ricarda Schmidt, viola and Ute Weickenmeier, piano.
description: The age-old tale of love and sorrow is perhaps as old as humanity itself; it is inextricably linked to the human condition. Besides writers, composers have also repeatedly explored this theme. In this concert, we tell our own unique version of the story, for example through Vaughan Williams' Suite for viola, Carl Philipp Emanuel Bach's Sonata for viola da gamba, several "snapshots" from Richard Strauss's inexhaustible repertoire of songs, and also Ludwig van Beethoven's Variations on Mozart's Ein Mädchen oder Weibchen – a musically exciting, moving and ultimately very comforting story set to music.

title: A Traitors Pantomime
description: Follow a new traitors series, with all the melodrama that we know and love, plus some panto pizzazz. Our Dame, Claudia, and her fringe will guide us through the twists and turns of each roundtable. A devious trio of traitors, a comical set of faithfuls, and a Romeo-and-Juliet love story; this series will be unlike any other. Using the power of deduction and a predictable parody (or two), will good win out? Or will evil take all the money, money, money for itself? (Yes, that is an Abba reference). Come and find out!

title: A Woman in Berlin 1945
description: Berlin, April 1945. As the Red Army storms the city in WWII's largest urban battle since Stalingrad, a young woman finds herself trapped in the wreckage of a collapsing society. Her testimony reveals the largely silenced story of the mass violence inflicted on German women in the final weeks of the war. Performed by Magda Pohl, this solo physical theatre piece weaves movement, Indian rhythm and dance into a formally bold, emotionally unflinching portrait of survival, dignity and historical memory.

title: AAA Comedy Gala
description: AAA Comedy Gala is a hand-picked comedy showcase featuring four outstanding comedians. Each act has been carefully selected for their ability to deliver big laughs in this fast-paced stand-up extravaganza – your chance to discover brilliant new comedians before they hit the big time. Expect sharp wit, big personalities and non-stop laughter as exciting rising stars take the stage. With a mix of unique styles and fresh perspectives, AAA Comedy Gala promises a brilliant night of live comedy.

title: Aaaaaaargh! It's the One Liner Show
description: Enjoy an hour of the best up-and-coming one-liner comedians on the circuit in this celebration of puns, one-liners and wordplay. Hosted by UK Pun Champion and Joke of the Fringe winner 2016, 2021 and 2022 Masai Graham.

title: Aaaah it's Nicole Smit and Jed Potts!
description: The dynamic 'King and Queen' of Scottish blues are back again. With five special Fringe dates and a varying set for every date. Whether you like Nina Simone, George Jones, Patsy Cline or Carl Perkins, every show will bring you vocal performances that will soothe your soul, move your body or make you cry. Give it a try!

title: Aalex Mandel-Dallal: Where Was I?
description: Aalex ('a charming humility that brings the audience together in laughter' ****, The Student) is overwhelmed and she's not afraid to show it. In this show, she unpacks the elaborate (and often ridiculous) lengths she's gone to in pursuit of clarity. Expect an abundance of misunderstandings, a rap about questionable life choices, and a whirlwind of overcomplication that somehow lands right here.

title: Abandoman – God is a DJ
description: Abandoman is back – and this year, it's a party. Blending hip-hop with euphoric dance music, Rob Broderick's award-winning improvised comedy show turns your suggestions into original bangers, live and unrepeatable every single night. Razor-sharp wit, genuine warmth and unstoppable audience interaction make this one of Edinburgh Fringe's most joyful, unpredictable nights out. 'Clever, quick-witted and audacious' **** (Scotsman). 'Raucous, expansive, and relentlessly hilarious' **** (Times).
content_warnings: Audience participation, Strobe lighting, Strong language/swearing

title: ABBA Odyssey Live in the Club! For One Night Only!
description: This one's for the Dancing Queens! Following two years of sold-out concerts, ABBA Odyssey bring their live show to The Liquid Room for one night only! This all-standing gig is for those who love to sing and dance the night away! Showcasing the most authentic tribute to the iconic ABBA sound, ABBA Odyssey have perfected their highly acclaimed vocal blend. This dynamic performance features all of ABBA's greatest hits, plus a few surprises for the die-hards! Come and join us for this Summer Night in The City...! Doors 7pm.
content_warnings: Audience will be standing throughout, Strobe lighting, Under 18s must be accompanied by an adult

title: ABBA Odyssey – The Live Concert!
description: The 2024 and 2025 sell-out concert returns to the stunning Greyfriars Hall! This all-seated show features singers who produce the most authentic tribute to the iconic ABBA sound. With over 14 years of experience performing throughout the UK together, our Agnetha and Frida (Fran and Kat) have perfected their highly acclaimed vocal blend. ABBA Odyssey – The Live Concert! features all the hits that you know and love, plus a few hidden gems for the most devoted ABBA fans! Suitable for all ages. Includes one interval.
venue_name: Greyfriars Hall at Virgin Hotels Edinburgh

title: ABBA, The Journey
description: Rediscover the story of the greatest pop band ever formed. From humble beginnings to Eurovision stardom, overcoming the odds to become international icons – all through the power of music. This highly anticipated world-premiere production from multi award-winning Night Owl Shows brings their trademark blend of musicianship and storytelling to Sweden’s greatest export. Dancing Queen, The Winner Takes It All, Mamma Mia and many more. Take A Chance on the journey of the finest pop songs ever created through the lives of the people who made it happen.

title: ABBA – The Singalonga Cabaret
presented_by: Antony (Dr H) Hubmayer / PBH's Free Fringe
description: Get it on with the greatest ABBA piano cabaret tribute singalong show ever! All the hits, fun stories and lots of laughs as you transform from an audience into the world’s greatest ABBAsolutely fabulous cabaret choir... This high-energy, interactive show will have you singing, laughing, dancing and generally having one of the best nights of your life. Award winning international piano cabaret entertainer Antony (Dr H) Hubmayer will lead the celebrations as we sing all the best bits from Dancing Queen, Mamma Mia, Fernando, Waterloo, Knowing Me Knowing You and many, many more.
venue_name: PBH's Free Fringe @ Fingers Piano Bar

title: Abbie Edwards: Knee Touch
description: Nothing consumes your life more than having a crush: making playlists, analysing looks, replaying conversations and – best of all – you never have to actually do anything about it. You can yearn forever... unless you leave it for too long and accidentally set them up with someone else. Abbie Edwards (as heard on BBC Radio 4 Extra) takes you through her first love and how she almost ruined everything. 'Original and compelling' (Chortle.co.uk). 'Considerable style' (BeyondTheJoke.co.uk). BBC New Comedy Award nominee. Leicester Square New Comedian of the Year runner-up.
content_warnings: Strong language/swearing, Buy a ticket in advance to guarantee entry or Pay What You Want at the Venue
venue_name: Just The Tonic at The Mash House

title: Abby Govindan: Pushing 30
description: A new show about dating, getting older and breaking generational curses, from Forbes 30 Under 30, Abby Govindan. Fresh from her international tour and critically acclaimed Off-Broadway run, produced by Daniel Sloss and presented by Hasan Minhaj, this biting and irreverent new hour is Abby's Fringe debut. 'Voice of a generation' (Paste Magazine). As seen on Vogue India, NBC, Daily Beast and LA Times.
content_warnings: This show contains strong language and references to child marriage.

title: Abi Carter-Simpson and Joe McTernan: Stand-up Couple
description: Still going strong following a hugely successful run last year, this real-life, stand-up couple are back with a brand-new hour of hilarity and fun. Join star of Britain's Got Talent Abi Carter-Simpson and viral sensation Joe McTernan for a date worth putting in the diary. 'Together they are a force to be reckoned with’ ****½ (One4Review.co.uk). 'Genuine star quality' (Simon Cowell). 'I was crying with laughter pretty much throughout this entire performance' ***** (ThreeWeeks).
venue_name: Scottish Comedy Festival @ The Beehive Inn

title: Aboot Time: Moulin-Esque the Scottish Moulin Rouge
description: A Scottish reimagining of Moulin Rouge bursting with wild energy, fierce humour and heart-pounding spectacle. Set in a world of glamour, this show blends soaring romance, bold characters and riotous Scottish wit with breathtaking dance, music and storytelling. Passion collides with chaos as dreamers, lovers, rogues and misfits chase truth, beauty, freedom and love against the backdrop of a dazzling, rebellious cabaret. This is a whirlwind of emotion and electricity. A celebration of Scotland’s spirit, swagger and soul. Reinventing the Moulin Rouge creates Moulin-Esque, which combines satire and a wee dram of scandal.

title: About a Bogle
description: On a quiet Scottish isle, two musicians set off for the island festival, instruments in hand and spirits high. Watching from the heather is the Bogle, a mischievous shapeshifter who has other plans for them. Will the two bards fall prey to his schemes? Can they reach the festival in time to perform? A mix of folk tales and original music bring to life a new version of a traditional Scottish myth. About a Bogle blends myth, music and mischief into a stoater of a show.
content_warnings: Contains distressing or potentially triggering themes, Strong language/swearing
venue_name: The Speakeasy at The Royal Scots Club

title: About Comedy: Stand-Up Comedy Course
description: Learn the skills and art of performing stand-up comedy on this two-day intensive comedy course. Including: joke-writing skills, generating material, comedy deconstruction, finding material, lively interactive performance practice sessions, history of comedy, technical skills and industry tips. Plus a graduation show performance in a Fringe show. Our tutors are professional comedians, comedy writers and experienced teachers. Courses run over two days, with two four-and-a-half hour sessions on each day, followed by the graduation show. 'This course has to be one of the best on offer. Highly recommended' **** (ThreeWeeks). Full course info at https://www.laughinghorsecomedy.co.uk/courses2day.asp
content_warnings: Ticket covers a 9-hour course, over two consecutive 4.5 hour days

title: About Legends and Legacies
description: A kaleidoscope of melody and memories. From Sinatra to Elton, The Eagles, Satchmo, Gerry Rafferty, Benny Goodman, Neil Diamond, Chuck Berry – musically accomplished, stylishly performed, charismatic, fun packed – completely uplifting!

title: About Women
description: Alison Bishop (soprano) and Stuart Hope (piano) embark on an exploration of women through music. Including arias looking at the roles they play, and songs by female composers setting words by female poets, with music by Weir, Smyth, Clarke, Hensel, Britten, Handel, Copland and more.

title: Absolute Burlesque and Cabaret
presented_by: Sassy School of Burlesque and Cabaret
description: Back by very popular demand after eight sell-out runs and counting, this burlesque and cabaret favourite is strutting back onto the stage with a wink and a nod. Expect a glitter-splashed “best of” bash, where brilliant local scene-stealers share the spotlight with jaw-dropping international stars. There’ll be teasing, tassels, and just the right amount of mischief. Add in laugh-out-loud comedy, spellbinding magic, big show tunes and moments that’ll have you cheering long after show is over. 'This is EXACTLY how burlesque should be done' ***** (One4Review.co.uk).

title: Absolute Bus Stops of Northern Europe and Beyond
description: The wait is over. Grab a ticket and climb aboard for a multimedia journey celebrating the overlooked magic, mystery and beauty of bus stops. From the bleak chic of a layby on the A47 to a sun drenched Swedish super shelter in Getgubben, Båstad, you will learn the secrets of the bus stop rating system and so much more! Warning, jokes subject to delays. Performed by Jim Judges, the comedian behind Cutlery Safety Expert Ian Crawford, 'Forkin’ good' **** (TheWeeReview.com).

title: Absolute Frankie Valli and the Four Seasons
description: Returning by popular demand after last year’s sell-out shows is UK tribute act The False Seasons. The quartet deliver a nostalgic and fun packed afternoon celebrating one of the greatest vocal groups of all time, with hits including Let’s Hang On, Can’t Take My Eyes Off You and Beggin' to name but a few. So for all you Ragdolls, Sherry's and Bye Bye Babies make sure you book early, as tickets will sell fast.

title: Absolute Improv!
description: Big laughs, multi-year sell-out. Absolute Improv! is a family-friendly, high-energy improv comedy show created entirely from audience suggestions. For 16 years, this Edinburgh team of global improv company TBC Improv have delivered lightning-fast games, outrageous characters and unforgettable moments – returning year after year to packed houses. Every performance is completely unscripted and totally unique. Expect quick-fire scenes, big characters and joyful chaos the whole family can enjoy together. No two shows are ever the same – once it’s over, it’s gone forever. Five-star Fringe favourite. Come see why audiences keep coming back.

title: Absolute Monopoly
description: Join comedian Benjamin Alborough as he attempts to improve Monopoly in this chaotic, high-energy game show. Audience members compete against each other and the host, with the audience physically becoming the game board. The show combines role-playing, physical challenges and psychological intimidation to make something that, if not the best board game in the world, is at least short. ***** (EdFringeReview.com). ***** (ThreeWeeks). ***** (NorthWestEnd.co.uk). 'Riotously entertaining' **** (Chortle.co.uk). Sell-out show in 2024. Benjamin Alborough is a Malcolm Hardee Award nominee for Comic Originality 2025 and a nominee for Best Variety Show Leicester Comedy Festival 2026.

title: Absolute Nickhead
description: Nick Kirk, West End New Act finalist, just wants to put on a silly character show. His own inner monologue has other ideas. Who will win? Will it make any sense? Does that even matter? These questions, and fewer, might be answered in Absolute Nickhead... 'Safety officer Dave Steed is an amusing tragi-comic conceit and expertly performed with fine timing' (Chortle.co.uk).

title: Absolutely Magic 2026!
presented_by: Tim Licata Magic / PBH's Free Fringe
description: Award-winning magician Tim Licata is back with new impossible magic and mind-reading for 2026! A fantastic hour with one of Scotland’s most entertaining magicians. Tim Licata brings his astonishing new show of magic, mind-reading and delightful deception to the Fringe 2026. Chicago-born Licata does not fail to amaze. Audience reviews: 'Mind blown! This guys' incredible!' 'One of the best magic shows I’ve seen!' 'Tim Licata is absolutely magic'. **** (WorldMagicReview.com). **** (AllEdinburghTheatre.com).

title: Achtung! The Only Sauerkraut in Town
description: Bauhaus meets Tommy Cooper via a Berlin beer hall. Fifty minutes of storytelling, stand-up and absurdist wit from a student of the legendary Ecole Philippe Gaulier. Less of an act, more of an experience: Jürgen explores what happens when German precision collides with honest foolishness. As seen at Altitude Comedy Festival. The only Sauerkraut you’ll need this August. 'Brilliantly mad' (Mike Gunn). 'No one does what you do' (Logan Murray, Museum of Comedy).

title: Acid's Reign
description: 2019: A new drag supergroup bursts onto the scene, intent on challenging climate change. Present day: Interest wanes. Climate funding falters. When commercial opportunity knocks the company faces a reckoning: stay radical or stay visible? Acid's Reign is a riotous queer musical with a live band and powerhouse vocals from drag superstars including Scarlett Harlett and Gigi Zahir (fresh from supporting Chappell Roan). Provocative, camp and razor-sharp, Acid's Reign is a hilarious musical about activism, community and the power of performance. 'Disarmingly poignant... Vibrant and expressive work with a wholly authentic voice' **** (Stage).
content_warnings: This show contains audience participation, scenes of a sexual nature, strobe lighting and strong language.

title: Acid With Jesus: A Revolutionary Comedy Show
description: This is a hilarious, personal, hopeful and thought-provoking comedy show about exploring the state of the world, neurodiversity, climate change and game shows for billionaires. Expect sharp punchlines, authentic material, fast jokes, messages of unity and well-researched jokes providing belly laughs and a show that you won’t forget.

title: Acoustic Blues and Roots in the Afternoon
description: Returning to the Jazz Bar for the eighth year, Scottish acoustic guitar and double-bass duo, Malt and Rye will be playing classic blues and roots songs from the last 100 years. Songs like Hoochie Coochie Man and San Francisco Bay Blues will be played with the duo’s distinctive passion and humour. The hour-long set not only includes songs by the greats like Robert Johnson, Willie Dixon, Lowell Fulson, Jimmy Rogers and Memphis Slim, but also comes up to date by including songs by modern-day blues masters, like Eric Clapton and Martin Harley.

title: Acoustic Blues with Smith and Tweeddale
description: Two of Edinburgh’s top blues guitarists / singers: Derek Smith (Main Street Blues) and Sandy Tweeddale (Blues & Trouble, Maggie Bell Band, Tim Elliott & The Troublemakers) have both collaborated together to perform their unique blend of acoustic blues, including a wide selection of acoustic blues classics and acoustic blues originals taken from their vast repertoire developed over the last 20 years.

title: Adam Bromley: Hyperconnected
description: This is a comedy show about one manic man navigating an increasingly deranged hyper-online world. Adam grew up in the analogue age when people had to remember facts and basic courtesy – now it’s ChatGPT and online hate mobs. Join him on this madcap journey through his own overstimulated brain and world that is too connected for its own good. Smartphones have taken over the world, AI will be next and we’ll be too busy doom scrolling to notice.

title: Adam Flood: Life and Death of the Party
description: Stand-up performed over big electronic beats. A show about hedonism and Adam's vanishing nightlife. 'It shouldn't work, but it absolutely does' (Metro). 'A multifaceted comedy talent' (Guardian). As seen on BBC and ITV. Adam Flood, from Stoke-on-Trent, was once a teenage drug dealer, then an indie rock star, now a comedian. In 2025 his debut stand-up show was released by the BBC. In 2026 he ran, sober, full speed into a closed glass door. **** (BroadwayWorld.com). **** (EdFringeReview.com). **** (Mervyn Stutter's Pick of The Fringe). **** (TheRealChrisparkle.com).
content_warnings: Strobe lighting, Buy a ticket in advance to guarantee entry or Pay What You Want at the venue

title: Adam Greene: The Wizard of Ozempic
description: Blending sharp stand-up with satirical storytelling, Adam Greene (writer for BBC Radio 4's The News Quiz) takes on bodies, brains, courage and the increasingly unhinged ways we try to fix ourselves. Expect big jokes, bigger ideas and a massive performer working hard enough to earn the sweat. 'Dripping with both sweat and comedy' **** (The Student). 'Definitely one to keeps tabs on' (Bruce Dessau, Evening Standard). 'Builds and easy connection with the audience' (Steve Bennet, Chortle.co.uk).
content_warnings: Audience participation, Buy a ticket in advance to guarantee entry or Pay What You Want at the venue
venue_name: Just The Tonic at The Hive

title: Adam Larter: Who Remembers the 90s?
description: Not a lot has been written about the decade the 90s, and so Adam Larter will finally try to get to the bottom of what happened in this decade. Expect well-researched journalism and not a load of surreal nonsense. 'One of the most stupidly brilliant things you'll see this Fringe' (Fest). 'There's certainly plenty to look at and for a lot of the time the audience is entranced by the sheer volume of physical chaos happening on and off the stage' (Scotsman). Directed by Ali Brice.
content_warnings: Buy a ticket in advance to gain entry or Pay What You Want at the venue
venue_name: Just The Tonic at The Hive

title: Adam Riches: The Captain
presented_by: Park Theatre Productions and Tigco present
description: From the writer of Jimmy, the totally sold-out, smash-hit, one-man show of Summerhall 2024 – '...solo shows are ten a penny at the Edinburgh Fringe, but this feels like one in a million' ***** (Telegraph) – comes the true story of Captain Matthew Webb, the first man to ever swim the English Channel. The bravery! The fortitude! The sheer outright insanity! It's time to remember this most humble of men, this Shopshire lad, whose extraordinary feat ought to be far more celebrated than it is. A man who died as he lived, chasing the impossible.
content_warnings: Contains distressing or potentially triggering themes

title: Adam Riches: The Critic's Way
description: Wanna be a comedy reviewer? Think you have what it takes to sit in a dark room watching something on your own without falling asleep? Then come join Caliban Munroe, 'the single most influential critic of our times' (The Caliban Munroe Podcast), and best-selling author of industry bible The Critic's Way, as he hosts his award-winning once-in-an-afternoon seminar on how to live your dream and crush everyone else's. NB there will be no press tickets available for this show. Previous Praise for Adam Riches: ***** (Times). ***** (Telegraph). ***** (Independent). ***** (Scotsman). ***** (Chortle.co.uk).

title: Adele Cliff’s Topical Early Late Show With Adele Cliff
description: Do you like American late night shows, but you aren't American? This show is the solution! Behold, Edinburgh's first American late-night style topical comedy extravaganza. Expect stand-up, analysis, guests and games. Award-winning stand-up and topical writer (Breaking the News and The News Quiz), Adele Cliff is joined by house band, Katie Pritchard, and reporter, Will Davies. A brand-new show written fresh everyday. Praise for Adele: 'Master of comedy' ***** (TheatreMatters.com.au). Praise for Katie: 'Creative, unique and hilarious' ***** (ThePhoenixRemix.com). Praise for Will: 'Deeply funny' **** (Young-Perspective.net).

title: Adele Cliff: Work in Progress
description: Multi award-winning comedian, Adele Cliff, brings a work-in-progress show to the Fringe. Expect material on love, life choices and llamas. Catch these jokes whilst they're still super fresh. Praise for Adele's previous shows: 'Master of comedy' ***** (TheatreMatters.com.au). 'Truly funny' ***** (TLA Adelaide). 'Guaranteed laughs' ***** (The Student Newspaper). 'A-list jokes' **** (TheComicsComic.com). 'Heartfelt storytelling and incredibly astute observations' **** (Hugging Comedians). 'Takes her job to be silly very seriously and it certainly pays off' **** (EdFringeReview.com). 'Funny, well-written' **** (One4Review.co.uk).

title: ADEY
description: Having graduated from drama school in 2023, Bethlehem is now navigating one of the toughest industries by herself – but she's never truly alone. Living at home with her traditional Eritrean mother Tsehaynesh, Bethlehem doesn't know what privacy is! Being a stoic woman of culture, Tsehaynesh struggles to understand Bethlehem's career in the arts. To make matters worse, something drastic happens to Bethlehem, meaning she'll have to work harder than ever. ADEY is a heartfelt semi-autobiographical play which combines spoken word, music and movement to transport us from vibrant West Green Road, Tottenham to palm tree covered Asmara, Eritrea.

title: Adi Parmar: Sunny Boy
description: Is fatherhood REAL or is it a lie made up by BIG childhood to sell MORE therapy? Join Adi Parmar (gay), as he recalls his unforgettable childhood in North India (India) and his unexpected fatherhood in North Holland (Netherlands) and makes sense of it all using the best medicine there is: Laughter (hahaha). 'Love, forgiveness and growth, all wrapped around with humour.' ***** (List). Winner Best Emerging Artist Adelaide Fringe 2026 weekly award. Soho Theatre London: Comedy Plus Lab 2025 Alumni. Newbie Comedian of the Year (Netherlands) 2024.
content_warnings: Audience participation, Contains distressing or potentially triggering themes, Scenes of violence, Strong language/swearing

title: Aditya Mayya Pretends to Be Sad
description: When he found out his younger brother had just committed suicide, Aditya had the same first thought we all do: how do I write a joke about this? Recounting his story in both hilarious and heart-wrenching detail, Aditya Mayya Pretends to Be Sad is an hour-long exploration of being earnest from someone allergic to sincerity. A tragicomic solo show for people who've seen a thousand tragicomic solo shows, this is an hour that both celebrates and satirizes the Fringe staple that we all know and love.
content_warnings: Contains distressing or potentially triggering themes, Buy a ticket in advance to guarantee entry or Pay What You Want at the venue
venue_name: Just The Tonic at The Hive

title: Adult Panto (Unscripted): The Improvised Adult Panto
presented_by: Matty Hurst Productions Ltd / PBH's Free Fringe
description: Now in its fifth filthy year, The Adult Panto Tour is cumming back to Edinburgh and this time it’s totally (Unscripted). This balls-to-the-wall panto smashes in the back doors of your favourite pantomimes, with every character, scene and even the title decided live by the audience. Expect outrageous characters, filthy humour and unpredictable chaos. No two shows are ever the same. Strap on for a wild night of improvised madness and unapologetically naughty nonsense as we drag you through Pantoland, where anything can happen (and it probably will)! ***** (South East Stage Reviews).
content_warnings: Audience participation, Scenes of a sexual nature, Strong language/swearing

title: Adults Only Magic Show
description: 'An absolute riot!' ***** (TheatreWeekly.com). Brace yourself folks – this is not your nana's magic show. Back and naughtier than ever for their fifth filthy year at Edinburgh Festival Fringe, the Adults Only Magic Show is an unapologetically wild ride of raunchy comedy, jaw-dropping illusions and a generous helping of skin. Join Sam, Justin and the outrageous Magnus 'Danger' Magnus as they blow the top off traditional magic with an X-rated twist. There's no bunny in the hat here – unless he's wearing leather and begging for it.

title: Adventures of the Improvised Sherlock Holmes
description: No script, Sherlock! Stars of UK and Australian Fringes take you on an award-winning improvised romp through the underworld of Victorian Britain, packed with shady villains, red herrings and the brilliant deductions of London's greatest detective. Light your (imaginary) pipe as an engrossing spontaneous mystery tale unfolds before you. Family friendly. 'Exhilarating! The best of its kind' ***** (FringeFeed.com.au). 'Excellent... very funny and beautifully devious' **** (FringeGuru.com). 'Copious amounts of talent and boundless potential' **** (PlaysToSee.com). 'Total mastery' ***** (GreatScott.media). Winner, Perth Fringe World Variety Show Award.
venue_name: Just The Tonic at The Caves

title: Afro Acrobatic Arts
description: Authentic Afro acrobatics and African performing arts. Featuring dance, music, performing arts, acrobatics, limbo, contortion, suspension and juggling.

title: Afronauts
presented_by: Underbelly, Circus Zambia and Wake the Beast
description: An all-ages, high-flying collision of circus, theatre and space adventure. 1964: the world’s superpowers are caught in the space race. Enter an unlikely contender... Zambia. Visionary Edward Mukuka Nkoloso aimed to send Africa’s first astronauts into the cosmos. His crew? A young girl, two cats and a missionary. His rocket? Aluminium, ambition and audacity. Wake The Beast and Circus Zambia bring this extraordinary story to life with breathtaking acrobatics, theatrical spectacle and irresistible heart. A true tale of courage, hope and willpower that can take you to the moon... or make you believe you could.

title: After Arthur
description: Once the wide-eyed star of a beloved kids TV cartoon, Arthur is now 36, skint and spiralling. After decades of autographs, arena tours and breakfast cereal endorsements, he’s facing obscurity, irrelevance and a group chat that won’t reply. In this sharp, surreal stand-up character comedy, Arthur wrestles with faded fame, adult reality and the crushing truth that nobody remembers him. Created and performed by Jack Scullion, as seen on U&Dave and ITV2, and member of Edinburgh Fringe hit Not Another Quiz Night, After Arthur is a nostalgic, chaotic unravelling you won’t want to miss.

title: After-Hours Burlesque Club 2026
description: Your late-night burlesque 'guilty pleasure' returns! Sell-out 2025 run. Sizzling striptease and alternative variety collide at the historic Caves. Leave inhibitions at the door. Anything goes. A part of the newly formed International Fringe Burlesque Festival. Seasoned international headliners, spectacular showstoppers, industry innovators and rising newcomers on the scene. After-Hours Burlesque Club is the ultimate party at the 2026 Fringe. Everyone welcome!
content_warnings: Audience participation, Nudity, Scenes of a sexual nature, Strong language/swearing
venue_name: Just The Tonic at The Caves

title: After Shakespeare
description: Returning for its third Edinburgh season, After Shakespeare asks what happens to Shakespeare’s heroes and villains once the curtain falls. Lady Macbeth, Portia, Hamlet and King Hal reflect on power, love and survival, beyond the endings we think we know. In this acclaimed solo show, Lexi Wolfe transforms seamlessly between four iconic characters, weaving Shakespeare’s language with historical insight and fresh dramatic imagination. Witty, poignant, surprising; a thoughtful, inventive celebration of voice and consequence, long after the lights fade. 'A must-see show' ***** (EdinburghGuide.com). 'One of this year's stand-out shows' **** (GetYourCoatsOn.com). 'Refreshing and gifted writing' **** (WestEndBestFriend.co.uk).
content_warnings: Contains distressing or potentially triggering themes

title: After the Fact
description: Set in 1980s Scotland during the Cold War, when nuclear bombs were a very real threat. The play is inspired by true events and real experiences, when one night in Peebleshire, Scotland, the unimaginable happened. Five scared, lost, turbulent young women grapple with the adversities and joys of life in the 80s, with the constant knowledge that their lives could be obliterated at any moment. In the face of nuclear war, how do they cope, love, and live?
content_warnings: Contains distressing or potentially triggering themes, Strong language/swearing

title: After Winter
description: In contemporary China, what happens when a woman refuses to be invisible? When a family crisis pushes former housewife Cheng Yuan back into work, she discovers independence, ambition and a life she was never meant to have. But as her husband’s promotion threatens to uproot everything, she must decide whether stability is worth self-erasure. Through live vocals and intimate storytelling, this powerful original musical examines marriage, gender roles and the quiet negotiations women make every day. Performed in Mandarin with English surtitles.
content_warnings: Performed in Mandarin with English surtitles.

title: Afternoon Arias
presented_by: Brian Bannatyne-Scott, Beth Taylor and friends
description: Afternoon delight will be provided by this starry concert, featuring some of Scotland's top operatic singers, in a programme of wonderful French opera highlights from Bizet, Berlioz, Debussy and Gounod. International stars Brian Bannatyne-Scott (bass) and Beth Taylor (mezzo-Soprano) are joined by three rising stars, Catherine Hooper (soprano), Magnus Walker (tenor) and Jonathan Kennedy (baritone). Providing the accompaniment is Michal Gajzler, the brilliant Scottish-based Polish pianist, who will conjure up the sounds of a full orchestra on the grand piano! The last two Fringe concerts were sell-outs, so get your tickets soon to avoid disappointment.

title: Afternoon Comedy and Magic Selection
description: Enjoy two professional comedians and two professional magicians in one bumper value afternoon show. Laugh, gasp and be amazed.
venue_name: Just The Tonic at The Hive

title: Afternoon Nap – Peter Bazely
description: Peter would love to nap but can’t. Award-nominated anti-comedian Fringe favourite Peter Bazely actively encourages you to fall asleep during his show. Ideally, everyone nods off so he can finally go on his phone (which he really enjoys). Afternoons are brutal. Energy dips. Your brain replays every embarrassing memory in order. Sleep is meant to make you successful. Peter would like to test that. Comfy clothes encouraged. Snoring welcomed. A live comedy experiment between awake and gone. ISH Edinburgh Comedy Awards nominee: Best Newcomer 2024. ‘Tired... inspired... Bailey-esque’ (Chortle.co.uk).

title: Against the Grain
description: Winter, 1943. As the Siege of Leningrad tightens its grip, two scientists guard a seed vault designed to preserve humanity. Faced with starvation, yet surrounded by food they refuse to touch. When a desperate intruder forces his way in, the moral line they have defended for years suddenly becomes unbearable. Nina and Olga must confront an impossible question: will they save the world or save themselves? A thrilling new work inspired by true events.
content_warnings: Contains distressing or potentially triggering themes, Scenes of violence

title: Ahir Shah: Golden
presented_by: Country Mile Productions in association with Avalon
description: Ahir Shah discusses love, money, family, responsibility, fear, forever and frogs. His last show, Ends, won the Edinburgh Comedy Award, toured to international acclaim and is streaming on Netflix. As seen on Live at the Apollo, Mock the Week, QI, that sort of thing. 'The most important stand-up of the year, if not decade’ (Stephen Armstrong). ***** (Guardian, Independent, Telegraph, Standard, Chortle.co.uk).

title: Aidan Greene: Stuttermilk Pancakes
description: Award-winning comedian Aidan Greene is Ireland's foremost stammering comedian (he's also the only one). For years he's been told not to let his stutter define him. Well... too late. Join the bad boy of stammering for a razor-sharp, big-hearted show about embracing what makes you different and having serious craic along the way. 'Destined for stardom' (RTE). 'A joy to behold' (PasteMagazine.com). 'A show which is as heartfelt as hilarious' **** (TheWeeReview.com).

title: Aidan Jones: Chopin's Nocturne
description: I grew up playing classical piano, but failed my conservatory audition at 18. After some time focusing on MDMA, I started stand-up comedy. During the pandemic I came back to the piano and now I've combined them. It's my favourite piece, Chopin's Nocturne in Eb Major, presented with jokes by a bald, Australian dickhead with a beard. Best Comedy, Adelaide Fringe Weekly. 'Sidesplittingly funny' (Guardian). 'Will leave you laughing for days on end' ***** (Advertiser, Adelaide). 'This should not work, but it does' ***** (List). ***** (ThreeWeeks). **** (Scotsman).

title: Aja! A Steely Dan Tribute
description: After a sell-out 2025 Fringe debut, Scotland’s premier Steely Dan tribute returns. This eight-piece powerhouse brings together some of the top professional musicians from across Scotland. Meticulously crafted arrangements of hits, deep cuts and fan favourites deliver the detail and musicality audiences expect, while leaving space for vibrant improvisation. The show faithfully recreates Fagen and Becker’s iconic catalogue with the energy and precision it deserves. Created to honour the legacy and exacting standards of the 1970s jazz-rock pioneers, the production pairs elite musicianship with high-energy live impact. Do not miss out!

title: Alan Bennett's Talking Heads
description: A multi-generational company of Edinburgh-based women perform four of Alan Bennett’s iconic Talking Heads monologues: A Lady of Letters, A Bed Among the Lentils, Her Big Chance and Cream Cracker Under the Settee. With wit, poignancy and emotional precision, each actor brings a distinctive voice to Bennett’s portraits of loneliness, quiet desperation and resilient humour. Though rooted in the 1970s and 80s, these sharply observed character studies remain strikingly relevant. Simply and sensitively staged, this production offers an intimate, moving and often unexpectedly funny exploration of women’s lives, seen anew through an intergenerational lens.
content_warnings: Contains distressing or potentially triggering themes
venue_name: The Speakeasy at The Royal Scots Club

title: Alan Jay: Hell Hath No Humour Like a Gayboy Scorned
description: In just a few short years, Alan Jay has become one of Scottish comedy's most exciting newcomers. Acclaimed for taking a life fraught with adversity and turning it into sharp punchlines, clever writing and topping it all off with his happy-go-lucky style and charisma. Much like his life, Alan's comedy pulls no punches, and this long-awaited debut will showcase the Leicester Square New Comedian finalist and BBC New Comedy Awards semi-finalist at his most real, raw and refined yet!
content_warnings: Contains distressing or potentially triggering themes, Strong language/swearing

title: Alan Palmer (A Little Bit Gay)
description: A Little Bit Gay is an outlandish, outrageous and out and out true, stand-up special about growing up a gay Mormon, touring with the Chippendales, an unexpected turn in soft porn and being a superhero in The Mighty Morphin Power Ranger Series. All with the mantra of life is a musical! Beyond mimicry, Alan Palmer's (A Little Bit Gay) is both reverent and irreverent. A loving and hysterical tribute to the fans of stage and screen, it's a must for all lovers of the entertainment community!
content_warnings: Strong language/swearing, Buy a ticket in advance to guarantee entry or Pay What You Want at the venue.
venue_name: Just The Tonic at The Mash House

title: Alastair Clark: On The Record
presented_by: Snap The Arrow / PBH's Free Fringe
description: High fidelity stand-up comedy. Alastair shares stories from a near decade working behind the counter of an independent record shop. A show that waxes lyrical about crate digging, needle dropping and arguing with children about Limp Bizkit. Back at the Edinburgh Fringe as part of Alastair's Record Store Comedy Tour, where he is performing this show in independent record stores across the UK. 'Playful, smart and quietly ambitious' **** (One4Review.co.uk). 'Thoroughly engaging... Genuinely moving' (Clash Magazine). 'Revealing insight into life at a record store' (Comedy.co.uk). Insider's Pick of Free Fringe Shows 2025 (TheQR.co.uk).
venue_name: PBH's Free Fringe @ Slow Progress Cafe and Records

title: Alastair Savage and Ailie Robertson: Fiddle and Clarsach – Scottish Roots
description: After the popularity of last year's festival collaboration, the versatile fiddler is again joined by five-time National Mod gold medalist and multi-award-winning composer/harpist Ailie Robertson, for a unique journey of sound. With Alastair and Ailie both steeped in traditional and classical disciplines, this again promises to be a tour de force of Scotland's finest melodies. Unmissable for folk music enthusiasts. 'Alastair Savage is a master of the instrument' (ThreeWeeks). 'Breathtaking effortlessness' (BrightYoungFolk.com). 'Flair, precision and consummate skill' (FolkWords). 'The ability to tear your heart out' (Maverick).

title: Alastair Savage and Alice Allen: Fiddle and Cello – Scotland and Beyond
description: Fiddle and cello at its finest. Alastair begins his eclectic festival programme alongside one of the country's most accomplished and versatile artists. The duo's groundbreaking 2024 double album Where The Good Ship Lands was heralded by audiences and critics alike. After a short hiatus, they bring their captivating array of moods back to the concert stage in 2026 with music from Scotland, Ireland and America. Finely balancing innovation and tradition, unmissable for folk music enthusiasts. ‘Perfect for enhancing the mood’ (Fatea Records). ‘Breathtaking effortlessness’ (BrightYoungFolk.com). 'Stunning' (FolkWales).

title: Alastair Savage – Scots Fiddle Old and New
description: Leading fiddle exponent Alastair Savage returns to the magnificent Canongate Kirk with his heartfelt celebration of the cherished Scots fiddle tradition. Accompanying him, a stellar cast of Scotland's finest musicians, featuring long-time collaborators Euan Drysdale (guitar/piano) and Iain Crawford (double bass), with special guests including acclaimed BBC Proms in the Park solo piper Chris Gibb alongside woodwind supremo Linda Spears (flute/piccolo/whistle). An undoubted festival highlight offering listeners a unique experience of Scottish culture, both ancient and modern. 'Panache, grace and affection' (Scotsman). 'A must for aficionados' (Herald). 'Master of the instrument' (ThreeWeeks).

title: Alastair Savage – The Fiddle and Robert Burns
description: The legend of Robert Burns offers diverse areas of intrigue for listeners. Undoubtedly the range of fiddle melodies collected for his songs, composed by contemporaries Niel Gow, William Marshall and others, offers an absorbing theme for the concert platform. Alastair, an award-winning fiddler with an extensive back catalogue of recordings and broadcasts, completes his Fringe journey this year exploring these classics alongside piano/accordion master Gregor Blamey. A sweet taste of Scottish history for Burns enthusiasts. 'Panache, grace and affection' (Scotsman). 'A must for aficionados' (Herald). 'Spectacular in simplicity, scope and delivery' (Folkwords).

title: Alcohol Free Comedy
description: Top comedians cover everything from booze-fuelled chaos to sober living and the blurry middle ground. It's the stories from wild nights out, morning-after regrets, decisions to quit and the awkward "one won't hurt" negotiations we all know too well. Expect big laughs, brutal honesty and some stuff that probably should've stayed private! Nothing is off limits, but it's all handled with wit and warmth. A funny AF show of memories you might actually keep. Hosted by Andy Roach, in association with Sentia Spirits.

title: Alcohol Is Good For You
description: Join us for a drink and another hour of non-stop inebriated laughter! The same spirited show hosted by Edinburgh's favourite Scouser, Kyle Legacy, but with all-new faces sharing their best drunken comedic tales! If they can't make you laugh, I guess you weren't drunk enough. Sold-out 8 years running!

title: Alegria Flamenca
description: Step into the vibrant world of flamenco with Alba Flamenca at the Edinburgh Festival Fringe. In an intimate venue, experience the electric combination of double bass, guitar, passionate vocals and mesmerizing dancing, where every stomp and strum tells a story. Feel the rhythm, emotion and drama of Spain come alive right before your eyes, transporting you to the heart of Andalusia. Enhance the experience with tapas and drinks at the bar next door, creating the perfect Spanish evening. This is more than a show – it’s a full sensory journey of music, movement and culture.

title: Alex Camp: Dopamine Rat
description: Alex Camp returns for his second Fringe show, a searingly honest yet bonkers look at addictions both big and small. Stampede through the rat run of booze, sex and mental health while injected buzzing on Alex's trademark original comedy songs. The Leicester Comedy Festival award nominee is a former Tokyo expat, failed musician, love-rat and addict. His argument is, these addictions shaped his life and made him a better person. Why do we get addicted? How do we find community? What are the toilets like? Featuring Taylor Swift, hand dryers, sweets, code-switching and much more.
content_warnings: Strong language/swearing, Audience participation, Contains distressing or potentially triggering themes

title: Alex Franklin: Kiss Me x
description: What if we kissed? Right now? Xx xXx Xx xxX X X x x (*kissing*). Wow. That was wonderful. Until we meet again. As seen / heard on Channel 4 / HBO Max / BBC Radio 4. 'Deeply affecting and incredibly funny' ***** (TheWeeReview.com). 'A one-woman multiverse of gleeful possibility' ****½ (The Reviews Hub). 'Fabulously funny, absurd and intelligent' **** (Everything-Theatre.co.uk).
content_warnings: Contains distressing or potentially triggering themes, Mentions of transphobia

title: Alex Kitson: Now Look Here
description: It’s nice to do things in real life isn’t it? After two critically acclaimed shows in 2024 and 2025, multi award-winning comedian Alex Kitson has a brand-new hour of stand-up comedy to show you. He's talking about attention so if you could direct yours his way he'd be very grateful. One of the best reviewed shows of the Edinburgh Fringe 2025. ISH Edinburgh Comedy Awards Best Newcomer nominee. Dave’s Funniest Joke of the Edinburgh Fringe nominee 'The future of British comedy' ***** (ThreeWeeks). 'The audience laughter is non-stop' ***** (ThePhoenixRemix.com). 'Insanely original' ***** (EuropeanComedy.com).

title: Alex La: Fool as Hell
description: Alex La is bringing his debut stand-up comedy special, Fool as Hell, to the Edinburgh Fringe this year. He'll be doing bits about puzzles and dragons, but he'll also be getting personal about his parents' marriage and his dating life, from his most recent breakup to his current relationship with an older woman. It's got a bit of everything! 'Whimsical, fun, a bit different' (James Mattern, comedian). 'Can't wait to see more' (also James Mattern, comedian).

title: Alex Leam's Absolute Scenes
description: The panel show that has improv, stand-up and acts from the festival getting burned by large candles is back for 2026. Formally called Improv Provocateur (cos changing names worked so well for Twitter). 'This was such good fun. A lovely team, new games, actual physical danger! See it, play it, love it!' (Tony Slattery).
venue_name: PBH's Free Fringe @ BrewDog Lothian Rd

title: Alex Leam: Two Turntables and a Microphone
description: Alex Leam used to be a DJ, but quit as he had enough of doing weddings. Then he became a comedian. Now he's combining the two. Expect to have your favourite songs ruined. 'A winning line in self-deprecation' (Chortle.co.uk). 'Excellent, a natural entertainer!', 'This is what you want, a comedian making your face ache and tears roll from your eyes. Alex is brilliant!' (Audience Reviews).

title: Alex Love: How To Win A Pub Quiz 2026
description: Part stand-up comedy, part actual pub quiz. Quick-witted quizmaster, Alex Love, returns to test trivia and split the audience into teams to compete in this highly interactive hour. Prepare for points, prizes and a pedantic host. The show has four sold-out Edinburgh Fringe runs, been performed in seven countries and almost caused a riot in a small Dorset town. 'A Fringe cult smash.... outstripping some of the festival's top-rated comedians in terms of both quality and quantity of laughter.' ***** (Broadwaybaby.com). 'It is hilarious.' (ArtMurmurs.nz).

title: Alexander Bennett: All It Takes
description: Wondering when all your work will pay off? Waiting for your lucky break? This is a show for you. Expect songs and strong feelings. Chortle.co.uk and Leicester Comedy Festival Award nominee. 'Surprisingly powerful - will leave you in tears of laughter' ***** (BroadwayWorld.com). 'Hugely talented' ***** (ThreeWeeks). 'Balances hilarity with poignant themes' **** (Edinburgh Festivals Magazine). 'A testament to the power of comedy to illuminate the human experience' **** (TheReviewsHub.com). 'Dark, biting, deeply cynical humour is part of his comedic DNA' **** (TheQR.co.uk). 'See this show' ***** (BroadwayBaby.com).
content_warnings: Audience participation, Contains distressing or potentially triggering themes, Strobe lighting

title: Alfie Brown: The Entertainer
description: Brand new show. A show so entertaining you can scarcely believe it. Written and performed (both!) by a man in crisis, desperate to find meaning in life. What is stand-up comedy for? Buy a ticket and find out, let me amuse you like you’ve never been amused before; I doubt you’ll ever need amusing again. 'The best thing I saw last year' (Stewart Lee). 'Wow! F**k! Wow!' ***** (Scotsman). 'Totally compelling' **** (Guardian). 'Forensically funny' **** (Times). Chortle Best Show Award Winner 2022. Edinburgh Comedy Award Nominee 2022.

title: Alfie Moore: Fair Cop – Live!
description: Cop-turned-comedian Alfie returns with a brand-new show ahead of recording his BBC Radio 4 comedy It's a Fair Cop. Using a real-life scenario from Alfie’s casebook, the audience are sworn in as cops and experience the thrills, spills and laughter of real-time decision making. Thought-provoking and fun, with every show unique to the audience in the room. Come along and find out what sort of cop you’d make. 'Brilliantly funny... genuinely hilarious' (David Mitchell). 'Thoroughly engaging, endlessly funny. His charisma shines through as bright and colourful as a twirling blue light' (Times).
content_warnings: Audience participation, Audience invited to join in but not mandatory
venue_name: Lower Hall at Braw Venues @ Grand Lodge

title: Ali Brice: This Is The Way We Brush Our Teeth
description: I like smiling. But only when I'm unaware of it. If you know you're smiling, you're doing it wrong. Unless you're looking at a camera. Or a dentist. I hope this show makes you smile without realising it. That would make me smile. It'll be chaotic, heartfelt and silly.  'Comic genius' **** (Skinny). 'Ali Brice is funny' **** (List). 'The most entertaining experience I enjoyed at the Fringe' (EdFringeReview.com). 'A show like no other' (Chortle.co.uk). 'A clever, off-beat talent with a penchant for risk-taking on stage' (BeyondTheJoke.co.uk).

title: Ali Woods: Working on it Part Two: The Revenge
description: After four sell-out Edinburgh Fringe shows, join award-winning stand-up comedian and online viral sensation Ali Woods as he works on new material! As seen on Comedy Central and Stand-Up Sketch Show. Coming hot off the back of his first worldwide tour, Ali is working on a new stand-up comedy show rumoured to be even more worldwidey. 'A perfect show' ***** (ThreeWeeks). 'This is Ali Woods' world, and we are simply living in it' ***** (LondonTheatre1.com). ***** (Everything-Theatre.co.uk ). ***** (@POWShowbiz). ***** (@gig.gossip).
content_warnings: Strong language/swearing, Buy a ticket in advance to guarantee entry or Pay What You Want at the venue
venue_name: Just The Tonic at The Mash House

title: Alice Cooper – Welcome To My Cabaret Nightmare
presented_by: Antony (Dr H) Hubmayer / PBH's Free Fringe
description: Release your inner goth-rock and descend into the underworld of Alice Cooper as Dr H welcomes you to the greatest piano cabaret tribute singalong nightmare ever! From School’s Out and Poison, to No More Mr Nice Guy and I’m Eighteen, every anthem you know and love is given new life at the keys – raw, dramatic and deliciously theatrical. It’s part rock history, part twisted bedtime story, part singalong and all pure entertainment.
venue_name: PBH's Free Fringe @ Fingers Piano Bar

title: Alice Fraser: Oh Man!
description: One of the Telegraph’s 50 Best Comedians of the 21st Century. She’s decided she actually quite likes men and wants to help. There are a lot of men telling men how to be, and how to optimise life, business and testosterone. Alice has been thinking about it ever since a near-near-death experience with some masculinity and has some stuff to say. Featuring a sentient Roomba and some Ancient Greek philosophy. 'Alice Fraser is a powerhouse' ***** (EdinburghGuide.com). ***** (BroadwayBaby.com).
content_warnings: Buy a ticket in advance to guarantee entry or Pay What You Want at the venue
venue_name: Monkey Barrel Comedy at O'Neill's (The Tron)

title: Alice Hawkins – Working Class Suffragette
presented_by: Great-Grandson Peter Barratt with Sister Suffragette Ruth Pownall
description: Great-grandson Peter Barratt with sister suffragette Ruth Pownall give a stirring and passionate account of working-class suffragette, Alice Hawkins, and her hard-fought campaign for the right to vote. Mother of six, lifelong socialist and shoe machinist by trade, Alice was arrested, imprisoned and almost forgotten, until now. As the UK approaches the centenary of working-class women gaining the vote, hear the suffragette history you were never taught and see her very own ‘Votes for Women’ sash, hunger strike medal, prison notes and more. Urgent, political and deeply human.**** (The Student Newspaper).

title: Alice Keys: Rocket Fan
description: Following a run of sold-out London shows, musical comedy star Alice Keys brings her one-woman Elton John sing-along romcom to Edinburgh. Expect silliness, glittering glasses and plenty of (optional) singalongs drawn from Elton's iconic back catalogue. Where will Alice's yellow brick road lead her? Will her story end happily ever after? Will her costumes fit behind the piano? Find out at Rocket Fan, 60 feel-good minutes of love, story and laughter.

title: Aliens
description: Join a real-life mother and daughter on a road trip from Donegal to southern Italy, as they weave their personal stories with those of Italian immigrants in Northern Ireland. Blending performance, video, archive testimony and live electronic music, the duo meet present-day migrants, activists and strangers along the route, asking who gets to draw the lines between us and them. Performed in English, French and Italian with integrated subtitles, Aliens is an 'ambitious, memorable piece that treats familiar themes in new, even alien ways' (Irish Times). A meditation on inheritance, migration and those who live in between: the aliens.
content_warnings: Performed in English, French and Italian with integrated subtitles.

title: Alison Kinnaird MBE – Art in Glass
description: Alison Kinnaird has an international reputation as an artist working in glass. Her work ranges from small intimate pieces to large architectural installations and is included in many important public and private collections, including the Scottish Parliament, the V&A Museum and the Royal Museums of Scotland. She combines the ancient art of wheel-engraving with the modern technology of LED lighting. This solo show is in her new studio/gallery in Edinburgh, next to Leith Library, where she can also be seen creating her detailed engravings.

title: Alison Spittle: Finger Guns (Work in Progress)
description: Winner: Comedian's Choice Award 2025 – Best Show. Winner: Dublin Fringe Award 2025 – Best Performer. As seen and heard on Ignore That Feeling, Wheel of Misfortune, Richard Osman's House of Games and Celebrity Pointless. 'Fearless – there's a wildness, honesty and charm' (Tommy Tiernan). 'Hilarious' (Rolling Stone).
content_warnings: Scenes of a sexual nature, Strong language/swearing, Buy a ticket in advance to guarantee entry or Pay What You Want at the venue

title: All Aboard the Jazz Express!
description: A high-spirited adventure from Paris to Istanbul. Join the Hot Jazz Vagabonds as they transform the dining car of the world’s most glamorous train into a whirl of hot 1930s jazz, smoky European chanson and lively post-war swing, complete with colourful characters, playful audience interaction and a nod to Agatha Christie-style intrigue. Led by singer and actress, Airlie Scott, and her live band, this stylish cabaret blends atmosphere, storytelling and irresistible rhythm in a journey for jazz lovers and curious minds alike. From the team behind five-star Fringe favourite, Paris in a Jazz Age. www.ProntoJazz.com

title: All Eyes On Us
description: University of Leeds’ hottest a cappella group, The Songsmiths, are back for their 7th year at the Fringe! After a 5-star run last year, the group’s newest endeavour All Eyes On Us tells stories of the stage, stardom and performance through the art of a cappella. Featuring outstanding original arrangements of chart-topping hits by Lady Gaga, Robbie Williams, Britney Spears and more, as well as first-class choreography, killer vocals and heaps of fun, this show is sure to be a favourite for families, musicians and music-lovers alike.

title: All Killa No Filla: Live!
presented_by: Berk's Nest in association with PBJ Management
description: For one night only, superstar stand-ups Kiri Pritchard-McLean (Have I Got News For You, QI) and Rachel Fairburn (Live at the Apollo, House of Games) bring their smash-hit true crime comedy podcast to the Fringe, following multiple sell-out shows across the UK. Never been to an All Killa No Filla live show before? There’s no revision required. Sit back and let two riotous and candid stand-ups at the top of their game guide you through an evening of horror and hilarity.
content_warnings: This show contains distressing or potentially triggering themes, strong language, references to death and violence.

title: All New Crazy Puppet Magic Show
description: Sell-out show every year! More puppets! More magic! More laughter! The perfect family show to start your day – the kids love the magic, mayhem and colourful cheeky puppets with some new furry friends to meet this year. Host, magician and puppeteer Leigh Milne is great with kids, who love getting up and being part of the fun and silly show. Booking in advance is advised as this is the best value and funniest lunchtime kids show on the Fringe. Perfect for all young ages too.

title: All Religions Explained – The Cabaret Musical
presented_by: Antony (Dr H) Hubmayer / PBH's Free Fringe
description: A joyous, piano-pounding cabaret musical where prophets rhyme, doctrines swing and we sing our way through the sacred, celebrating faith, doubt and the gloriously human comedy of belief. Join Dr H and his cast as they answer the BIG questions of life. With a storyline straight from eternity, it’s smart comedy for the soul: light-hearted, playful, yet respectful and inclusive. Think Monty Python meets Tom Lehrer and Tim Minchin, with Broadway flair, a splash of cabaret chaos, a lot of piano virtuosity and divinely funny revelations through song. Come curious – leave enlightened.

title: All Shook Up
description: Chad rolls into town, causes havoc and leads the teenagers to rebel and challenge the town authority. This Elvis musical is fast-paced, totally enjoyable and a great listen as this talented cast bring it to life! The musical includes some of Elvis’s greatest hits with fantastic harmonies and presentation as we barrel our way to its spine-tingling finale. A must-see for Elvis lovers and those that enjoy a foot-tapping musical as the lead actors weave a delightful and enjoyable storyline. A great way to spend an evening at the Fringe.
venue_name: Lower Hall at Braw Venues @ Grand Lodge

title: All-Stars Burlesque 2026
description: The ultimate go-to burlesque extravaganza at Fringe returns as part of the International Fringe Burlesque Festival. A celebration of bodies and inclusivity. Award winners, showstoppers and the hottest stars around! Appearing in the historic surroundings of the Caves. This new All-Stars Burlesque 2026 show pushes the boundaries of burlesque striptease one step further with a healthy dose of scintillating cabaret and world-renowned circus artists. With tradition, awe-generating spectacles, silliness and glamour, it's not only a great way to be introduced to burlesque but a brilliant and fun night out.
content_warnings: Audience participation, Nudity, Scenes of a sexual nature, Strong language/swearing
venue_name: Just The Tonic at The Caves

title: All the Animals: Ranked (by Comedians)
description: Everybody has opinions about animals. Some of them are funny. We’re going to attempt what Charles Darwin, David Attenborough and the Muppets have never quite managed to do: definitively rank the animals – and have a whale of a time doing it. A panel of not quite tame comedians battle it out to determine the ultimate list of the best (and worst) animals, with an ever-evolving leader board plus animal-themed interactive games. A funny panel-show spin on our furry, feathery, finny friends! From the creator of 101 Rules for a Better World (by Comedians).

title: All the Atoms in the Universe Really Made My Day
description: An astonishing ride rocketing through the greater universe from the award-winning master of one-liners and off-beat tangents. Absurd comedy accompanied by an epic score, exploring art, books, travel, perseverance and croissants. An underground sensation with music by Sachie Mikawa of Japan in an arthouse explosion about everything and everything else! 'Utterly endearing idiosyncratic geniuses' (Scotsman). 'Underground hero' ***** (TimesColonist.com). 'Brilliantly ingenious creativity' (Chortle.co.uk). 'Amazement' (Guardian). Nominee: Malcolm Hardee Award for Comic Originality, Edinburgh Fringe. Winner: Best Show, Wellington Comedy Awards. Nominee: Best Comedy, JFL Award Montreal Fringe.
venue_name: Just The Tonic at The Caves

title: All the Hits of The Beach Boys
description: The Beached Boys are back at the Fringe for a fifth consecutive year. After last year’s sell-out shows, the UK’s leading Beach Boys tribute return with a brand-new set, packed with the biggest hits from the iconic band. Whether it’s sailing on the Sloop John B, picking up some Good Vibrations or just an afternoon of Fun, Fun, Fun you’re looking for, then this is the perfect show for you. So let’s go Surfin' and book early.

title: All Tied Up
description: Within the setting of their mundane office jobs, a clumsy clown enters and disturbs the peace of the stubborn clown, causing a ruckus by playing endless games. But when tension reaches its height, in a moment of chaos the two clowns become bound together by a singular piece of rope. Now joint at the hip, the two must work together and put aside their differences to untangle themselves and return to their normal lives. Join To&Fro in a show that demands you to lose yourself in the relentlessly funny escapism of two fools.

title: Allura
description: With their stylized, signature fusion of multi-disciplinary dance and theatre, Suitcase Dance Theatre embarks on a spellbinding odyssey through a dreamy world of rhythm and movement. Tap, jazz and contemporary styles collide and intertwine, chasing human connection through shiny distractions that shimmer, mislead and seduce. Beneath the polish and pulse, the journey quietly reveals a deeper truth; the connection they seek has been there all along, hidden in plain sight. **** (Mervyn Stutter's Pick of the Fringe). **** (Edinburgh Festivals Magazine).

title: ALONE
description: On a failing spacecraft, two female astronauts fight to save Earth. This heart-racing, multi award-winning sci-fi thriller explores survival, climate change, human resilience and the silencing of female voices in STEM. As time runs out and tensions rise, this intense, captivating, heartfelt show asks: who will save our home? Winner: Best Drama, WHAT THE FRINGE?! Winner: 2025 Fringe Theatre Award. Winner: Best Theatre, Auckland Fringe. Winner: Pannz Tour Ready Award. Winner: SYNZ Tour Ready Award. 'Like nothing we've seen before' ***** (WestEndBestFriend.co.uk). ***** (AYoungishPerspective.co.uk). ***** (LondonTheatre.co.uk). **** (TheatreWeekly.com).
content_warnings: Contains distressing or potentially triggering themes, Scenes of violence, Strobe lighting, Strong language/swearing

title: Alternative Medicine
description: Alternative Medicine is an absurdist sketch comedy group hailing from New York City featuring Marty Chandler, Colleen Granberg, Brian Martin, Sofia Pastena, Katie Redden and Patrick Walsh. In 2025, they held a sold-out eight-month residency at NYC’s The PIT, and made their off-Broadway debut at The Theater Center (NYC). You can find them at major comedy clubs in NYC such as: Caveat, The PIT and Brooklyn Comedy Collective. Mr Show meets Monty Python meets a secret third thing. Alternative Medicine is written with, and produced by, Spencer Giles and directed by Jason Tyus Smith.
content_warnings: Buy a ticket in advance to guarantee entry or Pay What You Want at the venue

title: Am I Losing My Mind Or Just My Figure?
description: 'What is it about becoming thirty that gives everyone universal permission to offer advice on when you’re going to reproduce?' This Offie-nominated play tells the story of Fin, whose world shifts when she unexpectedly falls pregnant, her unconventional career as a zero-hour cycle courier and freelance illustrator suddenly colliding headlong with societal norms and expectations. Untethered + Hinterland bring their uniquely collaborative style to Edinburgh with a show that captures the millennial female zeitgeist and holds space for the quietly heavy things that shape us all.
content_warnings: Contains distressing or potentially triggering themes, Explores pregnancy loss.

title: Amadan and Mortair Kill the King
description: When two loyal guardsmen accidentally kill their king, they must scramble to set things right. This play is a rollercoaster hour of non-stop gags, demonic jesters and crab rangoon. Will our heroes make it out alive!? Probably not. Amadan and Mortair: Kill the King is the writing debut of Alex Bathe and Josh Aitken, the creatives behind the hit Dungeons & Dragons live show Tartan Tabletop.

title: Amanda Dwyer: Better Than Revenge
description: Better Than Revenge sees Glasgow’s Amanda Dwyer attempt to right every wrong ever done to her, from minor slights to full-blown criminal offences. Armed with razor-sharp punchlines and a dangerously long memory, she unpacks grudges and the art of the perfectly timed comeback. What starts as petty score-settling spirals into something sharper, smarter and unexpectedly heartfelt. She tackles a jaw-dropping revenge porn story with fearless honesty, turning fury into big, cathartic laughs. Smart, savage and gloriously self-aware, this is a riotous Fringe hour about power, payback and taking your narrative back.
content_warnings: Contains distressing or potentially triggering themes, Strong language/swearing

title: Amanda Hursy: Death of a Saleswoman (WIP)
description: A new show about masking in the corporate sales world for over 20 years and accidentally becoming a comedian – only to discover a crossover that has both saved and ruined her life. After her break-out success in her debut in 2025, join Amanda as she questions if it is too late to dare to dream as she dreads having to 'circle back'. 'Amanda is a very talented stand-up and comparisons must be made to the late, great Janey Godley' ****½ (One4Review.co.uk). 'Great Storyteller' **** (Scotsman).

title: Amazing Bangkok Thai Cookery – King Prawn Masterclass
description: Exclusive to the Edinburgh Festival Fringe and excellent for the adventurous. Cook to impress as you master three king prawn dishes in this 2-hour hands-on workshop: steamed spicy king prawns with lemongrass, hot and sour salad king prawns with glass noodles and lemongrass, and fried rice with king prawns. Learn the perfect blending techniques with Executive Thai chef, Rujira Herd, who will reveal the best-kept trade secrets she uses for her top-flight clients.

title: Amazing Bangkok Thai Cookery Workshop
description: Educational, informative, invaluable and eye-opening session. Hands-on masterclass. Understand the most effective blending techniques while using specific brands of ingredients that many people have never experienced before. Executive chef, Rujira Herd, will reveal her trade secrets and explain the essentials used by professionals in Thai kitchens. Learn how to master three delicious dishes in a very short time. Menu changes daily. Hands-on group work and demonstration. Exclusive to the Edinburgh Festival Fringe. All diets catered for – please email the cookery school with dietary requirements at least 7 days in advance of the workshop.

title: Amazing Bangkok Thai Street Food Masterclass
description: Exclusive, hands-on demonstration. Master three delicious dishes. A superb meal arouses three important senses: sight, aroma and taste. Enjoy cooking superior Thai food and Thai herbs to excite your taste buds. Executive Thai chef Rujira Herd will reveal the best-kept trade secrets she uses for her top-flight clients. You will learn perfect blending techniques. Excellent for the adventurous. Menu changes daily: pork, chicken or egg. Please advise the cookery school if you are a repeat customer and/or have any dietary requirements at least seven days in advance of the workshop. Age 12+ restriction.

title: Amazing Bangkok Vegan Street Food Masterclass
description: Cook with plant-based ingredients and create full flavour with plenty of nutrition for good health. Learn how to cook delicious vegan Thai food and take your cooking skills to the next level in this hands-on demonstration. You'll master three delicious vegan dishes as executive Thai chef, Rujira Herd, reveals her best-kept trade secrets and teaches you the perfect blending techniques. Excellent for the adventurous – enjoy cooking superior vegan Thai food with Thai herbs to excite your taste buds. Menu changes daily and all diets can be catered for. Age 12+ restriction.
content_warnings: Audience will be standing throughout, If you are under 18, have dietary requirements, or have done the workshop before, please email contact@kruathai.co.uk at least 3 days before. No wheelchair access. No level access. Must book by 21:00 the day prior.

title: Amazing Bubble Man
description: Louis Pearl has been thrilling audiences worldwide for over 30 years with the art, magic, science and fun of bubbles. An Edinburgh Fringe favourite, he has sold out for the last 14 years. Louis explores the breathtaking dynamics of bubbles, combining comedy and artistry with audience participation and enough spellbinding bubble tricks to keep everyone mesmerised. From square bubbles to rocket bubbles, the Amazing Bubble Man conjures shrieks of laughter and gasps of amazement from all ages.

title: Amazing Chicken Pad Thai Masterclass
description: Pad Thai. The legendary and the best. The world-famous noodle dish from Thailand. Pad Thai is not just noodles, beansprouts and peanuts as you've experienced, there are many more ingredients than those. Executive Thai chef, Rujira Herd, will reveal the trade secrets she uses for her top-flight clients. Learn essential blending techniques and the key ingredients used to complement the flavour including dried prawns, bean curd, preserved mooli, palm sugar and Thai chives. Make superior Pad Thai professionally in this hands-on demonstration. All diets catered for: email contact@kruathai.co.uk with dietary requirements three days in advance.
content_warnings: Audience will be standing throughout, If you are under 18, have dietary requirements, or have done the workshop before, please email contact@kruathai.co.uk at least 3 days before. No wheelchair access. No level access. Must book by 21:00 the day prior.

title: Amazing Family Comedy Bingo: Prizes Galore!
description: It's bingo with loads and loads of prizes. You get two bingo tickets as part of your entry. If you bring a wrapped prize, you get another ticket. Take your seats, get your dabber ready and let the winning begin. Jes is your game show host. He has crazy bingo variations like you've never seen before. Let's take the excitement through the roof! Oh, did I mention that there are loads of prizes? Just saying, because there are loads of prizes.

title: Amazing Two Curries – Red Curry and Panang Masterclass
description: Exclusive to the Edinburgh Festival Fringe, learn how to make amazing chicken curry dishes in this hands-on demonstration. Join a spectacularly entertaining cookery workshop where executive chef, Rujira Herd will reveal the blending techniques she uses for her top-flight clients. Learn how to make delicious dishes and the most effective way to create a traditional curry from 24 ingredients, a chilli fish sauce accompanying dish and how to make curry paste. Meal and recipes included. Please advise the cookery school of special diets at least three days in advance.
content_warnings: Audience will be standing throughout, If you are under 18, have dietary requirements, or have done the workshop before, please email contact@kruathai.co.uk at least 3 days before. No wheelchair access. No level access. Must book by 21:00 the day prior.

title: Amelia Hamilton: Moral Support
description: Amelia Hamilton, 'the rapping comic you instantly adore' ***** (One4Review.co.uk) and 2025 ISH Edinburgh Comedy Awards Best Newcomer winner, returns with Moral Support – a show that is unpredictable, sharp and surprising at every turn. Featured on BBC Radio 4 and BBC iPlayer, Hamilton skewers modern morality, joyfully dismantling everything from bad men with excellent manners to competitive happiness, gravedigging's inevitable rebrand and why we should absolutely re-stigmatise mental health.
