Gaffney grew up on Irish farms where the hardcore Irish ways of GAA, religion and drinking were instilled in him from an early age. A life of mad events and crazy Irish characters, his debut headline show The Full Gaffney sees him describe, rant, shout and laugh at his life as a 28 year-old "redneck culchie" from Ireland's quiet yet mental countryside. Sold-out solo run at Whelan's, Ireland.

title: Darren McGarvey: Performative Male
presented_by: Darren McGarvey / Vivienne Clore Artist Management
description: Performative Male is a sharp, darkly funny examination of modern masculinity. Darren McGarvey dissects the scripts men inherit – toughness, certainty, status – and what happens when the promised rewards never arrive. From working class boyhood to public moral display, he explores how masculinity mutates under pressure, online scrutiny and economic decline. This is neither confessional nor sermon. It is a clear-eyed interrogation of performance itself: how men learn the role, cling to it when it falters and sometimes choose to change. Challenging, humane and unsentimental, Performative Male rejects easy villains, easy virtue and easy redemption.
content_warnings: Contains distressing or potentially triggering themes

title: Darren Walsh: It's a Quarter Tutu
description: Join award-winning punslinger Darren Walsh, creator of the Jokes on the Street series you may have seen on social media, as he road-tests jokes, silly songs and visuals. Please don't come if you don't like puns. Jokes like: Saw a yacht with a sold sign on its mast. Before that, it was for sail. And: Did a gig with a jewel thief. They put him on first. Safe opener. That kind of thing. ‘Punbelievable!’ ***** (Mirror). Winner: Joke of the Edinburgh Fringe; Winner: Joke of the Leicester Comedy Festival.

title: Darryl J Carrington: Out of the Box
description: Out of the Box is a multi award-winning family show delighting audiences across the UK; an hour of joyful chaos, jaw-dropping skill and irresistible fun. Named Best Family Show at Brighton Fringe, Darryl J Carrington transforms everyday objects into extraordinary adventures. A toothbrush stars in a balancing act, a string sparks a heist and a tea party lands on someone's head! With over 20 years of circus and clowning experience, Darryl's silent comedy blends world-class juggling, inventive physical theatre and heart-warming audience interaction. His humour transcends age and language.

title: Darryl J Carrington: Tennish
description: Darryl J Carrington is a physical comedian and mostly non-verbal clown who loves messing around with objects, timing and visual gags. His last show, Out of the Box, won multiple awards with critics calling it utterly absorbing, charming and great fun. People loved how he connected with audiences using nothing but inventive physical comedy. Tennish starts as a tennis show but quickly goes off-court as Darryl discovers what he can do with tennis props – turning rackets, balls and towels into instruments, obstacles and punchlines. It's playful, chaotic, visual and all about ambition, performance, and failure.

title: Daughter of Sweden – That One Princess Who Got Drunk with Lizzie I and Thrown Out of England
presented_by: Teater Kaleido, By/With: Cecilia Säverman, Director: Judith Hollander
description: Award-winning one-woman show, bringing royal scandal and the high seas to life. When Sweden's 19-year-old Princess Cecilia Vasa is caught with a lover in 1559, Europe thinks the scandal will tame the harlot. But Cecilia is just getting started. Condemned, filthy rich and yearning for freedom, she enters Renaissance Europe where war, chastity and men rule. Could friendship with Queen Elizabeth I of England grant her the independence she craves – or why not a life of piracy? Translated into English.

title: Dave Chawner: Dry Humour
description: Dave is getting older. Everyone is. Now sober, he's worried about being beige. A sharp, self-deprecating look at ageing, outlook and identity. As seen on BBC, ITV and Channel 5. Heard on BBC Radio 1, BBC Radio 2 and BBC Radio 4. ***** (VoiceMag.uk). ***** (BunburyMagazine.com). **** (List). **** (Fest). **** (ThreeWeeks). **** (BroadwayBaby.com). **** (BroadwayWorld.com). **** (TheWeeReview.com).

title: Dave Durkan: Durk in Progress
description: He's the #1 'young sketch comedian to watch' (Telegraph). He has over 400 million views on social media. He is one half of Durk & Ski. He is 'very funny and genuinely gripping' (Telegraph). He is 'frantic, innovative, effortlessly likeable' (LeftLion). He's going to bring some NEW characters, sketches, jokes, videos and zingers for you. You don't have to bring anything (apart from your laughs haha... okay cheers, Dave).

title: Dave Reubens – Magic Survival Guide
description: Magician Dave Reubens shows how to tackle the chaos of modern life using magic. From crazy life hacks to escaping tricky situations, expect astonishing magic and mischievous humour. As seen on the BBC. Featured on TV show Today Tonight in Adelaide. Top 6 Fringe Picks (Sunday Mail, Adelaide).

title: David Alnwick: Magician. Not Creepy.
description: Praise for past shows: 'Inspired... beautifully creepy' (Guardian). 'A Fringe institution... high energy comedy magic' ***** (WorldMagicReview.com). ***** (The Student). ****½ (Fringesider.com). **** (Skinny). **** (FringeGuru.com). ‘Extremely funny’ **** (DeadlineNews.co.uk). 'Gobsmackingly brilliant' (Scotsman). A comedy magic show.

title: David Alnwick: Objectively the Best Magician
description: 15-year Edinburgh Fringe veteran David Alnwick returns with a fast-paced, hilarious magic show. 'The most spontaneously funny magician on the Fringe' (BroadwayBaby.com). 'Alnwick is wildly, ridiculously popular... Incredible.' ***** (WorldMagicReview.com). ***** (Suitcase Monkey). ***** (The Student). 'Awesome' **** (Skinny). **** (FringeGuru.com). 'Extremely funny and perfectly charming' **** (DeadlineNews.co.uk).

title: David Alnwick: The Haunted Magician
description: A magic show that tells a ghost story. Praise for past work: ‘Inspired… Beautifully creepy’ (Guardian). ‘Nerve-shredding for the sold-out crowd’ (Scotsman). ‘An absolute must see for horror fans’ ***** (WorldMagicReview.com). ‘From Alnwick’s brilliant delivery, to the seamless blend of horror and humour, this show was highly impressive and unlike anything I have ever seen’ ***** (The Student). ***** (ThreeWeeks). ****½ (Fringesider). ‘Creates horror and suspense through theatre magic’ **** (BingeFringe.com).

title: David Correos: Noise Zealand
presented_by: IAM in association with Century and Notorious
description: David here! This is the perfect late-night event for you! End your Edinburgh day with me!! Your brain’s gonna melt out of your ears. If you’re still reading this get a ticket cause these words are only the beginning of the adventure!! I’ve made a comedy rave that blends my favourite tracks to dance to with chaos that I’ve been honing in Aus and NZ over the past two years. This show has some of my favourite bits I’ve made to date. I learned how to DJ for this... and also magic. Come come come.
content_warnings: Audience participation, Strong language/swearing, Buy a ticket in advance to guarantee entry or Pay What You Want at the venue
venue_name: Monkey Barrel Comedy at O'Neill's (The Tron)

title: David Elms Describes a Room
presented_by: Celia Dugua and Berk's Nest in association with PBJ
description: Following last year's sell-out run, the critically acclaimed cult hit show returns. Together with his audience, veteran improviser Elms builds a comedy mind palace before your very eyes. 'David's very clever. He's made a show that's funny, original and different every time' (Tim Key). 'A lesson in the transcendent power of collective imagining' **** (Guardian). 'A strikingly impressive feat of memory, world-building and forging of communal purpose' **** (List). 'A real triumph of the human imagination' **** (Skinny). 'One of the most original and artistic comedy shows on the fringe' **** (Chortle.co.uk).

title: David Hoare: How To Live To 100
description: Musical-One-Liner-Stand-Up Comedian David Hoare (aged 37) will teach you how to live to 100! The award winning Hoare brings his rude songs, stupid jokes and insightful expertise to the Fringe. Winner of Musical Comedy Awards 2021 Audience Favourite Award, Sold Out Run Fringe 2022 and tour support for Alison Spittle, Mark Nelson, Lauren Pattison and Dr Ed Patrick! 'An annoyingly funny young man' (Gary Delaney). 'David has that magic combination of quick wit and observational insight' (EdFringeReview.com). 'With some slick one-liners and aggression akin to Bo Burnham, James Acaster or Tim Vine' (Deadline.com).

title: David O'Doherty: At This Stage
description: An evening of low-voltage song and chatter from the increasingly dishevelled Lidl Bruno Mars. In addition to his comedy and not being Chris O’Dowd, David co-hosts the What Did You Do Yesterday? podcast. He is sometimes on television.

title: David Tsonos: Club Comedian
description: Now with 25 years of stand-up comedy under his belt, Canadian David Tsonos is doing it by himself. He will be a one-man comedy club in which he is the compere, the opening act and the headliner. No sad stories, no uplifting tales, just straight stand-up comedy club style humour. David has not only performed stand-up but has studied it, and will bring his years of experience to the show and make sure you come out still laughing.

title: David William Bryan Dies On Stage
description: I, David William Bryan, present a brand new hour of stand-up. Am I gonna die on stage? Almost certainly, yes. Should you come along and watch it happen? Yes. You think this is a joke, but it isn't. I have no idea what I'm doing. If you know any jokes, please bring them with you. An hour is a long time. See you there. Bring your low expectations. Excited? Don't be. Multi-year Edinburgh Fringe sell-out. 50+ professional five-star reviews for solo work. 'A tour de force' (Scotsman).
content_warnings: Contains distressing or potentially triggering themes, Strong language/swearing
venue_name: Just The Tonic at The Caves

title: David William Bryan – In Loyal Company
description: The incredible true story of missing WWII soldier Arthur Robinson, written and performed by his great-nephew David William Bryan. May 1941. Hitler's bombs rain down on Liverpool. Local packer, Arthur Robinson, joins up becoming a private in the 18th reconnaissance division. Deployed to Singapore where his ship is destroyed by Japanese dive bombers on arrival, Arthur is declared missing. This extraordinary true story of survival is a one-man tour-de-force war epic. Important warning – this is the final chance to see David perform this multiyear sell-out show.
content_warnings: This show will contain references and depictions of war.

title: Davina Bentley: Dancing While Old
description: Featured in The Telegraph's Five Young Sketch Comedians to Watch and with 1.7m likes online for her viral parodies, Davina makes her Edinburgh Festival Fringe debut at only 37 (aka 42). Davina's doing what she swore she never would: getting older and talking about it. A debut about raging against the dying of the light, in the face of crushing middle age. Writer for Dead Ringers, DM's are Open, News Quiz, and sketches featured on BBC Radio 1, BBC Radio 4 and Dazed & Confused. 'We bloody love this' (Emily Maitlis). 'LOL' (Lily Allen).

title: Davro's Back! Bobby Davro
description: Davro's Back! Comedy legend Davro returns with another hour of jokes, impressions and songs in the feel-good show of the Fringe! Davro has been performing for 50 years with his own TV series and appearances on 100s of programmes. A consummate professional, this 75-minute show is now the highlight of the Fringe – joke after joke with proper belly laughs, he leaves the audience on their feet demanding more, night after night. Book early to avoid disappointment. Not for the easily offended.

title: Day of the Locust
description: The sun is hot. The air is dry. You have come to California to die. Award winning multi-instrumentalist and Pleasance stalwart storyteller Callum Patrick Hughes rips apart Nathanael West's 1930's Great American Novel, rebuilding it with loop pedals, guitar drones and a soundscape of broken dreams and fading stardom. The burning city of Hollwood's Golden Age collides with US contemporary chaos in a production described as part adaptation, part riot, part protest song. Presented by multi WhatsOnStage Award-nominated Fake Escape as part of their Decade of Fringe season.
content_warnings: This show contains strong language, references to civil unrest, immigration enforcement and group violence

title: Daydreams
description: It's 3am. The phone glows. The feed is insatiable. Sleep doesn't come. From the producer of Mother Has Arrived (The Stage's Top 50 shows of 2025). Daydreams locks you into a sleepless loop where headlines and half-dreams collide. A solo performer carries the night through spoken thoughts and a body that can't rest. 3D projection fractures the space into flickers, scrolls and sudden images. An ominous soundscape swells and distorts, turning notifications and breath into a tightening pulse. Dark humour cuts at the edge of collapse. By morning, you're still awake. Three coffees should do it, right?
content_warnings: Strobe lighting, Haze, Contains distressing or potentially triggering themes, Strong language/swearing

title: Dead Wrong
description: Dead Wrong is a gripping psychological thriller that pulls audiences into the aftermath of a night that may have ended in murder. Best friends Fiadh and Nolan have disappeared, hiding from the world and from the truth of what really happened. As fear tightens and outside pressure creeps closer, their bond is tested by suspicion, manipulation, and moral compromise. What begins as unwavering loyalty slowly fractures, forcing Nolan to question whether standing by the person he loves most is an act of devotion, or a dangerous refusal to see the truth.
content_warnings: Contains distressing or potentially triggering themes, Scenes of violence, Strong language/swearing

title: Deage Paxton: Immature
description: 'Inappropriately funny but we love it!' (The Stand Comedy Club). Circuit veteran Deage Paxton brings his high-octane punchlines back to the Fringe. Rejecting polite anecdotes, the "Geordie Adam Sandler" delivers a show Chortle.co.uk describes as 'steeped in juvenility' that 'sorely tests' the boundaries of taste. Kate Copstick (Scotsman) notes Paxton is an 'engaging presence' with 'energy that never flags.' From 'pitch-black' observations (@EdinburghEye) to 'brazen, bizarre, and brilliant' (One4Review.co.uk) routines, this is unmissable stand-up. For visceral laughter that ignores the rules of decorum, look no further. This is unapologetically immature.

title: Dean Friedman – Songs for Grownups
description: Every song a classic! Hailed by critics and fans alike as one of the finest songwriters of his generation, Friedman has achieved legendary, pop-icon status for chart-topping hits: Ariel, Lucky Stars, Lydia, Woman of Mine, Rocking Chair, McDonald’s Girl and more. Catch this legendary singer/songwriter for an unforgettable evening of funny, poignant, heartfelt stories and songs. Two nights only! 'The soundtrack of our lives!' (New York Times). 'Dean Friedman is entirely unique and utterly brilliant' (ThreeWeeks). 'One of the true greats of American music' (LiverpoolSoundandVision.co.uk).

title: Dear Emily
description: Dear Emily is a musical letter for everyone still finding their voice. Returning to the Fringe for a fourth year, Beyond the Blue present their brand-new show, an evocative and poignant collection of songs inspired by the timeless poetry of Emily Dickinson. Through original music, they explore the themes we all know so well: the ache of solitude, the power of hope and the courage it takes to be heard. This is a musical mirror – a mixture of storytelling intertwined with captivating songs, where 19th-century verse meets modern heartbeat.

title: Dear Evan Hansen
description: A Fringe premiere! Dear Evan Hansen is a deeply moving, contemporary musical about anxiety, connection and the search for belonging. Featuring unforgettable songs and emotional storytelling, it follows a teenager whose small lie spirals into something life-changing. Honest, heart-wrenching and hopeful, the show reminds us that even the most isolated voices deserve to be heard. Audiences laugh, cry and leave changed. Captivate Theatre is a local, vibrant, community-driven theatre company known for producing high-quality, engaging performances.

title: Dear Michelle Kwan
description: Set in the early 2010s, four teen figure skaters rehearse for their annual holiday show, led by their bizarre and obsessive coach. They pray to Michelle Kwan, their god, for guidance. In the locker room, the girls navigate friend drama, twerking and IBS. When a blizzard traps them in the ice rink, reality warps. Their prayers to Michelle Kwan turn into violent rituals and life becomes a never-ending rehearsal... a never-ending ritual. A dark comedy about the beauty, violence and camaraderie of girlhood in hyper-competitive spaces.
content_warnings: Contains distressing or potentially triggering themes, Scenes of violence, Strong language/swearing

title: Deckhand
presented_by: Spinelly Productions and Los Angeles Theatre Initiative
description: Joseph, an abrasive pushing-40 talent agent, is awoken in the middle of the night to a call from his top-billing client – she’s on Catalina Island for a photoshoot without any of her wardrobe or glam. Joseph arrives at the dock ready to set sail but waits on one last thing: his assistant Fiona. Join Joseph and Fiona as they embark on a tumultuous journey aboard a failing speedboat in this comedic look at the divide between agent and assistant. Fresh off a sell-out run in Los Angeles, Deckhand makes its Edinburgh Fringe debut!
content_warnings: Contains distressing or potentially triggering themes, Scenes of violence, Strong language/swearing

title: Dee Allum: Raumdeuter
description: Football is, of course, gay. Common knowledge, but important, nonetheless. But could it also be – transgender? In a show about mortality, transformation and genitals, comedian Dee Allum asks the big questions. What is purpose? Who is Britain? And why pick a show title that people won't understand? Some of these questions will be answered in this sophomore stand-up show following Dee's award-nominated debut Deadname. 'More than impressive; it's damn near perfect' ***** (EdFringeReview.com). 'Told with panache, charm, self-deprecation and copious wit' **** (Times). **** (BingeFringe.com).

title: DeepFake
description: You are the Head of Public Relations at MirrorMinds.ai, a company preparing for the launch of their newest product that allows anyone to create fake videos that look perfectly real. As sole audience member and active participant in this immersive theatrical experience, you will video chat with co-workers, investigate the materials in your office and argue for your own perspective on the appropriate use of AI. It's up to you to make this launch a success... or not. Part puzzle room, part quiet horror story.

title: Deirdre O’Kane – Work in Progress
presented_by: Deirdre O'Kane / Blue Book Artist Management
description: A chance to see Deirdre in creative mode. A work in progress show where you can see new jokes in their infancy as she refines the next chapter of her stand-up. Loose, lively and full of surprises. From The Deirdre O’Kane Show, Last One Laughing Ireland, QI, Gogglebox Ireland, Richard Osman’s House Of Games and Moone Boy.

title: Deluge
description: A comic exploration of grief, inspired by a break-up and over 40 interviews gathered via a social media call-out. In the wake of a relationship, a woman tries to contain the overflow of her thoughts…She ends up stuck in a ladder, fighting against komodo dragons, house leaks, holes and jam jars that only seem to multiply. Deluge puts a magic realist spin on dealing with and overcoming grief. Blurring imagination with real stories by invoking a surreal, tender and humorous dreamscape. ‘Intense physicality and irresistible charm’ **** (BritishTheatreGuide.info). ‘Incredibly beautifully written’ **** (TheSpyInTheStalls.com). ****½ (AYoungishPerspective.co.uk).

title: Delusions and Grandeur
description: 'Comic timing as impeccable as her playing' (Everything-Theatre.co.uk). Genre-blurring jester and cellist Karen Hall peels back the layers of formality leaving you with only the humanity and insanity of the artist behind the instrument. And yourself. Featuring Suite Number One in G Major by JS Bach and personal comedic pieces crafted in idiot classes, Karen fuses in a healthy dose of pathos tackling identity, expectations and success through the eyes of a fool. Winner: FringeReview.co.uk's Edinburgh Fringe 2025 Outstanding Theatre Award.

title: Democrazy
description: From the company behind The Italians in England comes an extraordinary tale about democracy and dictatorship, told through Balinese mask, music and physical theatre with Edoardo Vanoni and Denis Haugh. Cycling through the countryside of a tropical island, an Italian tourist loses his way when his phone battery dies. He enters the home of an old mask maker and from then on a remarkable political story unfolds. This play explores the lure of populism and the common traits shared by dictators, reflecting the political realities shaping our world today. The show is dedicated to Alexei Navalny.
content_warnings: Show includes mimed representations of war

title: Derek Smith Sings The Blues
description: Following successful solo-shows in 2023, 2024 and 2025, Scottish blues singer-songwriter and guitarist, Derek Smith (Main Street Blues and Whisky Road), returns to the Jazz Bar to perform his latest solo, up-tempo, foot stomping, acoustic blues and roots show. Packed with a great mix of blues classics, ranging from Robert Johnson, Albert King, Jimmy Rogers, Freddy King, Sonny Boy Williamson, BB King and more, plus a great selection of rearranged blues originals taken from his Main Street Blues band's albums and new acoustic blues projects. Audience Reviews: 'Brilliant live show', 'Great voice', 'Highly entertaining'.

title: Detective Heartbreak
description: Detective Heartbreak, a detective trained in solving the mysteries and complexities of love and desire, tackles what might just be his most unsolvable case yet: why did Connor's Hinge date leave him on read? An offbeat detective parody tackling some of the biggest problems in the modern world; clowns, magicians and... dating apps!

title: Devin Gray: Golden Retriever Energy
description: Golden Retriever Energy is Devin Gray’s third consecutive show at the Edinburgh Festival Fringe – and it sees him evolve his comedy while doubling down on everything audiences already love. Known for his relentlessly high energy performances, tight punchlines and onstage presence, Devin returns with a show that’s sharper, more self aware and more personal than ever.

title: Diary of a Mad Man
description: Diary of a Mad Man is a darkly comic one-man drama tracing the psychological collapse of a corporate worker whose status craving mutates into obsession. Adapted from Nikolai Gogol and relocated to contemporary Ireland, the play immerses us inside a mind where professional failure breeds paranoia, rage and terrifying logic. Consumed by race, hierarchy and fixation on his CEO’s daughter, his inner voice grows seductive, persuasive and lethal. As reality fractures, the audience becomes trapped inside his reasoning, forced to confront how ambition corrodes identity and madness feels disturbingly justified, dark, funny and deeply unsettling.
content_warnings: Contains distressing or potentially triggering themes, Strong language/swearing.

title: Did You Charge Your Phone for the End of the World?
description: The year is 2034. A city-demolishing asteroid is heading for Brooklyn. The government refuses to alert the public of the impending catastrophe until a boutique advertising agency can come up with a positive rebrand for the calamitous asteroid.
content_warnings: Strong language/swearing, Buy a ticket in advance to guarantee entry or Pay What You Want at the venue

title: Disciples of Anatomy
description: 1848. London’s surgical golden age. A parlour room. Cassandra Thwaite has misplaced her new husband, Adelaide Hall wants out of the countryside and Maud Flemming is pining to go back. Three women, the wives of eminent medical men, endure an excruciating afternoon tea as the table is set for calamity. Tense, darkly funny and true to life, Disciples of Anatomy champions Autistic-led theatre through its protagonist Maud, the first neurodivergent heroine in a period drama. Anatomy is a nasty business, and if the past won’t stay dead, you might as well dig it up again...
content_warnings: Scenes of violence, Strong language/swearing, Contains distressing or potentially triggering themes, Buy a ticket in advance to guarantee entry or Pay What You Want at the venue

title: Disenchanted! The Hit Musical
presented_by: The Production Garden presents The Lichfield Garrick Production
description: The hilarious hit musical with more bite, more sass and zero damsels in distress. Forget happily ever after! Cinderella's done cleaning, Sleeping Beauty's wide awake and Snow White's calling the shots now. These princesses don't want to play nice; they want to storm the castle! One showstopping number at a time. Disenchanted! is the side-splitting, cheeky, musical mash-up of all your favourite fairy tales. If you're looking to let your hair down, take a magic carpet ride or maybe kiss a frog or two, Disenchanted! is the night out you didn't know you desperately needed.
content_warnings: This show contains strobe lighting and strong language.

title: Disney's The Jungle Book Kids
description: Mowgli bounds through the jungle and learns what it means to be human. This production has a host of colourful characters and your favourite jumpin' beats from the film.
content_warnings: Buy a ticket in advance to guarantee entry or Pay What You Want at the venue

title: Ditko
description: In the Spring of 1966, Marvel Comics were on a roll. Every series they produced was a hit. The Fantastic Four, The Incredible Hulk, The X-Men, you name it. But above them all, their best seller was The Amazing Spider-Man, the co-creation of writer Stan "The Man" Lee, and artist "Sturdy" Steve Ditko. So what happens when Steve shows up at Stan's office to quit the company for good? Well, Stan decides to lock the pair inside and learn the real reason why Ditko wants out. Face front, True Believers – this one's gonna be spectacular!
venue_name: Just The Tonic at The Mash House

title: Diva Las Vegas
description: The Sundaes (BBC One's All Together Now finalists) are back at the Fringe with their sell-out show, Diva Las Vegas – a scoop-tacular cabaret treat served for a short, sweet run of just nine dates. Get ready for a triple helping of powerhouse vocals, comedy and diva hits from legends like Diana Ross, Tina Turner, Celine Dion, Shirley Bassey and more. With silky-smooth harmonies, sprinkles of comedy, and lashings of Vegas glamour, this show is the cherry on top of your Fringe experience. Don’t miss your chance before it melts away! It's like Vegas without the jetlag!

title: DIVAS: From Stage To Screen
description: The DIVAS are back... bigger, better and beltier! The five-star production is back for 2026 with a cast of professional singers and live band to celebrate some of the greatest DIVAS of all time from music, movies and musical theatre. From Carole King to Cher, Raye to Reba McEntire, and Sabrina Carpenter to Shirley Bassey, there will be something for everyone in this high-energy, fast-paced show. Winner of Best Theatre Production (TheatreScotland.co.uk, 2022 and 2023). 'A professionally executed show and a great way for a music-lover of any age to spend an hour' (Broadway.com).

title: Divas of Soul
description: Following the success of Divas of Jazz, we return with an evening celebrating the voices that have shaped soul music across generations. Tracing the journey from roots to the present day, this stunning show weaves iconic songs with engaging stories. Expect a carefully crafted blend of classic soul and modern favourites, revealing how the genre continues to evolve and inspire. Elegant and intimate, this beautifully curated show offers a pause from the frenetic Fringe. Rich with soul, stories and irresistible groove!

title: Django Reinhardt's Hot Club Jazz Meets Scottish Folk
description: Vibrant hot club jazz laced with Celtic spirit from the treasure trove of Scotland’s musical heritage. 'Thrilling collision of styles... an irresistible sound that is both technically brilliant and infectiously joyous, guaranteed to get feet tapping' (Celtic Connections). All three shows at Fringe 2025 sold out. Celtic Connections and Aberdeen Jazz Festival 2026 sold out. Comprising some of Scotland's finest gypsy jazz and folk musicians. Hot club jazz meets folk, creating a unique musical experience. Paul Paterson, John Carnie, Jim Mackay guitars, Martin MacLeod fiddle and Charlotte Patterson double bass.

title: Do Better: A Dramagedy
description: 'Side-splittingly humorous, completely confounding, and absolutely heart-rending' (Audience Review). Do Better is a one-person comedic drama with magic (a Dramagedy) that explores how we navigate life after unwavering grief. After experiencing unimaginable loss at 10 years old, the only way forward was to laugh through the pain and do a card trick. In essence, this is how we Do Better. Written and performed by Izzy Salant, directed by Peyton Ashby, produced by SpotCorp Events.
content_warnings: Audience participation, Contains distressing or potentially triggering themes, Strong language/swearing

title: Do the Thing: Choose Your Own Musical
description: Where is it set? Who is it about? What is the plot? You tell us. Get the fully improvised musical you want to see, brought to you by a cast of two (Tim Meredith and Simon Plotkin from Stellar Firma) and an orchestra of one (Ian Scott). Be careful what you wish for as things can and will get very silly indeed. 'Must see musical madness' ****½ (TheReviewsHub.com). 'A whale of a time' (Chortle.co.uk). 'Belly achingly funny... My only complaint is that it was too short' (VoiceMag.uk).

title: Do You Wanna Go?
description: Join David Nehls, composer / lyricist of The Great American Trailer Park Musical, as he presents his newest and most personal show to date. Do You Wanna Go? is a wildly funny, oh-so-gay, one-man musical odyssey that tells a raucous, yet intimate story of a romantic adventure that took place on an unexpected vacation to Greece in the mid 1990s. All original music from rock and blues to ballads, it’s like Shirley Valentine on steroids. From New York to Denver, Key West to St Louis, Do You Wanna Go? has been a sold-out, crowd pleasing show.
content_warnings: Audience participation, Scenes of a sexual nature, Strong language/swearing, Buy a ticket in advance to guarantee entry or Pay What You Want at the venue

title: Does the Oracle Speak Truth?
description: Modern day worshippers seek answers from the Oracle – the speaker of gods – to help them through their past, present and future. But how long will this support last?
content_warnings: Contains distressing or potentially triggering themes

title: Doktor Kaboom and the Wheel of Science!
presented_by: Doktor K Worldwide / Suzanna Rosenthal Productions
description: So much science, so little time. Doktor Kaboom is back with all his favourite, fun-packed science experiments, but there's too many for one show. The solution: The Wheel of Science! Spin the wheel, wherever it stops, that happens next! Will we fly across the stage on a homemade hovercraft, create a gigantic chemical reaction, or catapult bananas across stage? No two shows are the same, so step right up and let's spin that wheel! Back for a fifth year, don't miss this spectacular hour of 'perfect family entertainment' (POWShowbiz.com).
content_warnings: This show will contain audience participation and real science experiments on stage.

title: Dom McGovern: Prize Hog
description: Have you ever felt like the ugliest person at a party, but still the most beautiful girl in the world? Join Dom McGovern, the rising stand-up star cursed with the caustic wit of an old Noel Coward and the self esteem of a young Princess Diana, for his hotly anticipated debut show about bodies, blokes and b'something else. 'Endlessly entertaining and outrageously funny' (Rolling Stone). 'Bloody brilliant' (Rosie Jones). 'Gaggy' (Chortle.co.uk). Co-writer for Chicken Shop Date. Tour support for Sophie Duker, Olga Koch and Urooj Ashfaq. BBC New Comedy Awards.
content_warnings: This show contains references to disordered eating, body dysmorphia and homophobia.

title: Don Quixote (Is a Very Big Book)
presented_by: Opposable Thumb Theatre and Nordland Visual Theatre
description: Dik Downey's mid-life crisis crashes headlong into Don Quixote's crazed delusions. With a rogue's gallery of puppets and desperate clowning, Quixote embarks on surreal, comic misadventures with sidekick Sancho Panza and decrepit horse, Rocinante. Dik fights to make this huge novel joyous to a contemporary audience. But as Quixote chases impossible dreams, Dik faces his own dwindling relevance and mortality. A laugh-out-loud international co-production on the indignities of fighting the inevitable. 'Show of the year... so funny that your face will hurt' (Bristol247.com) 'Slapstick comedy and touching vulnerability... outstanding' (Scotsman).
content_warnings: This show contains a very small amount of undemanding audience participation

title: Don't know? Have a go!
description: Where do forgotten memories go? What’s the meaning of life? Why is this so hard to answer? Don't know? Well lets have a go! Welcome back for one last time to everyone's favourite quiz show. One lucky contestant will trudge through the trials of the evening in an attempt to enter The Tunnel of Mystery. Fast Snail Productions invites you to their brand new one man show that explores the power of memory, the pressures of living and the hope that love and music can give us. You won’t want to forget this!
content_warnings: Contains distressing or potentially triggering themes, Strobe lighting, Strong language/swearing

title: Don’t Rain on My Parade!
description: Don’t Rain on My Parade is a bold, hilarious and heartfelt 50-minute cabaret-theatre show starring award-winning Highland icon Miss Lossie Mouth. Featuring hit songs from stage and screen, razor-sharp comedy and moments of moving honesty, it tells the story of a boy who loved a fabulous dress and grew up under Section 28 – turning shame into sequins. With council-estate courage, queer resilience and gloriously camp theatricality, Miss Lossie Mouth celebrates identity, survival and sparkle in an uplifting show packed with heart, humour and powerhouse diva spirit.

title: Don't Wait For Me... – France Showcase
description: In a world where houses grow legs, wings or sails, and travel at night, one morning a house disappears – leaving its child behind. A tender and poetic quest begins to rediscover what home truly means. Through delicate glove puppetry and gently animated images, Don’t Wait for Me... unfolds as a dreamlike journey about loss, hope and belonging. Objects breathe, drawings come alive and the visible meets the invisible with quiet sincerity. Deeply human and emotionally resonant, the piece speaks across generations – a cross-cultural work designed to travel beyond borders.

title: Don't You Forget About Me
description: A Brain, An Athlete, A Basket Case, A Princess and a Criminal all walk into detention one 1985 Saturday morning. You know the story. Or so you thought... Forty years later, the forgotten sixth student hosts a reunion and we're all invited. Part homage, part identity crisis, this sharp, witty, nostalgic love letter to John Hughes' iconic 1980s film is dedicated to anyone who ever wished life felt more like the movies. WhatsOnStage Award nominated Fringe favourites Fake Escape present Don't You Forget About Me as part of their Decade of Fringe season.

title: Doom and Glitter: A Tribute To Tom Waits
presented_by: Mr Brake Down / PBH’s Free Fringe
description: In its fifth year at Fringe, return to the bluesy banter and iconic sound of Mr Brake Down’s incredible live band. Exploring the wit, wisdom and unstoppable force of eccentric cult icon Tom Waits, this award-winning live music experience gathers the outcasts, oddities and visionaries for a soulful fever-dream that runs the gamut of human emotion. Gloriously odd and experimental, the show takes audiences on a melodic journey through Waits' seminal works, where you get to be part of the music and enjoy special guests from the world of drag and burlesque.
content_warnings: Audience participation, Nudity, Strong language/swearing, Partial nudity in the form of burlesque performances

title: Doris, Dolly and the Dressing Room Divas
description: Secrets, songs and love lives of five legendary divas! Three make-up girls bitch, compete, harmonise and laugh as they entertain us with hilarious, heartbreaking, irreverent tales from the dressing rooms of Dolly, Doris, Judy, Liza and the filthiest Julie Andrews ever to grace the boards. Starring Gail Watson and featuring stories of backstage mammas, absent fathers, gay husbands, flunked auditions and sublime singing. 'Witty, impressive, rapturous' ***** (Herald). 'A wonderful night at the theatre' ***** (AllEdinburghTheatre.com). 'Hilarious and heartbreaking with a soundtrack to die for' (Graham Norton).

title: Double Bill
description: Two plays for the price of one – in Fool’s Errand by Georgia Smith, an apparently simple burglary takes a spectacular turn when the thief discovers the homeowner is actually a witch. Suddenly, making off with the loot becomes far trickier, especially with a sharp-tongued talking cat and a mischievous, magical house standing in his way. Still Life is Noël Coward's story of two married strangers living in pre-World War II England, whose chance meeting at a railway station leads to a brief yet intense emotional affair disrupting their otherwise conventional lives. It became the film Brief Encounter.

title: Doughboys
description: With America entering the Great War, Private Sandes has finally arrived at the Western Front with just one problem. A problem that must be kept secret from the bumbling Sergeant... Sandes is a woman. Disguised as an American Doughboy, Sandes isn’t the only drag king in the trench. Bianconi, a desperate bachelorette, has come to No Man’s Land to land... a man. And Furse, an orphan, is looking for her MIA brother. With battle looming and the Sergeant’s second-in-command threatening to reveal them, the women have just hours to find love, family and themselves before all hell breaks loose.
content_warnings: Contains distressing or potentially triggering themes, Scenes of a sexual nature, Includes the use of prop firearms.

title: Dowally
description: Dowally is a thrilling roots duo of fiddler Rachel Petyt and guitarist Dan Abrahams. Described as 'utterly enchanting' by Songlines magazine, the musicians take a folky roots approach to original compositions and weave in influences from klezmer, jazz, American old time and everything in-between. Expect songs and tunes which will both captivate and make you want to move your feet.

title: Down in Colorado
description: You sit on your front porch at 3am, a gun in one hand, a guitar in the other: what song do you play? With original music, dark humour and heart, Down in Colorado is an exploration of the self-destructive impulses that follow us wherever we go. After tours in Brighton, Bologna, Geneva and more, the excellent writer, musician and performer Gabriel Bird is back in Edinburgh to bring you more honest and powerful storytelling.
content_warnings: Contains distressing or potentially triggering themes, Strong language/swearing

title: Dr Mew's Sci-Fi Cabaret
description: Dr Mew Cabaret is an LGBT+ line-up cabaret show for sci-fi lovers, hosted by SJ and Dr Mew (a cat who used to be an anti-woke podcaster). This is an audience participation show with acts who are LGBTQ+ and allies who love sci-fi. The line-up will vary but it will include comedy, music, drag and other intergalactic performances – all with a sci-fi twist. There will also be an opportunity to test your sci-fi knowledge and be awarded the Jonesy Sci-Fi Cat of the show.

title: Dracula: Lucy's Dream
description: A hypnotic reimagining of Bram Stoker’s immortal masterpiece from award-winning Plexus Polaire, the ‘exquisite’ (New York Times) creators of Moby Dick (Barbican). Lucy Westenra is centred in this haunting reinvention of the heart-pounding gothic horror about obsession, control and the demon inside. Reality fractures as Lucy drifts between dream and nightmare, victim and liberator. Life-sized puppets and human performers collide with original music and cinematic video in an intoxicating descent into desire, fear and female emancipation. Dark, sensual and visually breathtaking, this wordless production blurs the line between beauty and horror, human and puppet, life and death.
content_warnings: This show contains scenes of a sexual nature.

title: Dragon Babies
description: Dragon Babies is a brand new show for babies under 12 months. This beautifully presented show leads into the world of dragons, story telling, beautiful felt puppets, sensory experiences and song. A must for families this fringe.

title: Dragon Tales
description: The Dragons return to Edinburgh with their new show Dragon Tales, a masterclass in preschool theatre.  Captivating early years audiences with stunning storytelling and puppetry. This show is a must for families in 2026.

title: Dream Watchers
presented_by: Harry Waters Jr featuring Jordon Waters and Kevin Belisario
description: Dream Watcher invites the audience into a multi-disciplinary interactive, storytelling performance. Performed by Jordon Waters, Harry Waters Jr and Kevin Belisario. Are you awake? In the bodies of butterflies and of the inner child. They tell us what our dreams might mean. What is now, what was and what will be. Are you a Dream Watcher?

title: Dreamgirl
description: What would happen if, instead of starting clown school in Paris, you accidentally ended up following a group of Syrian Refugees on their journey to seek asylum in Europe? How would your experience be different from theirs? Dreamgirl is an immersive experience of Norwegian filmmaker and clown Karen Houge’s real-life experience following refugees in her mid 20s through storytelling, play, clown, interaction... and a bit of Lego. 'Profound, playful and compelling' ***** (InReviewOnline.com). 'Renewed hope for humanity' **** (MustSeeTheatre.com).

title: Dreamgun Film Reads
description: Dreamgun and special guests perform a different parody film script every night, rewritten with fresh jokes and read live by completely unprepared comedians. It's an unrehearsed, rapid-fire, cinematic mess. Previous guests include Dara Ó Briain, Rose Matafeo, Nish Kumar and Aisling Bea. From The Shawshank Redemption to Psycho to Jumanji, no childhood favourite is safe. Check the web listing for the full schedule. 'Merciless, hilarious' *****  (Irish Times). 'Kept us in stitches' ***** (BroadwayBaby.com).

title: Dreaming of Max
description: Alex travels through Europe to secretly pursue a man she hardly knows. After a fleeting affair, captivated by his sparkling eyes, she becomes obsessed with finding him again. She follows clues to his whereabouts but seems to miss him at every turn, like Peter Pan chasing her Tinkerbell, always just out of reach. The chaotic, humour-filled adventure takes an unexpected turn when she learns of his sudden passing from an aggressive cancer. Letting go of her dream man, but never forgetting him, Alex discovers a new adventure of the heart: learning to love who she has become.

title: Dreamwalking
presented_by: Jordon Waters featuring Harry Waters Jr and Kevin Belisario
description: Dreamwalking invites the audience into a multi-disciplinary interactive storytelling performance. Performed by Jordon Waters, Harry Waters Jr and Kevin Belisario. A journey in shadow work through your dreams. Each performance has a different ending depending on the path you choose (dream, nightmare, fantasy). Which path will you walk!?

title: Dru Cripps: Juicy Bits
description: "Master clown" Dru Cripps presents his phenomenally successful loopstation-based shenanigans – a show so good it earned five 5-star reviews, sold out Edinburgh completely, and added extra dates. No wonder it keeps selling out. This quadruple award-winner (British Comedy Guide, Malcolm Hardee, Comedy Store King Gong, etc) and BBC New Comedian of the Year nominee uses questionable musical abilities that leaves audiences rolling in the aisles with laughter. Armed with his trusty loopstation, he transforms audience suggestions into improvised songs, spontaneous musical sketches, and utterly winning chaos in real-time.

title: Dune! The Musical
description: The critically acclaimed one-man show, back for its fourth Fringe. Comedy and tragedy collide in this fast paced, cult hit. Dan Collins assumes the role of troubadour-warrior Gurney Halleck, blending story and song in an unforgettable hour of sci-fi theatre. Suitable for hardcore fans and new initiates alike; arrive early to avoid disappointment. Can Paul Atreides tame the worm, save the world and get the girl? Forget everything you know about Arrakis and get ready for Dune! The Musical... 'Unexpectedly brilliant' (Telegraph). 'A work of genius or madness' (One4Review.co.uk). 'Musical storytelling marvel' (MusicalTheatreReview.com).
content_warnings: Contains distressing or potentially triggering themes, Nudity, Scenes of violence, Strong language/swearing

title: Dungeons and Shakespeare
description: Welcome to a world where you can see the greatest characters from Shakespeare face horrific monsters from Dungeons & Dragons! Inspired by the Bard. Determined by dice. Brought to life on stage. Join in an epic adventure that is different every time as audience chooses and the roll of giant dice decides if the heroes live or die. All the world's a game... Come be a player.

title: Durango Blue
description: Durango Blue are songwriter/guitarist Ryan Hooper and multi-instrumentalist Paul Templeman. The duo combine Ryan's gravelly vocals, heartfelt, intelligent, hook-laden lyrics, memorable melodies and funky acoustic rhythms with Paul's tasteful and inventive playing on guitar, Weissenborn and lap steel. Add a dash of live digital foot percussion, and you have a duo that sounds like a band. For fans of rootsy, country, bluesy grooves in the vein of John Hiatt, Jackson Browne, JJ Cale and James McMurtry. 'Durango Blue evoke a collaboration between Mark Knopfler and Ry Cooder, showcasing exceptional artistry and depth' (LastDayDeaf.com).

title: DUSK/NIGHT/DAWN
description: An experimental aerial pole dance explosion performed by NYC collective VERTICAL DREAMSCAPE, featuring US Pole Art Champion Donna Carnow and interdisciplinary artist Gina Alm. Their hour-long montage of dream worlds is a sensual and cinematic, dark yet dazzling vision of a journey when the sun goes down – from the luminous tones of Dusk, the darkest underbelly of Night, into the messy brilliance of Dawn. This durational work pushes the performers' bodies to the limit, producing a powerful, visceral and transcendent product that feels vibrant, textured, unpredictable and of an alien world. 'A genuine work of Art' *****(BroadwayBaby.com).
content_warnings: Scenes of a sexual nature, Strobe lighting

title: DUST
presented_by: Charlaina Thompson and Yellow Brick Theatre Company
description: England. Lock down. 2:20AM. A man fights to make it home. In his morphine-fuelled delirium, we relive his past: a boxer, a soldier and a miner. Is it fate, or will, that decides when we return to dust? DUST is dedicated to the servicemen who fought for their country, the seven men who tragically died in the Lofthouse Colliery disaster of 1973, and every miner who lived their lives in darkness so we could live in the light. Based on a true story and infused with Northern grit, humour and soul. Adelaide Fringe Award Winning Show.
content_warnings: This show contains strong language, scenes of violence and themes of generational trauma and mental health.

title: Dust: The Sixth Sense
description: The Sixth Sense pulls you into a world of decay and possession, following five fractured identities navigating darkness when guidance is absent. At it’s centre is Girl, confined to her home and to Mother, Dust, Air and Narrator. Experience our world of chaos and the original soundtrack that pierces through dimensions. This play insists on listening. On recognising. Dust is a story about the unstable sense of self and how we are shaped by our fortunate and unfortunate events alike. We invite you to sit with the parts of yourself the cracked mirror reflects.
content_warnings: Contains distressing or potentially triggering themes, Scenes of a sexual nature and of violence, Strong language/swearing

title: Dynamics at the Movies
description: Lights, camera, a cappella! Durham Dynamics invites you on a whistle-stop tour of the biggest blockbuster hits through song. From the action-packed suspense of James Bond to the fairy-tale fun of Shrek, the riff-off filled Pitch Perfect and the show-stopping spectacle of The Greatest Showman, this high-energy production spans genres, decades and cinematic icons. Expect tight harmonies, dynamic choreography and movie magic created entirely by voice. Whether you love action, animation, musicals or comedy, there’s something for everyone. Sit back, relax and let Durham Dynamics take you to the movies.

title: Dystopia 26: The Rock Opera
description: A five-star, two part, immersive political satire and electrifying rock spectacle. You’re not just an audience – you’re a Dystopian, summoned to join a state “Dystopiation” event where you will vote. From martial law to election to a glittering new cult of happiness, this two-part odyssey skewers power, greed and propaganda with monstrous masks, biting lyrics and a ferocious live band. Performed as if from prison by disgraced spin doctor Beldon Haigh and arsonist Helen Raiser, it’s bold, provocative and unexpectedly human – a defiant, beacon of hope.
content_warnings: Audience participation, Strobe lighting, Strong language/swearing

title: E-bike Cycle Tour of Arthur's Seat
description: Returning by popular demand! Escape the Fringe crowds on our e-bike cycle tour. Ride mostly traffic-free paths with a local guide and discover hidden gems most visitors miss. Discover the 'other castle' of Craigmillar and ride round Arthur's Seat for stunning views over the city and beyond. We will stop and learn about the Scottish Parliament, Holyrood Palace and how Mary Queen of Scots helped shape this ancient city's feel. E-bike, helmet and guide included. (For ages 14+)
content_warnings: Audience participation and required to walk or move around during the performance, All participants must be able to ride a bike and bikes of all sizes available. Ticketholders will be contacted in advance for height, and age details (if under 12)

title: ...Earnest?
description: Perfect for fans of The Play That Goes Wrong and Noises Off. ***** (Skinny). Returning to the Fringe for the sixth time due to phenomenal demand, this Oscar Wilde twist is guaranteed to have you in stitches. When a traditional production of Oscar Wilde’s classic play gets underway, everything seems to be going perfectly to plan... until the lead actor fails to arrive on cue. 'Guaranteed to bring a smile to the face of even the greatest of improv-phobic curmudgeons' **** (Scotsman).

title: Earth to Squiggy: A Lenny and The Squigtones Musical
description: A ground-breaking musical comedy starring real-life daughter of David L. Lander (TV's Squiggy from Laverne & Shirley) Natalie Lander and Alex Ellis. Squigronica (Lander) and her best friend Leni (Ellis) embark on an intergalactic rock ‘n’ roll mission. Convinced her father was abducted by aliens, Squigronica believes that a once-in-a-lifetime cosmic alignment is her only way to reunite with him. Natalie Lander and Alex Ellis reinvent the songs of David L Lander and Michael McKean with hijinks, hilarity and heart as two best friends navigate the meaning of life and beyond.

title: Eccentrics Return! Meet the Legends Onstage. Guerilla Autistics Year 12.
description: Are you eccentric? Take the free Eccentriconograph test and find out if Quentin Crisp, Spike Milligan, Pete Burns, Patricia Highsmith and Dame Edith Sitwell were your neurotribe. With music and some dodgy singing, Paul Wady (Scouser and Edinburgh Fringe veteran here presenting Guerilla Autistics Show Year 12) introduces the original outsider neurodivergents. It will be funny, moving and free. Warning: Screaming Lord Sutch goes wild and Ed D Wood wears Angora...
content_warnings: Audience participation, Contains some adult content

title: Echoes of Self
description: In Echoes of Self, Yzaura unearths ancestral memory through taste, touch and confession. Dulce de coco wrappers, simmering sofrito, a wounded record circling remorse. As she opens her lineage, something begins to stir in the room. Through food and grief, memory flickers. The mind strains to hold what time is trying to erase. Sound gathers like wind beneath the words, building breath into rhythm until poetry becomes invocation. What unfolds is a living act of remembrance, intimate, visceral and stirring long after the final echo fades.
content_warnings: Contains distressing or potentially triggering themes

title: Ed Byrne: Work in Progress
description: It's me, Ed Byrne. I'm heading out on tour in 2027 with a new show provisionally titled No Dramas but first I need to knock it into shape. That's where you come in. If you're a comedy fan with an interest in how the sausage gets made then come and watch me perform a mixture of bits that can be described as already funny, nearly funny and definitely worth exploring. If you prefer the slick stuff, come see me next year. ***** (Rolling Stone). ***** (Evening Standard). ***** (Mail On Sunday).

title: Ed Night: We'll Be Alright, Darling
presented_by: Standing On Productions in association with PBJ Management
description: Underrated stand-up and asthmatic wretch Ed Night lumbers back to the Fringe with yet another new show. Prepare to have your ribs tickled to the max with material about all sorts of different topics and subjects. 2025 Edinburgh Comedy Awards Best Show nominee (it's not a science). 'A singular talent who very much deserves a place on everyone's must-see list' (Skinny). 'This is comedy as poetry... so good it seems effortless' (Standard).
content_warnings: Audience participation, Strong language/swearing, Buy a ticket in advance to guarantee entry or Pay What You Want at the venue

title: Ed Patrick: Numb and Number (Work in Progress)
description: Is this NHS doctor and comedian completing his Edinburgh Fringe registration months before hospital rotas come out again? You bet. Does he know if he has the time off? Well, come see if this anaesthetist makes it to the Fringe where he'll be working on a new show. Expect bits of paper on stage. As seen on BBC One's Have I Got News For You. 'Had the audience in fits of laughter' (Scotsman). 'Packed with funny anecdotes' (Guardian).

title: Edinbra Fringe Comedy
description: Following on from its success at the Edinburgh Fringe the past few years, along with its sister shows Brighton Belles and Adelaides in their respective cities, this delightful, funny, award-nominated show returns with a revolving line-up of the best established and up-and-coming female comedians from around Scotland and the Fringe. If you're looking for funny females at this year's Fringe, you may find them at other showcases, but at Edinbra, you are guaranteed to see an entire line-up of women at an hilarious early evening showcase.

title: Edinburgh – A Tale of Two Towns
description: Our unique tour sets out to inform and entertain as we take you into both the Old and New Towns, giving you a real sense of the two sides of Edinburgh, revealing some of the secrets hidden within a city rich in culture and history. We will bring Edinburgh to life for you as we stroll along the narrow streets of the Old Town, revealing the secrets that lie hidden in its dark closes. Accompany us to Edinburgh’s elegant Georgian New Town to get a sense of Edinburgh moving into a modern era.
content_warnings: Audience will be standing throughout, Audience required to walk or move around during the performance

title: Edinburgh Comedy Allstars
description: The biggest, brightest comedians at the Edinburgh Fringe all in one huge show, staged in the famous Udderbelly. A one-stop shop for your comedy fix right in the beating heart of the festival. Every show sold out since 2017! Previous performers have included Jason Byrne, Nina Conti, Phil Wang, Fern Brady, Ivo Graham, David O'Doherty, Sam Campbell, Joanne McNally, Larry Dean, Amy Gledhill, Ian Smith, Flo & Joan, Olga Koch and Ahir Shah. Every weekend – Friday and Saturday nights. Nightly line-ups available at UnderbellyEdinburgh.co.uk.

title: Edinburgh Fringe Comedian of the Year
description: It’s the main event – our annual hunt for the best comedian at the Edinburgh Fringe. 100 of the Fringe’s sharpest comics go head-to-head for the title of Edinburgh Fringe Comedian of the Year, the trophy and a £1500 cash prize. Each show showcases five outstanding acts from our top 100, delivering their very best stand-up in a bid to win over the crowd and secure a coveted place in the prestigious finals week. Big laughs. High stakes. One champion.

title: Edinburgh Renaissance Band's Saints and Sinners 2026
description: We presented a show with this name in 2000. Saints are still in short supply, sinners perhaps less so, but this is a new and delightful selection of religious and secular vocal and instrumental music from Medieval and Renaissance Europe. The huge variety of pieces is matched by the band’s enormous range of period instruments. The presentation is friendly and informative, and members of the audience are invited to take a closer look at the instruments at the end of the concert. Early music as it should be! Children free, but ticketed.

title: Edinburgh Renaissance Band’s Viol Rackett Show 2026
description: Edinburgh Renaissance Band’s ever-popular Viol Rackett Show presents a varied selection of instrumental and vocal music from the Middle Ages to the Renaissance. The award-winning troupe of eleven musicians show off a large range of period instruments, including shawms, cornetti, sackbuts, nakers, viols, fiddles, crumhorns, gemshorns, bells, bagpipes, racketts and a serpent. This delightful show, fronted by musical director Murray Campbell, is suitable for all ages, and members of the audience are invited to take a closer look at the instruments at the end of the concert. Children free, but ticketed.

title: Edinburgh’s Fun and Funny Walking Tour
description: Edinburgh’s Old Town as the city deserves to be seen: walking with a local tour guide with a wealth of experience and humour. This is a walking tour with local guides who mastered the art of guiding (humanity’s oldest profession) through years of practice. A hilarious and insightful outlook into what it means to be Scotland’s capital. You’ll see stories of royals, invention, violence and culture on this two-hour tour offered on a Pay What You Want basis. Fun facts, amazing stories and great recommendations to see beyond.
content_warnings: Audience will be standing throughout, Audience required to walk or move around during the performance, Tour can be modified to include rest stops and less stairs for those who need it.

title: Edinburgh's Greatest Hits Music Walking Tour
description: Walk on the wild side and go off the beaten track with a witty guided tour packed full of stories from Edinburgh's past and present music scenes. From Bowie to the Bay City Rollers via Nirvana and Shirley Manson's Garbage, these 90-minute tours uncover the capital's musical secrets. Irreverent and entertaining, the walks show a different side of Edinburgh which will appeal to all, whether you have an ear for folk, funk, pop or punk. Led by a Scotsman music journalist. Produced by the highly successful Glasgow Music City Tours. Five stars since 2015!
content_warnings: Audience required to walk or move around during the performance
venue_name: Meeting Point at Edinburgh's Festival Theatre (Next to the Festival Theatre Café side door)

title: Edinburgh’s LGBTQ Walking Tour
description: A walk through Edinburgh’s LGBTQ history with local LGBTQ guides, dealing with history as well as contemporary issues. This walk follows part of Edinburgh’s Pride route to tell the story of how the capital went from being the sort of place queer folk avoided, to being a welcoming and loving place. In a world which is becoming more hostile, this tour aims to provide a welcome reprieve for queer folks and those that love them. Part of the profit goes to support LGBT Health and Wellbeing, one of Scotland’s leading LGBTQ charities.
content_warnings: Audience will be standing throughout, Contains distressing or potentially triggering themes, Audience required to walk or move around during the performance, Scenes of a sexual nature

title: Eight
description: A collection of searing monologues from contemporary Britain, each offering a distinct and uncompromising voice. From privilege and politics to identity, faith and personal responsibility, these characters wrestle with the beliefs that shape their lives and the society around them. Sharp, provocative and darkly funny, this acclaimed play examines the fault lines running through modern culture. Each story stands alone, yet together they form a striking portrait of a nation questioning itself. Bold, intelligent and unflinching, this compelling production invites audiences to confront uncomfortable truths and consider where they stand.
content_warnings: Contains distressing or potentially triggering themes, Strong language/swearing

title: EIGHT: The One (Wo)Man Drag King Musical Parody
description: Henry VIII has returned to the land of the living to discover he is exclusively remembered as that bloke with six wives. So there was only one thing for it. Henry is clearing his name in a musical drag extravaganza. Featuring parodies of songs by Meatloaf, Celine Dion, Ed Sheeran and more, this bonkers show explores the lesser known side of the Tudor king. Inspired by the drag performers of the Victorian Music Hall, melodramatic rock music and musical theatre, EIGHT is a parody musical written and performed by Hannah Clift.
content_warnings: Audience participation, Strong language/swearing, Sexual references, Misogyny.

title: ELBA
description: Elba is a tiny island in the middle of the Mediterranean. We are best known for those 10 months where Napoleon Bonaparte graced our shores. He promised us wealth and prosperity. We trusted him. We gave him all we had... But we were foolish, weren't we? And now we will never be able to escape him. Napoleon's banishment on the island of Elba was unexpected – nobody, least of all the Elbans, saw this coming. Perhaps a sign of hope, or had Elba become a sacrificial pawn in a megalomaniac's masterplan? Can one man really change an island?

title: Ele McKenzie: Bringing It All Back Home
presented_by: Country Mile Productions in association with PARKAS and Independent Talent
description: Ele McKenzie's back (at her parents' house), baby! Sexually constipated. Literally constipated. Addicted to Rennies. Life has truly never been better! No, really!! In her highly anticipated debut hour, the Pleasance Comedy Reserve alum is going to tell you all about it – maybe a little too much? 'No one else is doing this flavour of haunted / gross / hysterical modernism' (Chortle.co.uk). 'I haven't seen... such fearless monstrosity since Julia Davis' (Guardian). As seen in Funboys and Everyone Else Burns. Royal Television Society Breakthrough Award winner.

title: Eleanor Morton: The Mermaid
description: Fresh from her new show on BBC Radio 4, award-winning comedian Eleanor Morton returns with a show all about mermaids and why she wants to be one, even though she can't swim. A show all about wanting to be beautiful, mythology, 2000s magazine sex tips, rat boyfriends, and James Cameron's submarine. Justice for Nicola Roberts. Praise for 2024's show Haunted House: 'Belly laugh funny' ****½ (Metro). **** (BeyondTheJoke.co.uk). **** (Skinny).
content_warnings: Strong language/swearing, Buy a ticket in advance to guarantee entry or Pay What You Want at the venue

title: Elf Lyons is The Woman on the Edge
description: 'I'm sorry, I've said too much...' Sky Arts Award-winning comedian Elf Lyons is The Woman on the Edge. A completely normal, autobiographical (and in no way complex) – observational stand-up show about love. A perfect show to take yourself to. Inspired by Vertigo, Apollo 13 and the opera Pagliacci. Directed by Ingmar Bergman. One of The Telegraph's 50 Funniest Comedians of the 21st Century. 'Praise her genius – and go' ***** (Telegraph). 'Expert clowning' **** (Times). **** (Guardian).
content_warnings: This show contains audience participation and strong language.

title: Eli Matthewson: Blood Bender
description: Eli just became the first ever New Zealander to move to London, after applying for the "youth" visa on the last possible week he was eligible. He's ready to be a star and the only things in his way are his age and the impending apocalypse. From his brief ballet career to the lofty heights of performing at Dining In The Dark, Eli is ready to share it all to win you over... including the horrific story of his first visit to a gay sauna. **** (Chortle.co.uk). **** (Everything-Theatre.co.uk).

title: Elise Harris: Better Be Best
description: If you can help yourself, you don't need anyone else's help. Elise Harris, self-proclaimed expert on most things and various "gurus" who seem to think they know everything else will guide you through the process of knowing exactly everything about all things. You too can be better, or best, and navigate through all life's pitfalls and obstacles. Finance, health, love and conspiracies. Fifty minutes to change your life! All you need is this show and 99 extra follow-up sessions at the low price of anything you can afford. Coo, what a bargain.

title: Elizabeth Blackadder: A Life in Colour
description: Dame Elizabeth Blackadder (1931-2021) is the first woman to have been elected to both the Royal Scottish Academy (1972) and the Royal Academy of Arts (1976). The breadth of her work in oil, watercolour and printmaking techniques has long been celebrated for its new perspectives in contemporary art. Blackadder collaborated with Dovecot across five decades to create over 30 tapestries and hand-tufted rugs. This exhibition will not only shed light on her illustrious career but also showcase her work in the context of the world-famous Studios.
content_warnings: Audience will be standing throughout and required to walk or move around during the performance

title: Elliot Bibby: Abracadada
description: Comedy. Magic. Parenting. What could possibly go wrong? In Abracadada, Elliot Bibby (co-creator of sell-out sensation 1 Hour of Insane Magic) delivers a fun, high-energy magic show for all ages. He explores the triumphs and total mayhem of life as a professional magician and dad of two. Packed with big laughs and jaw-dropping tricks, it's where parenting hacks meet impossible illusions. Perfect family entertainment at the Fringe. Fast-paced, friendly, and guaranteed to entertain audiences from ages 5 to 95. 'Cheeky, charming magician' ***** (EdinburghSpotlight.com).

title: Elouise Eftos: Aphrodite
presented_by: Show And Tell in association with Century and Curtis Brown
description: Nominee for Best Newcomer Edinburgh Comedy Awards 2025. To be desired is currency. To desire is a liability. Australia’s First Attractive Comedian is back! Award-winning, critically-acclaimed, smart, sexy, successful, talented – but all of this comes at a cost. Elouise has never been in love. This is part two of a sexy, silly, feminist trilogy but is this show a Greek comedy or tragedy? You’ll just have to wait and see x 'She's a feminist, fembot and fully fledged superstar' ***** (Time Out). 'Refreshing, upending, laugh out loud funny' **** (Times). 'Wickedly amusing and original' **** (Guardian).
content_warnings: This show contains strong language and audience participation.

title: Elsa McTaggart: Capturing the Light
presented_by: sruth-mara in association with An Lanntair
description: The fifth child of Gaelic-speaking crofters, William McTaggart became one of Scotland’s most celebrated artists through sheer determination and hard work. What is his legacy a century on, for his country and family? Songwriter Elsa McTaggart tells the story of her great-grandfather’s extraordinary life and talent, and how it shaped her own creative identity. Made in the Outer Hebrides – and part of the Made in Scotland showcase – this visually striking new theatre show is written by Elsa McTaggart and directed by Fringe First winner Laura Cameron-Lewis. Production design by Robbie Thomson. MadeInScotlandShowcase.com

title: Elton John Songbook
description: Oliver Harris delves into the extraordinary songbook of music icon Elton John. All the great songs accompanied on piano. Not to be missed! Book early to be taken on a musical journey from Our Song and Rocket Man to the score of The Lion King. Oliver will be joined by guests during the run at Frankenstein's.

title: Elvis
description: Oliver Harris returns for his 10th anniversary show. Packed with all of Elvis Presley's classics. The extraordinary Oliver Harris makes this show an unmissable hour of nostalgia and truly amazing vocals. From The Wonder Of You to Blue Suede Shoes. These great songs chart one of the most unforgettable musical icons of all time. Beat the queues and book early!

title: Elvis in Chaos
description: Hallucinatory PowerPoint raves on: Elvis' branching timelines, romance in the multiverse, the top five gods of all time, the politics of the Oreo cookie, the quantum physics of baseball pitching and how bagpipes caused the Black Death. A fire hose of images powering Michael Anderson’s ecstatic rants, a manic series of hilarious TED Talks that will overload your senses and rumple your mind! Michael Anderson is a two-time winner of the Festival of Bad Ad Hoc Hypotheses, performing at MIT and Imperial College London. All proceeds go to immigrant-defence networks in Boston, USA.

title: Em Humble: Lady of the Lakes
description: Good 'morrow, weary traveller! Lay thine arse upon a plastic seat and bear willing witness to a fantastically surreal procession of Arthurian-inspired freaks! BAFTA-longlisted comedian, Em Humble, brings you a magical tale of wizards, goblins and urchins (oh my!) in her debut character comedy show. In a time of myth and a land of sorcery, who will the fickle finger of fate choose to emerge victorious and be deemed the worthy wielder of the legendary Excalibur sword?!
content_warnings: This show contains audience participation and strong language.

title: Embro
description: Poet Ken Cockburn presents, on and around the Royal Mile, 'an Edinburgh alive with literature' (BroadwayBaby.com). Stroll quiet historic closes, bustling contemporary streets and open green spaces, all to a soundtrack of poetry 'deftly and lovingly performed by Cockburn' (AYoungishPerspective.co.uk). If you're new to Edinburgh you'll see some key sights, and if you know the city you’ll experience it afresh by slowing down and listening to the words of poets writing across the centuries. 'Highly informative, thoughtful and a great way to discover bits of Edinburgh we’d never seen before' (Audience Review).
content_warnings: Audience will be standing throughout, Audience required to walk or move around during the performance

title: Emma and Warren in the Garden of Eden
description: Where has all the whimsy gone? How can we find it again and at what cost? God, gardens and familial trauma figure prominently in this prosaic, philosophical two-hander all about the younger generation’s cerebral approach to life and love. From NYC’s hit underground playwright, Luc D’Arcy, Emma and Warren signifies a formal shift away from traditional theatricality toward simple situations, complex characters and fluid ideologies. D’Arcy is one of the first playwrights to capture the voice of the next generation – a generation that is only now becoming aware of itself.

title: Emma Davies: You Are All Resources
description: Ever wondered whose side HR is really on? Join HR consultant, Alllison Pope, as she leads Remark Insurance through a workforce restructure. This satirical comedy puts HR under the microscope. Expect questionable professional advice, power dressing and corporate duplicity, with 90s references abound. If you remember Kilroy, work in HR or have had a contretemps with HR, this show is for you. Runner-up West End Women's New Comedian of the Year 2025 and Sketch Off! semi-finalist 2025. 'A real bouffon energy' (TheReviewsHub.com).

title: Emma Doran: Emmaculate
description: Smash-hit Irish comedian, best-selling author and podcast host Emma Doran makes her Edinburgh Fringe debut with her latest stand-up show Emmaculate. The many trials and tribulations of Emma's blended family are laid bare in this rambunctious show, jam-packed with razor-sharp observations and conspiratorial gossipmongering. As seen and heard on No Worries If Not! (RTÉ 2), The Tommy Tiernan Show (RTÉ 1), LOL: Last One Laughing (Prime Video) The Late Late Show (RTÉ) and her podcast Keep it Tight with Deirdre O'Kane. 'You'd be mad to miss her' **** (Evening Standard). 'Wickedly funny' (Guardian).

title: Emma Holland: The Dog Dies at the Start
presented_by: Impatient Productions in association with Jubilee Street
description: I told my manager I wanted to write a show about dead dogs, and she said 'oh god' but that's not really my problem, it's her job to market it. This show isn't sad, you will leave feeling good. I promise. Thinking about asking my vet for a refund on the euthanasia just to see what happens. 'Holland is an act in absolute mastery of her craft' ****(Scotsman). 'A whirlwind of comedy, chaos, and charm' **** (ThreeWeeks).

title: Emmeline Downie: Gail
description: Middle-aged. Middle-class. Middle England. Gail Summerfield is happy, successful and certain she has all the answers. After a milestone birthday (54), she's trained as a life coach. It involves three things she loves: helping people, watching them grow and charging them £200. She's going to transform people's lives. Whether they want her to or not. Playful, provincial and unpredictable, Gail is a character comedy that gives a voice to the voiceless: vivacious middle-aged women from Milton Keynes. Written and performed by Emmeline Downie (Brainsluts, Channel 4's It Gets Worse). Directed by Leo Reich.
content_warnings: This show contains strong language and themes of suicide, mental illness, substance abuse, and discrimination

title: Emotionally Undercooked
description: A funny, intimate solo show about people-pleasing, self-growth and dating after healing, Emotionally Undercooked traces Lisa Sa’s reflections on childhood, love and the patterns that shape us. From early lessons in performing to the complexities of adult relationships, Lisa explores boundaries, attraction and the courage it takes to embrace vulnerability. With warmth, honesty and sharply observed humour, the show navigates the messiness of emotions, the tension between desire and self-respect, and the moments that help us grow.

title: Endgame by Samuel Beckett
description: Bold and muscular with haunting physicality and razor-sharp comedy, this gripping staging of Samuel Beckett’s Endgame brings the playwright’s poetic masterpiece to life. In a dying world, four survivors cling to routine, memory and one another as time slowly runs out. Brutal humour and stark poetry collide in a raw, visually striking production blending physical theatre with Beckett’s savage wit. Devastating, hilarious, strangely tender, this fearless interpretation captures the dark comedy and haunting humanity of one of theatre’s greatest modern classics. 'Wonderfully fearless imagination and visceral strength' ***** (BritishTheatreGuide.info, for Macbeth). Supported by Theatre Royal Winchester.

title: Enrico Touché: Hot Knees
description: From sold-out cabarets across Europe, Enrico Touché brings their unique brand of comedy to the stage in an hour of unbelievable nonsense. Enrico has a dream: to be the best at business. But what kind of business? Hot Knees is a high-energy comedy about ambition, passion and following your dreams to their illogical conclusion. Expect briefcases, suitcases, and cases of uncontrollable laughter. For lovers of slapstick and the absurd – meet Enrico Touché. You will be touched. 'Enrico Touché exemplifies why classic slapstick still #slaps' (FringeBiscuit.co.uk). 'The shtick is absolutely delightful' (Kate Copstick).

title: ERAS
description: ERAS: no stadium, no backup dancer, no glitter (not much talent either). A woman traces her life through ten Eras. From childhood chaos to a wedding in Edinburgh, this solo show blends storytelling, cultural commentary and dark humour. Just one woman reclaiming her narrative. Set against cultural shifts from 9/11 to #MeToo to COVID and beyond, this solo autobiographical piece explores trauma, generational inheritance, addiction, academia, love and the radical act of choosing yourself. Blending sharp political observation with intimate confession, ERAS examines what we carry, what we inherit and what we refuse to pass on.
content_warnings: Contains distressing or potentially triggering themes, Buy a ticket in advance to guarantee entry or Pay What You Want at the venue

title: Eric Lampaert: Zero Minus One
description: After a brush with total amnesia, a mind wiped clean, comedian Eric Lampaert (Lamb Pear) returns from the void with questions only madness can answer, fractured memories, multiple personalities and a darkly funny perspective on what it means to be human.
content_warnings: Contains distressing or potentially triggering themes, Strong language/swearing
venue_name: Just The Tonic at The Caves

title: Eric Rushton: Could Well Be In
description: Eric Rushton brings a brand-new stand-up show to the Fringe after the sell-out success of his last show, Innkeeper. Winner: Channel 4 Sean Lock Comedy Award. Winner: Leicester Mercury Comedian of the Year Award. Nominated: ISH Edinburgh Comedy Awards for Best Show. 'No wonder it sold out. A thinking man’s comedian with a gift for subverting standard tropes hilariously' ***** (One4Review.co.uk). 'With his deadpan delivery and finely wrought gags, he commands the audience and delivers a lot of laughs' **** (TheArtsDesk.com). 'One of the most fluid and meticulously crafted routines you'll see' **** (EdFestMag.com).
