But as he’s introduced to her friends, family and all their expectations, the gap between who he is and who he pretends to be widens. As the deception grows deeper, Dylan must decide if he can keep up the act or if the truth must come out. Introductions is an audacious new musical comedy about relationships, performative identity and the compromises we make for connection.
venue_name: Lower Hall at Braw Venues @ Grand Lodge

title: INTRUSIVE
description: INTRUSIVE is a psychologically charged drama about anxiety, intrusive thoughts, and the weight of unspoken experiences. Set during a seemingly ordinary night with friends, the story follows Jess as her inner world begins to overwhelm reality. Blurring the line between memory and imagination, the play invites audiences to experience the unsettling intensity of a mind struggling for control. Honest, intimate, and unsettling, INTRUSIVE offers a raw exploration of mental health and trauma.
content_warnings: Contains distressing or potentially triggering themes, Scenes of sexual violence, Scenes of violence, Strobe lighting, Strong language/swearing

title: Invasion (JoMarZeb)
description: Invasion, a bold multimedia spectacle from Philippine Theatre UK’s 23rd anniversary season, leaps across time – from the tense streets of 1940s Manila to the quiet corners of modern-day Oxford. Three mischievous spirits, a teacher, a lawyer and a nun crash into the present, pulling audiences into a haunting yet humorous journey blending horror, drama, comedy, music, film and history. At its heart is a stark look at Imperial Japan’s wartime atrocities, including the silenced suffering of Comfort Women. Guided by award-winning writer-director Ramon C. Teñoso, JoMarZeb explores memory, faith, loyalty and the lingering shadows of colonial trauma.
content_warnings: Strong language/swearing, short film containing an explosion and flashing lights

title: Irene Cleans Up
presented_by: Rebecca Taylor Al-Samaraie in Association with Abu Dhabi Dramatic Society
description: Irene Cleans Up is about a middle-aged London cleaner with a remarkable palate for wine, and decades of social conditioning telling her to stay in her place. When a highly successful and fiercely competitive sommelier bets she can transform Irene into an elite expert, an unlikely partnership begins. As ambition, class and confidence collide, both women confront what it means to change direction later in life. Warm, funny and sharply observed, Irene Cleans Up is a new play about reinvention, female friendship and the courage to redefine yourself after years of expectation when it matters most.

title: Irene Woo: Golden Child
description: Until recently, Irene Woo embodied the 'Golden Child'. As a Senior Software Engineer at Google, she had it all: the six-figure salary, the impressive job title and the unconditional approval of her immigrant parents. But when she turned 28, she quit her job to tell jokes in damp basements. With the unrelenting standards of a Type-A Asian oldest daughter and the messy reality of a human being, Irene explores the golden handcuffs of the tech world, the cultural whiplash of being a French-Chinese woman in America and the baffling logic of modern relationships.
content_warnings: Strong language/swearing, Buy a ticket in advance to guarantee entry or Pay What You Want at the venue
venue_name: Just The Tonic at The Mash House

title: Irish Comedy Free-For-All
description: A collection of the best Irish comedians at Edinburgh Festival Fringe all under one roof with a new line-up every single day!

title: Irish Comedy Headliners
description: Top professional stand-up from the Irish comedy scene and beyond. Sold out at Edinburgh Fringe 2023, 2024 and 2025. Each day presents a selection of top quality stand-up comedians who have their own show at the Fringe or have popped over for a few days. A great value show to add to your day at the Fringe.
venue_name: Just The Tonic at The Caves

title: Ironing Board Man
description: One man. Twelve ironing boards. One epic soundtrack. Get ready to be amazed as physical comedian Jody Kamali masterfully transforms everyday household items into the tools of a Hollywood-style, action-packed movie. With heart-pounding moments and emotional depth, this show thrilled audiences during its packed-out Fringe runs in 2024 and 2025 earning numerous standing ovations. There's gunfire, there's a wedding, there's more gunfire and there's revenge – plus plenty of laughter along the way. 'Demands applause' (Scotsman). 'Astonishing' (DarkChat.co.uk). 'Unapologetically mindless' (Guardian). 'Wonderfully "fringe-y" Fringe show' (BroadwayBaby.com). 'Slapstick and delightful' (One4Review.co.uk).

title: Is It Too Late Now To Say Sorry?
description: We've all said things we wish we could un-say. Done things we wish we could undo. Broken things we wish we could un-break. But is one word enough to fix all our regrets? Acclaimed theatre-maker Adam Lenson returns to Summerhall with a new collision of gig, storytelling and autobiographical investigation. Moving from synagogue to school playground, from online feuds to family drama, Is It Too Late Now To Say Sorry? examines the way we apologise, the pain we carry and the opportunities for healing amidst the damage.
content_warnings: Contains distressing or potentially triggering themes, Strong language/swearing

title: Is This Your First Crime?
description: A new comedy set within a police interrogation. When Tim is brought in for questioning, he knows he's in for the third degree. But nothing can prepare him for what the desperate detectives have in store! From cops undercover to rehashed routines, from skittish psychologists to a problematic polygraph, watch the insane interrogation unfold, as the police pull out every trick in the book to get Tim's confession! Will they succeed? Or will Tim walk free? And are there more secrets at play? Who else has something they need to confess?

title: Isabelle Glinn On Ice
description: Fallen former child figure skating starlet now drives the Zamboni at the ice rink. Is this her destiny? Or can she glide her way back to the top again? Isabelle Glinn (Man Up finalist, Soho Labs alum, cast member of five star award-winning show Crime Scene Improvisation, ex-Disney princess) is 'charm-personified' (TheReviewsHub.com) and will delight you in this surreal, whimsical and totally ridiculous solo clown show through the medium of song, dance and of course, ice. 'A phenomenal performance... impressive to see such creativity on display' (EdFringeReview.com). ‘Over-confident in her sporting abilities' (BroadwayWorld.com).

title: It Couldn't Get Worse; or, The Margarita Boat Tour Incident
presented_by: Mariah Lee Squires, SW Jones and Riley Gene
description: Maggie is lost at sea after the Margarita Boat Tour Incident. Who even knew Edinburgh had one of those? As a storm closes in, her mother Judy and her fiancée Claire find themselves locked inside a lighthouse with only each other's opposing ideologies. Forced into an uneasy alliance, the pair desperately search for the person who ties it all together. It couldn’t get worse. Probably.
content_warnings: Contains distressing or potentially triggering themes, Strong language/swearing, Scenes of violence, death, homophobia and religious trauma, Strobe lighting

title: It Happened on a Tuesday
description: Six employees. An ordinary Tuesday in the office. One of them stole £60,000. To solve the mystery, the boss asks each of his employees to walk him through their day, leading to absurd recreations and ridiculous revelations. It Happened on a Tuesday is a new comedy play that merges the workplace sitcom with a whodunnit mystery, in the structure of Rashomon. In a world where everyone believes their own version of the truth, how can we ever be objective?

title: It's a Mute Point
presented_by: Zoe Keddie and Tori Kay, Water Horse Productions
description: Welcome to an average day at The Firm, where you can be electrocuted, waterboarded, strip-teased, and faxed before noon, all before coffee arrives. Clara, head of operations and part-time cult leader, runs the office with charisma capable of sending fleets of dancing men to war and back again for tea. Beside her is Marie, the newest and most competent assistant in company history, diligent but rarely heard once Clara begins. Today, however, the universe has unionised against them: systems fail, clients revolt, and disasters multiply from a single, damning mistake.
content_warnings: Audience participation, Nudity, Scenes of a sexual nature, Scenes of violence, Strong language/swearing

title: It's a Mystery!
description: For those who have ever wondered ‘whodunnit’ and why... Detective Tim Benzie examines the clues that drew him to the genre as a child – from Scooby Doo to Encylopedia Brown, to gobbling up the entire works of Agatha Christie as a teenager. Along the way he draws draws connections between obsessions with detective films the the TV series Murder, She Wrote.

title: It’s Always Sunny on Olympus
presented_by: Mind Yer Head Theatre and New Celts Productions
description: The Olympians have won the war with the Titans. The cosmos is theirs. Zeus, Poseidon, Hades, Hermes and Athena find themselves in the uncomfortable position of organising everything. Roles must be chosen, leaders must be appointed, worlds must be created and cared for – this is not what they signed up for. Egos clash, relationships are stretched thin, and the Earth is in peril from day one. The universe might be doomed before it’s even begun.
content_warnings: Scenes of a sexual nature, Strong language/swearing

title: Jack Ansett
description: I, Jack Ansett (Taskmaster NZ), am making my Edinburgh Debut! Please come! I'd also like to take this opportunity to plug a young up-and-comer Sam Campbell, who I think could do really well in the UK market if he can get in front of enough people. Yes, you'd rather buy tickets to the big acts, McIntyre, Minchin, Jack Ansett – but it is always good to take a shot on a lesser-known face.

title: Jack Brookmyre: Impressionable
description: Jack Brookmyre is Scottish comedy’s up and coming impressionist. Voicing Trump, Attenborough and many others in Noising Up on BBC Radio Scotland, Jack is bringing his spot-on impressions and absurd humour to the Fringe! In Jack’s Fringe debut, Impressionable, he exhibits his full vocal repertoire while exploring what the way you speak says about you and how surface-level snap judgements are becoming more important in a world of dwindling attention spans and sensory overload.

title: Jack Dee: Jack's Joke Show
description: A show by Jack about jokes. Who doesn't like jokes? If your answer to that question is 'Me!', then steer well clear of this show. Celebrating 40 years in standup comedy, Jack takes us on a memoir of all his favourite old stories. Jokes and funny anecdotes have intrigued Jack for as long as he can remember. Now he has assembled the best of them to form a new show that offers a glimpse of the influences that led him into and helped shape his comedy career. Guaranteed no new material.

title: Jack Off The Beanstalk
description: Jack's hard... on his luck! After playing with more than just his beans, he's got a giant problem on his hands (and not the fun kind!) When Giant Spunktrumpet comes banging and there's no cash to spare, Jack's brother Thick Twatt and his mother, Dame Twatt are left clutching their sagging udders with nothing left in their coin purse! Join The Adult Panto Tour for their fifth filthy year of the No. 1 Outrageous Adult Panto.
content_warnings: Audience participation, Scenes of a sexual nature, Strong language/swearing

title: Jack Rooke: Good Grief
presented_by: Berk's Nest in association with Soho Theatre and Curtis Brown
description: BAFTA winner and recovering spoken-word artist Jack Rooke (Creator of Hulu/Channel 4's Big Boys), revives his debut comedy-theatre hour, a decade after its first Fringe run. Featuring the original show (co-written with his nan) and new content, this retrospective explores grief, milking having a dead dad for personal/professional gain, the innocence of writing just for oneself before the interference of "telly wankers", and the palpable regret of his own decline into becoming said "telly wanker". Directed by Gabriel Bisset-Smith. 'Good Grief 2.0 [is] a delightful and still affecting watch' (Guardian). 'Engaging, frank, humorous' (New York Times).
content_warnings: Contains distressing or potentially triggering themes, Strong language/swearing

title: Jack Skipper: Skint
description: Carpet-fitter turned comedian Jack Skipper returns with his Edinburgh Comedy Award-nominated show about how he went from a tradesman with no qualifications to a full-time stand-up (with no qualifications) – offering insights into the endeavours of a working-class father struggling to navigate his way through life. As seen on BBC One's Live at the Apollo. Tour support for Michael McIntyre, Jack Dee and Josh Widdicombe. Winner of Best Debut Show at Leicester Comedy Festival 2024. 'A very entertaining hour of comedy' **** (One4Review.co.uk). 'Definitely a name to watch' **** (BeyondTheJoke.co.uk). **** (Fest).

title: Jacob Hatton: Ruins
description: Archaeology for perverts. An excavation of the soul. Also, some actual old things: castles... pottery... your mum. A spiky, filthy, uplifting hour of stand-up by Jacob Hatton about dark times, old and new featuring cats, fascism, the Romans and MILFs. A show that will, this Fringe, be your Roman Empire whether you like it or not. No truth will be left unburied.  'Proper gags' (Chortle.co.uk). Brilliantly British humour' (Audience Review). Hastings Fringe Best Newcomer nominee.
content_warnings: Contains distressing or potentially triggering themes, Strong language/swearing

title: Jacuzzi by Twilight
description: A grizzled private investigator partners with a dewy-eyed homicide detective to solve the mysterious murder of a journalist that dug too deep. Together, they work to outmanoeuvre the crooked cops and scheming politicians that deal in the shadows of Metroville. But will they finish the case before the case finishes them?

title: Jade Gebbie: The People Pleaser
description: Jade Gebbie (British Comedy Guide Performance Award finalist 2025 and writer for The News Quiz, Nature Table) has always been a people pleaser – but now she’s hit her mid-thirties she’s delving into how it’s held her back, annoyed her loved ones and why overthinking fictional scenarios isn’t a reasonable excuse for missing a work meeting. Come along to this debut from Jade for fun, laughter and a bit of anxiety... after all, she is a millennial.

title: Jake Baker: The Gentle Men's Club
description: Masculinity is in crisis! Alpha Dogs and Macho Maniacs dominate the conversation. But is there another way? Can feminism work for men? What are the benefits of the sit-down-wee? Join hilariously funny, critically acclaimed, all-round good egg Jake Baker (recipient of the Fringe Monkey Talent Award 2025) as he explores a more gentle approach to being a chap. 'Thoughtful and very funny!' (List). 'Quietly impressive; a talent that shouldn't be overlooked' (Chortle.co.uk). 'Endearingly offbeat' **** (TheEdinburghReporter.co.uk). ‘Consistent laughter throughout, an easy manner at the mic belies the cleverness of the writing’ (Scotsman).
content_warnings: Strong language/swearing, Buy a ticket in advance to guarantee entry or Pay What You Want at the venue.

title: Jake Chapman – Nicesis: The Unwellness of Wellbeing
description: Long regarded as the bravest of the Young British Artists, Jake Chapman holds no punches when it comes to attacking... well, everything really. This time it's the "wellness" industry. Oh yes. Jake's relentless bravery and uncompromising questioning straddles a fine line between utterly shocking and laugh out loud funny. He's an essential voice in the world of contemporary art, and this new exhibition is a UK first, created especially for Edinburgh.
content_warnings: Contains distressing or potentially triggering themes, Scenes of violence

title: Jake Donaldson: The Fifth Weezer
description: Jake was born in the 90s, a teenager in the 2000s, and never really fit in. Turns out being into X-Men and the band Weezer didn’t win you much respect growing up in a North East ex-mining village. He only had one real dream but never followed it. Maybe all of this is why he’s ended up the way he is. Brand-new stand-up comedy from BBC New Comedy Award 2024 finalist Jake Donaldson, packed with nostalgia, punchy jokes and stories about finding your place in the world. ‘Excellent’ (Comedy.co.uk). ‘Truly brilliant humour’ **** (NorthWestEnd.co.uk).

title: James Acaster
presented_by: Plosive Live in association with PBJ Management
description: A brand-new show, full of everything you love about James Acaster and more! These shows are being filmed for future release, please arrive promptly as latecomers will not be admitted.
content_warnings: Strong language/swearing, please arrive promptly as latecomers will not be admitted and being filmed for future release, Buy a ticket in advance to guarantee entry or Pay What You Want at the venue

title: James Barr: A Punchy Title (WIP)
description: 'Hi James, We're finding audiences don't really want trauma right now. Would you consider something punchier? Warmly, The Industry.' NextUp's Biggest Award in Comedy nominee, James Barr is back with a brand-new show! A comedian and broadcaster on Hits Radio, he is the storyteller behind one of the most talked-about shows of Edinburgh Fringe 2025, Sorry I Hurt Your Son (Said My Ex To My Mum). British Comedy Guide's Best Reviewed Shows of Edinburgh Fringe 2025. ISH Edinburgh Comedy Awards Best Show longlist, British LGBT Awards 2025 Top 10 LGBTQ+ Public Figure.
content_warnings: Contains distressing or potentially triggering themes, Strong language/swearing

title: James Beatty: I'm Not Busy
description: James returns to Edinburgh with his brand-new solo show after previous critically acclaimed runs. Comedy’s cheekiest chap delivers a high-energy hour of sharp jokes, stories and brilliant crowd work that makes every show unique. Warm, quick-witted and effortlessly likeable, his conversational style feels like a hilarious chat with a mate. Expect big laughs, audience interaction and great vibes throughout. As audience members put it: 'Absolutely hilarious... if you only see one show this Fringe, make sure it’s this one.' 'Exactly what comedy at the Fringe should be.' 'Loved his positive outlook.'

title: James Mileham: 1 Joke After Another
description: 45 mins of stand-up from the reigning Roast Battle UK Champion. 'Incisive and prolific joke writer. He has made me howl with laughter' (Eshaan Akbar). If you like your jokes short, sharp with sprinkle of spice from one of the rising stars of the UK comedy scene, then this show is for you. If you are looking for a show with a deep message or a sad reflective moment, you will not find it here. All I have are jokes.
content_warnings: Strong language/swearing, Buy a ticket in advance to guarantee entry or Pay What You Want at the venue.
venue_name: Just The Tonic at The Mash House

title: James O'Donoghue Is Normal
description: James O'Donoghue is unlikely to cause issues for pensioners. James O'Donoghue is liked by all of their friends. James O'Donoghue Is Normal is a stand-up comedy show about WWII Soviet tank warfare, eight-year-old street hecklers and a very personal vendetta against Mickey Mouse. It is about failing spectacularly to be a Normal Human Being, while wearing a sequinned ballgown and six-inch heels. Defiantly weird and wickedly funny, enjoy a ramble through the wet pulsating brain of one of the most unique rising stars of the UK comedy circuit.
content_warnings: Audience participation, Contains distressing or potentially triggering themes, Strong language/swearing, Buy a ticket in advance to guarantee entry or Pay What You Want at the venue
venue_name: Just The Tonic at The Mash House

title: James Phelan: SHOWMAN
description: Direct from London's West End and an unprecedented run of sold out shows in theatres around the world – a show that guarantees to leave you aching with laughter and dizzy in disbelief. Presented by James Phelan, the first magician in history to sell out a two week solo run at The Magic Circle. Join us for the most astonishing and impossible night of magic.
content_warnings: Audience participation, Strobe lighting, Smoke, fire, haze.
venue_name: Underbelly’s Circus Hub on the Meadows

title: James Regal is a People Pleaser
description: Punchy hour of stand-up from a guy who's desperate to make you happy, no matter the cost. Based in Barcelona, James Regal has performed in top venues around the world since 2019 and is now bringing his debut show to the Fringe. Winner of Dov's Best Jewish Joke of the Edinburgh Fringe 2024. What other people said about James and hopefully meant it: 'Sharp and witty' (Michelle Wolf). 'An amazing joke writer' (Brian Moses). 'Loose, raw, and genuinely funny, with stories that somehow manage to be both wildly specific and totally relatable' (Audience member).

title: James Rowland: Team Viking
description: Ten years after premiering at the Edinburgh Fringe, Team Viking returns for another send-off. The remarkable, hilarious and heart-lifting story of how James managed to give his best mate the send-off he wanted. A comic ode to death, friendship and the beautiful absurdity of life. 'Joyous – heart lifting and incredibly moving' ***** (Stage). 'Sometimes stories are better than real life' ***** (TheWeeReview.com). 'A reminder that life really is for the living' **** (Fest). 'The best theatre I saw was Team Viking by James Rowland' (Stewart Lee).
content_warnings: This performance will contain strong language and distressing or potentially triggering themes surrounding death and illness.

title: Jamie Leonard: Blink of an Eye
presented_by: Jamie Leonard Magic / PBH’s Free Fringe
description: After a hugely successful 2025 Edinburgh Fringe – earning five-star reviews, multiple sell-out performances and a Best Show of the Fringe nomination (MixUpTheatre.com) – Jamie Leonard returns with Blink of an Eye, a stylish, story-driven hour of comedy and magic. Blending sharp wit, astonishing sleight of hand and moments of quiet wonder, the show explores time, attention and the things we miss when we’re not really looking. 'One of the best magic shows I’ve seen' ***** (MixUpTheatre.com). 'One of magic’s rising stars' (Colin Cloud).

title: Jane Austen's Love & Freindship [sic]
presented_by: Edinburgh Rep / Erstwhile Media / PBH’s Free Fringe
description:
When young Marianne convinces her aunt Laura to reveal her tragic origin, she little expects such a tale of death, robbery and heartbreak. And Laura wasn't even responsible for all of it.
Written when she was just a teenager, Love and Freindship [sic] is like no other Jane Austen story. Prepare for protagonists casually starving their parents to death, women fainting so often it's a deadly hazard, improbable revelations of parentage, dramatic (or underwhelming) death scenes, and, of course, the basis of real love being entirely that your parents don't approve.

title: Jane Eyre Convention
description: Jane Eyre Convention. At the world's first ever Jane Eyre Convention, slightly neurotic aficionados gather to reenact their favourite novel. They squabble and fight over the best bits, correct interpretation etc. Real emotions are experienced as they follow Jane on her journey, including running wailing across the moors. They also attempt to rescue shackled Bertha in the attic. Finally they gain new insights and generally feel better. Show contains unrealistic violence, bonnets and minimal raunch. It may be mildly therapeutic and audience participation is optional. Double Fringe First winners.
content_warnings: Audience participation, Buy a ticket in advance to guarantee entry or Pay What You Want at the venue
venue_name: Just The Tonic at The Mash House

title: January 6th the Musical
description: When violent insurrectionists stormed the United States Capitol on 6th January 2021, they ruined a birthday forever. Kiely and Jessie are best friends who share the same birthday and the same big dreams of theatrical stardom. On the fateful day of the insurrection, their birthday goes from bad to worse when allegations emerge of their involvement in the attempted coup. Faced with their special day going down in infamy and spending the rest of their lives in prison, can Kiely and Jessie sing and dance their way to innocence?
content_warnings: Audience participation, Strong language/swearing, Simulated gunshots

title: Japanese Grandma Funeral
description: Kento the clown missed his grandmother's funeral in Japan due to Covid restrictions. He's trying to recreate the traditional rites, but it keeps going wrong. Can the audience help him achieve closure in this gentle, heartwarming comedy? Blending clown and storytelling with Japanese and Okinawan funeral customs, Kento attempts to process 108 of his grandma's memories, along with unresolved thoughts and small, stubborn facts about her life, in a show that is both deeply personal, yet widely relatable. What begins as a failed ceremony becomes a gentle, intimate invitation to laugh, remember and let go.

title: Jason Byrne: 30 Years Byrning
presented_by: Phil McIntyre Live Ltd in assosciation with LTM Management
description: Jason Byrne is back "Byrning" brighter than ever, celebrating 30 glorious years of stand-up with his brand-new show, 30 Years Byrning. Byrne delivers a riotous night of high-energy storytelling, surreal tangents and unstoppable laughter. From razor-sharp observations to gloriously unhinged audience interaction and brave improvisation that has made Jason a festival favourite for three decades. This anniversary special is a hilarious return to props and stunts of the past decades, a fearless leap forward and a masterclass in comic mayhem. Do not blow it by missing this show, get tickets early, it makes sense.
content_warnings: Audiance Participation, No babies allowed in any performances of the show. The age rating for the show applies to everyone.

title: Jaz Mattu Fights His Audience
description: In my comedy career, work life and actual life, people have tried to fight me. Jaz Mattu Fights His Audience is about all those moments, why it keeps happening and how I deal with it, wrapped in one absurd, multimedia stand-up experience. Please don't try to fight me during the show. 'Truly unique.' **** (Entertainment-Now.com). 'Ambitious and innovative' (Fest). 'A great deal of creativity and ingenuity' (BroadwayBaby.com). Work in Progress.

title: Jazz a la Carte
description: We invite you to our quaint Brass-erie for a sumptuous supper of only the choicest cuts of traditional jazz. You, our audience, select from the musical menu for our evening together in this intimate venue. (No food included). Scotland's own Tenement Jazz Band have been delighting audiences across the UK with their hot brand of acoustic traditional jazz, ragtime and blues since 2018. With special guests from across Scotland, join them for this musical teatime treat in the bar where the band began. 'The future of traditional jazz is in good hands' (Bert Thompson, MusicWeb-International.com).

title: Jazz at Lunchtime
description: Sell-out shows since 2004. Saxophone and piano duo playing high-quality melodic jazz in a comfortable, intimate jazz club setting. A welcome break from the hustle and bustle of the Fringe. Includes 'Tales From the Tour Bus' from their tours around the UK and beyond in their tour bus (a converted ambulance). A favourite of the Fringe, now in its 21st year! Many audience members return year after year. Have lunch or just listen! More info at millarandspencer.co.uk

title: Jazz at the Fringe: Ballads, Spirituals and Blues
presented_by: Matt Holborn, Fraser Urquhart and Ed Kelly
description: Matt Holborn (violin), Fraser Urquhart (piano) and Edinburgh-based bassist Ed Kelly present a trio set drawn from the roots of American song and the early language of jazz. From traditional melodies and spirituals to favourites from the Great American Songbook, the programme centres on melody, storytelling and swing. Jazzwise praised Urquhart for '...melding the twin worlds of jazz modernism and American songbook exploration'. The performance also features music from Holborn’s album For Stuff, described by Jazzwise as 'a delightful album shedding sunlight on a rather neglected patch of jazz'.

title: Jazz in the Cellar
description: Descend beneath the street and into the atmospheric Argyle Cellar Bar for a truly intimate jazz experience. In this authentic cellar setting, there’s no distance between band and audience – just the shared pulse of live music shaped in the moment. The Argyle Jazz Quintet bring incredible melodies to life only a few feet away, creating a sound that is raw, immediate and alive. Every note is shared in real time, every solo unfolding before you. Featuring Nick Gould (tenor), Iain Carleton (guitar), David Midas (guitar/keys), Mark Crossley (double bass) and Kevin Dorrian (drums).

title: Jazz Jamboree
description: Dynamic renditions of great timeless jazz tunes from two award-winning performers: Paul – an improviser of subtle, inquisitive intelligence, and Dick – virtuosity with wit, feeling and not a little soul.

title: Jekyll and Hyde
description: Everyone has another face they hide behind... A radical re-imagining of Stevenson’s classic tale, where Victorian morality and modern feminist issues collide. This adaptation begins with Dr Jekyll’s wife, Harriet, continuing his work and exploring the duality of the soul – but her transformation is not all it seems. With powerful links between past and present, this gripping ensemble piece explores the timely question of how social change can be won, and at what cost. And crucially, do we all have a Hyde inside us?
content_warnings: Contains distressing or potentially triggering themes, Strong language/swearing

title: Jennifer Jane: Happy Tea
description: If you love true stories that are hilarious, heartfelt and a little bizarre, this is the show for you. Happy Tea is a one-hour real-life story of love, chaos and impossible choices, told through wildly honest stand-up storytelling. With an electric bear, lots of tea and unexpected turns, this story blends big laughs with real emotion as it shows how dark humour and resilience can carry you through the unthinkable. Unpredictable, provocative and ultimately uplifting. Directed by Stuart Laws.
content_warnings: Contains distressing or potentially triggering themes, Scenes of a sexual nature, Strong language/swearing, More information
venue_name: Just The Tonic at The Mash House

title: Jenny Gorelick: SORRY
description: Jenny Gorelick presents her flirty debut hour about bad dates and worse decisions. She’d like to pre-emptively apologize to every man she’s ever dated – or ever will – for writing about them. Directed by Ashley Rodbro. As seen on Netflix Is a Joke and in Cosmopolitan. 'Fiercely funny' and 'crush-worthy, ever charming' (Time Out). 'Incredible host' (Jezebel.com). New York Times Critic's Pick.
content_warnings: Strong language/swearing, Buy a ticket in advance to guarantee entry or Pay What You Want at the venue

title: Jeremy Dooley: Daddy Cool
description: Australia's Jeremy Dooley beings his debut solo show to the Edinburgh Fringe! Packed full of quick jokes and storytelling, with moments that will make you laugh out, be happy it wasn't you and all delivered with Dooley's signature blend of conversational hilarity, heart and delightful mayhem. 'About to take the world by storm' (ForteMag.com.au). 'Laugh until your guts hurt' (WeekendNotes.co.uk). 'Supremely talented. A rising star' (BeatMag.world) ***** (WhatsTheShow.com.au). ***** (27Magazine.com).

title: Jeromaia Detto: Giuseppe's Love Quest
description: Have you ever been in love? From the loins of multi award-winning goofball, Jeromaia Detto (Australia), the disarmingly charming Giuseppe Alfresco is desperate to finally find connection and fall in love. Winner Best Comedy Weekly Award – Adelaide Fringe 2026. 'Laughter therapy' ***** (@ThePerthDiary, Instagram). 'Magical evening of big-hearted humour' ***** (SeeDoEatReview.com). 'An abs workout and total laugh' **** (List). Praise for previous work: Winner of People's Choice Award, Sydney Fringe 2025. Judge's Pick (Comedy) – Melbourne Fringe, 2024. Winner of Best Comedy Weekly Award – Adelaide Fringe, 2024.

title: Jess Fuchs: Feral
description: Not all those who wander are lost. Sure... but some who wander are walking slowly because they've shattered their coccyx on the Cliffs of Moher. Jess Fuchs left home to avoid her problems and returned even more broken. This debut is less an hour of stand-up, more a much-needed debrief session with your best friend. Support for Fortune Fiemster, Gianmarco Soresi and Morgan Jay. 'Finding a new comic that hits every note is a rare treat. Fuchs is so relatable and clever' ***** (TheatreThoughtsAus.online). 'Uproarious... had the audience continuously laughing' **** (SydneyArtsGuide.com.au).

title: Jess Robinson: Elton Reimagined
presented_by: Jess Robinson, Topper & Fred with Sophie Chapman Management
description: Elton John's greatest hits are reimagined by multi award-winning Jess Robinson (Dead Ringers, The Last Leg), renowned for her pitch-perfect impressions. Celebrating Elton through the voices of iconic women: Britney, Barbra, Amy, and more, Jess returns for her 10th Fringe with her 'dazzling vocals and wickedly sharp impressions' ***** (BroadwayWorld.com). ***** (Edinburgh Festivals Magazine). ***** (Edinburgh-Reviews.co.uk). ***** (StageDoorJoe.co.uk). ***** (Edinburgh Evening News). **** (List). **** (Fest). **** (Chortle.co.uk). 'It's like a mega concert with all your favourite stars' (ITV1). 'Naturally funny, pitch perfect' (Telegraph).

title: Jessica Barton: Dirty Work
description: Mary Floppins has cracked the sh*ts. Wipe the wee from the toilet seat and pick up your dirty undies, because the perfect nanny is back to teach all you little boys – and girls – a thing or two about running a prim and proper household. Hailed 'a rising star and quadruple threat' (TheSpyInTheStalls.com) and returning after a completely sold-out Edinburgh Fringe run in 2025, Jessica Barton combines a spoonful of song, dance, clowning and deep-cleaning to present a skanky and empowering comedy debut. Newly directed by Dan Wye.
content_warnings: Audience participation, Scenes of a sexual nature, Strobe lighting, Strong language/swearing

title: Jessie Cave: Only Work [in progress]
description: Jessie explains what a year of doing "long hair content" has done to her psyche, confidence and bank balance. It's a strange story about the creator/subscriber dynamic and an exploration of fetishism and financial domination. No puppets included.
content_warnings: Scenes of sexual violence, Strong language/swearing
venue_name: Just The Tonic at The Caves

title: Jessies
description: Winner of the Creative Arts Award at the Proud Scotland Awards 2025, this powerful new play follows three unforgettable drag queens – The Jessies – and the staff of the infamous Jessie’s Bar in Scotland. Spanning from 1980 to 1995, the story dives into the highs and lows of queer life during a time of upheaval, hope and hard-won joy. Set against the backdrop of a changing world, this hilarious and deeply moving play is a celebration of resilience, love and the enduring power of community.
content_warnings: Contains distressing or potentially triggering themes, Nudity, Scenes of violence, Strong language/swearing

title: Jew-O-Rama
description: Return of the popular Fringe show that boasts a rolling line-up of Jewish (and Jew-ish) comedians and performers, bringing you the best in neurotic comedy. Oy vey! This show is in its 10th year and is loved by audiences of all persuasions. Brought to you by Aaron Levene and Philip Simon. 'Comedy is guaranteed' **** (Jewish Chronicle).

title: Jewellery of the World
description: This year we are celebrating 40 years of exhibiting world jewellery at the Edinburgh Festival Fringe. A magnificent exhibition, featuring jewellery from the Sahara, Central Asia and India, antique glass trade bead jewellery, amber, pearls, lapis lazuli, turquoise and modern designer jewellery from Thailand.

title: Jewish Plot
description:
Jewish Plot is a shape-shifting work of meta-theatre by Torrey Townsend. What begins as a witty reconstruction of a fictional Victorian melodrama about antisemitism fractures in real time, erupting into a searing contemporary reckoning with Jewish identity, politics and inheritance. Fierce, funny and unflinching, the play asks what it means to create – and to belong – amid historical trauma and present-day violence.
Following a sold-out New York premiere and recognition by Vulture as one of 2025’s Top 10 Plays in New York City, Jewish Plot is daring, urgent theatre at its most alive.
content_warnings: Contains distressing or potentially triggering themes, Strong language/swearing

title: Jill's Tupperware Party
presented_by: Asparagus Mousse productions starring Coral Bevan and Ricky Hunt
description: You're invited to Jill's Tupperware Party. A perfect world where plastic lids click, smiles almost never falter and microwaves hum with divine purpose. Jill's Tupperware Party is an auspicious afternoon where sales records, hearts and bones could all be broken. This interactive comedy-horror blends retro suburban camp with B-movie terror all sealed in a pastel fantasy. Come join the party. What's the worst that could happen? You're in the company of friends...
content_warnings: Audience will be standing, Contains potentially triggering themes, Strobe lighting, Audience required to move around during the performance,satirical cult themes,audience participation and immersive interaction.

title: Jill Weiner: Soup Freak
description: Jill Weiner's Soup Freak is darkly funny, silly, smart and sharp hour of stand-up comedy. With topics ranging from Peloton to gas huffing, dating a guy in a van to suicide by sea, Jill expresses her perspective on the human condition while sharing her own insecurities, memories and, of course, favourite soups, stews and stocks. From top to bottom, better said, soup to nuts, her show maintains a high energy level akin to a slumber party at 2am.
content_warnings: Audience participation, Strong language/swearing, Buy a ticket in advance to guarantee entry or Pay What You Want at the venue.
venue_name: Just The Tonic at The Mash House

title: Jitters
presented_by: Country Mile Productions in association with United Agents
description: 'I've dreamed of this day. My whole life.' There's one hour to go before the wedding, but now the wedding may not be going ahead. From Lyn Gardner-recommended double act Britney – aka Ellen Robertson (Vladimir, Mickey17, The Pale Horse) and Charly Clive (Rooster, Pure, The Lazarus Project) – comes a brand new two-hander about ownership, tradition and the all-important 'L' word of any relationship: leverage. Praise for previous shows: 'Charly Clive and Ellen Robertson's wonderfully infectious relationship radiates warmth and mischief from the stage' **** (Scotsman). 'A surreal, sensitive triumph' **** (Independent). 'Funny, heart-wrenching and honest' (i Paper).
content_warnings: Contains distressing or potentially triggering themes

title: Jody Kamali: This is My Dad
description: After his father's sudden death, Jody digs through his belongings, uncovering the man he thought he knew. Suddenly, he's back for one hour to tell us who he was. Playing both himself and his father, Jody unpicks his Dad's bizarre life in a thoughtful, funny theatrical solo show about grief, secrets and the contradictions within us all. From the creator of the fringe hit Ironing Board Man: 'Makes every individual moment entertaining' (Stage). 'A genius for storytelling' (GetYourCoatsOn.com). 'Astonishing' (DarkChat.co.uk). 'Demands applause' (Scotsman).

title: Joe Casey and Pierce Higgins: Northern Soul
description: Joe Casey and Pierce Higgins present a split-bill stand-up show from two of the Scottish scene's fastest rising stars. Joe Casey has been shortlisted for the BBC New Comedy Awards while Pierce Higgins has supported Paddy McDonnell, Stuart McPherson and Gary Faulds on tour.

title: Joe Sib: Aggie – A Comedy About Moms
description: Joe Sib returns to Fringe with his most personal and universal hour yet. Aggie is a hilarious and heartfelt stand-up show about the one person who loved you first. Through sharp storytelling, big laughs and honest moments, Joe explores what it means to be raised by someone who would do anything for you, and what happens when you realise you would do anything for them too. It is about mothers, family and the stories that shape us. Guaranteed laughs and maybe a few tears.

title: Johann Sebastian Bach
description: The Bach Ensemble of Edinburgh return to the Edinburgh Festival Fringe at Canongate Kirk for the 14th time with an all Bach programme featuring highly accomplished soprano Angela Hicks and the exciting young trumpeter Aaron Akugbo in the cantata Jauchzet Gott in allen Landen. The Brandenburg Concerto No. 6 will feature violists Daisy Richards and Robert Dick and the programme is completed with Orchestral Suite No. 1 featuring oboists Morven Bell and Helen Wright, and bassoonist Abi Adam.

title: John Achkar: His country is collapsing. He's having a baby. So obviously, this is the right year for a Lebanese comedian you've never heard of to try English stand-up for the first time.
description: Fresh off a sold-out Arabic tour across 85 cities, John has decided, for reasons he's still figuring out, that now is the time to try stand-up in his third language. He hasn't checked if Edinburgh is ready. He hasn't checked if his vocabulary is ready. But somewhere in the chaos, he's betting on one simple theory: we're all carrying the same stories, just told in different languages.
content_warnings: Buy a ticket in advance to guarantee entry or Pay What You Want at the venue
venue_name: Just The Tonic at The Caves

title: John and Christian: Teenage Heartthrobs
description: 'Give me a time, give me a venue, I know what I'm having when Love's On The Menu...' Move over Oasis: it’s the reunion gig of your favourite 00s boyband that definitely existed – The Teenage Heartthrobs. Hear the scandalous, moving, and at times erotic story of the band’s rollercoaster journey from rags to riches and back to rags. Featuring the hits ‘Ooo Girl’, ‘Monday Morning’ and many more. Hilarious musical comedy from John and Christian, the BBC-featured, Leicester Square Sketch-Off 2025 semi-finalists. 'Hilarious' **** (VoiceMag.uk). 'Flight of the Conchords meets Busted' (Jake Baker).

title: John Hegley's New and Selected Potatoes
description: A warm, witty and utterly unmissable evening of comic poetry, musical mischief and wry chat. Featuring a selection of John Hegley's work from his enormous oeuvre – old favourites mixed with newer work, along with the kind of optional audience participation he does best: the fun kind, that audiences really enjoy doing, not the embarrassing cringey stuff. Every audience with Hegley is a night of community – and a rollicking pleasure to boot. One of the UK's most original and endearing voices. 'Fabulously funny' (Time Out). 'Scandalously talented' (Sunday Times). 'An incurable entertainer' (Guardian).

title: John-Luke Roberts: What I Talk About When I Run About, Talking
description: Fringe legend returns with his first new show in four years. Hilarious stand-up about the human condition, about how little we know about what’s going on inside our bodies and our minds, and about what it’s like to have an endoscopy on Remembrance Sunday at exactly 11am. Some poems too. Maybe a few songs. Five to six laughs a minute, so at least three hundred total which is pretty good actually. Good quality laughs, too, real marrow-shakers. Fringe Legend Award winner. ***** (List). ***** (Fest). **** (Guardian). **** (Telegraph).
content_warnings: Strong language/swearing, Buy a ticket in advance to guarantee entry or Pay What You Want at the venue

title: John O'Keeffe: Surviving Myself
description: After a sold-out 2025 run, the hit show returns! Accepting responsibility for life's disasters with sharp, self-deprecating humour. From therapy struggles, to awkward relationships and common frustrations, this hilarious Irishman will have you laughing non-stop. One of the most exciting stand-ups in the Irish comedy scene. Winner Best New Act Award at Bray Comedy Festival, he has performed with top comedians such as Michelle Wolf, Joanne McNally, David O'Doherty and Neil Delemare. 'So funny' (Wendy Liebman). 'Classic stand-up' (Ruben Rajah). 'Savage' (Amos Gill). 'A cracking Irish comedian' (Comedy.co.uk). **** (One4Review.co.uk). **** (TheWeeReview.com). Comedy.co.uk recommended show 2025!

title: John O'Keeffe: Work in Progress
description: After a sell-out show in 2025, award-winning Irish comedian John O’Keeffe debuts a new work-in-progress show in Edinburgh! One of the most exciting stand-ups in the Irish comedy scene and Best New Act Award-winner for Bray Comedy Festival. He has performed with Michelle Wolf, Joanne McNally, David O’Doherty, Neil Delamare and provided tour support for Steve Hofstetter and Amos Gill. ‘So funny’ (Wendy Liebman). ‘Classic stand-up... a real showman’ (Ruben Rajah). 'Savage' (Amos Gill). **** (One4Review.co.uk). **** (TheWeeReview.com). Comedy.co.uk recommended solo show 2025! 'Lushly unpredictable, dark but personable, a cracking Irish comedian' (Comedy.co.uk).

title: John Robertson: Excitable Boy!
description: The UK’s most manic comic! Life-affirming, high-octane improv filth! 'A force of nature' **** (Daily Telegraph). 'Secure tickets now before some Taskmaster-type programme claims him for mainstream fame and his star becomes unreachable' **** (TheReviewsHub.com). Expect trademark wildness from the creator of legendary improv game-show – The Dark Room (British Comedy Guide’s Best-Reviewed Comedy Edinburgh Fringe 2025 and nominated Best International Act New Zealand Comedy Festival 2025). Check viral clips on Instagram: @Mr_Dark_Room, TikTok: @RobbotronTwitch, YouTube: Robbotron.

title: John Robertson's The Dark Room
description: Come play the legendary Fringe live-action videogame! Win money or ya die! New deathtraps for 2026! The Dark Room fuses improv, gaming and stand-up into the Fringe's most deranged gameshow! Sold out 2019-2025. Best-reviewed comedy show of Edinburgh Festival Fringe 2025 (Comedy.co.uk). 'Hilarious' (Independent). 'Rocky Horror for nerds... I howled' **** (Telegraph). 'Not to be missed' (Guardian). Viral on TikTok and Instagram, as seen at Glastonbury, Download, PAX, MCM Comic Con and on national UK tour. Winner: Legends of Lockdown Chortle Award. Nominated: Best International Act, NZ International Comedy Festival 2025. Find out more: TheJohnRobertson.com.
content_warnings: Audience participation, Strong language/swearing, Flashing lights

title: John Tothill: Close Your Eyes With Holy Dread For He On Honey-Dew Hath Fed, And Drunk The Milk Of Paradise (WIP)
description: Edinburgh Comedy Award 2025 nominee, John Tothill, is back to work up a brand-new show. Expect an hour that is the only thing better than good – useful to him. Chortle.co.uk Awards Best Show nominee 2026. 'One of the funniest hours of stand-up at this year’s Fringe' ***** (Telegraph). 'One of the most distinctive stand-up voices of his generation' ****½ (Chortle.co.uk). 'Brings us closer to stand-up paradise' **** (Guardian). As seen/heard on Channel 4, E4 and BBC Radio 4.
space_name: Nic 2 (The Main Hall, Nicolson Square Venues)

title: John Tothill: This Must Be Heaven
presented_by: Country Mile Productions in association with United Agents
description: John Tothill's critically-acclaimed, Edinburgh Comedy Award-nominated show returns for its final ever performances. In 2024, John nearly died. In 2025, he went on an underwhelming cruise. Both events were equally life-changing. Join him in his own personal paradise as he continues to monetise what life he has left. Guardian's Top Comedy Shows 2025. Best-Reviewed Fringe Shows 2025 (Comedy.co.uk). 'The show of his life' ***** (Evening Standard). ***** (Telegraph). **** (Guardian, Times, Scotsman). Support for Simon Amstell, Alan Davies and Emma Sidi. Featured on 8 Out of 10 Cats Does Countdown and This American Life.

title: John Wayne Gacy: The Killer Clown, Born Evil?
description: Gacy was one of the most prolific serial killers in US history. Between 1972 and 1978 in Chicago, he was responsible for the rape, torture and murder of at least 33 innocent teenage boys and young men. He became known as the Killer Clown due to his public performances as a clown prior to his crimes. In this theatrical piece, his story is told from his own perspective in chilling, vivid and unrelenting detail. This production is in memory of the 33 who died at the hands of a 'devil in disguise'.
content_warnings: Contains distressing or potentially triggering themes, Strong language/swearing

title: Johnny and June: The Story of Johnny Cash and June Carter
description: Fresh from their UK tour, Johnny and June hits the Fringe! This is a powerful live theatre experience celebrating the music, love, and legacy of the Man in Black – Johnny Cash – and the iconic June Carter. This show brings to life the sound and spirit of two of country music’s most legendary voices. From Folsom Prison Blues to Ring of Fire, and Jackson to I Walk the Line, this is more than just a concert – it’s a journey through the heart and soul of American music.

title: Johnny Hollywood
description: Dublin Fringe award-winner, John Spillane, has gone full Hollywood and is ready to bring all the glitz and the glamour of tinsel town to the Edinburgh Fringe. Moving at a mile a minute, this show is weaponised chaos, a Fringe experience unlike any other! Host of Ladbible Ireland. Socials @JohnSpillaneComedy. As seen on Comedy Central, RTÉ, WWE, SXSW and more. 'John may be the most talented and naturally funny performer at the Fringe' ***** (Distractify.com). 'The maddest man on the Irish scene' (IrelandBeforeYouDie.com). 'One of the country's most energetic performers' (RTE.ie).

title: Join the Club! A Story About the Sex You Never Wanted
description: One woman’s journey to reclaim agency after trauma, blending humour and heartbreak to transform silence, shame and survival into connection and empowerment. Between hook-ups, vibrators and Tinder, she navigates the chaotic hellscape of modern dating. With wit and no-holds-barred honesty, it confronts a culture of sexual misbehaviour while celebrating resilience and desire. Raw, funny and disarmingly intimate, it asks the unaskable – like whether survivors should wear matching sashes – and invites audiences to laugh, reflect and heal alongside her as she rewrites her story on her terms.
content_warnings: Contains distressing or potentially triggering themes, Scenes of a sexual nature, Scenes of sexual violence, Strong language/swearing

title: Joke Thieves: World Championship
description: The cult hit show returns – bigger, riskier and more competitive than ever. Comedians go joke-for-joke, showcasing their own material before fearlessly performing their rivals jokes, battling for the title, the championship belt and a £1500 cash prize. 'A brilliant format' (Guardian). 'An undoubted hit' (Chortle.co.uk). Piloted for Comedy Central (US) and BBC Two (UK). Top five comedy shows of the year (List). Top 10 late nights out at the Fringe (Time Out). Top 25 shows at the Fringe (Comedy.co.uk). 'Spontaneous and anarchic' **** (Fest). 'A truly electric night' **** (Scotsman). ‘Action-packed and chaotic’ **** (BroadwayBaby.com).

title: Jokers in the Pack
description: A compilation show featuring four of the funniest comedians from across the Edinburgh Fringe! The line-ups are shuffled daily so you're always sure to get dealt the very best of all the jokers! Expect storytelling, one-liners and a little bit of naughtiness! Every show is different, so make sure you check out a Jokers in the Pack show! It's always loads of fun and you're guaranteed a great night's entertainment!

title: Jollybox Party Games
description: The comedy game show where you the audience play along! Quip, quiz and draw your way to VICTORY! It's like a smartphone pub quiz, but with no correct answers. If you like party games, Jackbox games, or just trying something fun and different, this is for you. Bring a charged smartphone and join the party! Previous Shows: ***** (ThreeWeeks), ***** (BroadwayBaby.com), ***** (InformedEdinburgh.co.uk), ***** (GeekChocolate.co.uk).
content_warnings: Audience participation, Content is written live by the audience.
venue_name: Binkies Lounge at PBH's Free Fringe @ Whistlebinkies

title: Jonathan Oldfield: Exquisite Corpse
description: The Oxford English Dictionary describes a corpse as (1) a body or (2) spoiling a performance by laughing. Jonathan Oldfield will be using both definitions in his highly anticipated debut show of exquisitely silly character comedy. Creator and star of BBC Radio 4's award-winning Time of the Week. BBC New Comedy Awards finalist. Director of Lorna Rose Treen and Joe Kent-Walters. You also may have seen him in Star Wars: Andor or online in those sketches someone sent to you. 'Brilliant' (Observer). 'Always funny' (Chortle.co.uk). 'Left me snorting with laughter' (BroadwayWorld.com).

title: Jonathan Rudge: Stay at Home Son
description: In this, his brand new show 'Stay at Home Son', Londoner (oh shut up) Jonathan dives into the world of messed-up-millennials and manifesting adoption into the Beckhams now there's a spare seat at the table (Love heart hands Brooklyn x). Nominated for no awards and never a sold-out show – Jonathan is fresh meat. This is a chance to see him before he hits the big time so don't miss out. *Not written by ChatGPT.
venue_name: Just The Tonic at The Mash House

title: Jonno: Here Comes Mr Funny
description: Hello son. So you’re reading back your old man’s show blurbs, are ya? This one was for my first (and, sadly, best) show Here Comes Mr Funny way back in 2026! While I have your attention, if you find a way to travel back to the past, let’s have a same-age arm wrestle. I’d love to see who comes out on top. Can’t wait to defeat you. Can’t wait to conceive you. Yours, Dad. Jonno is in Sheeps ***** (Guardian), 'funny' (Chortle.co.uk), 'Johnson' (Times) and is the Head Writer for Saturday Night Live UK.
content_warnings: Audience participation, Buy a ticket in advance to guarantee entry or Pay What You Want at the venue

title: Jonty O'Callaghan's Got Some Notes: A One-Man Sketch Show
description: A five-star one-man sketch show packed with fast-paced, character-driven comedy. Expect madness and audience participation. And maybe a unicorn or two. It's gonna be a laugh... Fresh from a five-star run at Camden Fringe 2025 and Brighton Fringe 2026, the show is coming to Just the Tonic at Edinburgh Fringe for its first-ever run of performances in Edinburgh! Get your tickets now for a great hour of laughs that'll leave you feeling uplifted and involved in the chaos!
venue_name: Just The Tonic at The Caves

title: Jordan Brookes: The Part of You That's Always Screaming
presented_by: Country Mile Productions in association with PBJ Management
description: The award-winning Elvis of comedy continues his residency at the gates of Hell, with a new show inspired by an absolutely shocking incident on a train. Have you ever felt seen and unseen at the same time? Have you ever wondered what's lurking just in the corner of your vision? Yeah me too, what is that? What IS that?? 'Absurd... achingly funny' ***** (Scotsman). 'Majestic and challenging' ***** (List). 'Profound' ***** (Skinny). 'Funny and disorientating' **** (Chortle.co.uk). 'The existential Michael McIntyre' **** (Guardian).
content_warnings: This show contains strobe lighting and loud noises.

title: Joseph Morpurgo: Highlander 70
presented_by: Berk's Nest in association with Independent Talent Group
description: The Edinburgh Comedy Award nominee and cult favourite returns with a deliriously funny new show. 'That rare thing, a high-concept, unashamedly arty production that also has entire rooms laughing'  ***** (Evening Standard). 'A rich, multilayered comedy experience, that’s both retro and cutting edge, and keeps whirling away in your mind long after it’s finished' ***** (Time Out). 'The UK’s foremost alchemist of “found” comedy and irreverent, cross-media mash-up humour' **** (Scotsman). ***** (Skinny). **** (Times).

title: Josh Glanc: New Show / Musical / Something (WIP)
description: Edinburgh Comedy Award nominee returns to Fringe to work on his brand-new show. 'Imagine Robin Williams but Australian' (New York Times). 'An extraordinary talent' **** (Scotsman). 'Joyfully subversive' ****  (List). **** (Guardian). A work-in-progress show from one of Australia's 'most exciting talents' **** (Sydney Morning Herald).
content_warnings: Audience participation, Scenes of a sexual nature, Scenes of violence, Buy a ticket in advance to guarantee entry or Pay What You Want at the venue

title: Josh Pickar: Getting Off
description: Death penalty defense attorney Josh Pickar debuts a high-energy hour of stand-up and clown. From a stripper who accidentally stopped executions to a suicidal groundhog, Getting Off offers a darkly hilarious look at the bizarre theatre of capital punishment.
content_warnings: Audience participation, Contains distressing or potentially triggering themes, Strong language/swearing

title: Joshy in Paris
description: Aussie comedian Joshua Hauville presents a spectacular comedy cabaret that shares the story of a gay Australian trying to make it as a creative superstar in the piss-ridden streets of Paris. Like Emily in Paris but gay and broke, told through a camp blend of stand-up, cabaret and clowny burlesque. After touring the show throughout Australia, Europe and the UK, this show is glitzier, grungier and gayer than ever. Join Joshy as he braves a slew of ridiculous scenarios. Will he triumph over Paris, or will France smoke this fag just like every other?

title: JOSIAH
description: Based on the autobiography of Josiah Henson. Born into slavery in Maryland, enduring 41 years of unimaginable brutality and persecution before escaping to Canada. The play dramatises his unwavering resilience, determination and faith; the indomitable spirit which led him to become a respected leader, minister and teacher. His story inspired Harriet Beecher Stowe to create Uncle Tom in the seminal novel of the 19th Century – Uncle Tom’s Cabin. This is a story that matters today in a time when histories are being erased and challenged. It is a compelling true Canadian story of triumph over adversity.
content_warnings: Contains distressing or potentially triggering themes, Scenes of violence, Strong language/swearing, Contains the sound of lashing that may be triggering to some. These are historically accurate devices appropriate to the period.

title: JUDAS EXCLUSIVE
description: Mere days after the death of Jesus Christ and hell-bent on clearing his name, Judas Iscariot makes his first public appearance on Simona Tonight, an ailing late-night talk show. But 33 AD Judea is a volatile place, and it's not just Judas and Simona whose reputations are on the line, but the broadcast TV industry's. Exploring themes of celebrity, betrayal and redemption, Judas Exclusive is a psychedelic channel-changing odyssey across 33 AD Judea through the dying lens of broadcast TV.

title: Juliette Burton: Villain Era
description: As the sun sets, a new antihero awakens. Calling all big-hearted heroes! Award-winning comedian Juliette Burton is summoning YOU. Join the dark side in a comedy quest for grown-up geeks and justice-hungry joy seekers ready to battle the REAL dragons: inequality and bad sex lives. It's time to iron out the kinks! Burton brings armour of hard truths, high fantasy and hilarity. Live nerdgasms possible. 'Fun, fabulous, relatable, and a safe space for nerds. **** (Edinburgh-Reviews.co.uk). Praise for previous shows: 'Hilarious' ***** (EdFestMag.com). 'Marvellous' ***** (StarburstMagazine.com). ***** (VoiceMag.uk). ***** (FemaleArts.wordpress.com). 'Fringe favourite' (Guardian). 'Fringe legend' (FringeReview.co.uk).

title: JULIUS CAESAR VARIETY SHOW
presented_by: Joy Nesbitt supported by Culture Ireland
description: JULIUS CAESAR VARIETY SHOW is the worst audition you've ever had. A Black actor, a woman actor, and a straight white male actor walk into a Shakespeare audition in a condemned theatre space. Amidst a riot outside the theatre, three auditionees attempt to impress an intensely respected director set on reinventing the play in "unorthodox" styles. As the audition unfolds, the actors' identities are called into the audition room and exploited for better performances.
content_warnings: Contains distressing or potentially triggering themes, Scenes of violence, Strong language/swearing

title: July 15th to...
presented_by: Producer: Wangjiayu Chu (Stephanie) Performer: Peiyi Zhong
description: A one-woman physical theatre performance about bipolar disorder, trauma, and the long, non-linear search for healing. We enter Ella’s world as she moves through cycles of intensity, creativity, doubt and emotional collapse. Moments from the past surface without warning, interrupting the present and blurring her sense of time. Through movement, the piece makes visible what is often hidden, the swing of mood, the weight of silence and how trauma settles in the body. At its heart, the work asks whether confronting painful truths can lead to healing, exploring the fragile space between survival and recovery.
content_warnings: Contains distressing or potentially triggering themes, Strobe lighting

title: Just Blokes
description: A gay man, a total virgin, a soldier and Buddha walk into a bar. Just Blokes, new Scottish writing, explores male relationships today through sharp dialogue and uncomfortable honesty, challenging masculinity, vulnerability and the quiet pressures men place on themselves and each other. When silence is treated as strength and humour as the universal bandage, what remains unspoken? The piece asks how men can better advocate for themselves and for one another, questioning stoicism as survival, laughter as the best medicine and the Irish goodbye as the only way to leave a party.
content_warnings: Strong language/swearing, Nudity, Scenes of a sexual nature and of violence, Contains distressing or potentially triggering themes

title: Justice
description: A solo show by Tiffany Esteb. Sarah is a lawyer at the top of her game. She defends tech companies against those who sue for damages caused from harassment on their sites, all in the name of freedom speech. When she is harassed herself, she has to face the world she helped to create.
content_warnings: Contains distressing or potentially triggering themes

title: Justin Elizabeth Sayre Is a 40-Year-Old Woman
description: A comedy about false eyelashes and the truth that sizzles beneath: with the signature wit that's made them a staple of downtown New York, Sayre celebrates the stylish women of yesteryear and forges a path towards being the witty, wonderful, fabulous and foul-mouthed dame they've always dreamed they'd be. To Sayre, being a 40-Year-Old Woman is more than candles on a cake; it's a way of being fully yourself. Fasten your seat belts, it's going to be a hilarious ride!

title: Kafka for Beginners
description: In an imaginary, yet all-too-recognisable empire, a poet languishes in solitary confinement for the “heresy” of confiding to his own diary the perilously obvious: 2+2=4. Will he “recant” to save his life? Will he let himself be bribed just to survive? Will he go mad? Will he stay true to his ideals of love, freedom beyond the power of tyrants and their bullying to suppress? How can he stay hopeful when it seems all hope is lost? A dark comedy inspired by true stories of prisoners of conscience around the world.

title: Kanpur: 1857
presented_by: Niall Moorjani in association with Jasmine Cole Productions
description: The Fringe First-winning, sell-out smash-hit Kanpur: 1857 returns to the Edinburgh Fringe. Strapped to a cannon, an Indian rebel finds themselves answering to a British officer for the crimes of Kanpur. Based on historical events, this new play comically satirises contemporary conflicts around gender, colonial violence and making art in times of crisis. Written by and starring 'storytelling genius' ***** (Scotsman) Niall Moorjani, and co-directed by and starring Jonathan Oldfield, director of 2024's Best Newcomer Award-winning show. But who is the hero and who is the villain? Whatever happens, it's going to be explosive.
content_warnings: This show references moments of historical violence, racism and colonial oppression and contains strong language.

title: Kat Ronson: Millennial Girl (WIP)
description: Millennial Girl throws you headfirst into the drama, nostalgia and chaos of the 2000s through Kat Ronson’s viral throwback character, Katie, amassing over 70 million views online. Join Katie as she salutes the generation that didn’t break the internet, but built it. Millennial Girl will haunt you with sweeping fringes, limewire viruses and questions you couldn't help but ask... ASL? Kat Ronson, hailed by Wonderland as 'One of British comedy’s brightest new talents', has performed to sold-out crowds across the UK, culminating in her sketch show 'The Whoreing Twenties' debuting at Leicester Square Theatre.

title: Kate Butch: A Kate in the Hand is Worth Two in the Butch
description: Kate Butch, the star of RuPaul's Drag Race UK, The Power of Parker, Celebrity Mastermind and at least three episodes of Crimewatch, is back in Edinburgh with a new stand-up show. This 'great comedian' (WhatsOnStage.com) is on a mission: become a better person or die trying. Through the medium of sequins, proverbs and foliage, join Kate as she dissects the shadiest moments of her life and find out whether you really can teach an old dog to change its spots as it shits in the woods.
content_warnings: This show contains strong language and adult themes.

title: Kate Dolan: Trout
description: Join award-winning comedian Kate Dolan for her brand new hour of rapid-fire, off-kilter stand up. In 2026, is being a fish in the river nicer than a woman on land? 'Irrepressibly funny... reminiscent of Jim Carrey' **** (Scotsman). 'Her performance screams star quality' **** (Chortle.co.uk). 'A wild assault of jokes, voices, act outs and asides... Where have you been all of my comedy life?' **** (Fest). Winner of the Skinny-Fest Festival Breakthrough Award 2025 and Melbourne Comedy Festival's Golden Gibbo Independent Show Award 2025.
content_warnings: Buy a ticket in advance to guarantee entry or Pay What You Want at the venue

title: Kate Hammer: Government Approved Comedian
description: One Canadian needs to make you laugh, otherwise she will be deported. Join Kate as she navigates proving herself to get a Global Talent Visa, getting dominated on Vinted, and breaking up with an identical twin. As seen on Breaking the News, BBC Scotland, Roast Battle League and Channel 4. 'A full package, all tools comedian... It is impossible not to vibe with Hammer' (Comedy.co.uk). 'Frenetic and clownishly graphic' (Chortle.co.uk). 'Dynamic and charismatic' (BroadwayWorld.com). 'Delightful on stage… knows exactly how to land a line' (One4Review.co.uk).
content_warnings: Strong language/swearing, Buy a ticket in advance to guarantee entry or Pay What You Want at the venue

title: Kathleen Hughes: Twig
description: Like most people, Kathleen comes from a long line of other people. Following her acclaimed Fringe debut, Glaswegian comic Kathleen Hughes returns with a show all about family, legacy and why we're all like this. 'Confidence, charm and whip-smart wit... an incredibly funny woman' (Skinny). 'One of the bright new hopes of Scottish comedy' (Scotsman).

title: Katie Mitchell: Giddy
description: In the Los Angeles suburb of Ilkeston, Derbyshire, there’s scams brewin’. Under the earth, seeping up between your toes from where the coal used to be. Here is a place of monsters, darkness and sports! Join the World’s Greatest Sportsman Katie Mitchell for an hour of absolute silliness about how growing up an orphan on a council estate is the third funnest thing you can do. In an ambitious return to character comedy, Mitchell (Best in Class 2023, **** BroadwayWorld.com, **** TheWeeReview,com) is setting out to make her silliest and yet most autobiographical show yet.

title: Katie Pritchard is Sir Elton Scone
description: Get ready for a madcap, comedy-gameshow adventure from Leicester Comedy Festival Best Variety Show nominee – Katie Pritchard. Expect songs, romps, the best suit ever made out of a pair of curtains, and the unexpected in this off-the-wall caper which obeys no conventional rules! This b!tch is batch cooking! 'A comedy music powerhouse' ***** (VoiceMag.uk). 'Literally the most hilarious thing in the world' ***** (PepperAndSalt.uk). 'One of my favourite shows' ***** (ThePhoenixRemix.com). Musical Comedy Award-winner. As seen on Harry Hill’s Clubnite (Channel 4). Directed by Adam Larter.

title: Keep It Tight Podcast Live – Deirdre O'Kane and Emma Doran
presented_by: Deirdre O'Kane and Emma Doran / Storied Management Limited.
description: Queens of Irish comedy, Deirdre O’Kane and Emma Doran, are bringing their hit podcast Keep It Tight on the road. Fresh from their weekly podcast success, Deirdre and Emma are hitting the stage to share their take on everything that’s delighted, bewildered or downright enraged them. Expect quick wit with no topic off limits – from the highest brow to the lowest pelvic floor! With their natural chemistry and razor-sharp humour, this is your chance to see two comedic powerhouses live and unfiltered.

title: Kemah Bob: Love Child
presented_by: Berk's Nest in association with Sophie Chapman Talent
description: The acclaimed stand-up (The Guardian's 10 best comedy shows of 2024) returns with her much anticipated second hour, asking if we ever really stop growing up? ISH Edinburgh Comedy Award Best Newcomer nominee 2024. As seen on QI, Richard Osman's House of Games, Jonathan Ross' Comedy Club, Comedy Central Live, Don't Hate The Playaz and Guessable. As heard on the Off Menu podcast. 'Chest-achingly funny' **** (Skinny). 'A delight to witness on stage' **** (Fest). 'Kemah's presence is captivating' **** (DIVA Magazine). **** (Guardian). **** (List). Directed by Alison Spittle.

title: KEVIN!!!!!
description: From the creators of smash hits Hold On To Your Butts and Fly, You Fools comes a new UK premiere! Four actors and a Foley artist perform a live, shot-for-shot parody of the greatest Christmas film of all time. Recent Cutbacks returns with an astonishing blend of comedy, puppetry, live projections and Foley in this wildly inventive and hilarious homage to the 90s classic about leaving your kid alone... at home. 'Laugh-out-loud funny' (StageBuddy.com). 'One breathless hour' (New York Times). 'Loving parody at its finest' (ManhattanDigest.com).

title: Kevin Quantum: Invisible Force
description: What is the most powerful force in the universe? You may be closer to it than you realise. In this thrilling new show, magician-scientist Kevin Quantum explores the hidden forces that shape your world. Electricity crackles, reality bends and impossible moments unfold that feel both scientific and otherworldly. Trained by Penn & Teller and winner of Best Magic (Adelaide Fringe), expect raw, unfiltered magic from a world-class showman. 'Astonishing' ***** (Edinburgh Evening News). 'Defies imagination' ***** (Advertiser, Adelaide). 'Unfathomable' **** (Scotsman). Think you know what's real? Think again.

title: Kevin! [The Musical]
description: Described as High School Musical on crack! Kevin! [The Musical] is an up-and-coming dark comedy show written by Will Sharland. It follows an exchange student from England, named Kevin, who comes to America intending to find out what the USA is really like in 2026. Kevin, however, finds himself trapped inside the world of a cheesy high school musical, which only becomes more absurd and nightmarish during his time across the pond. Kevin is unsure who to trust as everyone seems crazy, though it might be Kevin himself, or something else, that is actually going insane...
content_warnings: Audience participation, Contains distressing or potentially triggering themes: racism, gun control, misogyny, torture, conspiracies, mental illness and shool shootings, Scenes of violence, Strobe lighting, Strong language/swearing, Loud noises

title: Kiell Smith-Bynoe's Kool Story Bro
description: Following a huge debut national tour and sell-out runs across London and Edinburgh, Kiell Smith-Bynoe (Ghosts, Taskmaster, Stath Lets Flats) is bringing his smash-hit improv show back to the Fringe. Featuring a celebrity guest every night, a cast of the UK's best improvisers and stories from you, the audience, to inspire the comedy! Previous special guests have included: Amelia Dimoldenberg, Lily Allen, Jamie Demitriou, Adam Buxton, Mo Gilligan, Lolly Adefope and Nish Kumar. Previous improvisers have included: Emma Sidi, Lola-Rose Maxwell, Graham Dickson, Lara Ricote, Janine Harouni, Nic Sampson, Brendan Murphy and Rob Gilbert.
content_warnings: This show contains audience participation and strong language.

title: Killer Comedy Club
description: Killer Comedy Club brings you the very best comedy talent from the UK comedy circuit and beyond for a killer night of stand-up comedy. Hosted by Harry Stachini, 'British comedy at its best' (One4Review.co.uk), and the award-winning Lewis Coleman. Join Harry and Lewis for an evening of laughs and a new special guest comedian every night. No gimmicks, just exactly what it says on the tin: Killer acts. Killer line-ups. Killer Comedy. It's a no-brainier choice for a guaranteed giggle!

title: Killian Sundermann: Killian Dollar Baby
description: One of Ireland's most exciting new comedy stars returns with a brand-new show. After his sell-out UK and Ireland tour in 2025 including a total sell-out run at the Edinburgh festival Killian is back with Killian Dollar Baby. Killian is one of the biggest stars of Irish sketch comedy with a huge online following. He is also one part of the award-winning Young Hot Guys podcast.

title: Kim Blythe: Puzzle
description: Sold out Fringe run 2025 and Sir Billy Connolly Spirit of Glasgow nominee 2025 and 2026. CLUES – Single Item (1) Foolish Bird (5,5) Onstage Routine (5,2) Stage Presentation (4)

title: Kim Edgar: Songs of Unity
description: Acclaimed Edinburgh-based songwriter Kim Edgar performs an uplifting evening of songs of unity. These include her own songs, and favourites from other songwriters, performed on grand piano and acoustic guitar. Feel connected, inspired and hopeful! Kim will be joined by a scratch choir who have learned some of the songs with her during a singing workshop that day. 'Heart stopping' (Sunday Herald). 'Very special' (Fatea-Records.co.uk). 'An inspired empathy... her gentle personality and relaxed interaction would melt the stoniest of hearts' ***** (FringeReview.co.uk). 'Probably one of the best songwriters in Britain today' ***** (SpiralEarth.co.uk).

title: Kim Edgar: Songs of Unity Singing Workshop
description: Join Kim Edgar, an experienced choir leader and acclaimed songwriter, to form a scratch choir to learn and perform uplifting songs in Kim’s Songs of Unity concert (7-9pm) – her own songs, and favourites from other songwriters, performed on grand piano and guitar. Feel connected, uplifted and hopeful! All welcome! BYO lunch plus a break to go out and have your dinner elsewhere before the show. No sight-reading required. 'Heart stopping' (Sunday Herald). 'An inspired empathy... her gentle personality and relaxed interaction would melt the stoniest of hearts' ***** (FringeReview.co.uk).

title: KINDER
description: Winner, Best LGBTQIA+ Edinburgh Fringe Award (List). An unexpected call from a library derails a performance planned by newly arrived drag artist Goody Prostate, booked to headline the local reading hour. But as they race against the clock to scramble together a new act in real time, they spiral into a chaotic interrogation of childhood, memory and a long overdue examination of what it means to grow up. The library is open – sit down, be quiet and listen. Because sometimes, reading is what? Fundamentalist. ***** (List, BingeFringe.com, TheatreWeekly.com, AYoungishPerspective.co.uk, WhatsTheShow.com.au, SeeDoEatReview.com).
content_warnings: Strong language/swearing, occasional mild sexual references; references to homophobia/queerphobia. Audiences are invited to participate in brief moments of the work, but participation is not expected or imposed at any point

title: Kitty Daddy
description: How an unexpected cat turned award-winning monologist Bob Brader's life upside down. After weeks of hissing and growling from under Bob’s bed, his brand-new surprise feline, Jade, is determined to be alone, inspiring Bob to confront his own desire for isolation. A funny and touching examination of rage, love and healing. And how one impurrfect kitty can change everything. 'Storytelling gold!' (TheatreInLondon.com). 'Brader keeps the audience mesmerized with his dark comic relief!' ***** (Uptown Magazine). 'A must-see performance that will make you laugh, cry and just feel good' ****½ (London Free Press).
content_warnings: Contains distressing or potentially triggering themes, Strong language/swearing

title: Kitty's Salon of Dreams
description: Dive into the wonderful weird world of Kitty's salon, where you're not just a spectator but an active participant. Get ready to be entertained by the vivacious and totally trustworthy beautician, listening to her quirky tales whilst getting your imaginary hair done. Take an hour to escape with your favourite Northern beautician, where every seat is the best in the house because you're right in the thick of the action.

title: Knight's Dream
description:
A dark musical comedy with a new pop/jazz soundtrack. Follow an underpaid bartender trying to make it through the night under the watchful eye of the owner, Oscar Pendragon, and his eternal fiancée, Tulisa.
A new threat, 'love drug', is making its rounds in the bar, damaging both relationships and reputations. A young love triangle, too naive for the night they've chosen, find themselves in a twisted game. Enjoy witty lines and catchy songs on this absurd night out inspired by the Shakespeare classic 'A Midsummer Night's Dream.'
content_warnings: Audience participation, Contains distressing or potentially triggering themes, Strobe lighting

title: Krapp's Last Tape
description: Krapp's Last Tape is a journey through an old man's life, filled with hilarious memories and hopes for the future, coupled with the mourning of lost love and unfulfilled ambition. This production, directed by Academy Award nominee Stockard Channing and starring David Westhead, tours globally throughout 2026/27. Revel in Samuel Beckett's classic play, as audiences are invited into Krapp's world of solitude, memories, dreams, elation and despair. Post-show 15-minute Q&A on selected dates noted with a 65-minute runtime.
