title: Kristen Schaal: The Legend of Crystal Shell
presented_by: Berk's Nest in association with Sophie Chapman Talent
description: The brand new comedy play from Kristen Schaal (Bob's Burgers, BoJack Horseman, Flight of the Conchords) comes to Edinburgh for five nights only. Co-starring John Roberts (Bob's Burgers), with music by Big Black Delta and directed by Frank Smith. The Legend Of Crystal Shell is about an extraordinary soul who has been hiding from the world because of a fantastic secret. She now prepares to execute her long-held dream: a solo dance interpretation of Tchaikovsky's Swan Lake. Kristen Schaal is an Edinburgh Comedy Award nominee and Melbourne Best Show winner.

title: Krystyna Hutchinson: Congrats On Not Killing Yourself!
description: Stand-up meets storytelling in this unflinching and darkly funny solo show from comedian Krystyna Hutchinson. Raised by a mentally ill mother and an emotionally distant father, Krystyna confronts the moment she realizes her parents weren't the heroes she imagined them to be. Blending sharp comedy with raw honesty, the show explores childhood trauma, going no-contact, and the complicated freedom that follows. Featuring audio from a real psychic medium reading, this is a bold, cathartic voyage through grief, anger and radical self-reclamation.
content_warnings: Contains distressing or potentially triggering themes, Strong language/swearing

title: Kurtág at 100!
description: Kromatic Ensemble presents acclaimed pianists Valeria Szervánszky and Ronald Cavaye in an unforgettable lecture-recital exploring György Kurtág’s Játékok (Games) the extraordinary series of piano works – playful, profound and deeply human. Friends of the Hungarian composer György Kurtág for over 50 years, Valeria Szervánszky and Ronald Cavaye blend insight and performance, offering a rare glimpse into Kurtág’s imaginative musical world.

title: La Musicca von Scene / Sonata
description: Turkish-Norwegian theatre-maker Guliz Portakaloglu travels to Edinburgh with her new show. It is a solo theatre performance where a former actress creates a theatre play through improvisation, using objects found on stage to reflect on love, home, and music, as emotions awaken through sounds and theatrical remnants.

title: Lady Bolognese: Class War
description: 'Ridiculously funny' and 'extraordinarily talented' (TheReviewsHub.com) clown duo Lady Bolognese are encouraging you, dumb-dumb, to go back to school. But beware: your dinner ladies Barbara and Veronica are in charge now. And they're serving up a scrumptious blend of greasy friendship and anarchic delight, with hints of impending peril. If you behave, you'll be home in time for cocoa and Fray Bentos. It's Thelma & Louise meets George's Marvellous Medicine meets a big pile of offal. So come to class. It's gonna be a riot. 2026 Leicester Comedy Festival Awards nominee.

title: Lager Jus
description: Merryck’s back with a new show that, despite the title, has absolutely nothing to do with fine dining. Just another hour of jokes, lies and daft stories. Many comedians produce shows with depth and meaning, that slowly reveal some kind of message, and you may leave having learned something about the world around you and, perhaps even, yourself. None of that nonsense here. You will learn nothing and may even leave slightly thicker than when you arrived. It’s a bloody good laugh though and goes down very well with a pint or two of cooking lager.

title: LANDSFRAU
presented_by: Doris Crea Collective (Performed by Mariann Yar)
description: When the last plane left Kabul, Afghanistan vanished from Ariana’s reach. In LANDSFRAU, the return of the Taliban and the withdrawal of the western troops in 2021 triggers an autofictional reckoning with war, memory and responsibility. Onstage, Ariana dismantles images of Afghanistan and builds her own counter-archive: fragments of family history, imagined pasts, longing and rage. Afghan folk music collides with electronic beats; Attan meets contemporary dance. Through a feminist lens, she confronts the quiet guilt of living safely abroad. Refusing explanation or absolution, this performance becomes a personal act of political resistance.
content_warnings: Contains distressing or potentially triggering themes

title: Lara Ricote: INKLING
description: You know when stuff happens to you and you react in a certain way (read: cry) so then you lean in? To know thyself? A man in a museum was mean to me (classic) and I’ve gotten a lot out of it (hell yeah). My stupidest and smartest show yet (alright!). INKLING is a show about How to Salute to the Mystery of Being Alive (ok?). Might that be of intrigue...? To you? Big kisses to you and yours. Love, Lara. PS I am trying my best. Edinburgh Best Newcomer winner 2022. As seen on TV.
content_warnings: Audience participation, Strong language/swearing, Buy a ticket in advance to guarantee entry or Pay What You Want at the venue

title: Larry Dean: Hellbent
description: Recently married, emotionally feral. The gallus Glaswegian goon returns with a riotous show about refusing to grow up. As seen on SNL, Live at the Apollo, QI and The Royal Variety Performance. ***** (Telegraph). ***** (BroadwayWorld.com). ***** (Herald).
content_warnings: This performance will contain strong language.

title: Last Laugh
description: This black box is now a bunker. With global apocalypse at the door, Alice and Bee present their contribution to mankind: one last improv show before the world ends. The two best friends-turned-unlikely humanitarians race against time in their desperate attempt to make you laugh. Just ignore the sirens. In the face of intergalactic doom, Last Laugh is a zealous eulogy to live performance. Thankfully, crusaders Alice and Bee have the toolkit to go out with a bang: monologues, trashcan lids, homoeroticism, puppets and – dare they say it – hope.

title: Late'n'Live
description: The original late-night show returns with stellar line-ups of your favourite acts from the festival, hosted by the best MCs in the country, every single night of the Fringe. 'The best late-night show on the Fringe' (Scotsman). 'A Fringe institution for a reason' (TheRecs.co.uk). Previous acts include Johnny Vegas, Bill Bailey, Rich Hall, Jason Byrne, Mawaan Rizwan, John Bishop, Larry Dean, Maisie Adam, Reuben Kaye, Jordan Grey, Viggo Venn and just about every notable name in comedy. Late'n'Live guarantees an unforgettable night of live comedy and is an essential addition to any Fringe bucket list.

title: Late Night Comedy Death Camp
description: Returning for its sixth year, Henry Ginsberg presents a possibly anarchic, probably slightly depraved and almost certainly alcohol-fuelled showcase of the best stand-up comedy from the Fringe. Hopefully, everybody makes it out alive!

title: Late Night with Stuart Laws
description: 'Stuart Laws Must Keep Joking. The world is a much better place for it,' said TheReviewsHub.com of comedian and Fringe veteran Stuart Laws – acclaimed stand-up and creator of multiple cult shows, 'one of the most skilled and likeable comics on the circuit' (Scotsman), director of most of the UK's best stand ups and now the host of a series of late night shows that'll be different each day – follow Stuart on socials for exactly what chaos he has planned for each show.
content_warnings: Audience participation, Strong language/swearing, Buy a ticket in advance to guarantee entry or Pay What You Want at the venue
venue_name: Monkey Barrel Comedy at O'Neill's (The Tron)

title: Late Night with Terry Wogan
description: Terry's back from the dead and he's brought a chat show with him Featuring interviews with "real" celebrities and accompanied by a live band. Previous guests include: George Lucas, Ray Parker Jr, Sir Anthony Hopkins, Liza Minelli, DB Cooper, Tim Henman, Scarlett Johansson and several different Michael Caines. Every night one lucky member of the audience will give Terry £5000. Terry Wogan is a recipient of a KBE / dead. 'A clever late-night romp' **** (Telegraph). **** (Mervyn Stutter's Pick of the Fringe).

title: Late with Pear
description: Top Ten Best Reviewed Acts of Edinburgh Fringe 2024 and 2025. Pear are 6 foot 7 identical twin comedians Hugo and Patrick McPherson, returning with Late With Pear, a riotous late-night extravaganza which promises mayhem, comedy guests and all the jokes they can only tell under the cover of night. Sold out entire 2025 run. 'Effortlessly funny' (Independent). 'A masterclass in sketch comedy' (EdFestMag.com). 'They are destined for greatness' (List). ***** (BroadwayBaby.com). ***** (ThreeWeeks). ***** (EdFestMag.com). Winner – Critics' Choice Award: Fringe World. Nominee – Best Show: ISH Edinburgh Comedy Awards.

title: Laughing Horse Fringe Comedy Selection
description: See the very best comedians, selected from across the Fringe, alongside hot new talent and fresh Fringe newcomers, with a different comedy line-up daily at each show in this selection box of laughs! The line-ups include performers selected from Fringe shows and the international comedy circuit, with guests from the best in new talent appearing at the Fringe – plus it's Pay What You Can entry! Sell-out show 2004-2025. ***** (FestivalReview.com). 'Cracking comedy selection' ***** (Cream of the Fringe). 'A great night out' **** (SouthWestLive.co.uk). **** (The Student). **** (List). **** (BroadwayBaby.com). **** (TheArgus.co.uk).

title: Laughing Horse Pick of the Fringe
description: The very best comedians selected from across the Fringe with a different top-notch comedy line-up at every show. It's the absolute best way to see a great Fringe comedy smorgasbord, with line-ups selected from shows and venues all around the Fringe and the international comedy circuit... And you can Pay What You Can to watch! International festival sell-out shows 2004-2026. ***** (Cream of the Fringe). 'A great night out' ***** (SouthWestLive.co.uk). 'A fantastic night of comedy' **** (ThreeWeeks). **** (List). **** (BroadwayBaby.com). **** (Student). **** (Herald Sun). **** (TheArgus.co.uk).

title: Laughing Matters
description: Half stand-up show, half play, Laughing Matters follows Chris, an up-and-coming comedian forced to throw out his material following the tragic loss of his girlfriend. As the audience watches his grief reshape both his life and his comedy set, he must figure out how to be funny, and how to live, without her. Fresh from successful London runs, Alec Watson's 'laugh out loud funny' (TheReviewsHub.com) solo show lays bare the complex and deeply personal relationship between a comedian, their material and their life. A bittersweet exploration of grief, creativity and starting again from a blank page.
content_warnings: Contains distressing or potentially triggering themes, Strong language/swearing

title: Laughing Out Lonely
description: Laughing Out Lonely (LOL) is a portrait of contemporary loneliness. With a universal relevance, and a tour de tour performance from acclaimed countertenor Morten Grove Frandsen, this thrilling new opera is a thought-provoking performance that pushes the boundaries of what opera can be. Created using English lyrics that are based on posts from young people on social media, and staged by Louise Beck as a theatrical echo chamber where the audience is part of the setting, Laughing Out Lonely is a compelling work that is relevant for audiences of all ages.
content_warnings: Strobe lighting, Contains distressing or potentially triggering themes, Strong language/swearing

title: Launa
description: After the loss of her daughter, young mother Edna must navigate the shifting terrain of grief as memory begins to consume her present. Movement, music, dialogue, puppetry and shadow-play converge in this visually arresting production. Within the cluttered familiarity of her apartment, grief erupts amidst the mundane like the sudden chorus of a song: supermarket flowers, intrusive cold calls and the apparition of Launa herself. This is a world in which the echo of childhood imagination and devastating loss co-exist, asking whether we have to let go of the past to remain present with the living?
content_warnings: Contains distressing or potentially triggering themes

title: Laura Lexx: Work in Progress
description: Edinburgh ISH Awards Best Show nominee 2025 (****, Scotsman, ****, Guardian, ****, Telegraph). In a ten-year marriage, eventually your partner sees it all. Every bad idea. Every silly decision. Every unfiltered thought... and somehow, they still say they love you. Fresh from her critically acclaimed show Slinky (Winner: Best Show, Women in Comedy Festival and twice nominated Best International Debut, New Zealand International Comedy Festival), multi award-winning comedian Laura Lexx returns with a brand new work-in-progress. As seen on Mock the Week and Live at the Apollo.

title: Lavender
description: Summer 1916. Following a shrapnel injury to his shoulder, WWI Captain Edward Beaumont returns home to his devoted fiancée’s estate. Yet the peaceful convalescence he longs for is unsettled not only by the disturbing effects of shellshock, but also a new presence on the estate – one that awakens forbidden emotions he thought he buried in the trenches. Over a series of encounters, he grows close with new farmhand, Sam, and battles the boundary between duty and desire. Exploring war trauma and queer romance, Lavender is a must-see for history enthusiasts and fans of original queer media.
content_warnings: Contains distressing or potentially triggering themes, Strong language/swearing

title: Lawrence Dodd: This Can't Be It
description: Playful, chaotic clowning meets existential confusion as one man desperately tries to make sense of life. Perpetually derailed, deluded and paralysed by overwhelm, Big Loz Dodd arrives to do something very special indeed – something that might just deliver the kind of profound insight that shakes our contemporary situation to its core. Blending performance art and contemporary clowning, This Can't Be It is a semi-improvised, feverish and open-hearted exploration of how we stay open to the mystery when everything is closing us down. Directed by Lara Ricote, with Rachael Dobbie on tech.

title: Lawrence of Arabia and ME
description: Hollywood needed a cast of thousands, David Lean, and won seven Oscars. Eamonn Gearon had a camel called Osama. This Oxford-trained historian spent decades in the Middle East – living with Bedu, risking his neck and uncovering secrets Britain buried with Lawrence. History and comedy collide; a sharper image emerges. Neither villain nor hero, but something more interesting. What was promised? What was broken? What would Lawrence make of Peter O’Toole’s performance? With the wit of a raconteur and authority of a scholar, Gearon reveals man, myth, movie... plus camels.

title: Le Vent du Nord
description: The multi award-winning and highly acclaimed Le Vent du Nord is a leading force in Québec’s progressive francophone folk movement. The group’s vast repertoire draws from both traditional sources and original compositions, while enhancing its hard-driving soulful music with a broad range of global influences. The group exhibits great finesse and flexibility, appearing regularly on Canadian, American, French and UK television and radio, participating in a wide variety of special musical projects.

title: Lear's Fool
description: The riveting tale of what happened to the Fool, who mysteriously disappears halfway through Shakespeare’s tragedy. 'A gorgeous, lyrical and heartbreaking variation on the themes of Shakespeare’s play...' (Scotsman). 'David Henry Wilson’s one-act play is a self-contained, self-imagined work of genius' (GlasgowWestEndToday.scot). A brand-new production, directed by Liz Carruthers, following the sell-out production by Bard in the Botanics, for which Nicole Cooper was shortlisted for Performance of the Year at the Critics' Awards for Theatre in Scotland. In this production, the Fool will be played by Jill Riddiford, who herself has twice been on the short list.
content_warnings: Buy a ticket in advance to guarantee entry or Pay What You Want at the venue

title: Legendary
description: Ancient myths. Modern questions. International multi award-winning artist and singer-songwriter Cheeyang Ng blends Chinese mythology, memory and queer legacy in the electrifying solo ritual musical Legendary, a life-affirming tale of queer joy and identity. Through communal song and the retelling of ancient myths, they explore their relationship with family, tradition and the stories that have shaped them, but never reflected them. In the beginning, there was a god named Pan Gu and a ravishing goddess named Nü Wa. A global internet sensation, Legendary doesn't just tell a story: it invites the audience to create one. 'Extraordinary' (Jason Robert Brown).

title: Legends of Music
description: Step into the golden age of sound as we celebrate the music of Johnny Cash, Neil Diamond, Frank Sinatra, Dean Martin and Buddy Holly in this unforgettable one-hour special. Starring award-winning Pete Storm and Pete Sinclair. As brought to you from the performers of previous popular Fringe tribute shows Cash & Diamond and Frank & Dean. 'Great stage presence, great vocals and, of course, some fantastic song choice' (EdFringeReview.com).

title: Leo Mahr and Jonny Bennett: Two Hot Gays Telling Jokes
presented_by: Two Hot Gays Telling Jokes / Free Festival
description: Two incredibly hot (you decide) gay men, one British, one Swiss(ish), cover everything from Kylie to K-holes, Le Creuset to cruising, with some musical comedy to keep things interesting. Leo Mahr is back at the Fringe after a packed-out run of Leo Mahr Is a Seasoned Whore in 2025. Jonny Bennett will be answering important questions musically. Why is LinkedIn so bad? What would country music sound like if it was from the UK? And is your ex-girlfriend’s dad an acceptable sexual awakening? Free poppers for the front row!

title: Les Misérables School Edition
description: Performed entirely by very talented students, Captivate’s production has been seen by an estimated 24,000 people, with sell-out crowds, standing ovations and multiple five-star reviews. Don’t be put off by School Edition: 'From beginning to end, the show is faultless... Captivate's production blows every other musical at the Fringe completely out of the water. A musical masterpiece – book your tickets now' (TheReviewsHub.com). ‘When young people, with talent and a love for performing get together with a skilled creative team and pull off an entertaining and affecting story, I recommend people go and watch it’ (FringeReview.co.uk).

title: Let The Best Man Win
description: Save the date for the wildest wedding you've ever been to. Let the Best Man Win is the ultimate comedy showdown where three stand-ups compete to deliver the funniest improvised best man speech for one lucky couple. After a sold-out run in 2025 with Ray O'Leary, Craig Hill and Kate Dolan walking away with bouquets, this is less about the tiered cakes and more about tears of laughter. No seating plan. No regrets. Just grab a drink, relax and let the best man win.

title: Lewis Garnham: Work in Progress
description: A brand new work in progress hour by one of Australia's most exciting and distinctive comedians. 'A rich source of edgy jokes' **** (Chortle.co.uk). 'A very assured, natural raconteur' **** (Scotsman). 'Relatable stories and meaningful punchlines' **** (Artshub.com.au). 'The comedian other comedians go to see' (TheatreTravels.org). Winner, Adelaide Fringe Best Emerging Artist Weekly Award 2017. Nominated Best Comedy, Perth Fringe World 2018. Nominated Best Newcomer, Melbourne International Comedy Festival 2018. Moosehead Award Recipient, Melbourne International Comedy Festival 2024.

title: Li Jin Hao: Falling From a Moon
description: I'm addicted to time travel. I keep living in the past. I want to go back. Not too far though. Not Pangea. What would I even do there? I could beat a T-rex at rock paper scissors, but he wouldn't know what was going on. I think these thoughts as I hold a dino nugget in my hand. I think the present feels heavy and the past feels like the moon, where there was less gravity and I was lighter. Meet me on the moon. Edinburgh Comedy Awards Best Newcomer nominee 2024.

title: Liam Tulley: Adult-ish
description: Following a 'solid debut' (Scotsman) at the Edinburgh Fringe in 2025, Liam Tulley returns with a brand-new stand-up show. On the brink of turning 40, Liam doesn’t feel like a proper adult – not because he’s failed, but because adulthood seems to come with a very specific checklist. By a certain age you’re meant to have a good career, a nice car, a place of your own and a settled family life. Adult-ish explores what happens when those expectations don’t quite match reality. Through sharp observations and deadpan delivery, Liam examines anxiety, self-doubt and growing older.

title: Lianna Holston: Haha, Oh God 2.0
description: Haha, Oh God 2.0 is a work in progress show in which Lianna Holston asks the true and necessary question: does ANYONE want to kiss? If you come to this show you will learn one (1) big secret. Lianna's accolades include: BBC New Comedy Awards 2025, Funny Women Stage Award 2025 (Semi-Finalist), Leicester Square Theatre New Comedian of the Year 2024 (2nd Place), once did a wall sit for 2.5 minutes (2013). 'A comic you'd definitely want to hear more from' (Chortle.co.uk). Tickets are Pay What You Want, pls come xoxo.
content_warnings: Audience participation, Contains distressing or potentially triggering themes, Strong language/swearing

title: Life of Pie
description: Through live music, storytelling, and extra cheese, pizza blogger Sean Taylor shares his quest for home – one slice at a time. Raised in a nomadic Mormon military family, Sean found stability in one unexpected constant: pizza. He explores how this universal comfort food became a way to survive everything from culture shock to loneliness, eventually leading him to improv comedy and his creation of 31daysofpizza.com, the world’s longest-running pizza blog. Through humour and heart, audiences will see how this saucy obsession helped him create community, find love, and ultimately, a sense of belonging.

title: Life Writing with Jez Lowe
description: At his fifth consecutive Fringe appearance, Jez Lowe delves deep into 40 years of songwriting and reads from his newly published fifth novel, The Bow String Wager, all of which share an inspiration from the songs, music and social history of his native North-East England – with all its humour, hardship and resilience.

title: Lighthouse
description: Friends. Comrades. Enemies... Caillte Lighthouse. The North Sea just after WWI. The story follows two keepers and their training of a third before things occur that question their loyalty, friendship and ultimately, their sanity. Lighthouse is a gripping piece that delves into the human psyche of trust, paranoia and greed with stylish, well-placed humour, jeopardy, suspense and a stellar cast. Listed by The Herald as one of the Top 20 Must-See Shows of Edinburgh Fringe 2022, Lighthouse will take you on a 50-minute journey to hell and back like no other. It's not just the past that haunts you.
content_warnings: Contains distressing or potentially triggering themes, Scenes of violence, Strong language/swearing

title: Lights Out By Nine – Live!
description: Lights Out By Nine's origins are firmly rooted in soul music, mixed with powerhouse Rhythm & Blues and a blend of New Orleans Funk. The seven-piece lineup features guitars, horns hammond and harmonies underpinned by a powerful and soulful lead vocal. LOBN have recorded a collection of their original songs over 12 albums since 1990 and have supported Hue and Cry, AWB, Hamish Stuart, Paul Carrack and Nazareth amongst others, along with appearances on STV and BBC TV and Radio. Their show delivers their original material mixed with eclectic soul and funk covers.

title: Lil Wenker: BOYKING
description: All hail BOYKING! Eight-year-old Prince Wilfred (Willy for short) seeks power at all costs including but not limited to: death, destruction and dastardly deeds. Nowhere near in line for the throne, Prince Wilfred ruminates on a plan for total world domination while guzzling mummy's milk. Bow down – this coronation's a killer. Created by the award-winning performer / director duo Lil Wenker and Cecily Nash. 'Sheer, brilliant, well executed madness' ***** (ThreeWeeks). 'A masterclass in clowning' ***** (VoiceMag.uk). 'A pure hour of genuine laughs' **** (BroadwayWorld.com). 'Farcical and whip-smart' **** (Fest).
content_warnings: This show contains strong language, audience participation, nudity, and potential discussions of war and violence.

title: Lindsey Santoro: It Was Like That When I Got Here
description: Lindsey returns following the huge success of her Fringe debut, which won NextUp’s Biggest Award in Comedy and earned her an Edinburgh Comedy Award Best Newcomer nomination. Seen on Live at the Apollo, Mel Giedroyc's Unforgivable and Comedy Central Live. Heard on The Jon Richardson Show, Sarah Millican’s Elephant in the Room and Russell Kane’s Evil Genius, plus her own BBC Radio 4 comedy series, The Lively Life of Lindsey Santoro. Tour support for Joe Lycett. ‘Surely only a matter of time before she becomes a television fixture’ **** (Scotsman).
content_warnings: Strong language/swearing, Buy a ticket in advance to guarantee entry or Pay What You Want at the venue

title: Lions
description: Fringe First winners return with a sweaty mustache of a comedy about the business of letting our dads die. With a dose of Kafka and 'A Christmas Carol,' Lions disassembles the myths our fathers told themselves about becoming great men. Part clown show and part deconstructed eulogy, Lions honors our fathers by not denying them the humanity they could not offer themselves. 'Lions made me laugh, cry and consider my doomed legacy' (8 Best Shows at Philadelphia Fringe, Philadelphia Inquirer). From the creators of UNDERGROUND RAILROAD GAME (Fringe First Award, The Stage Award, Obie Award, **** Guardian, ***** Stage).

title: Lipstick
description: A post-apocalyptic tale of beauty, misogyny and bisexual baggage. Amidst societal collapse, Mila and Sam find comfort in their close friendship and budding attraction. It seems possible that the end of the old world could be the beginning of something better. All that changes when a strange man arrives. Joe is desperate for Mila’s companionship, and in exchange he can give her an artefact of her former life: a lipstick. As tensions among the three rise, Mila finds herself caught between Sam’s hopes of a better future and Joe’s offer of the safety of male approval.
content_warnings: Contains distressing or potentially triggering themes, Scenes of a sexual nature, Strong language/swearing

title: Little Shop of Horrors
description: This delectable sci-fi horror musical with fantastic music is a brilliant family watch as Seymour finds a plant and it grows and grows but what is it eating? Great songs great acting. Follow the action as Seymour falls for Audrey but someone gets in the way. How will they get rid of him and what does the plant really want? Is he kind, considerate or out for world domination? Toe-tapping songs, great acting and a buzzing script makes this musical a standout. A Fringe must-see!
content_warnings: Contains distressing or potentially triggering themes, Scenes of violence

title: Live From The Afterlife
description: Ping-ponging between campfire storytelling and psychedelic, gut-punching folk-rock, Live From The Afterlife is a solo piece by Charlie Kilgore about time, hitchhiking, surviving a terminal illness, and anal.
content_warnings: Contains distressing or potentially triggering themes, Scenes of a sexual nature, Strong language/swearing

title: Live Original Music by Folk-IndieBob
description: Bob Augustine aka Folk-IndieBob is a singer songwriter based in Pittsburgh Pennsylvania, US. He writes songs in a folk and folk-indie style with poetic lyrics and acoustic guitar accompaniment. He has been featured at arts festivals, concerts, galleries, coffee shops, restaurants and poetry readings and has received much positive feedback as people enjoy his insightful writing, soulful voice and original sound.
content_warnings: Buy a ticket in advance to guarantee entry or Pay What You Want at the venue
venue_name: Just The Tonic at The Mash House

title: Living the Dream
presented_by: Steel Antler Theatre and New Celts Productions
description: After a failed attempt to get Oasis tickets, a group of friends meet for another night in the pub. Once discovering The Hardest Geezer’s marathon, the group decide to walk the Fife Coastal Path hoping to achieve something in their lives. Will this adventure be enough to break their midlife crisis, or have they bitten off more than they can chew? Living the Dream is a Scottish coming of age comedy drama, exploring mental health, friendship and a love of the Scottish Coast.
content_warnings: Scenes of violence, Strong language/swearing, Use of drugs and alcohol, mentions of suicide/death, cancer, child neglect/abuse, physical violence.

title: Liz Wesleydale: (Shadow) Home Secretary
description: After a devastating loss at the last general election, politician Liz Wesleydale finds herself in a scary place – the Shadow cabinet. Desperate for attention and relevancy, Liz embarks on a number of campaigns in order to win over the public before the next election.
content_warnings: Contains distressing or potentially triggering themes, Strong language/swearing

title: Lizzie Simpson: Just Be Confident, Loser!
description: BBC New Comedy Award 2024 shortlisted Lizzie Simpson has always been told she should be more confident, as if that helps in any way. Now the Leicester Square Theatre New Comedian Award 2025 Runner Up, and 'gleefully ribald' (Scotsman) oversharer, is asking the hard questions with a 'vivid streak of well thought out personal humour' (BeyondTheJoke.co.uk). What is true confidence? Where does it come from? And can it be found in a book written by a millionaire?
content_warnings: Audience participation, Contains distressing or potentially triggering themes, Strong language/swearing

title: Locomotive For Murder: The Improvised Whodunnit
presented_by: Pinch Punch Improv promoted by Benjamin Alborough
description: Five-star, sell-out Fringe favourites, Pinch Punch, welcome you aboard Locomotive for Murder – The Improvised Whodunnit, where killing the cast and cracking the case is in your hands! Four characters board a train but not everyone will survive. Luckily, a world-famous detective is on the case. But who is the killer? Only the murderer themselves knows. Using audience stories, watch Pinch Punch create a never-to-be-repeated whodunnit full of thrills, spills and good old-fashioned kills. 'Fans of murder mystery or improv comedy, this is the perfect show for you' ***** (CurtainCallReviews.co.uk).
content_warnings: Audience participation, Due to the improvised nature of the show, we cannot guarantee specific content warnings. General content warnings include audience participation, comedy peril and potential bad language.

title: Loft Clearance
description: Join Eileen as she rummages through a hundred years’ worth of possessions that have accumulated in her loft. It's like finding an old diary but in physical form. Collections, hoardings and family traits abound. What will she cling onto? What will she let go? But where will these pieces of her go to? Enjoy 50 minutes of light-hearted despair as the clearance unfolds.

title: LOLyamorous: A Speed-Dating Comedy Show
description: First Dates meets comedy chat show in this unhinged, unpredictable and hilarious night of on-stage matchmaking. Pairs of strangers have a two-minute date on stage before being interviewed by comedians and a sex and relationships therapist about their love lives. But will we hear wedding bells? Hosted by James Regal and a different comedian co-host every night. Never the same show twice – always fun, welcoming to all and occasionally emotional. Participation voluntary. All genders, orientations, genders and ages (18+) welcome! Not Single? No problem. Watch from the crowd and witness the sparks fly.

title: Long Story Short
description: Four fast-paced comedies about love, life, murder and... houseplants. From dating disasters to domestic dramas and a good old-fashioned whodunit. Two Sides: a couple replay their break up, two memories, two truths, both are right obviously. Hello Plant: a woman finds unlikely relationship advice from her houseplant. I Wrote A Play: a mum unveils her "masterpiece" with an unexpected twist. And, award-winning whodunit, 15 Minutes To Solve a Murder: a period farce where everyone is desperate to solve Tubby's murder. Four Plays. Plenty of laughs.

title: Lord of the Zings: A Kiwi Comedy Showcase
presented_by: Danny Sewell, Hoani Hotene, Fin McLachlan
description: The last Lord of the Rings movie came out in 2003 and these three NZ stand-up comedians are still riding that wave. They don’t have a single joke about hobbits, dragons or really any opinions on the works of Peter Jackson – they’re just using this as a marketing ploy. Although, they are travelling all the way to Edinburgh so, in a way, their journey is a lot like Frodo and Sam taking the ring to Mordor (We assume. We haven’t actually seen the movies).

title: Lorna Rose Treen: Now That's What I Call Characters
presented_by: Country Mile Productions in association with United Agents
description: Fresh off the back of three critically-acclaimed, sell-out Fringe runs, Redditch's best-loved freak Lorna Rose Treen is back with more nonsense. A surreal, silly and joyful compilation of her favourite characters, songs, content, content, content, costumes and content. Writer for Saturday Night Live UK. Creator/star of BBC Radio 4's award-winning Time of the Week. Next Big Thing Award nominee 2026. Comedians' Choice Awards Best Show nominee 2025. Dave's Funniest Joke of the Fringe winner. 'The buzziest of the buzzy' (New York Times). ***** (Observer, Telegraph, Standard, Independent). Directed by Jonathan Oldfield.

title: Lorna Rose Treen: Work in Progress
description: Award-winning character comedian Lorna Rose Treen is trying out a bunch of bits that some people have called ‘too new’. It’s going to be rough, it’s going to be messy, it’s going to be Lorna. 'A gloriously daft hour that is heavily reminiscent of peak-era French and Saunders' ***** (Telegraph). 'I laughed so much I violently bit my tongue' ***** (Independent). ‘Killed comedy’ (Sun).
content_warnings: Audience participation, Buy a ticket in advance to guarantee entry or Pay What You Want at the venue

title: Lorraine Hoodless: Mean
description: A fast, funny and fiercely relatable blast through capitalism, rockets, tradwives and the everyday chaos of keeping it together without losing your mind (or job). With cheeky wit and warm self awareness, Lorraine tackles burnout, billionaires, consumer guilt, the myth of meritocracy, and the slow collapse of society. Smart, cathartic and joyfully cutting, Mean speaks to women who are tired of the state of things and ready to unleash hopeful rage, with riotous calls to action. Wildcard Amused Moose New Comedian 2020. Semi-finalist British Comedian of the Year 2021. 'Finding the funny wherever she goes' **** (One4Review.com).

title: Los Años Maravillosos: Archive, Image and Collapse
description: A Uruguayan model. Diana Spencer. The Doors. Montevideo. The future as longing. Collapse as an inevitable destiny. 'Come on, baby, light my fire.' Between image, memory and fracture, Los Años Maravillosos explores the distance between who we imagined we would become and who we were not. Through real archive, music and living presence, the performance moves between illusion and the wound of the real, confronting what remains when narratives we believed in fall apart. A theatrical experience about who we were, the future we imagined and the moment everything begins to collapse.
content_warnings: Contains distressing or potentially triggering themes

title: Lost at Sea!
description: A heart-warming success last year, we're back again! Rich harmonies, soulful melodies, a cappella joy. Our 15-piece vocal ensemble weave together traditions of folk, jazz, classical and pop – sung with the warmth and musical chemistry that define our group. A 60-minute eclectic musical journey of music old and new. Connection is at the heart of what we do, between singers, music and audience, so don’t be surprised if you’re invited to join in for a song or two! Sea shanties, sad songs, love songs, choral harmonies that transcend what is possible to express in words.

title: Lost in Translation
description: Your favourite movies translated badly. Each night, we take a different classic film script, run it through an online translator a dozen times and then read the results live on stage in character! The final twist is that the guest stars read the scripts on stage for the first time. To get the most enjoyment, we recommend you watch the film beforehand. Films are listed on https://tickets.gildedballoon.co.uk/

title: Lou Wall: Where Are All The Tall Grandmas?
description: Where are all the tall grandmas? Be honest, you’ve never seen one, have you? So where the f#%k are they? Do they shrink? Die young? Are short kings eating them? In this hilariously unhinged new hour, Lou dives head first into the disappearance of tall old women everywhere. A comedic investigation into height, heritage and what it truly means to live large. 'Wall is a comedy whirlwind' (New York Times). Nominee: Most Outstanding Show, Melbourne International Comedy Festival 2025.

title: Louis de Bernières: Poetry, Stories and Songs
description: Louis de Bernières, master musician and award-winning author, hosts an intimate evening of self-penned poetry, songs and stories. 'Bernières’ jagged voice cuts through darkly arresting vignettes full of evocative lyrics. Powerful stuff' (Mojo).

title: Louise: The Last Dance
description: Paris, 1928. A bent and squinting old woman in rags shuffles out of a caravan in a slum market. This is Louise Weber: the woman who invented the cancan, seduced princes and made the Moulin Rouge famous. Toulouse-Lautrec painted her. Journalists destroyed her. Nobody let her speak. Until now. A solo multidisciplinary performance with live dance, projection and theatre, Louise: The Last Dance reclaims the story of the most famous woman you've never heard of. Loud, queer, working class and unforgettable. She was leered at her entire life. This time, she gets to talk back.
content_warnings: Contains distressing or potentially triggering themes, Nudity, Strong language/swearing

title: Love, Katiuska
description: In England, she's 'Kat' – the simplified version of a woman living abroad. But to her family back home, she's still Katiuska. After moving to the UK for love, she found herself caught between two identities. Through musical theatre favourites, youthful diaries and family stories, this intimate cabaret explores the bittersweet reality of building a new home while anchored to an old one. Heartfelt, funny, and moving, Love, Katiuska is a song-filled journey through the people who knew us "before", the lives we leave behind, and the challenge of becoming someone new without losing your true self.

title: Love Light and Labels
presented_by: Cognitive Behavioural Theatre / PBH's free fringe
description: What if neurotypical is the mask society hands you and neurodiversity is the moment your spirit finally breathes? Join an AuDHD, emotionally unstable unicorn trying to decode humanity through our divine diagnosis, exploring the law of attraction and what on earth it means to be human. Celebrating neuro-species of all kinds in a 45-minute spoken-word joyride of chaotic rhymes, cosmic questions and unfiltered woo-woo. Found on all music platforms under Ellerose the Unicorn, fusing and bending genres such as musical theatre, conscious rap and new age.

title: Love's Labour's Found
description: Facing redundancy after years of lacklustre publications, lecturers Jackie and Kate hatch an audacious plan to save their skins – they announce the discovery of Shakespeare’s long-lost play. What begins as a harmless white lie quickly spirals out of control when they’re invited to perform the “new” work at the 45th Shakespearean History International Teaching Conference the next day. With no script, no knowledge and barely any time, they scramble to invent a masterpiece overnight. As their manager’s suspicion grows, their desperate improvisation becomes a farcical web of deception, threatening humiliation and friendship.

title: Lucy Best: Unbelievable
description: Most people have an unbelievable, fantastical story from their life; the kind that makes others question if that really, truly, happened. Thanks to an unconventional life, Lucy Best has collected more than most. In this one-woman storytelling show, Lucy unpacks a treasure trove of hard to believe but true tales. Do you know anyone else who held a baby dolphin as it died? Or was expelled from boarding school? Did you know bisexuals are actually real? Pocket rocket Lucy Best will share (mostly) hilarious true tales about these things and more!
content_warnings: Contains distressing or potentially triggering themes, Strong language/swearing

title: Lulu Popplewell: Work in Progress
description: Lulu tries out some brand-new jokes for one week only – come and laugh while she talks about eggs, death & misc. Possibly with a piano, definitely with the dog. 'Biting wit and playful punchlines' (Comedy.co.uk). 'Sharp, unexpected jokes. A strong all-rounder' (Chortle.co.uk). 'Incredibly entertaining confessional comedy' (LifeIsAFestival.wordpress.com). 'The poor woman's been through enough' (Chortle.co.uk). The Times Best Jokes of the Fringe 2025. Cheap! Fun! Themes potentially too dark for a lunchtime show oops!
content_warnings: Audience participation, Contains distressing or potentially triggering themes, Strong language/swearing

title: LuluLand
description: LuluLand is a one-act musical about Lucy, a girl who has always felt out of place. When she's abducted by an alien race exactly like her, she finally finds a world built to suit her brain. In LuluLand everyone understands, everyone agrees and everyone sings the same note. But when Lucy meets Matty – a human who doesn't quite fit their system – she begins to question the comfort of perfect sameness. As the two form an unlikely connection, Lucy must decide whether belonging is worth the cost of losing what makes her different.

title: Lysistrata
description: Imagine 20 years of war. A war in Ancient Greece, between Sparta and Athens. Now picture Lysistrata, an ordinary Athenian woman who says, 'Enough war! We women will end this war!' But how? 'By going on a sex strike! Are you with me?' Aristophanes' comedy Lysistrata gets an explosive, modern reimagining through protest, politics and power.

title: M.I.S All Night Long
description: M.I.S – All Night Long takes measure of the modern man. How is he really doing underneath those woollen socks and comfy sandals? In a hard-boiled mix of jackass stunts and slapstick comedy three men get out of their comfort zone to come to grips with their inner beasts; the Latino lover, the pushover, the best buddy – and all the others – in a quiet battle for a man’s right to be himself. A backdrop of wacky film projections and club music frame the characters’ physical endeavours and keep the audience amazed all night long!
content_warnings: Audience participation, Nudity, Scenes of violence

title: Macbeth: Blood and Bluegrass
description: Critically acclaimed, highly original adaptation of the Bard’s dark tale. Tragic yet uplifting, tender, raucous, poignant and high-energy. Set to a live score of Americana and bluegrass music, the multi-award-winning New Zealand troupe blend classic literature with a modern twist alongside original arrangements of Mumford and Sons, Dolly Parton and The SteelDrivers, creating an emotional, accessible, toe-tapping theatrical experience. Winner Best Theatre Award Adelaide Fringe 2025. Received multiple five-star reviews Edinburgh Fringe 2025, including: 'Fantastically gifted team' ***** (TheatreWeekly.com), 'Macbeth as you’ve never seen it before' ***** (MusicalTheatreReview.com), 'Bravo' ***** (TheWeeReview.com).
content_warnings: Contains distressing or potentially triggering themes, Strong language/swearing

title: Mad Ron Presents Identity Theft – The Gameshow
description: Expect the absurd as Uxbridge's third hardest man and multi award-winning Mad Ron presents a hilariously surreal game show, where he tries to guide his comedy apprentice as a glamorous game show host. 'Keeps the onslaught of jokes coming, contributing to the rowdily fun atmosphere' (Steve Bennett, Chortle.co.uk). 'The funniest most inventive nut bag show I think I’ve ever seen I love it love it love it!' (Terry Alderton).

title: Madam(e) Lou
description: Seattle is known for Frasier, coffee and tech bros. But it's not known for its history, and that's a shame because Seattle’s history is bonkers. It honours its founding fathers, but there is a founding mother who is written out of history books because of her trade: Madam Lou Graham. Join award-winning performer, Kate Danley, for a funny, fascinating, meticulously researched look at one of Seattle's most influential and erased power players. Truth is stranger than fiction, and you couldn't make this up. For You’re Dead to Me and Horrible Histories fans.

title: Madame Chandelier's Grand Theft Opera
description: When Madame Chandelier's daughter gets sucked into her video game and is kidnapped by the evil Queen of the Night, there's only one thing to do – gather opera's fiercest characters for an epic battle. Will Carmen, Tosca and Madame Butterfly help defeat the ultimate boss, or will all arias lead to death? Directed by P Burton-Morgan. Praise for previous work: 'Expert timing' **** (Observer). 'Madame Chandelier could be the ticket that opens up opera to new audiences' **** (Broadway Baby). 'Infectiously bonkers' **** (Scotsman).

title: Madeleine Brettingham: Legend
description: What does it take to become a legend? Fuelled by pork scratchings and a lust for glory, 2025's So You Think You're Funny? winner Madeleine Brettingham presents her highly anticipated debut hour of stand-up, exploring what growing up in a world of booze-soaked bad behaviour taught her about how man becomes myth. Praised for her 'distinctive worldview' (Chortle.co.uk), 'tight and gag-packed writing' (Bruce Dessau), and 'knack for blending offbeat observations with pacey, unexpected punchlines' (List). As heard on Breaking The News and Drunk Women Solving Crime.

title: Madeleine Munford: Who the F*ck is Madeleine?
description: Not only Lily Allen's hit song, but the question Madeleine has grappled with through years of living abroad, navigating Irish and French culture, and messing up her romantic life fantastically. This is Madeleine's recount of misadventures to a soap-opera degree and a love letter to the gays and girlies for their supportive voice notes, loud karaoke sessions and endless gig pig behaviour at live music events, showing her time and time again where the healthy love is.

title: Magic Faraway Cabaret with Mister Meredith
description: Delighting and confusing people since 2009, Mister Meredith returns with his infectiously joyous and unpredictable variety show. Who will appear tonight? Perhaps magic, sideshow, burlesque or that strange amazing cabaret act that you’ll never be able to describe to your friends? 'A wonderful lineup in a comfortable, fun environment. Great way to end the evening!' (TheRealChrisparkle.com). 'A festival stalwart, notable for its range of eclectic acts' **** (Scotsman). 'An exciting array of the best in burlesque, comedy and sideshow... this fun late-night show has a taste of everything' **** (ThreeWeeks).
venue_name: PBH's Free Fringe @ Fingers Piano Bar

title: Magic Maestros
description: Join the Canadian Watson brothers in a world where melodies shimmer, rhythms cast spells and every note feels enchanted. Magic Maestros is a one-of-a-kind magic-themed music show that blurs the line between concert and illusion, inviting audiences into an immersive experience where sound and wonder collide encouraging creativity long after the show ends. Audiences don’t just watch this performance, but rather they become a part of it! Whether you’re a fan of live music, theatrical spectacle, or sleight of hand, this is an experience you won’t want to miss.

title: Magic Mic
description: Irish comedy magician Alex J Byrne brings his show Magic Mic back to the Edinburgh Festival Fringe following a successful run of shows at last year's festival! Magic Mic is a comedy magic show that is suitable for all ages and was very popular at last year's Fringe. If you like clean comedy, puns, silly observations and magic, this is the show for you!

title: Magic Spectacular
description: A thoughtfully curated Fringe showcase celebrating magic, mind reading, circus skill, and international variety. This family-friendly compilation brings together exceptional performers from around the world, guided by a warm, engaging host who sets the tone and keeps the experience flowing. Expect polished routines, clever illusions, audience involvement, and moments of genuine surprise, all presented in a relaxed, accessible format perfect for all ages. With multiple acts in every show, no two performances are the same, making it an ideal choice for festival-goers seeking quality entertainment, variety, and wonder in one unforgettable Fringe experience.
content_warnings: Audience participation, Buy a ticket in advance to guarantee entry or Pay What You Want at the venue

title: Magical Maestro
description: Incredible magic, elegant illusion and mysterious melodies performed to an eclectic soundtrack on a gramophone. British Magical Champion, member of the Magic Circle and creator of London's longest running magic show, Oliver Tabor conjures impossible happenings including bubbles morphing into glass, music notes plucked from thin air, and magical curiosities inspired by the music that shaped him. Be taken on a magical musical journey featuring marvels, mystery and melodies. 'A modern-day gentleman of magic' (The Magic Circle). 'Oliver was so good it made me realise the true value of going to see a magic show' (Sun).

title: Maia Tassalini: I Was 22 and Stunning
description: Ever served so hard you almost toppled a government? In her debut hour, BBC New Comedian of the Year finalist and Pleasance Reserve alum Maia Tassalini channels the muse (Monica Lewinsky) to boldly ask the question on everyone's lips: is there anything more cursed than being 22 and stunning? 'Maia is a natural. Born to do it. Unreal!' (Shaparak Khorsandi).
content_warnings: This show contains strong language, sexual themes and references to diet culture and body image.

title: Making Love with David Magidoff
description: Featuring Fran Healy of Travis and more special guests! Making Love with David Magidoff is in the middle of a three-year sold-out run in Los Angeles and is proud to make its Edinburgh debut! Each night David Magidoff (Dexter) interviews a celebrity about a real love story, then he and his improviser friends turn it into a fully improvised musical. Past guests include Tony Hale (Veep), Michael C. Hall (Dexter), and Oscar Nuñez (The Office). You never know who will show up! 'Making Love is Hilarious!' (Alex Horne, creator of Taskmaster).
content_warnings: Audience participation, Scenes of a sexual nature, Strong language/swearing

title: Mama G: The Magic Bookmark
description: Join 'everyone's favourite pantomime dame!' (Metro) and Britain's Got Talent semi-finalist, Mama G, on an award winning, panto adventure for the whole family. Book Worm is livid that encyclopaedias give people so much knowledge, so decides to steal all the books from Mama G's library! Mama G vows to save the day by proving that books can help make the world a better place. But she can't do it alone! Enter the mysterious and wonderful Magic Bookmark... She needs your help too, to discover why everyone deserves to be part of the story!

title: Man Sings the Same Song Over and Over Again for an Hour
description: One man. One song. One hour. Award-winning comedian Conk takes to the stage and sings the same song over and over again on repeat for an entire hour. That's it. That's the show. Which song? You'll have to come and find out. Equal parts comedy and live art experiment, what begins as a simple musical premise of singing the same hit song over and over again spirals into a hilarious feat of absurdity.

title: Manogram – A Man with Breast Cancer. Stories of Confusion, Disbelief, Irony and Downright Ridiculousness
description: A story of a man with breast cancer. Mammograms, mastectomies, lumpectomies, chemotherapy and hormone therapies from a different angle. The weird ways that men support each other. 'You dead yet?' The love of woman who occasionally lets her guard down determined to colour co-ordinate the sick bay. Ever heard from a man who can talk from experience about a mammogram, a mastectomy and hormone therapy? You have now. A light-hearted look at sharing love and laughter through adversity with a smile never too far away.
content_warnings: Contains distressing or potentially triggering themes
venue_name: Just The Tonic at The Caves

title: Marc Burrows in the Ten Best Songs of All Time
description: Everyone has an opinion about the best songs ever recorded but Marc Burrows, music journalist, author, and man who has thought about this way too much, has the answers. Join him as he counts down the ten greatest records in history: authoritatively, definitively and almost certainly incorrectly. A warm, funny show about music, memory and the songs that have no business meaning as much to you as they do. 'Unmissable' **** (ThreeWeeks). **** (BeyondTheJoke.co.uk). **** (BroadwayBaby.com). **** (ScotsGay.co.uk). **** (TheWeeReview.com).

title: Marc Jennings: If & When
description: Glaswegian comedian and Some Laugh podcast host Marc Jennings returns to the Fringe with his trademark sharp observations on current events, politics and relationships. Sold-out Edinburgh Fringe 2022-2025. 'Killer lines' (Scotsman). 'Will be a household name very soon' (Rolling Stone). 'An astute observer who is adept at channelling his frustrations into a wider social critique' (Chortle.co.uk)
content_warnings: Strong language/swearing, Buy a ticket in advance to guarantee entry or Pay What You Want at the venue

title: Marchmont Music
description: Marchmont Music: a series of free concerts from up-and-coming musicians at the Marchmont Hub of Blackford and Grange Church on Tuesdays, Thursdays and Saturdays at 2.30pm throughout the Fringe.

title: Margaret Thatcher Queen of Hollywood
presented_by: Wildpark Entertainment, Matt Tedford and Jon Brittain
description: Lights! Cameras! Maggie! Mrs Thatcher goes to Hollywood to play herself in a musical remake of the Iron Lady and a Prime MiniSTAR is born! Will Maggie pull herself up by her bra straps or be trampled down by the man? And will she find a moment to ugly-cry so she can win an Oscar? A drag musical romp from the producer of Unfortunate and Olivier Award-winners behind Kathy and Stella Solve a Murder. 'Hilarious camp with political punch' **** (Times). ***** (Attitude.co.uk).
content_warnings: Contains distressing or potentially triggering themes, Strong language/swearing

title: Mario Adrion: Live a Little
description: A darkly funny show about a boy from a picturesque German town who leaves it all behind to become an international fashion model. Armed with a need for approval, Mario dives headfirst into the modelling world, navigating the chaos of pseudo professional relationships, the European runway, and sketchy modelling gigs. Along the way, Mario faces unhealthy power dynamics, constant rejection, and significant sexual abuse within the industry. The show explores themes of self-love, the need for acceptance, and grappling with sexual trauma from a male perspective. It’s a story about being hot — and sad.
content_warnings: This show contains audience participation and references to eating disorders and sexual assault.

title: Mark Black: Horrible Family
description: Mark Black brings his brand-new stand-up comedy and musical show, Horrible Family, to the stage for 2026. Best known as the star of BBC’s Pity Party, Mark has amassed millions of online views with his razor-sharp sketches and songs. Following sold-out performances at the SEC Armadillo and Pavilion Theatre in 2024, he returns with his signature dark wit, brutally honest storytelling and a brand-new collection of hilarious original songs. Expect big laughs, biting observations and outrageous tales from a family you’ll be glad isn’t yours.

title: Mark Nelson: Seven Night Run
description: New show from multi award-winning Scottish stand up, returning for a one-week run. Expect the usual musings. UK Comedian's Comedian of the Year. Five-time Best Headliner at Scottish Comedy Awards. Host of BBC’s The Good, The Bad and The Unexpected and Edinburgh Unlocked. As Seen on Have I Got News For You and Have A Word. Over one billion views online. 'Possesses a talent that's simply obscene' ***** (List). 'A majestic hour of comedy. Perhaps the purest form of stand-up' ***** (Arts Award, VoiceMag.uk). 'As accomplished a stand-up as you’ll see' (Rolling Stone).

title: Mark Row: A Class Act
description: Teacher turned comedian Mark Row has had enough of the endless carousel of uninspiring lessons, inane questions and kids with attitudes that stink worse than their PE kits. But will a new life in the limelight prove to be any better? Bringing together the best bits from his two previous shows, A* in the Making and Don't You Know Who I Am?, this show demonstrates why Mark Row doesn't need to stay in the classroom to prove that he's a class act!
venue_name: Flight Club at Laughing Horse @ West Port Oracle

title: Mark Silcox: Gold Trading Sucks, I Lost Everything.
description: Dr Silcox believed that gold trading would land him in the company of successful entrepreneurs but a series of events broke all his dreams. Thank god he found silent meditation to keep himself sane. Now he wants to spread peace and advise his audience what is life and how to fulfil it without materials, through meditation. The show is full of eye opening events to keep you on the edge of your seat. After the show Dr Silcox claims you will find peace with the world and its fellow inhabitants.

title: Mark Thomas: 40 in Stand-Up Years
presented_by: Mark Thomas / Tin Cat Entertainment Ltd
description: Mark Thomas celebrates 40 years at the mic. In that time, he has changed laws on tax, jailed arms dealers, kickstarted a comedy circuit in Palestine, given evidence before three Parliamentary select committees and taken the police to court three times and won. The world’s moving too fast to predict what the content will be. Expect a taster menu of government and personal mayhem, jokes, rants and a personal state of the nation broadcast. Join Mark as he tries to turn 'what the f*ck is going on' into a cogent hour of stand-up.

title: Mark Vigeant: OUT THERE
description: From comedian Mark Vigeant (whose last Fringe hour became a special on Dropout TV) comes a wildly inventive character-comedy hour. Meet Larry: a burnt-out engineer on a mission to gain fame by livestreaming a survival adventure from the Alaskan wilderness. Armed with a camera, unshakeable optimism and questionable survival skills, he livestreams his journey into the wild. But when the wilderness pushes back, his mission spirals into chaos. Blending live video, immersive tech and fearless clowning, OUT THERE is a hilarious, unpredictable descent into ambition, delusion and the things we do to prove our lives matter.

title: Mark Watson: Before It Overtakes Us
description: Taskmaster cheeky texts icon, multi award-winner, YouTube cult figure, BBC Radio 4's favourite and recently Baby Reindeer actor. A recent encounter with a stranger caused Mark to spend some time pondering the uncertain future facing humanity. After seasons at the Melbourne, Sydney, Adelaide and Brisbane Comedy Festivals, as well a huge national tour and a 100% sell-out at last year's Fringe, he brings the show back to Edinburgh for three final performances. 'Unlike anything else I've seen' ***** (Telegraph). 'Genius-level' ***** (Time Out). 'One of the most genuinely joyous presences in comedy' **** (Times).

title: Mark Watson Tries to Impress Children, for Some Reason
description: Mark Watson has done almost everything in comedy: awards, worldwide festivals, Taskmaster, other TV, radio, you name it. But not a kids' show. Not until now. Is this wise? 'Unlike anything else I've seen' ***** (Telegraph). 'Genius-level' ***** (Time Out). 'One of the most genuinely joyous presences in comedy' **** (Times).

title: Married at Fringe Sight
description: An exciting crowd-work show where the audience decide who gets married today, by the end of the show! You have the power, using our app, to decide who is getting married! Our comedians will find out what the audience is really like while you get to decide who makes the perfect pairing and decide who is going to get Married at Fringe (first) Sight! From the team that The Guardian called 'an institution' and Attitude Magazine called 'hilariously funny... inspirational'. 'A true masterclass in crowd work' (NorthWestEnd.co.uk). Don't forget your hat!

title: Martin Luther: Not For Sale
presented_by: Miller College of the Bible Drama Team
description: After abandoning his promising career in law, Luther dedicated his life to answering one question: What can I do to be made right with a God who seems impossible to please? Luther became a monk but found no peace. He followed the church’s ordinances but felt no assurance. It was not until he began to read the Bible that he realised the truth: salvation cannot be purchased. Under constant threat of arrest and death, Luther must decide: Is this truth worth dying for?

title: Martin Urbano: #Standup #Funny
description: Edinburgh Fringe Best Newcomer Nominee (2023). We are living in the golden age of stand-up comedy, allegedly. Martin Urbano spent years of his life working on a satirical stand-up show lampooning cancelled accused entertainers and their blatant return to the spotlight, and it went horribly wrong. But now he's BACK, and he's learned from his mistakes. ***** (ThreeWeeks). ***** (VoiceMag.uk). **** (Times). **** (List).
content_warnings: This show contains audience participation, distressing or potentially triggering themes, and strong language.

title: Marty Gleeson: Dog Ear
description: Hello, Irish comedian Marty Gleeson whispers gently but sternly, her hand outstretched, one eye lit like a spark, the other dead behind it. Come on. Unnerved but excited, you take her hand. Gleeson begins to buck and screech; her sparky eye glows brighter. The other falls right out of her head. Leave it, she growls, pulling you headfirst into her debut hour, Dog Ear. You'll see magpies like you've never seen, news reporters in unexpected places and flaw-filled moments of humanity. BBC New Comedy Award finalist and Channel 4 Sean Lock Award 2024.

title: Mason King – The Mind Spy
description: After a sell-out 2025 Edinburgh Fringe run, The Mind Spy returns with an immersive, theatrical, magic and mind-reading experience inspired by real Cold War psychic experiments. Could you be a psychic spy? Expect impossible predictions, thought transmission and unexpected connections as the audience becomes part of the test. Stylish, interactive and quietly provocative, this is psychological theatre where nothing is quite as it seems. Winner of Best Original Show, Liverpool Fringe 2025. 'Mind blowing' ***** (TheatreAndArtReviews.com). 'Astounding' ***** (FringeReview.ca).

title: Mat Wills: My Wife Took My Dad to a Brothel (I Drove)
description: Mat Wills' brutally honest yet heart-warming and hilarious take on family, love, social taboos and the absurd realities of growing old. Underground hit of Fringe 2024 and 2025.

title: Material Girl: Madonna The Icon
description: Award-winning Night Owl Shows chronicle the story of the most successful female artist in history, starring Voice of the Fringe 2025 Maia Elsey (Derek Awards). This anticipated journey spanning from Like a Virgin, Papa Don’t Preach through to Ray of Light and beyond, will remind you why Madonna’s story is the most inspiring of all pop music. The unique formula that has won Night Owl Shows international acclaim brings Madonna’s story to life through a spellbinding performance from Maia Elsey and her dynamite band. Relive the magic of the ultimate Material Girl. World Premiere.

title: MATES: The Improvised 90s Sitcom
description: It's New York City. It's the 90s. And this is the world's craziest sitcom. A parody of classic TV such as Seinfeld, Frasier and Friends and completely improvised from your suggestions. Could this show BE any funnier? From some of the comedians behind the award-winning Lying Together and CSI: Crime Scene Improvisation. Theatre Weekly's Best Improv Show at the 2022 Edinburgh Fringe. 'Uproarious improvised comedy' **** (AYoungerTheatre.com). 'Laugh-out-loud' **** (ThePhoenixRemix.com). 'Extremely quick and funny' **** (TheatreWeekly.com). 'Had the audience laughing from the get-go' **** (NorthWestEnd.co.uk).
content_warnings: Strong language/swearing, Buy a ticket in advance to guarantee entry or Pay What You Want at the venue
venue_name: Just The Tonic at The Hive

title: Matilda Junior
description: Captivate Theatre’s five-star Matilda returns after a sell-out 2025 run. Cheer on the “revolting children” as they take on the grown-ups in this energetic, heartwarming production. A fantastic cast brings boundless energy, sharp choreography and superb vocals, doing full justice to Tim Minchin’s witty, unforgettable score. ‘Energy and commitment abound… a really charming and likeable show, a satisfying and accomplished piece from this prolific community theatre company’ ***** (AllEdinburghTheatre.com). Book now to experience the magic, the mischief and the music.

title: Matthew Gallagher: Last Minute
description: Matthew is bringing his debut Fringe hour to Edinburgh and it will see him tackle a wide range of subjects such as love, life, laundry and seagulls. Matthew has a chaotic style that will ensure no two performances will be the exact same. Come and join him as he tackles the big issues in the world as well as discovers a bit more about himself. He just wants to try his best to make you laugh and hopefully not leave it to the last minute... hence the title... get it.

title: Max Davidson: Strangers
description: An interactive mentalism show where the audience plays a central role, and no secret – or phone passcode – is safe. The sold-out sensation comes to Edinburgh on the heels of multiple U.S. tours and NYC runs. Part mind-reading, part storytelling, the show is ultimately a joyful celebration of the beauty we find in strangers when we slow down enough to see them. A Time Out NYC Top Magic Show. As seen at The Magic Castle, Caesars' Palace and in the NYT.
space_name: Just The Tonic at The Subway

title: Max Fulham: Memory Foam
description: After last year's sold-out debut, Max is back and sorting through some boxes, but what will he find? Most likely a mixture of puppet characters, sketches and stand-up for you to rummage through. There'll be family history, charity shopping, financial advice and more! 'I couldn't physically breathe from laughing so much' ***** (ThreeWeeks). 'His ventriloquism skills are incredible... a terrific first outing' **** (EdFestMag.com). 'Original, charming, genuinely funny, clever... solid gold and has the house in stitches' **** (TheWeeReview.com). **** (TheTheatreReviewer.com) **** (BeyondTheJoke.co.uk). **** (OnTheMic.co.uk).
content_warnings: This show contains strong language and audience participation.

title: Max Fulham's Monkey Business
description: Join Max, his sidekick Gordon the Monkey, and a gaggle of puppet friends as they get down to the seriously silly business of making big laughs for the whole family. Expect sketches, slapstick and briefcase full of nonsense. With years of family comedy experience under his belt, come along as Max brings his family-friendly show to the Fringe for the very first time! ***** (ThreeWeeks). **** (EdFestMag.com). **** (TheWeeReview.com). **** (TheTheatreReviewer.com). **** (BeyondTheJoke.co.uk). **** (OnTheMic.co.uk).

title: Max Olesker: Making the Cut
description: Edinburgh. 2am. Max falls for Eliana – but to marry her he must convert to Orthodox Judaism… despite already being Jewish. Confused? Imagine how he feels. A hilarious, heartbreaking true story about love, identity and belonging, from one half of comedy double-act Max & Ivan. Adapted from Max’s critically acclaimed memoir Making the Cut: An Unorthodox Love Story (Ebury/Penguin). ***** (Times). 'Britain’s answer to David Sedaris' (Andrew O’Hagan).
content_warnings: This show contains strong language, audience participation and contains references to the holocaust, descriptions of medical procedures, and themes of grief and loss with references to dementia.

title: Maya Ricote: Ay Am!
description: Cryogenically preserved and freshly defrosted, this passionate Latina with dangerous curves is ready to make you melt. In her debut clown spectacle, The Queen of Wails finally performs her Latin-melodramatic-soap-opera slash camp musical, for you. Maya Ricote is a Mexican/Venezuelan-American telenovela actress turned clown. 'A charismatic delight to watch... I predict big things' (Chortle.co.uk).
content_warnings: This show contains strong language and audience participation.

title: MC Hammersmith: Ice Ice Nepo Baby
description: MC Hammersmith is posh West London's leading freestyle rapper, with 500 million views online. He presents his new show: Ice Ice Nepo Baby. When MC Hammersmith turned 18, his parents (MC Hammer and Vanilla Ice) shockingly revealed he was adopted. His two famous dads helped him ascend to the top of the rap game. He now embarks on a quest to find his biological family, the only way he knows how: by performing an hour of improvised hip hop comedy based on audience suggestions. Lightning-fast raps, explosively funny rhymes, and utterly captivating genealogical investigation!

title: McVea and Rea Go Away
description: Two very different comedians take on the Fringe in McVea and Rea Go Away. Sam McVea; autistic, with unashamed confidence and unpredictable energy. Will Rea; neurotic and overthinking, telling honest stories that might either entertain or make you cringe. With a clear generation gap and contrasting styles, this fast-paced split bill mixes chaos, honesty and changing forfeits into a show full of surprises.
content_warnings: Audience participation, Buy a ticket in advance to guarantee entry or Pay What You Want at the venue
venue_name: Just The Tonic at The Mash House

title: Me and the D.O.G
description: Ever return home from a comically bad date to a Dead Old Guy under your bed? Same. By comparing the loneliness of a single woman approaching 30 and a widowed elderly man, this tragically comical one-woman show unpacks the all-consuming obsession of trying to find love in the first quarter of life and the driving forces behind making life-altering choices in your late twenties. It explores themes of rejection, romance, reproductive choice, friendship, loneliness, loyalty and heartbreak through one woman and a pair of feet sticking out from under her bed.
content_warnings: Contains distressing or potentially triggering themes, Scenes of a sexual nature, Strong language/swearing, Buy a ticket in advance to guarantee entry or Pay What You Want at the venue
venue_name: Just The Tonic at The Caves

title: Meat Loaf – Just the Best Bits
presented_by: Antony (Dr H) Hubmayer / PBH's Free Fringe
description: This is piano cabaret that ROCKS! Dine out on a hearty serving of your favourite Meat Loaf pieces as we slice through his back catalogue and digest the finest moments. Like a Bat out of Hell, award-winning Australian piano cabaret entertainer Antony (Dr H) Hubmayer will serve up a smorgasbord of entertainment that will have you laughing, singing along, reminiscing and consuming the interactive fun and games. The menu will include all his greatest pieces, trimmed to perfection, marinated in the finest Steinman style and garnished by the musical excellence of Dr H.
venue_name: PBH's Free Fringe @ Fingers Piano Bar

title: Megasquirt: Fully Loaded
description: Second City Mainstage alums Ashley Blair and Drew Reilly are Megasquirt, an experimental comedy music project from Brooklyn. Fully Loaded is the unhinged hybrid concert/sketch show of your wet dreams – a high-octane flood of gay brain rot set to a sickening beat. Imagine being at an underground rave that is also hilarious and maybe illegal. That's the vibe. Featuring hit songs like Butt of the Bread, Gooning in the DJ Booth, Centaur Boyfriend and more! Come thirsty. Leave fully loaded.
content_warnings: Audience participation, Contains distressing or potentially triggering themes, Scenes of a sexual nature, Strong language/swearing

title: Mel Hudson: Richard Ashcroft Revived My Libido
presented_by: Blue Book Artist Management in association with MMBCreative
description: See how Mel Hudson revived her libido, courtesy of Richard Ashcroft. In 2022 Mel thinks her love life is over. She is prepared to go to her grave as a sexually redundant cat lady. Then 3 things happen: lockdown ends, the cat dies and Mel attends a momentously revitalising musical event at Crystal Palace Park Bowl. Suddenly men are not so paused. From Alan Partridge, The Catherine Tate Show, Hudson and Pepperdine. 'What an honest, funny show, cleverly insightful and life affirming' (Phil Clarke, Producer of Peep Show).

title: Men Love Horsies: The Musical
description: Just a man singing songs about horses. Men Love Horsies: The Musical won Best In Fringe, Critic's Pick and Best In Series at the Hamilton Fringe Festival. It was selected to showcase at San Francisco Sketchfest and Toronto Sketchfest. Which is surprising. Because again: it's just a man singing songs about horses.

title: Merlesque: How an Adult Woman Became a Mermaid
description: Merlesque is ultimately a tale about a tail. Dr Elle Rochford is a policy expert uprooted by America’s 2024 presidential election. Finding her PhD useless in a dry job market, Elle decides to get wet. A real fish out of water epic, Merlesque is the true story of how she transformed from a statistician into a birthday party mermaid. Because sometimes all you can do is lean into the absurdity, challenge fascism, and keep treading water.

title: Mervyn Stutter's Pick of the Fringe
description: It's like the Royal Variety Show of the Fringe. Mervyn and his team carefully research the Fringe and bring you live extracts from seven top shows in a packed 90-minute lunchtime extravaganza. Every day there is a different selection. Pick the ones you like and then go and see them. Simple! Brilliant! There's comedy, theatre, cabaret, music, dance, circus and the indefinable. Daily line-ups at MervsPick.com.

title: Mesmerising Mechanisms
description: A free, hands-on exhibition featuring a collection of wooden machines which demonstrate the fascinating and often bewildering motion of mechanisms. Old-school, hand-driven mechanics: gears, cams, levers... those twisty bits... All working together to produce interesting and often amusing effects. You’ll see Drawing Machines, which produce elaborate patterns. Just turn the handle to make your own unique artwork to take away and impress your friends. There are Ball Runner Machines, which propel a set of balls around in complicated circuits. This year, the Hedgehog Automata are helping out with the other machines. The results will be... interesting...
content_warnings: Audience participation, Audience will be standing throughout, Audience required to walk or move around during the performance

title: Metroland Live: As Seen On TV
presented_by: AEG Presents in association with Parkas at Independent Talent
description: In an age where gathering round the television with the family – doing anything but talking to each other – is a thing of the past, this comedy group is determined to bring you a genuine shared experience of sitting and watching. Known for their 'sharply surreal writing and natural funny bones' (Chortle.co.uk) and 'whatever The Scotsman said' (Scotsman), Metroland invites you to an hour of programmed entertainment full of absurd, acerbic characters painted with a smattering of Geordie charm. It's definitely not a simulation. 'Get them on the telly now' (Rolling Stone).

title: Mi Casa es su Casa
description: The high energy and interactive creation of Ecuador's number one comic El Purnell. A gag-heavy show that travels from the UK to Asia, South America and New Zealand in an hour! He will cover culture, family, politics, relationships, music, travel and some dark Latin secrets. El Purnell is a unique duo-lingo act, performing comedy in both Spanish and English. It does not matter if you do not understand Spanish, you will still belly laugh. He also promises to teach the audience some essential (and not so essential), Spanish holiday phrases.
venue_name: Flight Club at Laughing Horse @ West Port Oracle

title: Miami Advice
description: In this interactive comedy show, two renegade American cops, Tito Perez from Texas and Jacob Liss from California, are hilariously forced to provide community service by answering audience questions live. They transform an anonymous Q&A into a riotous experience filled with side-splitting insights and unexpected twists. Blending Texan charm with California crazy, Tito and Jacob promise outrageous antics and balls-to-the-wall bravado that will keep you locked and loaded in laughter all night long. Join them for an unforgettable night of spontaneity, hilarity and 80s chaos that promises to deliver an experience you won't soon forget.
content_warnings: Audience participation, Strong language/swearing, Buy a ticket in advance to guarantee entry or Pay What You Want at the venue
venue_name: Just The Tonic at The Caves

title: Michael Brunström: William Tell vs the Algorithm
description: The medieval Swiss folk hero stands up to the tyranny of AI in this surreal take on the William Tell legend, from Malcolm Hardee Award winner Michael Brunström. Death to The Algorithm! Freedom for Switzerland! Michael Brunström is an award-winning surrealist comedian. His show Copernicus Now was nominated for the Best Show Award at Leicester Comedy Festival 2024. 'A true comedy original ... a joy' **** (Scotsman). 'An artistic genius' **** (Skinny). 'You will see nothing else that is so clever and funny' **** (NorthWestEnd.co.uk).

title: Michael Shafar: Inappropriate
description: 2025 Leicester Comedy Festival Best Show Nominee. Edgy. Dark. Hilarious. In his trademark unfiltered and unapologetic style, Australian comedian, Michael Shafar, weighs into the topics that most comedians are smart enough to avoid. 'Shafar has a disarmingly relaxed approach... with a wildly inventive, darkly comic imagination.' ***** (TheEdinburghReporter.co.uk).
