'He circumnavigates the line between edgy and offensive with beautiful finesse' ****½ (Age). 'If you fear comedy has gotten too politically correct, Shafar will put those fears to rest' **** (Time Out). 'He drives across taboos... this is equal opportunity Sacred Cow slaughter' (Scotsman).
venue_name: Scottish Comedy Festival @ The Beehive Inn

title: Michael Spicer: Hope All's Well
presented_by: Mick Perrin Worldwide by arrangement with Sophie Chapman Talent
description: Another hilarious and brilliantly entertaining satirical show from the online sensation behind the award-winning hit The Room Next Door. Packed with sketches and stories about having hope despite the current political and global shitshow. Featuring characters from his BBC Radio 4 show, No Room as well as some old friends too. ‘Huge comedy talent’ (Radio Times) **** (Guardian). **** (Daily Mail).

title: Mickey's Uncut Hits: A Raunchy Cabaret
description: Mickey's Uncut Hits is an interactive sex-positive comedy cabaret. Featuring parody versions of Disney tunes, favourite childhood melodies are “re-imagineered” into a soundtrack of salacious songs, including (Your) Booty is a Feast (Beauty and the Beast), The Circle Jerk Tonight (Circle of Life), You’ve Got an STD (You’ve Got a Friend in Me) and many more! Making their international debut, catch the continuing adventures of Dickey and Ditzy Mouse! Put your carnal knowledge on display with XXX trivia and you never know what you might win! Dirty jokes, sexy sing-alongs and happy endings guaranteed!
content_warnings: Audience participation, Scenes of a sexual nature, Strong language/swearing

title: Midday Cabaret
description: Your full Fringe fix before lunchtime! A rotating selection of the best in variety at the festival in one jam-packed show. Enjoy stunning musicians, top comedians, the best in burlesque, guest magicians and multiple surprises from the circus tent! From the producers of the award-winning Big Gay Afterparty and the sell-out 11pm Live at the Big Cave, this is the best way to sample the best of cabaret and variety at the Fringe in one electrifying hour of entertainment.
venue_name: Just The Tonic at The Caves

title: Midnight Treats at the Fringe
description: Join Team Tipsy for a special midnight treat during the Fringe. Voted Whisky Bar of the Year 2023, 2024 and 2025, allow the team to pick three special drams and pair them with tasty tipsy treats of delicious Scottish canapes! Colin, award-winning chef and bar owner has been wowing the world of whisky and cuisine for over 30 years. The perfect way to enjoy fab whisky from the mind of an award-winning chef. Expect three hand selected whiskies from Scotland with three bespoke canapes that harmonise and enhance your whisky experience.

title: Mike Rice: A Work in Progress Show (Testing New Horrible Material)
description: Mike Rice returns to the Fringe to test out new rotten ideas, stories and jokes. The material will touch on subjects ranging from adventures in Africa to dodgy medical procedures.
content_warnings: Strong language/swearing, Scenes of a sexual nature, Contains distressing or potentially triggering themes, Buy a ticket in advance to guarantee entry or Pay What You Want at the venue

title: Mike Wozniak: The Bench
description: New stand-up tour show from Mike Wozniak in which a story about a bench will be prominent. Previous experience of or strong opinions about benches not required. Let Mike worry about that. As seen on Taskmaster, Man Down and Junior Taskmaster. As heard on Three Bean Salad podcast.

title: Milkdrunk
description: Crackling with humour and vulnerability, writer-performer Cathleen O'Malley plunges headfirst and tit-deep into childbirth, milk and what it takes to be a nursing mammal in a modern world. 'A hilarious one-woman hurricane of a show' (RocCityMag.com). 'Brilliant' ****½ (AllAboutSOLO.com, Critics' Choice).
content_warnings: Contains distressing or potentially triggering themes, Strong language/swearing

title: Mills & Farrell
description: Mills & Farrell are noted for their rootsy minimalist approach. Using two voices and acoustic instrumentation, inspired by Gillian Welch and Dave Rawlings, The Milk Carton Kids and the Waifs, the duo have a timeless sound characterized by intricately woven acoustic guitars and tight harmonies. Coming from backgrounds of Australian rock (David Farrell) and Nova Scotia folk (Janet Mills), geographic improbability yields an undefinable element to their modern and traditional offerings.

title: Mind Full
description: How do you know what is reality and what is not? Mind Full: new writing by Lewis Teckkam. This surreal, Brechtian and Beckett-esque play combines quirky humour with existential thoughtfulness. Conscience, Memory, Imagination and Intrusive Thoughts explore what it means to live in a body that needs help with everything. Except thinking. Entertaining, provocative and darkly funny, Mind Full examines society, disability, politics, and the arts. It questions our individual and collective responsibilities and hopes to inspire audiences to imagine real change. For the better.

title: Mind The Gap Year
description: Four teenagers. Twelve months. Endless possibilities. Four teenagers are ready for a taste of the real world before they embark on... whatever comes next. As they plan their adventures and start to figure out who they’ll be, a frightening realisation hits: a gap year can’t last forever. There’s so much to do and only so much time. Will they rise to the challenge and forge an iconic legacy, or crumble and question everything? Only time will tell... Filled with laughs, live music and a touch of pathos, you can't miss it.

title: Mindreading and Other Freaking Wonders
description: International mentalist Christian Lavey invites you into a world where psychology, intuition and illusion blur together. In this fast-paced and interactive show, thoughts are revealed, decisions predicted and impossible coincidences unfold live on stage. Volunteers from the audience become part of astonishing demonstrations that seem to defy logic. Is it psychology, suggestion, intuition – or something more mysterious? With humour, charm and razor-sharp timing, Lavey takes you on a journey into the strange world of the human mind.

title: Mistakes on Maps
description: Mistakes on Maps is a witty, visually immersive journey through 20 historical maps, each featuring a fascinating flaw. Encounter sea monsters in the 1539 Carta Marina, the phantom continent of Terra Australis, California drawn as an island, the Open Polar Sea, canals on Mars, and the Mountains of Kong. Were these errors accidents, ambition, propaganda or fear of empty space? Along the way, see how trade, empire, faith and imagination bent geography. Through projected maps, story and music, this show reveals how cartographers got it wrong, and what their errors reveal about us.

title: Mistakes Were Made: Shiver Me Timbers!
description: Three heroes. One dungeon. No dragons. They’re back, and this time they’re on a boat! Bottoms Up Theatre returns with Mistakes Were Made: Shiver Me Timbers! When the crew’s treasure hunt takes an unexpected turn, it’ll take all their daring to set sail... and to survive your dice rolls. You shape the action from the comfort of your seat in this exhilarating and hilarious show! This is Mistakes Were Made’s third outing at the Edinburgh Fringe and we’re back once again at Surgeon’s Hall. Will this magical tabletop improv show sell out yet again?!

title: Mister Jackpot
description: Mister Jackpot lives in Lexington, Kentucky. By day he endures the grinding monotony of a gardening equipment company. By night he dreams of being a winner – money, women, luxury cars, the James Bond life. Then a chance encounter with a slot machine changes everything. What begins as harmless entertainment quickly spirals into a compulsion fed by his darkest inner demon. A tragicomic solo performance that blends physical theatre and dark comedy to explore the psychological spiral leading to pathological gambling.

title: MISTRANSLATED
description: Mistranslated is an interactive stand-up comedy show about the absurd and hilarious side of speaking (and misspeaking) languages, delivered by a polyglot comedian who does comedy in seven languages. This show is a masterclass in how to (badly) learn a foreign language, offering hacks and tips while featuring tales of languages fails, tonal triumphs and finally being able to understand what those Thai masseuses are saying. It's all in English, but with no promises you won't walk away knowing how to bargain in Indonesian or chitchat about dried fish in Norwegian.
venue_name: Just The Tonic at The Caves

title: Mitch Benn: Asking Elvis
description: The King is back! Mitch Benn resurrects Elvis from BBC Radio 2's legendary Steve Wright in the Afternoon show, to answer hunks of burning questions about life, death, cheeseburgers and everything in between... including the story of how Mitch managed to be possibly the most popular thing on the most popular show on British radio for over ten years, without anyone ever knowing it was him. If you have a question for Elvis, hit the QR code on the flyer or go to: mitchbenn.com/asking-elvis Thankyouverymuch. 'The country's leading musical satirist' (Times).

title: Modern Medicine: Menstruation
description: Join menstruation specialists Prof Anne MacGregor and Prof Hilary Critchley for a ground-breaking discussion busting myths and sharing their expertise on the latest science about periods. Known for their experienced, compassionate and accessible advice, Anne and Hilary can be found sharing their knowledge on podcasts, social media and public talks. Have your questions answered about menstrual health.
venue_name: Royal College of Physicians of Edinburgh

title: Mohan: A Partition Story
presented_by: Niall Moorjani in association with Jasmine Cole Productions
description: Fringe First Award-winning and critically acclaimed storyteller Niall Moorjani presents a heartfelt piece which explores their grandfather's experiences of the Partitioning of India in 1947. It follows the eleven-year-old Mohan as he flees from his home in Sindh, across a border which didn't yet exist and into uncertain times in Delhi and later the United Kingdom. Lyrical storytelling and live music from Sodhi combine to create a provocative and stunning account of a much omitted story from British-Indian history.
content_warnings: This show references moments of historical violence, racism and oppression and contains strong language.

title: MOM! WTF!!
description: MOM! WTF!! is a comedy confessional about being raised by a “happy homemaker” in the era of free love and free-range parenting. Somehow she still became a mom herself. Carol Johnson delivers sharp stand-up, raw honesty and a cheeky women’s-rights sing-along while unpacking the drama our mothers passed down like heirlooms. Big laughs, real talk and moments that may hit a little close to home. Perfect for anyone who’s ever said, 'I thought it was just me'. Whether you’re a mom or still recovering from one, traumaste – the trauma in me bows to the trauma in you!
content_warnings: Audience participation, Strong language/swearing, Buy a ticket in advance to guarantee entry or Pay What You Want at the venue

title: Monks
description: Falala, brothers! Join two medieval monks (modest!) on the quest of a lifetime (brave!) in this sacredly-stupid interactive clown epic. For the lentils are many, the donkey is happy and the Abbott won’t be back for hours. When two medieval brothers are left home alone they fling open the monastery doors and invite a wagonload of strangers to join them for a full day of doing nothing... What could go wrong? Ahhhhh! ‘Sublime’ ***** (NextMag.ca), ‘These clowns are gifts from God’ ***** (MyGayToronto.com), ‘Wickedly funny and surprisingly poignant’ (TheGlobeandMail.com), ‘Canada’s Best New Work’ (Toronto Theatre Critic’s Awards).
content_warnings: Audience participation, Strobe lighting, Strong language/swearing, Partial nudity and allergy notice – lentils.

title: Monski Mouse's Baby Cabaret
description: Join Monski Mouse, and her super talented friends, for a live musical singalong cabaret of nursery classics, song, puppetry and bonkers fun for 0-5s and their parents/carers. All the big topics covered: elephants, fish, wiggly worms, transport and the existential ways of the toddler. 'Moments of utter beauty' ***** (Edinburgh Festivals Magazine). 'Monski shines bright, inviting us into a world of wonder' ***** (One4Review.co.uk). 'Delightful' **** (FamiliesOnline.co.uk). 'At the Fringe with a toddler? Recommend Monski Mouse Baby Cabaret' (@AlMurray). Nominated for Best Family Friendly show, WTF Best of Fringe Awards 2025.
content_warnings: Audience participation, Babes in Arms: Babies are required to have a paid ticket

title: Monski Mouse's Baby Disco Dance Hall
description: Why toddle when you can dance? Join this must-do, award-winning, epic session of bopping, bonkers, beautiful fun. Expect high-energy smiling to retro beats and thumping nursery rhymes. Best of Kids Weekly Award winner, Adelaide Fringe 2024. Best of Kids Award nominee, Sydney Fringe 2022. Sold-out season Edinburgh Festival Fringe 2022, 2023, 2024 and 2025. 'Best. Time. Ever' ***** (FamiliesOnline.co.uk). 'Deserves all the praise' ***** (One4Review.co.uk). 'This is what the experts meant when they said spend quality time together' ***** (GlamAdelaide.com.au). 'Tune after tune perfectly chosen for the youngsters' ***** (Edinburgh Evening News).
content_warnings: Audience participation, Audience will be standing throughout, Audience required to walk or move around during the performance, Babes in Arms: Babies are required to have a paid ticket

title: Monster Made
presented_by: Strickland Scenic Adventure / Alex van Ric / Astrid Gutscher
description: Monster Made is the story of two people who could not be further apart. Amanda Crowley is an unyielding lawyer who will not be intimidated by a man accused of murder. This man is Thomas Duncan who committed a heinous massacre. He is guilty. Without a doubt, the case is lost. Nevertheless, Amanda wants the case. She does not want to win it, but rather to understand how someone can become such a monster and possibly set a development into motion that will finally change something. 'Monster Made is a captivating, psychological, intimate play' (Audience Review).
content_warnings: Contains distressing or potentially triggering themes, Strong language/swearing

title: Monty Python's Previous Cabaret Singalong Circus
description: Join the hilarious fun as Dr H revives the great satirical songs from the Monty Python era. Participation is a must, featuring piano cabaret antics, interactive patter and plenty of singalongs. Your piano song-master is Antony (Dr H) Hubmayer and he’ll have you rolling and ‘silly-walking’ down the aisles. No experience necessary. So, book your tickets, bring your friends and family, and enjoy an uplifting and fun hour revisiting the songs and stories of one of the world’s most successful comedy groups: the Monty Python team.

title: More Myself Than I Am
description: A vivid exploration of how three sheltered young women from a remote Yorkshire parsonage created some of the most raw, violent and passionate literary works of all time. Charlotte: the ambitious dreamer. Emily: the intense loner. Anne: the gentle, would-be social reformer. And their brother Branwell: the brilliant "lost" boy whose disappointments served only to highlight the extraordinary success of his sisters. 'Gripping and unforgettable' **** (BroadwayBaby.com). 'A cut above' **** (TheWeeReview.com).

title: More Tales From Your Queer Elder
description: 'If you need an hour of positivity and wonderful dancing (and lots of good laughs!), this is one for you.' (TheEdinburghReporter.co.uk). An acclaimed performer delivers a vibrant dance/spoken word show. 70+, plus-sized lesbian artist shares intimate, queer-centred stories that celebrate inclusivity and urge audiences to chase their dreams. In Lucia’s fifth Edinburgh Fringe production, she premieres new work alongside timeless gems, weaving personal narratives from decades of experience into a powerful testament to authentic living and artistic passion. Lucia’s performance inspires viewers to push beyond their limits and pursue their life's ambitions.
content_warnings: Reference to drug use, Buy a ticket in advance to guarantee entry or Pay What You Want at the venue

title: Morgan Rees: What a Bummer (Tour Warm-Up)
presented_by: Berk's Nest in association with PBJ Management
description: Following a sold-out 2024 tour, acclaimed stand-up and online sensation Morgan Rees is back with previews of his hugely anticipated brand-new show. A stand-up show about the trials and errors of falling in love and keeping the spark alive, the spiral-inducing limbo of awaiting a diagnosis, and the experience of being a white Welsh valley boy integrating into a proud Gujarati family. 'A fine storyteller... with tremendous heart and warmth' **** (Scotsman). **** (Entertainment-Now.com). **** (BroadwayBaby.com). **** (Skinny). Tour support for Joanne McNally, Rhys James and Lucy Beaumont.
content_warnings: Scenes of a sexual nature, Strong language/swearing, Buy a ticket in advance to guarantee entry or Pay What You Want at the venue

title: Most of My Moms Are Gay
description: Abby is the daughter of five mothers (mostly lesbians). Turkey-basted into existence, her immaculate-conception-adjacent origin story has always defined her. But when your conception is iconic, you become the mystery. Cue: identity crisis. There’s gay divorce, coming out as straight, OCD, Jewishness and Germans who fetishize it, and career heartache. And instead of going to therapy, Abby wrote this musical.

title: Mother Earth
description: Mother Earth. Who's there, in the dark, when you're lost...? Only time will tell. Cadet Earth is on a mission across the stars. When a sun-stroked tyrant sets eyes on the inbound planet, Earth will have to turn to a new community for support. No matter how small they may be. Find your place in the universe with this light-hearted reimagining of our planet's history, premiering at this year's Edinburgh Fringe.
content_warnings: Flashing lights. Some loud sound effects.

title: Mother, Maiden and Crone
description: By the receding of my gums... Something wicked this way comes. A comedic and farcical retelling of Macbeth from the witches perspective... If the witches were a bimbo shot boy, a klepto DJ and a drag queen. Set on an imaginary strip in Edinburgh, colleagues of Club Limbo, Mother, Maiden and Crone, are confronted with McBride and her heinous hen party who are soon to find out the dos and don'ts of queer spaces.
content_warnings: Nudity, Scenes of a sexual nature and of sexual violence, Scenes of violence, Strong language/swearing

title: Mothman: A Romance Musical
description: It's 1943, and the Nazis are winning. Luckily, America has one last trick up its sleeve – a super soldier! But uh oh! A moth snuck into the machine! It's mutating! It's becoming a... moth... man!? Written and performed by Alex Franklin (as seen on Channel 4 and HBO Max) and Nikola McMurtrie (Sketch Off 2025 Third Place, Funny Women Shorts winner), with Alex Prescot (Musical Comedy Award finalist) and Hudson Hughes (Double Sketch Off finalist). Prepare for the ultimate romantic comedy musical that no one asked for. Mothman!

title: Movieoke!
description: It's karaoke, but with the movie scenes you love! Cinema's most iconic moments get rewritten, recast and utterly reimagined by top stand-up comedians, with audience members stepping in for surprise cameos. Whether you are an A24 buff, part of the popcorn crowd or just looking for a good giggle, come and take a seat in the director's chair! Unscripted, unpredictable and definitely not in cinemas now!

title: Mr Bergmann of Deadman's Point
description: A basement in Sligo town, Ireland. An embalmer and a mysterious stranger. One of them wants to disappear, leaving no trace, while the other is desperate to be remembered forever. A brand-new play based on the extraordinary true story of the so-called Peter Bergmann, Ireland’s most famous unidentified man, who spent three days in Sligo town deleting himself and was later found deceased at Rosses Point, Sligo. A mysterious, comic tale exploring legacy, reputation and what it is to live close to death. Created by the multi award-winning Nth Degree Productions. 'Unforgettable' **** (Advertiser, Galway).
content_warnings: Contains distressing or potentially triggering themes, More information

title: Mrs Gary Breath
presented_by: Blue Book Artist Management in association with MMBCreative
description: When Annie's parents offer her a life-changing sum to get married by 35, she can't refuse. Even if she definitely should. Part romcom, part social autopsy, this ‘relentlessly funny’ (Rosie Jones) new solo show satirises our obsession with ticking life’s boxes. Big-hearted, big-character storytelling about the cost of fitting in – and the freedom of opting out. Written and performed by Ellie Ross (BBC Radio 5 Live, i Paper's 50 Best Jokes of the Fringe, Leicester Square Theatre's SketchOff!), with direction from Liam Williams (Sheeps). ‘Bursting with big laughs’ (Jesse Armstrong; creator of Peep Show & Succession).

title: Mrs Macbeth
description: If you hear everything and say nothing, does that make you complicit? From multi award-winning writer and performer Susanna Hamnett (Nearly Lear, Hotel Elsinore), Mrs Macbeth is a new solo show exploring the complexities of integrity in dark times. Set in the aftermath of Macbeth's fascist rule, explanations are being demanded from those closest to the murderous couple, including Margaret, Lady Macbeth's gentlewoman, who happens to share her last name. Tragic, funny, and unsettling, Mrs Macbeth is presented here in a 50 minute version. 'A virtuosic performer' (New York Times).
content_warnings: Audience participation, Contains distressing or potentially triggering themes

title: Mrs Weatherby's Concert Party
description: An evening of good, old-fashioned Scottish entertainment, featuring some of Edinburgh's best-known performers. Join Wendy Weatherby (cello, vocals), John Sampson (trumpet, crumhorn, recorders), Sandy Brechin (accordion), Andy Cannon (storyteller), Allan and Rosemary McMillan (vocals, guitar), Pete Baynes (ukulele, vocals) and Lawrence Dunn (fiddle) for a cheerful, poignant or nostalgic jaunt through our favourite songs, tunes and stories. From Scotland's rich, dramatic folk traditions to the light-hearted fun of its variety theatres, come along, sing along – there's something for everyone at our party!

title: Muck – The Dark Jokes Show
description: Sex, death, religion, filth – nothing is off limits in our rotating selection of muck merchants telling their dark, dirty and degenerate stand-up. Five-star comedians picked from across the festival. Not punching up or down, more like a cheeky comedy poke at everything! This strictly 18+ hour of good, clean, dirty fun is not for the easily offended!

title: Mummy’s Dead, Long Live Mummy!
presented_by: Koël Purie Rinchet Mic and Couch Entertainment Ltd
description: Raw, chaotic, heartbreaking; much like motherhood. God couldn't be everywhere, so he created mothers. Of course, he could be everywhere, he's God, he chose not to be, he knew mothers have the hardest job. This dark comedy from Paris dramatizes the relentless nature of motherhood by following the often ridiculous but sometimes moving journey of four diverse mothers. The play opens as each one is dealing with a 'die or kill' moment of mothering. The acting is compelling, the writing is painfully funny and, at times, painfully painful. It'll change your perspective.
content_warnings: Contains distressing or potentially triggering themes, Strong language/swearing

title: Murder at the Fringe 2
description: Back again! Carry on dying! Prof Stiff has been found dead. Who had the motive to kill? You listen to the evidence, you cross examine the suspects and then you decide this interactive murder mystery, but are you right? Have you worked it out? It will take all your private investigator and Miss Marple skills to sift through the evidence and announce your verdict to solve this murder case. A brilliant comedy expertly acted out by this stellar cast. A must-see for all those amateur sleuths in the audience.

title: Murder at The Speakeasy
description: The 2024 and 2025 Fringe sell-out returns with a brand-new interactive murder mystery event. 1958, the Edinburgh Festival Fringe is still in its infancy, and new Fringe venue The Speakeasy is celebrating its opening night. From a demanding manager and long-suffering technician to disgruntled actors and even a representative from the newly-created Fringe Society, everyone is in attendance. Meet and mingle with the staff and performers and when the killer strikes, follow the clues and interrogate the suspects to work out whodunnit. A lively and immersive evening of suspense and sleuthing with 1950s dress encouraged.
venue_name: The Speakeasy at The Royal Scots Club

title: Murder, She Didn't Write
presented_by: Wildpark Entertainment presents Degrees of Error's
description: Don your deerstalker and grab your magnifying glass as this talented company use audience suggestions to create a hilarious improvised murder mystery. All you have to do... is solve it! Ms Gold poisoned at a synchronised swimming gala? Dr Blue exploded by cannon during a hot air balloon race? Professor Violet crushed to death at a Love Island recoupling? You decide! But will you guess whodunnit before the killer is revealed? 'A rip-roaring, side-splitting whodunnit' ***** (WhatsGoodToDo.co.uk) 'Outstanding performances delivered by a seriously talented cast!' ***** (ThreeWeeks).

title: MUSE: The Shakespeare Mayhem Musical
description: Before he was the Bard, he was just Will… with a problem: his publisher will only print one of his plays. With Puck as instigator, Lear, Cleopatra, the Macbeths and more of Shakespeare’s greatest characters erupt into rebellion in a chaotic race to become the chosen tale. Pop musical comedy meets absurdist theatre in this riotous story of ambition, ego and the birth of a legend.

title: Music & Murder By...
presented_by: Jessica Welsh and Wikus van der Hoven
description: Music & Murder By... is a new musical to die for! A last-ditch writers retreat to finish writing a new musical turns deadly when two of the writers decide the only way to save their show is to kill their insufferable collaborator – only to find the plot spiral out of control when his faded Broadway diva mother crashes the retreat with a sinister scheme of her own.

title: Musical Soulmates: Songs of Billie Holiday and Lester Young
description: Christine Adams' soul-stirring vocals and Dick Lee's ebullient sax and clarinet celebrate two friends whose musical and spiritual compatibility verged on telepathy. Features guitarist Phil Adams and bassist Jerry Forde.

title: My Date with Pierce Brosnan
description: It's anarchic, it's saucy and it's totally unpredictable. It's a clown romance controlled by you! Mademoiselle Cafetière is a lonely clown who meets the man of her dreams: Hollywood actor Pierce Brosnan. There's just one catch. Pierce Brosnan is a talking dummy piloted by you, the audience. Scan a QR code with your phone and type what you want Pierce Brosnan to say. If you type it, he will say it – he has no filter! Play matchmaker or wreak havoc in the most bizarre love story ever to grace the stage!

title: My History of Country
description: Follow Nicole Flynn as she uses some country music classics to weave her musical magic to bring her life story to the stage. Intriguing and mesmerising, she engages audiences with her fantastic voice. Back after an abundance of positive audience reviews and with a voice to die for. Touching heartstrings and bringing country music to life. She captures us with her talent, sharing her story with all.
venue_name: Studio at Braw Venues @ Grand Lodge

title: My Name is Spring Day and Other Stupid Facts
description: Watch Live at the Apollo comedian Spring Day prove that not only is truth stranger than fiction, it’s a hell of a lot funnier too. 'A joke heavy storytelling show' **** (OnTheMic.co.uk). 'A sharp set with great punchlines' **** (One4Review.co.uk). 'Wow, does Spring Day have an amazing story to tell' **** (BeyondTheJoke.co.uk). 'Wicked punchlines' **** (BroadwayBaby.com). 'A definite must-see' **** (ThreeWeeks).
content_warnings: Contains distressing or potentially triggering themes, Strong language/swearing

title: My Oh My, Mr Dream
description: My Oh My, Mr Dream. He is older than stars, lonelier than gods and he has stories to tell – stories before the cold. From a cage deep in the dark, Mr Dream emerges. Ancient. Alone. Holding three tokens, three dreams. A sailor rowing towards the edge of the world. A king commanding an army of mice. A voiceless boy who speaks only to birds. You choose the order. He does the rest. Part dream, part ritual: he will watch you back. Be gentle with the tokens. Some of them bite.
content_warnings: Audience participation, Contains distressing or potentially triggering themes, Scenes of violence, Strong language/swearing

title: Mythos: Ragnarök
description: The 'maddest, baddest show of the Fringe' (Daily Mail) is back and bigger than ever! Join Loki, Thor and the Norse Gods in this five-star groundbreaking blend of mythological storytelling and high-octane wrestling. Back for its fifth consecutive year at the Fringe, this 'knockout spectacle' (Telegraph) is a one-of-a-kind theatre experience unlike any other show in the world. A true cult classic of the festival, it sells out fast so move quickly! ***** (BroadwayBaby.com). ***** (LondonTheatre.co.uk). ***** (BingeFringe.com). **** (Telegraph). **** (Daily Mail).
content_warnings: Scenes of violence, Strobe lighting, Strong language/swearing

title: Natalie and I
description: Remember the rush of emotions as a teen, trying to transition into being an adult and finding your place in the world? Simon does. The joy of finding your favourite pop star as a teen and growing up with them means you always have their music to guide you. This charming funny show takes you through the highs and lows of Simon’s life as he comes to term with being himself, learning about his visual disability and how to rebuild his life.
content_warnings: Discussion of and reference to visual disability

title: Nate Kitch Replica
description: I return (again), industry plant, hat in hand, more jackets, sold out, similar. A version of a comedy show of a life manufactured, all to scale (1:1) but what if I broke it? Pockets are getting full, weighed down: stars, nominations, a urinal or a lid. Don't narrow your gaze, I'm stuck and cannot go back to your frownland. 'Post-modern yet old school... glorious' (List). 'A comic masterclass... like jazz' ***** (Scotsman). 'Clearly a case of emperor's new clothes' (Audience Review). ****** (Chortles.co.uk).

title: Nathan Cassidy: Ewwww!
description: Multi award-winning Fringe legend with an extraordinary new stand-up show. Contains full-frontal nudity! Ewwww! After a throwaway comment from a 20-year-old, Nathan begins to unravel. Is he old? In this daring, electrifying hour, he responds the only way he knows how: by taking the biggest risk of his career. Expect powerful storytelling, brutal honesty and a moment you will never forget. Star of six specials (three on Amazon Prime), BBC Radio 5 Live and million-downloaded podcast Daily Notes. ‘An excellent comedian’ ****½ (One4Review.co.uk). 'Vulnerability, self-exposure (literally), and razor-sharp storytelling combine' (Leicester Mercury).

title: Nathan Cassidy: From the Ashes
description: Multi award-winning Fringe legend with a hilarious tale of love, loss and an Ashes cricket miracle. One of comedy’s most original voices. 'Few have been as deeply moving as Nathan Cassidy' (Scotsman). A deeply funny, heart-opening journey through sport, collapse and the strange magic of Christmas – and a bigger question: can stand-up be art? Like the stories his grandad told, this one may only be half true. 13 Best Show wins/nominations since 2019. Star of six specials (three on Amazon Prime), BBC Radio 5 Live and million-downloaded podcast Daily Notes. **** (Times).

title: Nathaniel Jones: 2 BY 2
description: Noah's in charge, and you're all animals!! Embarking on his first cruise ship contract, newly single Noah flees his old life in search of stardom on the ark. Finding himself caught up in cosmic plans much larger and apocalyptic than he could have anticipated, he must find ways to keep the existential dread (and animal couples) at bay. Nathaniel Jones writes and performs in a Noah's Ark character comedy about a cappella, the apocalypse and stepping up at work. Directed by award-winning director Sam Smith.
content_warnings: Audience participation, Contains distressing or potentially triggering themes, Strobe lighting, Strong language/swearing

title: Naughty Boy
description: He's making a list. He's checking it twice. He's gonna find out that he's been naughty, not nice. Can Santa rediscover the meaning of Christmas before it's too late? Find out in the holiday clown show, Naughty Boy.
venue_name: Just The Tonic at The Caves

title: Naughty Cabaret
description: After a run at Adelaide Fringe and Melbourne International Comedy Festival, Naughty Cabaret is coming back to Edinburgh in 2026. A queer feminist extravaganza full of energy, absurdity and ridiculousness. 'Late night absurdity doesn't come much more fun than this' **** (ToDoList.org.uk). With an ever-changing line up of clown, character comedy, boyband, burlesque and more. Previous guest performers include Lorna Rose-Treen, Lara Ricote, Elf Lyons, Siblings, Ria Lina, Lucy Hopkins and Paulina Lenoir. Hosted by Anna Marie Simonsen and Marie Kallevik Straume, also seen in the 'irresistibly silly' **** (Guardian) clown comedy Troll.
content_warnings: Audience participation, Nudity, Strobe lighting, Strong language/swearing

title: Nearlyweds – The Musical
presented_by: Jaz Alice Music in collaboration with ERA Theatrical Productions
description: Nearlyweds is a brand-new musical comedy that will have you laughing, crying and singing along! We follow Lily, a people-pleasing Scottish bride as she runs away from her wedding, and Jake, a confused fiancé-to-be whose life isn’t as glamorous as he thinks. Along the way they meet an array of relatably quirky and vibrant characters, who have hilarious scenarios to overcome. Will Lily learn to stand up for herself and will Jake finally stop spouting awful puns? This relatable musical comedy by Jasmine Alice has extremely lovable characters and way too many dad jokes!

title: Neil Young On Piano
description: Award-winning jazz pianist/composer/producer Mike Kearney debuts a brand new show at this year's Edinburgh Fringe – timeless classics and folk anthems from Neil Young’s back catalogue, reimagined for piano trio with top session jazz musicians on drums and double bass. Come a little bit closer, here what I have to say – An intimate acoustic hour of beloved Young favourites and a handful of deeper cuts; a high-calibre, close-up performance from a Fringe stalwart with over a decade of sell-out shows, offering audiences a fresh take on some of the most enduring songs ever penned.

title: Nerdy and Dirty: Part Classroom, Part Classless
description: Did you know what undiagnosed STD can cause mental disorders? Or which wild animals can be gay? Or anything about duck penises? Zoltan Illes, a former international biology teacher turned comedian, will answer all these questions and more in the critically acclaimed Nerdy and Dirty. Set up like a class you actually want to attend, Zoltan (real name) will conduct lessons that seamlessly intertwines his nomadic, globe-trotting life as a clueless American with educational facts you definitely weren't taught in school, presented by a teacher who says things he probably shouldn't.

title: New York City Dreams
description: New York comedian Meka Mo returns to Edinburgh with New York City Dreams, following her award-nominated 2024 Fringe run. Using New York not as a backdrop but as a lens, she explores her view of the world right now – and how multiculturalism shapes that perspective. In an age of political chaos and cultural contradiction, Meka delivers fearless, fast-paced stand-up packed with sharp observational humour and relentless punchlines. Bold without being preachy and clever without being smug, this is an unapologetic hour that calls out the absurdities while keeping the laughs coming hard and fast.
venue_name: Just The Tonic at The Caves

title: New York, Finding Sunny Days
description: A solo dance-theatre work following an immigrant dancer chasing her New York dream. Through movement, spoken word and simple props, the piece traces the city’s dazzling promise, restless speed and the collision of visa uncertainty, fleeting romance, friendship, and loneliness. As hope of staying meets bureaucratic scrutiny, the performer confronts her identity beyond ambition and approval. Intimate and immersive, the work blends humour and melancholy, offering a tender portrait of longing, resilience and the courage to seek light in a shifting city.
content_warnings: Audience participation, Audience required to walk or move around during the performance

title: New Zealand Comedian, New Zealand Comedian, New Zealand Comedian
description: Up-and-coming NZ comedian and serial OCD sufferer Danny Sewell presents his funniest hour of comedy to date. Winner of Best Up-and-Coming Comedian at the 2022 NZ Comedy Guild Award. Nominated for Best Newcomer and Most Unhinged Show at the 2024 NZ International Comedy Festival. 'Danny's comedy could be described as pure talent.' (TheatreView.org.nz).

title: Newsies JR
description: Inspired by the rousing true story of New York City’s newsboys, Newsies JR. features a Tony Award-winning score by Alan Menken and Jack Feldman, with a book by Harvey Fierstein. When publishers raise prices at the boys’ expense, charismatic Jack Kelly rallies the newsies to strike. United in courage and friendship, they discover their strength together. Featuring classics like Carrying the Banner, Seize the Day, and Santa Fe, this high-energy musical is packed with heart, hope and unstoppable spirit. ‘The company you can trust to do things well’ (ThreeWeeks).

title: NewsRevue
description: In a world losing its marbles – felon presidents wreaking havoc, royals stripped of titles and AI on the rise – we need NewsRevue more than ever. While it’s still allowed. 'Spectacularly funny and fast-paced commentary on current affairs' ***** (Skinny).

title: Next to Normal
description: Following a string of five-star, sell-out shows, Bare Productions return with Next to Normal, the Tony and Pulitzer Prize-winning musical that took Broadway by storm. Featuring an unforgettable rock-infused score and moments of heart-stopping honesty, this powerful show explores love, loss and the pressures of modern family life. At its centre is a family struggling to hold things together while facing grief, mental illness and the question of what normal really means. Electrifying and deeply moving, Next to Normal is a bold, emotionally charged night of theatre that stays with you long after the final note.
content_warnings: Contains distressing or potentially triggering themes, Strobe lighting, Strong language/swearing

title: Nick's Daughter
presented_by: Nick and Livi Graham / PBH's Free Fringe
description: Back for a fifth year, hit songwriter/multi-instrumentalist Nick Graham and stellar vocalist/pianist Livi Graham present their captivating father-daughter music show at legendary Fingers. The new 2026 set features Liv's beguiling original songs, cool tunes from Nick's diverse back catalogue (inc. US No.1 ‘The Flame’) and unique covers celebrating songwriters who inspire them (e.g. Joni Mitchell, CSNY, Bacharach, Stevie Wonder). Uplifting and always irresistibly catchy – expect a genuinely engaging experience. 2025 audience reviews: 'Livi's voice is truly incredible... brilliant show in great venue', 'Beautiful songs and fantastic musicianship' 'Absolutely awesome, blown away by this father and daughter duo'.
venue_name: PBH's Free Fringe @ Fingers Piano Bar

title: Night Mail (WIP)
presented_by: Tom Whiston, presented by Pierrot Productions
description: In the sorting room of a late-night post office, a naughty 1940s postman passes an hour with pranks, letters and telegrams from the future, while waiting for news of the war in this fast-talking, absurdist character comedy. Brand new show from acclaimed clown, Tom Whiston. Directed by Tanika Lay-Meachen. 'A night of great fun' (Chortle.co.uk). ***** (ThePhoenixRemix.com). **** (Fringesider.com). ****(GetYourCoatsOn.com).
content_warnings: Audience participation, Contains distressing or potentially triggering themes

title: Night of the Fox
description: Attie can’t stop dreaming of a fox-masked truth-teller who lives deep in the woods, a mysterious figure said to reveal who you really are. When Attie dares to summon him, he vanishes. As his friends struggle with a sudden social media ban, they follow him into the forest, hoping to bring him home. But the deeper they go, the more they’re forced to face painful truths. In a place where every truth must be spoken aloud, saving Attie may come at a cost. Will they risk revealing their true selves or lose their friend forever?

title: Nightpiece Film Festival
description: Nightpiece presents unique, curated content from amazing filmmakers across the world. Over 400 projects have now screened since the event's 2014 debut. Champions of the filmmaking talent the mainstream ignores, the event is a portal to the reality of independent filmmaking. In 2026, Nightpiece Film Festival enters its 13th season. We schedule thematically with five nights of programming sourced from submissions entered from FilmFreeway and usually, we're also premiering a feature film or two on launch. Hosted by indie director Al Carretta – come support the Fringe's premier independent short film festival.

title: Nish Kumar: Angry Humour From a Really Nice Guy (Work in Progress)
presented_by: Plosive Live in association with PBJ Management
description: Work-in-progress show from ‘the pre-eminent comic political polemicist of our time’ **** (Guardian). The world's in chaos. Inequality is widening, autocracy is rising, political parties are collapsing. In these divided times, what this country desperately needs is Angry Humour from a Really Nice Guy. Nish Kumar – co-host of hit podcast Pod Save the UK, former host of axed BBC show The Mash Report, and one of Taskmaster’s greatest losers – is back with a formidable batch of passionate, progressive stand-up for the ages. ‘Roaringly funny’ **** (Times).
content_warnings: Strong language/swearing, Buy a ticket in advance to guarantee entry or Pay What You Want at the venue

title: (No) Refunds
description: (No) Refunds is an interactive game show play hosted by Tiffany Gold, an old-school American host and model presenter all-in-one who quite literally depends on your entertainment. One premium ticket holder, dubbed the Star Player for the evening, will compete in three games designed to amuse the audience and showcase their talents. Only those best-suited to handle the demands of stardom will walk away with a full refund. Do you have what it takes?
content_warnings: Audience participation, The Star Player is onstage for the duration of the show, and experiences a much higher level of interactivity. That ticket is for 18+ only.

title: No Strings Attached Community Wind Band
presented_by: No Strings Attached Community Wind Band
description: After last year's standing ovation, Edinburgh's No Strings Attached Wind Band returns with a funfest of musical delights. Blowing hot air, or not, this local wind band of worthy citizens excels in unique interpretations of modern day classic, and not so classic, tunes. Always a musical adventure for the players and the audience alike, the annual Fringe concert is filled with joyful chaos and heartfelt flair. Come and be part of it.

title: No' The Corries
description: The Corries were at the forefront of the folk music revival in Scotland and quickly became household names packing halls throughout the country. Since Roy’s untimely passing in 1990 their music continues to inspire listeners through others. Kev and Ross grew up listening to the Corries in the 70s and 80s and have been singing their songs as a duo, and solo, ever since. Re-live some of their best songs sung by well-experienced folkies. Join in with choruses and laugh at the humour as you are taken back in time to these wonderful songs.
venue_name: The Speakeasy at The Royal Scots Club

title: Nocturnal Is The New Sexy
description: A darkly comic, movement-led play about love working against the clock. When NHS call-handler Alice is swapped onto night shifts, her relationship with nine-to-five Ben begins to unravel. Using an inventive ensemble and striking physicality, the show explores exhaustion, intimacy and working whilst the world sleeps. Fast, funny and painfully human, this absurdist love story asks whether being loved means being seen and what happens when you disappear in plain sight. Perfect for afternoon audiences, Fringe romantics and anyone who has ever felt invisible at work or in love. Overnight.
content_warnings: Scenes of a sexual nature, Strong language/swearing

title: North Sea Gas
description: Celebrating 45 years on the road. The show will consist of Dave, Grant and Ronnie delivering a good mixture of Scottish folk songs old and new. With 23 albums recorded, there is no shortage of material to be accompanied with a wide selection of instruments and a keen sense of humour. It makes for a great night!!

title: Not Another Quiz Night
description: The critically acclaimed, sell out, unmissable late-night hit is back, bigger than ever! Join Jake Bhardwaj and "celebrity" guests for the most chaotic, high-energy quiz show in town. Expect music, comedy, interactive bonus rounds and surprise appearances. 'I can confidently say this is the best show I've seen' ***** (GetYourCoatsOn.com). 'You leave feeling like you have just been at the greatest... late-night party' ***** (BroadwayBaby.com). 'Breathless, non-stop fun' ***** (Ralph Magazine). 'One of the most entertaining and mad things I've seen' (Joe Lycett). 'One of those rare shows that makes controlled chaos look effortless' (Jordan Gray).
content_warnings: Audience participation, Audience required to walk or move around during the performance, Strobe lighting, Strong language/swearing

title: Not Another Whisky Tasting!
presented_by: The Scotch Malt Whisky Society, 28 Queen Street.
description: Think you’ve seen it all? Think again. In just 30 minutes, you’ll sip three bold drams, each bursting with character and chosen to challenge your expectations. No long lectures, no tourist cliches – just pure Society flavour! Why the Society? Because we do things differently. Every bottle is a single cask, cask strength and never repeated – meaning what you taste is truly one-of-a-kind. Perfect for a quick whisky adventure between shows, this tasting is your chance to discover the good stuff.
venue_name: The Scotch Malt Whisky Society - Queen Street

title: Not Black Enough
description: This show mines the depth of human identity while deftly exploring all sides. Who am I kidding? This show is just me proving how Black I am. Because I am so Black. Nate takes us on a journey through his life using storytelling from his childhood and beyond to fix racism in America. In one show he fixes all of American racism. I promise you.

title: not for glory
presented_by: Jack Anderson, Charlotte Mclean, Malin Lewis
description: not for glory is a restless, relentless, rebellious unravelling of traditional dance and music. It is not a radical Highland Dance show, not a reinvented Irish dance display and not an experimental piping competition. It's bodies, bagpipes and brutality. It's kilts, queerness and ceremonial violence. It's back beats, high cuts, striking in, a battering, flinging skirl. not for glory resuscitates tradition with respect and resilience, dissects heritage and dances solidarity. It's a dance-theatre gig balancing virtuosity with vulnerability, pride with shame. Three performers reclaim the traditions they grew up in, not for glory – but for what?

title: Not My Audience! The Stand-Up Panel Show You Control!
description: The Fringe's long-running, cult-hit comedy panel show that you influence in real time is back. Three top comics answer your daft questions, perform the stand-up you want to see and do fiendish comedy challenges set by you. Never the same show twice, a must for comedy fans who want to see some of the sharpest comedy minds at the festival be put through their paces. A great chance to find your new favourite comedian and create real Fringe memories.

title: Notes from a Narcissistic Negro and Other N Words
presented_by: Elizabeth June and Theatre Beyond Broadway
description: Award-winning solo show by Elizabeth June (Blackish, Hightown), Notes from a Narcissistic Negro and Other N Words is a dramedy detailing her childhood and clergy sexual abuse and cancer survival. All songs, stories, spoken word and stand-up sets are a testimony of her triumph over trauma. Explicit language and situations.
content_warnings: Contains distressing or potentially triggering themes, Strong language/swearing

title: Noteworthy: The Made-Up Musical
description: Join the fun as the talented Noteworthy crew devise a brand-new one-hour musical right in front of your eyes, inspired by audience suggestions. Nothing is pre-planned, so the performers are just as surprised as you are by what happens next! The joyous worlds of comedy, improvisation and musical theatre collide as this charismatic bunch serve up crazy characters, silly storylines and inexplicably catchy tunes. No script... No score... No problem! Audience reviews: 'An absolute must-see at the Fringe... I didn't want it to end.' 'Hilarious characters and catchy musical numbers.' 'Truly masters at what they do.'

title: Now That's What I Call Irish Stand-Up Comedy! Vol 1
presented_by: Patrick Conlan, Jack Shortall, Cormac Sinnott / Free Festival
description: Dublin's youngest and hottest (career-wise) stand-up comedians (Patrick Conlan, Jack Shortall, Cormac Sinnott) host a riveting comedy show featuring a range of Ireland's best established and up-and-coming comedians for your entertainment and pleasure. The night's sky couldn't host this many stars!!

title: Nu Metal Karaoke
description: Alison Spittle hosts a night to not remember. Comedians let it all out to Linkin Park, Korn, Limp Bizkit, Crazy Town etc. Is emo nu metal? Is Smash Mouth nu metal? What about Metrostation? That's on the edge. No queen! We'll probably end on Black Parade. Do not put your drink near my laptop, or I will throw hands, I will not have a repeat of last year. Long live Monkey Barrell!
content_warnings: Strong language/swearing, Scenes of a sexual nature, Audience will be standing and required to move around, Contains distressing or potentially triggering themes, Buy a ticket in advance to guarantee entry or Pay What You Want at the venue

title: Nude
description: 'No, but how funny would it be though? Like, he turns up, and it’s just me – with my tits out. His model student.' Clara has a plan. It involves a life drawing class, her favourite lecturer and stripping naked in front of a room full of strangers. What could go wrong? A lot, it turns out. Funny and devastating, Nude is a solo play about desire, fantasy and the seductive idea that being seen is the same as being empowered.
content_warnings: Contains distressing or potentially triggering themes, Scenes of a sexual nature, Strong language/swearing

title: Nude Parade (WIP)
description: Roll up your sleeves, and go under the knife as we enter into an anaesthetic world turned upside down. Like a live theatre version of the game of Operation – but make it trans. A work-in-progress by Edinburgh Comedy Award nominee, S.E. Grummett, combining live-feed video, interactive surgery and trash puppets. From the creators of SLUGS 'Brilliantly smart and beautifully stupid' **** (Guardian), Creepy Boys ***** (ToDoList.org.uk) and Something in the Water (Winner of Best Theatre award at Adelaide Fringe), comes a glittery and gory dissection of bodies, queerness and identity.
content_warnings: Flashing lights, Audience participation, Contains distressing or potentially triggering themes, Nudity, Scenes of violence, Strong language/swearing, References to and depictions of surgery and gore

title: Nuns!
description: Nuns!: A medieval comedy created by Dog Complex Theatre in collaboration with globally acclaimed Police Cops. The Place: Bavaria. The Year: Medieval. The Teeth: Rotten. Sister Gertrude wants to be the holiest nun: forgoing sin, fearing desire, yet secretly wondering what lies beneath Monk Bertram’s robes… So when whispers of witches start to plague the convent, Gertrude teams up with mysterious witch-hunter Yarrow and sets forth to rid the world of devilry and naughty lustful thoughts. Expect action-packed physical comedy and an all-female soundtrack (except that one Evanescence song where the guy says 'wake me up').
content_warnings: Audience participation, Nudity, Scenes of a sexual nature, Strobe lighting, Strong language/swearing

title: Nuns of Fury!
description: The nuns are back in town! The sell-out Nuns of Fury are back in full habitual glory. Everyone's favourite heist-embarking sacred sisters wrestle with personal dilemmas... What secret force is threatening Sister Agnes, stone-cold leader of the Nuns of Fury? Who is orphaned tech-whiz Sister Gabriel's birth mother? Why is Sister Julian still juggling her inopportune pregnancy and sick martial arts? Time, and catchy songs, will tell. Operating to award riches to the poor, these women of the cloth find themselves threatened by devious, yet lovable, gangsters... These sisters are going to have to ACT!

title: O Brave New World, That Has Such People In’t!
description: The sky, it seems, would pour down stinking pitch... and for Maya the rain wouldn’t stop coming. Her parents are away, tending to her sibling in hospital, leaving Maya in a house that doesn’t feel like home. Her saving grace is a garage of junk left by the previous owners. With the help of her cat, she fetches stories from across town, bringing them to life. But when the town floods, she is forced to step into the real world and find her place amongst the community. Fringe First winners return.

title: Of Mice And Men
description: It breaks your heart, an epic tragedy in miniature: two men, a couple of sacks and a crate, but their plight and their dreams rise before us in pathetic grandeur. Drilling into the heart of the famous John Steinbeck novella, Nigel Miles-Thomas' simple staging fully evokes its bleak compassion and harsh unsparing humanity. The story of the itinerant farmworkers, clever thwarted George and big, dumb Lennie, is conjured up, a fleck of individual love and pain in the Dustbowl America in the '30s.

title: Of The Land
description: Of The Land is a contemporary jewellery exhibition presented by ætla during the Edinburgh Festival Fringe. Bringing together jewellers whose work is shaped by place, the exhibition explores how landscape informs making through texture, colour and material. Rather than depicting scenery directly, the work reflects quieter influences: surface, palette, weight and material choices shaped by lived and remembered environments. Visitors are invited to experience jewellery as a response to land, movement and memory, and to consider how place continues to inform contemporary craft practice.

title: Off With Your Head!
presented_by: Bowtie Productions / RGB Monster / Free Festival
description: Who lives? Who dies? You decide! Enter a 12th-century throne room, where you decide the fates of two guest performers trying to rule your kingdom. Play peasants, warlords, dragons or just sit back and cheer for their demise! An interactive comedy game show that merges video games and TTRPG into 100% ridiculous improvised chaos! Hosted by your Royal Advisor, Sam See (****, Fest), and your Jester Boy, Stephen Case (Tanuki Games).

title: Oil & Whiskey
presented_by: AK INK LLC / PBH's Free Fringe
description: Come see Oil and Whiskey, the award-winning, off-Broadway, country rock musical from New York City. Two ex lovers meet for a drink and relive their entire relationship over a couple rounds of whiskey. You'll laugh, cry and remember why: you don't text your ex. The best part is the show is free as a part of PBH's Free Fringe! Oil & Whiskey is composed by Nashville's own, Kit Nolan. Kit has worked with Robbie Williams, One Directon, and now... Oil & Whiskey! Everyone loves a juicy break-up story. See ya there, cowgirls.

title: Olaf Falafel Presents: I Used to Work in a Helium Balloon Factory Until they Let Me Go
description: Shortlisted for the ISH Edinburgh Comedy Best Show Award in 2025. The best-joke-list-bothering, holey-cheese-flinging Falafel is back with another thickly-sliced slab of stupid. Including but not limited to: mind reading mic stands, sausage-based nonsense and art-related buffoonery. It won’t be sensible. 'On course to become an Edinburgh Fringe legend' ***** (GetYourCoatsOn.com). 'This is a must-see show' ***** (ThePhoenixRemix.com). 'One of the most creative shows I've seen at the Fringe' **** (EdFringeReview.com).

title: Olaf Falafel’s Stupidest Super Stupid Show: This Time It’s Stupider!
description: The comedy show that comedians take their kids to is back and even funnier! Join Olaf Falafel (if that is his real name) for an hour of kid's comedy, which will be the stupidest show he has ever let ooze out of his brain. Expect jokes, futuristic dung beetles, truth-telling cheese and we might also all draw a Spewnicorn! And, after selling out completely for the last two years, the genuinely stupid people will be the ones who don’t get tickets straight away!

title: Olga Koch: Fat Tom Cruise
description: Olga Koch has one good story. Only it's not really her story. Do you wanna hear it? In Fat Tom Cruise, see the Melbourne and Edinburgh Comedy Award-nominated star comb through recent history in an immersive and genre-defying new show. Directed by Jet Vevers. ***** (Telegraph). **** (Guardian). **** (Observer).
content_warnings: This show contains distressing or potentially triggering themes and strong language.

title: Olivia Raine Atwood: Oops
description: She's a professional matchmaker who accidentally set up her college boyfriend with her high school bully. Sorta like if Ron set up Hermione with Malfoy. Or Romeo set up Juliet, with someone who bullied Romeo. You know. Like that. You get it. Comedy.co.uk recommended show. Top Ten Solo Shows of Hollywood Fringe (StageTakes.com). 'Side-splitting comedy' (TheEdinburghReporter.co.uk). 'Hypersonic physicality' **** (MumbleComedy.net ). Top 9 Shows to See: Edinburgh Reporter. Featured: BBC, NPR and Off-Broadway. From the creator of Faking It, a five-star, award-winning, FringeReview.co.uk Highly Recommended Show and Off-West-End hit.

title: Olympic Hopefuls
description: Olympic Hopefuls is a sharp, funny and unexpectedly moving new play about four Filipina women of a certain age who decide, against all logic and gravity, to qualify for the Winter Olympics in curling. Armed with grit, group chat loyalty and a suspicious amount of delusion, they train on borrowed ice while wrestling with identity, ambition and the quiet ache of being underestimated. As Olympic fever rises, so do long-buried rivalries and impossible dreams. Part underdog sports saga, part diaspora comedy, Olympic Hopefuls asks: who gets to chase glory, and who’s told to sit in the stands?

title: Omar Badawy: Guided Detour
description: Last year, Omar Badawy accidentally found himself in the middle of a far-right march. And somehow that still wasn't the hardest part of his day. Join the award-winning Saturday Night Live UK writer for his highly anticipated debut show, a collection of stupid little tales about the comfort and cost of avoidance, The Daily Mail and nose jobs. Support for Emmanuel Sonubi and Aziz Ansari. As seen on Channel 4. BBC New Comedy Award finalist. Chortle Awards Best Newcomer nominee. So You Think You're Funny? winner. 'A veritable gag-machine' (Chortle.co.uk).

title: On Some Far Shore
description: Midnight. Euan sits alone, his mother’s eulogy lies unwritten. As he and Isla start to piece together his mother’s life, Euan learns more about his own. This musical is an honest exploration of what makes a life worth living and the stories we end up telling, accompanied by a score inspired by Hadestown and The Last Five Years. Can the tides of time resolve unanswered questions of the past, present and future, and will Euan come to see how the tales from the shoreline have shaped his own life? Previous work: ‘Impactful and emotional’ (TheOxfordBlue.co.uk).
content_warnings: Contains distressing or potentially triggering themes

title: On the Watchlist
description: On the Watchlist with Jay Servedio is a brand-new live late-night comedy series that blends biting satire with investigative curiosity. Rooted in its own chaotic, absurdist voice, On the Watchlist dives headfirst into the week's headlines, media manipulation and political theatre. Each show features Jay's incisive monologue, live sketches, field segments and character interviews with comedians portraying public figures: plus conversations with real journalists, writers and cultural critics. Smart, silly and unapologetically weird, On the Watchlist is equal parts comedy show, social autopsy and media exorcism. Join us for our exploration into the Age of Misinformation.
content_warnings: Contains distressing or potentially triggering themes, Strong language/swearing
venue_name: Just The Tonic at The Mash House

title: Once Upon a Tune
description: Once Upon a Tune – Join a fairytale princess with her sing-a-long show of your favourite animated characters! With enchanting vocals and gorgeous gowns, this new show emulates the magic of the animated movies. Jasmine Alice is a professional singer/actress who has toured internationally with her engaging shows. Sing along to the most acclaimed Disney songs and you’ll discover a world of magic unfold in front of your eyes and ears. This creative, dynamic children’s show is certainly the best way for the whole family to start the day!

title: One Dog, One Nutter
description: How do you rediscover pleasure after 23 years of military service, medical discharge and complex PTSD? Obviously, you make things worse by becoming a stand-up comedian. Jay turns trauma into titters, pain into performance, self-loathing into laughter. With honesty and sharp humour, he explores mental health, recovery and the absurdity of healing while holding a microphone. Joined by his partner (not his pet), Hawke, Jay delivers a funny, moving, hopeful journey proving life is worth living, whatever pain or disability you carry. Laughter is the medicine, come get your dose and support a wounded veteran's recovery.
content_warnings: Contains distressing or potentially triggering themes

title: One House on Brick Lane
description: From the Fringe First winning Mulberry Theatre Company, One House on Brick Lane is an original play rooted in East London. Set in a single house, centuries collide with the voices of past and present. In 1985, a Bangladeshi family faces eviction amid protests. Through stories told by Huguenot weavers of anti-fascist resistance, migration and community struggle, the house reveals its memories. Drawing on oral histories and lived experience, this powerful production asks who gets to belong when home is under threat. Created by young East London voices, it celebrates resilience, humour and collective hope.
content_warnings: References to racial violence and discrimination.

title: One Joke
description: How many comedians can tell one joke each, in an hour? We're going to find out. One Joke is a one-of-a-kind experience as each comedian tells just one single perfect joke before leaving the stage. All in the name of charity. It's a rapid fire, rip-roaring, completely contextless joke factory with the best and biggest line-up on the Fringe. Join us for an hour of jokes, jokes, jokes and jokes. Hosted by Jonathan Oldfield (BBC New Comedy Awards) and headlined by Lorna Rose Treen (SNL writer) with the joke that 'killed comedy' (Sun).

title: One Man One Mullet: The Dan Stephens Show
description: A stand-up comedy show featuring Ireland's Next Top Comic Winner 2024 Dan Stephens. He talks about the ups-and-downs of a single 37-year-old Irish man with a mullet. He is a regular at all of the main stand-up comedy venues in Ireland including The Laughter Lounge, The International Comedy Club, and The Craic Den. He has also headlined shows across Texas and Florida.

title: One Man Poe: The Black Cat and The Raven
description: Immerse yourselves in two timeless Edgar Allan Poe classics. Arguably Poe's darkest tale, The Black Cat depicts an alcoholic's last confession on the eve of his death. Then, the poem that made Poe famous: The Raven. In the midnight hour, an elderly man laments the loss of his love, when an ominous visitor is heard tapping on his chamber door. One Man Poe returns after sell-out runs in 2024 and 2025, bringing Poe's words to life as never before. Voted Best Overall Show at Edinburgh Fringe 2025 by the Derek Awards.
content_warnings: Contains distressing or potentially triggering themes

title: One Man Poe: The Business Man and The Case of M. Valdemar
description: Discover two lesser-known stories from Edgar Allan Poe. First, in Poe's dark and comedic political satire on American capitalism, the dubious, "self-made" businessman Peter Proffit wants your vote as President of the United States. Then, a gruesome account of an experiment gone wrong, when a renowned mesmerist hypnotises his willing patient at the very moment of his death. Brand new for the 2026 Fringe, One Man Poe adds this more obscure, yet distinctly unsettling, double bill to its critically acclaimed repertoire of the finest examples of gothic literature.
content_warnings: Contains distressing or potentially triggering themes

title: One Man Poe: The Tell-Tale Heart and The Pit and the Pendulum
description: Using the original Edgar Allan Poe publications from 1840s, award-winning storyteller Stephen Smith faithfully brings to life the most terrifying tales, from the pioneering Godfather of Gothic Horror. In The Tell-Tale Heart, we meet a madman convincing us of his sanity, whilst explaining a murder he's committed, with meticulous detail. Then, in The Pit and the Pendulum, we join a prisoner attempting to escape the various torture devices of the dreaded Spanish Inquisition. 'Could not have been more wow-ed by this 'marathon of the macabre'' ***** (National).
content_warnings: Contains distressing or potentially triggering themes

title: One Million Words
description: Step into a world of words and human connection, inspired by the writings of Rainer Maria Rilke. Letters, love and longing connect a poet of the past with an actor of today. Struggling with writer's block, Rilke only expresses himself through letters for a year. A century later, the letters help Ivo Müller navigate his own challenges in a world where even his name feels foreign. 'Masterful meditation on art, life and the yearning for quiet in a chaotic world... electric.' (TheatreBeyondBroadway). From Brazil, this English-language production celebrates the writer's centenary. Part of the São Paulo Showcase.

title: One More Time
description: A paper boat becomes the path through which an elderly woman revisits the regrets she left unresolved. Wrapped in humour and heartbreak, she finally comes to terms with her past.

title: One: The Musical
description: You’ve heard of the smash pop musical Six... but have you heard of One? What happens when a woman destined to be a star (Carlie Craig) falls in love with her childhood crush from TV, only to discover they've been living a double life through their whole relationship? She writes pop songs about it! But then what happens when she sells out her concert about that relationship and then there's no more running from herself? She is forced to reconcile her reality with her newfound popstar identity.
content_warnings: Audience participation, Contains distressing or potentially triggering themes, Strong language/swearing

title: Only Bones – Daniel Nodder
description: Explore a microscopic universe from the Big Bang to the death of the stars in this multi award-winning, physical-theatre odyssey through deep space. A nonverbal, jelly-like performer plucks creatures from evolutionary history and pushes, bends and twists their body and the boundaries of physics, creating mind-bending comedy and entire worlds out of nothing. ***** (TheClothesline.com.au). ****½ (ArtsHub.com.au). This mesmerising work is the latest iteration of the Only Bones Project. Each version adheres to a simple set of rules: One performer, one light, no text, no set, no props, no narrative, all within 1m2.

title: Only Fans for Therapy
description: OnlyFans for Therapy is a darkly comic solo about trauma, accountability and the absurd economics of healing. Whilst triggered on holiday, a woman realises the only way to remain a functional member of society is therapy for life. Quick maths: 2,599 sessions at £70 each. And that’s without inflation. So who pays: the victim, the perpetrator or the state? A razor-edged exploration of abuse, revenge and survival in a world where recovery comes with a receipt. 'An exceptionally strong and intelligent performance, full of humour' (E-tcetera.be). Part of Big in Belgium.
content_warnings: Contains distressing or potentially triggering themes

title: Oops! We Lost a Nuke
description: Oops! We Lost a Nuke is a comedic play set in the 1950s, featuring four characters performed – sometimes simultaneously –  by two actors. When an unassuming pacifist abuses his position within the US government in order to hide a nuclear warhead, it becomes clear that his affair with his secretary and his wife's affair with her doctor are the least of their worries. As the government closes in, secrets come to light.
content_warnings: Scenes of a sexual nature, Strong language/swearing
venue_name: Just The Tonic at The Mash House

title: Open Studios at Beaverhall Arts Studios
description: An opportunity to see behind the doors of the studios of four local artists and makers. All four makers will be present and will have a wide selection of work to see and buy. Sheila McDonald designs and makes precious metal jewellery and objects, all with colourful enamel decoration. Rona McLean’s prints and paintings are inspired by her interest in the natural world. A love of textile crafts is evident in Lucy MacLeod’s upholstery, rugs and smaller fabric pieces. Ann Shearer uses metal folding and forming techniques to create silver jewellery and decorations.

title: Opera Gala Concert
presented_by: Fife Opera with special guest Beth Taylor, Mezzo Soprano
description: Opera Gala Concert conducted by Derek Clark. Celebrating 50 years of Fife Opera, we present a Gala Concert of solos, ensembles and choruses from operas we have performed, including works by Verdi, Puccini, Mozart, Bizet and Donizetti. We are delighted to have as our special guest internationally acclaimed Scottish mezzo-soprano, Beth Taylor.

title: Operation Blank
description: Someone has dropped an atom bomb on Copenhagen! With all-out war looming, one junior minister in the British Government must somehow stimulate a response from his hopeless superiors. There’s just one thing standing in his way: Microsoft Teams. Welcome to Operation Blank, the subversive dark comedy debut from up-and-coming Scottish writer, George Grant. Delve into this biting critique of modern online working, that weaves laugh-out-loud humour to themes of unfulfillment and existential dread. It’s the show where nothing happens, and nothing has ever been more entertaining. Leading Light Prize nominee, Scottish Theatre Awards on the Fringe 2025.
content_warnings: Contains distressing or potentially triggering themes, Strong language/swearing

title: Operation Market Garden
description: A powerful new piece of verbatim theatre, inspired by the wartime diary of Welsh paratrooper Neville Neads, captured during the 1944 operation of the same name. Offering a raw, personal perspective on war, identity and survival as a prisoner of war, the show centres the real testimony of the often-overlooked foot soldier. This is a story of resilience and remembrance, told from the ground up. Drawn directly from Neads’ own diary and letters to his fiancée, the production traces his experience and that of his comrades during almost a year in captivity.
content_warnings: Contains distressing or potentially triggering themes, Scenes of violence, References to discrimination (distressing symbolism and war imagery)

title: Operotica: Lovers in Every Lifetime
description: Operotica: The UK's premier kinky opera duo. Classically trained, fetish-approved and, as of yesterday, dead. Their bodies are cold, but their spirits are restless. Join psychic extraordinaire Séayoncé for a journey through Operotica's many past lives. From star-crossed nuns to 18th-century ladies-in-waiting, these theatrical reincarnations reveal the true purpose of history's horniest souls. Will their story of love after death be the greatest (and sexiest) ever told? Witness a haunting that will tear down the opera house and transport you through time.
content_warnings: Nudity, Scenes of a sexual nature, Strong language/swearing, More information

title: Orpheus: A New Musical
description: Step into a world where music has the power to move mountains, soften hearts and even challenge death itself. When Eurydice is lost to the underworld, Orpheus refuses to give up on his love. Armed with nothing but his music and unwavering determination, he embarks on a daring quest that brings him face to face with fate, monsters and even the gods themselves. Follow Orpheus on his incredible journey to the underworld, where love, courage and music collide in an unforgettable reimagining of this timeless myth performed by teenagers from Knaresborough, North Yorkshire.

title: Ostrich
description: A solo show about a single woman with a dead parent and no prospects? Not another one! Yet here she is. Tilly's ferocity and Scottish humour provide a guise hiding her fragility. She's lost her Mum and broken up with the love of her life. Distraction appears to be the perfect solution to her problems, running away to London from her small town in Fife. In an attempt to escape, new problems arise; the misogyny of modern dating and classism. Oh and turns out, moving city doesn't cure grief. Can she really bury her head in the sand forever?
content_warnings:
Contains distressing or potentially triggering themes, Scenes of a sexual nature, Strong language/swearing
Grief/ loss of a parent

title: Otway
description: John Otway is an English singer-songwriter who has built a sizeable cult audience through extensive touring, a surreal sense of humour and a self-deprecating underdog persona. He's had two hit records, celebrated his 5,000th show at London's Shepherd's Bush Empire in 2022 and has just taken his band around the world playing in Canada, New Zealand Australia and Japan.

title: Our Other Organ
description: With brutality and humour, Boaz Barkan digs into a living body to uncover a new organ – the place where our racism resides. Our Other Organ dissects antisemitism and its impact on Jewish identity, culminating in the creation of a new Zionist body and structures of violence and domination. The performance explores the anatomy of victims and oppressors as simultaneous conditions within the same body. Moving through bodies and time, it connects personal histories to collective trauma, tracing how oppression is embodied, reproduced and transformed into systems of power, fear and ultimately, genocide.
content_warnings: Contains distressing or potentially triggering themes

title: Out Damned Traitor!
description: All the worlds a stage and Claudia Winkleman is its mighty director. In Out Damned Traitor!, the greats of Shakespeare’s plays take to the Roundtable – but little do they know, under the cover of Birnam Wood, fair is foul and foul is fair. Will faithful blood make our traitors hands unclean? Well, revenge is a dish best served at the Fringe. Join us for a night of poisn'd chalices and blood stained hands. With daggers drawn and trust undone, will the faithful stand when the final banishment falls?

title: Out of the Blue
description: Following their fan-favourite run at the Fringe last year, Out of the Blue are back again for their 22nd year with tighter harmonies, crazier choreography and enough high notes to reach the stratosphere! OOTB is Oxford University's internationally acclaimed a cappella group and, after jet-setting across the world earlier this year, are excited to return to their home turf to showcase new talent and new songs. Don't miss your chance to see these singers in action for an hour of incredible music with something for everyone, from Olivia Rodrigo to Jon Bon Jovi!

title: Outlaugh: Edinburgh
description: Outlaugh is a cut-throat comedy and social strategy competition show using the rules of the reality show Survivor. Over the course of six shows, twelve comedians will face off in comedic challenges for immunity, while the losers have to vote each other out at tribal council. Every show will feature unique comedy challenges and live eliminations, with a chance for audience members to help their favourite contestants with hidden advantages. Twelve comedians. Six shows. One (similar to / legally distinct from) Survivor.

title: Paddy Seery: Hereditary
description: A riotous deep dive into the contradictions of Irish identity, told through the lens of family, booze, sex and a misguided stint in the army. From the generational curse of alcoholism to the uniquely Irish knack for being both sexually repressed and wildly promiscuous, no taboo is safe. Just when it can’t get more absurd, along comes the paradox of a peace-loving hippy in the Irish Army. With razor-sharp wit and heartfelt chaos, Hereditary explores the things we inherit, the battles we fight (literal and metaphorical), and the joy of embracing contradictions that shape who we are.
venue_name: Flight Club at Laughing Horse @ West Port Oracle

title: Paddy Young Presents: A Night with the Stars
description: Join SNL UK's Paddy Young and the biggest stars of the Fringe for the showbiz event of the year. It’s a wild late-night mash-up of stand-up, sketch and character comedy (the good kind). Featuring Ed Night, Sam Campbell, Bella Hull, Dan Tiernan, Horatio Gould, Mike Rice and loads more. If you’re looking for chaos with a touch of glam, grab your tux! ‘Young is surely on the road to stardom' ***** (Rolling Stone). **** (Scotsman). ‘One of British comedy’s most intriguing new voices' **** (Independent).
