content_warnings: Strong language/swearing, Buy a ticket in advance to guarantee entry or Pay What You Want at the venue

title: Paddy Young: Will Sir Be Laughing Alone?
presented_by: Berk's Nest in association with PARKAs at Independent Talent
description: You’re born alone, you die alone. That’s true enough. But what happened to that part in the middle? Big Year for Pad. SNL (UK, but still a big deal), a bunch of awards (hate bringing them up), and plenty of bit-parts to boot. But what’s it all about? I’ve fallen in love more times than you’ve had hot dinners and I’ve fumbled every single one of them. But I don’t even think about that shit anymore. Edinburgh Comedy Award Best Newcomer nominee in 2023. ***** (Rolling Stone). **** (Independent). **** (Chortle.co.uk).
content_warnings: Strong language/swearing, Buy a ticket in advance to guarantee entry or Pay What You Want at the venue

title: Padlocked!
description: Guy prepares himself for a bondage session with his Grindr hook-up, the alluring but elusive Fabio. Once the chains are on, there’s no escape – certainly not from Guy’s problems. As the minutes tick by, Guy must face a reckoning with all the responsibilities of his life. It’s Pillion without motorbikes; Gerald’s Game without Gerald; Locke with locks! Revealing, exposing comedy drama. Sex positive, life negative. Definitely adults only.
content_warnings: Nudity, Scenes of a sexual nature, Strong language/swearing

title: Painting the Roses Red
description: An absurd piece exploring themes around immigration, patriotism and what it means to belong. The project takes both inspiration from Lewis Carroll’s classic work of fiction Alice in Wonderland, and the reality of the past six months, where we have seen a rise in overt nationalism. In the words of Carroll; ‘the time has come,’ the walrus said, ‘to talk of many things: of shoes and ships, and sealing wax, of cabbages and kings'.

title: Paisley Patterns
description: Contemporary Edinburgh artist Davy Macdonald presents a stunning new collection of abstract, conceptual and fine art paintings exploring the evolution and perpetuity of Paisley the place and paisley the pattern. The exhibition traces the enduring appeal, identity and cultural appropriation of the boteh form, from its Middle Eastern origins to its industrialisation when Paisley became the epicentre of a global trade, producing millions of shawls on Jacquard looms. The works reflect how paisley the pattern and Paisley the place have indelibly shaped one another. Through abstraction and deconstruction, Macdonald reveals the pattern’s enduring integrity and endless evolutionary possibilities.
content_warnings: Audience required to walk or move around during the performance

title: Pajama Talks
description: Pajama Talks is a coming-of-age story following childhood best friends Abby and Nina as they relive memories of their sleepovers. Together they are forced to confront their friendship, their girlhood and their personal identity. The show examines the joys and hardships of growing up and grief in all forms, asking the question: are the people we’ve loved and lost still with us? A play about platonic love, figuring out life and existential conversations in the middle of the night.
content_warnings: Contains distressing or potentially triggering themes

title: Paper Sparrows
description: After a run of sold-out 2025 Fringe shows, Scotland’s roots folk/Americana trio return with a 'depth of skill and experience' (Rock-N-Reel.co.uk), showcasing their 'rich song writing craft' (Shindig-Magazine.com) with twin-guitar lines, double bass and 'infectious harmonies' (Americana-UK.com).

title: Parasocial Activity
description: Jenny meets her favourite A-List celebrity in Costa and they instantly fall in love. She knows that they are meant to be, but some jealous sceptics don't seem to agree. How far will she go in the name of love? Parasocial Activity is a dark comedy exploring parasocial relationships in the digital age. Praise for previous work: 'A triumph' **** (BroadwayBaby.com), 'Martha had my attention instantly' ***** (EdFringeReview.com), 'An intricately written, impeccably acted, and perfectly pitched piece of Fringe theatre' ***** (BingeFringe.com).
content_warnings: Contains distressing or potentially triggering themes, Scenes of a sexual nature, Strong language/swearing

title: [Parent]ified
description: Sissy is 25 but, in a way, she has always been an adult. When a call from her sister, Bug, arrives in the night, Sissy must come to terms with all the years that came before. As the lines between childhood and parenthood continue to blur, the messy threads of a childhood cut short begin to unravel, and hopes for a better future may be rooted in the past. A five-star reviewed, deeply vulnerable and beautifully acted play about being parentified, and the messy threads of a childhood cut short.
content_warnings: Contains distressing or potentially triggering themes
venue_name: The Speakeasy at The Royal Scots Club

title: Paris in a Jazz Age: The Memoirs of Eloise Defleur
description: Step into a Parisian cafe – relive the music, romance and glamour of the Jazz Age through the eyes of chanteuse Eloise DeFleur and her talented band. Featuring vintage swing, evocative chanson and timeless classics performed live, this stylish cabaret transports audiences to the smoky clubs of 1930s Paris and beyond. 'As Eloise, Airlie Scott sparkles like a coupe of champagne at one of Gatsby’s shindigs' (GetYourCoatsOn.com). The five-star reviewed show blends storytelling, music and charm.
content_warnings: Brief discussions of grief and wartime.

title: Parkies
description: Porn star wannabe, retired accountant, Croatian student on a gap year, Christian proselytizer and a drag queen in training. We all live and work together in a remote corner of one of America’s most beautiful national parks. Parkies is a train wreck of humour, mischief and intrigue. Come take a look at what happens when this land of misfit toys collides with greedy corporate America and the National Park Service.

title: Pascol – Vocal Performance
description: Pascol is an experimental vocal performance that invites the audience into a collaborative, immersive space. Five vocalists transform personal stories shared in the room into improvised compositions. Each performance begins with an invitation: audience members may share a memory. The ensemble listens, moves and sings together, composing live using only voice and physical expression. No instruments, no script. The result is a spontaneous, one-of-a-kind musical reflection shaped by the emotions. Harmonies and layered textures become a sound mirror for shared memories. Combining improvisation, storytelling and emotional resonance, Pascol creates fleeting, expressive, deeply human collective experiences.
content_warnings: Audience participation, Contains distressing or potentially triggering themes

title: Patient 13
description: 'I got rid of all the toxic people and there was no one left.' Gail is good at setting boundaries and staying busy until a scary diagnosis forces her to ask for help. But, who can she trust? Her life takes unexpected turns, hilarious and shocking, leading to her participation as patient #13 out of 29 in a clinical study treating cancer survivors with anxiety and depression with magic mushrooms. Winner: Progie Theater Award for outstanding progressive plays. Winner: LA Hidden Gems award. 'Magnetic and engaging in her intensity and candor... a masterclass in storytelling' ***** (BroadwayWorld.com).
content_warnings: Contains distressing or potentially triggering themes, Discussion of sex, mental health issues, and legal psychedelic drug use.

title: Patrick Monahan: I'm Not A Terrorist – I'm Freddie Mercury
description: Since coming to England from Iran in 1980, if Patrick had £1 for every time someone called him a terrorist, he'd have enough money to run his own terrorist organisation. He has more in common with Freddie Mercury than Hezbollah. He has had visas turned down, extra checks and restricted access. He has 60 minutes to prove: I'm not a terrorist. 'His kind of funny is an irresistible force' (Scotsman). 'Monahan is clever, very funny and hugely likeable' (Scottish Field) 'Has his audiences in stitches from the off' ****½ (One4Review.co.uk).

title: Paul Currie: REMOVE YOUR SKIN PLEASE
description: This will be award-winning absurdist comedian Paul Currie’s brand-new show, and his 11th full hour-long show. A welded fusion of ADHD, stand up, clown, art, noise rock and utter nonsense squeezed into 60 minutes of the most utterly bonkers comedy madness ever brought to a live stage. Strap in for a rusted rollercoaster ride into the southern hemisphere of reality. Imagine David Lynch, Iggy Pop and Spike Milligan on Buckfast and Haribo. 'Incredible' ***** (Scotsman). 'The best comedy I saw' ***** (Stewart Lee). 'Unique and jaw dropping' ***** (Entertainment-Now.com).
content_warnings: Audience participation, Nudity, Strong language/swearing, Contains distressing or potentially triggering themes

title: Paul Dennis: Title Explained In Blurb – The Musical. Well… sort of.
description: "Make the title self-explanatory", they said. Yeah. You can't say that to an autistic person and expect them not to hemorrhage. The show is funny songs and stories about office friendships, overrated lyrics, the shadowy underworld of karaoke and musical comedy itself in a choreographed maelstrom of neurodiversity. It's self-explanatory but with nothing left to the imagination, it's useless as a selling point. There; title explained. Well... sort of. Just see it, mun. You could win a crème egg.
content_warnings: Strong language/swearing, Contains explicit material about drugs, sex, and religion, Buy a ticket in advance to guarantee entry or Pay What You Want at the venue

title: Paul Foot: The Future
description: Remember when people were excited for the future? With visions of jetpacks, friendly robots wheeling around and solar-powered bidets. Well, we don’t have visions like that anymore, do we? But the universe is not over. The light has not gone out. Here’s a candle in the dark. Contagious and whispering. And you can take it with you when you leave. A new stand-up show from pioneering alt-comedy hero and star of Cats Does Countdown. (ISH) Edinburgh Comedy Awards Best Show winner, 2023. ‘Has the audience laughing so hard they’re about to leave their bodies’ ***** (Chortle.co.uk).

title: Paul Hilleard: Grog
description: BBC New Comedian of the Year 2024, Channel 4's Sean Lock Award finalist 2025 and winner of Chortle Hotshots 2026 debuts this Fringe! Hailing from Pontypridd in the South Welsh Valleys, Paul shares experiences of growing up in a deprived area. Expect dry oddball observations from the Valleys and beyond! Content includes; market towns, God, gates, the class system, hot food, relationships, yoga, landlords, Epstein. Be kind to yourself. 'Projects the image of a man not too successful at life but still clinging to hope... Precision and obscurity' (Chortle.co.uk). 'Top-rate comedy' (Spencer Jones). 'Absolutely fantastic' (Babatunde Aléshé).
content_warnings: Strong language/swearing, Buy a ticket in advance to guarantee entry or Pay What You Want at the venue

title: Paul McDaniel: Harder Better Faster Paul-er
description: Come see the Northern Irish deadpan comic's new show where he talks about coming to terms with his "inner" Paul. Perfect if you're a Paul or friends with one! Tour support for Susie McCabe. As seen / heard on Breaking the News and Edinburgh Unlocked. 'An inexplicable delight' (Chortle.co.uk). 'Glorious' (Comedy.co.uk). 'Paul McDaniel is f*cking brilliant' (Janey Godley).

title: Paul Merton and Suki Webster's Improv Show
description: An hour of sensational improvised comedy hosted by two of the UK's masters of improvisation with their old friend, improv virtuoso, Mike McShane and a host of very special guests. Fast, fabulously funny improvised games, scenes, stories and laugh-out-loud surrealism. 'Amongst the best in the business for years... class, nonsense, inventiveness and a whole barrel load of laughs' ***** (One4Review.co.uk). 'Absolutely delivers the big laughs... hilariously absurd' **** (BroadwayBaby.com). 'Merton and Webster have established themselves as two of the UK's best... this show is improv comedy at its strongest' **** (TheScotsReviewer.com).
content_warnings: Due to the improvised nature of this show, there may be adult themes and strong language.

title: Pear: Callback
description: Top Ten Best Reviewed Shows Edinburgh Fringe 2024 and 2025. After four consecutive sold-out Fringes, six-foot-seven identical twins Patrick and Hugo McPherson return with what they believe is both their funniest and most recent show yet. As the best-selling sketch comedy of Edinburgh Fringe 2025 and nominee for Best Show at the ISH Edinburgh Comedy Awards, Pear hit Pleasance this year with Callback, an hour of hilarious characters, props, and characters holding props. Directed by Jonny 'SweetJon' Harvey. 'Effortlessly funny' (Independent). 'They are destined for greatness' (List). ***** (BroadwayBaby.com). ***** (ThreeWeeks). ***** (EdFestMag.com).
content_warnings: This show contains strong language, loud noises, sexual themes and audience interaction.

title: Peregrinations
description: A powerful wordless work of masked physical theatre and puppetry with original music, exploring displacement and the immigrant crisis in America. Created from interviews and the lived experiences of an international ensemble, the piece uses masks, puppetry and poetic movement to illuminate border crossings, exile, the search for belonging and the barriers imposed by others. As hostility toward immigrants intensifies, this visually arresting performance moves beyond headlines to reveal deeply human stories of courage, loss and resilience. Urgent and intimate, it asks audiences to reflect on migration, memory and compassion in a nation shaped by arrivals.

title: Pergolesi – Stabat Mater and Magnificat
description: CORO 26 return to the Edinburgh Festival Fringe at the beautiful New Town Church in George Street to perform these two baroque masterpieces. Neil Metcalfe directs the singers and small string ensemble from the harpsichord.

title: Persona
description: Deliciously disturbing. Award-winning, sold out LAMDA graduate company Namesake Theatre returns to the Edinburgh Fringe with their new play Persona, a gripping, darkly comic and cathartically unsettling reunion. Four boarding-school alumni gather in a secluded country house to divide a dead friend’s trust, but the night quickly begins to unravel. Insults are flung, compliments concealed and civility begins to fracture under the weight of social grace pushed to its breaking point. By turns hilarious and hellish, Persona peels back the curtain on the masks we wear to survive, and asks what, if anything, lies beneath.
content_warnings: Scenes of a sexual nature, Scenes of violence, Strong language/swearing

title: Perth Youth Orchestra Concert
description: Perth Youth Orchestra was founded in 1962 and has showcased generations of talented young musicians. It offers members valuable orchestral experience through concerts, tours, and collaborations, fostering musical excellence and passion in Perth and beyond. Tonight's programme includes: Monti's Czardas for violin (soloist Finlay Rutherford), Haydn's Trumpet Concerto 2nd movement (soloist Joe Rogers), Finlandia (Sibelius), Sentimental Sarabande from Simple Symphony for String Orchestra 3rd movement (Britten), and Brahms' Symphony No 1 4th movement. We finish with a selection of contemporary pieces, including Hoedown, A Touch of Jazz, Into the Storm, Opening Night and Loch Lomond.

title: Pervert Werewolf
presented_by: Stolen Table Collective / PBH's Free Fringe
description: One village, one werewolf, one live game of wits, savagery, and deceit... And also a pervert. Find him/her before them catches he/you. A *new* interactive game show that’s *NOT* like The Traitors because there’s a pervert in it now. A new comedy show from your friends at Stolen Table, about whom the following has previously been said: 6th best-reviewed comedy show of Edinburgh Fringe 2025 (Comedy.co.uk), Top Pick of Fringe 2025 ***** (EdFringeReview.com), 'Chaotic...anarchic energy' ***** (@TheCrumbReviews), 'Less like a show, more like a club' **** (BingeFringe.com), Funniest Show Award winner at Stockholm Fringe Festival 2025.

title: PG Hits! The Best in Stand-Up Comedy Without the Rude Bits!
description: Three top stand-ups perform their very best routines just as they do in comedy clubs all over the world, but without the swearing! PG Hits is a professional stand-up comedy compilation show that leaves out the really rude bits so everybody can have fun. Comedy fans of all ages and all tastes will have something to enjoy, as we bring you a diverse lineup from the very best that the festival has to offer. ***** (MixUpTheatre.com). 'PG Hits! is for you' **** (GlamAdelaide.com.au).

title: Phil Ellis: Bath Mat
description: Multi award-winning 'comic genius' (Scotsman) and the new star of Taskmaster (Channel 4), Phil Ellis returns to Edinburgh on his first full national stand-up tour. Following his three big award wins at the 2025 Edinburgh Fringe, Phil, the very definition of funny bones, presents his brand-new show Bath Mat. Jam-packed with laugh-out-loud profound silliness, superbly crafted gags and constant surprises, Phil is bringing his Bath Mat to a city near you. ***** (Mirror). 'Every moment he is on stage something funny, and then funnier, is happening' ***** (Scotsman). ****½ (Chortle.co.uk).
content_warnings: Buy a ticket in advance to guarantee entry or Pay What You Want at the venue

title: Phil Nichol: Aren't We Lucky
description: Lou Reed. The lottery. Ecstasy. Prince Andrew. Punk. Barenaked Ladies. Crisps. Terry Jones. Leukaemia. Butterflies. Dizzy Gillespie's cheeks. Chance. Scat. Sunshine on Leith. Boo-bee-dee-do. Wasps. Double helix. Comedy. Dennis Hopper. Scrotums. Life. Edinburgh Comedy Award Winner, Phil Nichol is back with a brand-new show. An acclaimed actor, award-winning comedian, producer, presenter, writer and musician, there is no end to his talent. As seen on The Graham Norton Show (BBC One) and Never Mind the Buzzcocks (BBC Two). ***** (Scotsman). ***** (List).
content_warnings: Contains adult themes of sex and drugs

title: Phil Nichol: The Naked Racist
description: 20th anniversary of the 2006 Edinburgh Comedy Award winning show. The unhinged re-telling of an Amsterdam trip gone wrong ending with an epiphany of epic proportions. 'You won't see many comedy shows that actually exert g-force. Exhilarating, incredibly funny and clever' (Scotsman). 'This is a show that makes you laugh and think while you are watching and then wakes you up in the night to laugh and think again' (Scotsman). 'Mind-blowing. Infectious joy' ***** (Scotland on Sunday).
content_warnings:
Nudity, Strong language/swearing
Will contain adult themes of sex and drugs.

title: Phoebe Anna Traquair Murals at Mansfield Traquair Centre
description: Come and see the stunning murals painted by Phoebe Anna Traquair between 1893-1901. The murals are a wonderful example of Scotland's arts and crafts movement in the late 19th century and are known as 'Edinburgh's Sistine Chapel'. Home to the world-famous Phoebe Anna Traquair murals, the Mansfield Traquair Centre is a restored neo-Romanesque church built in the 1870s. Free tours are available from our trained guides - no need to book. We welcome donations to maintain these significant artworks.
content_warnings: Audience will be standing throughout, Audience required to walk or move around during the performance

title: Phuckets and Rainbows
description: Lizzie Bean’s Phuckets and Rainbows is clever, chaotic, witty and wise. One woman takes you on a wildly honest ride through her outwardly ordinary life. Sharing laughter, tears and mayhem, exploring freedom, joy and self-love. Expect swearing, absurdity and truth bombs, as Lizzie bends reality, breaks rules and asks the big questions in the small moments. It’s messy, magical and joyous. A celebration of being alive, human and gloriously imperfect. By the end, you might laugh until you cry, cry until you laugh and leave feeling a little liberated, braver and more free to be.
content_warnings: Strong language/swearing, Includes talk of mental health experiences

title: Piano Masterworks 2026
description: For his 2026 Piano Masterworks recital, New Zealand pianist Charles Whitehead presents a fascinating, new programme of Romantic and early 20th-century solo works. Robert Schumann’s Kreisleriana is one of the cornerstones of the piano literature, featuring a kaleidoscopic range of ideas and music that is impulsive, dreamy and intensely emotional. By contrast, Alexander Scriabin’s Piano Sonatas No. 5 and 7 are shorter works, mystical, ecstatic and full of spontaneous musical movement. Prepare to be transfixed by the drama, unique musical poetry and colours of this powerful music!

title: Piano Recital with Marc Corbett-Weaver 2026
description: The acclaimed London-based, international classical pianist Marc Corbett-Weaver returns to the Edinburgh Festival Fringe for a recital featuring Haydn's great London Sonata in E flat, Chopin's epic Fantasie and pieces by Debussy and Ravel.

title: Piemaggedon
description: The silliest game show ever. Kids versus comedians in a head-to-head battle of wits. The loser gets a custard pie and most likely so will everyone else. Leave your respect at the door. Anyone questioning the quizmaster gets a pie. Anyone calling for the quizmaster to get a pie, gets a pie, anyone using the word pie... guess what. And being old enough to have a driving license doesn’t exclude you from any of the rules.

title: Pierrepoint: The People's Hangman
description: Albert Pierrepoint was an English hangman who executed an estimated 435 people in a 25-year career with HMP Prisons between the 1930s and 1950s. During his tenure, he was responsible for the executions of several high-profile murderers including the Acid Bath Killer – John Haigh, and Ruth Ellis – the last woman to be hung in England. Another was the case of one John Reginald Christie of 10 Rillington Place infamy. Through the executioner's eyes, this theatrical production dissects and scrutinises Christie's crimes and examines how he came to be on the end of a rope.
content_warnings: Audience participation, Contains distressing or potentially triggering themes

title: Pigeon Syndrome
description: When a hapless husband accidentally steps on a bee that his wife has been trying to save, it seems that their marriage really has hit rock bottom. But when he inadvertently gets back into her good books by saving an injured pigeon that's flown into the window, he finally believes he's found a way to restore their former passion for each other. An absurdist comedy, with a dash of dark humour and questionable puppetry, that explores the fundamentals of relationships.

title: Pimm's Without the Cucumber
description: What is masculinity from a gay perspective? A one-man comedy about a mixed race gay guy, masculinity and breakups. Jordan, and his much smarter ‘professor’ alter ego, has just broken up with his first boyfriend, and has dreams of entering his healing era. From nights out, to hook-ups, to joining a football team, Pimm’s Without the Cucumber tells the all too familiar story of the lasting effect someone can have, highlighting every queer boy’s experience of unexpected relationships and learning to accept who they are.
content_warnings: Scenes of a sexual nature, Strong language/swearing

title: Pink Rabbit
description: Amna is a good Muslim daughter. Mostly. At home she’s modest, obedient, invisible. Online she’s PersianBaby – bold, flirtatious, watched. Pink Rabbit is a fierce, coming-of-age, darkly funny solo play about faith, female desire and the intoxicating power of attention. As Amna hides her OnlyFans from her strict mother, the lies start to fracture. Caught between mosque and male gaze, shame and thrill, she begins to ask: who is she performing for? Raw, intimate and electric, Pink Rabbit explores intergenerational and cultural conflict – and the dangerous moment when being seen finally feels better than being honest.
content_warnings: Strong language/swearing, Contains explicit sexual content, adult themes, and psychological intensity.

title: Pins & Needles
description: Pins & Needles is a high-voltage stand-up comedy show where ink meets irreverence. Hosted by New York comedians Justin Hartmann and Taylor Drew, this no-holds-barred showcase features heavily tattooed comics who strip down to their underwear and show off their art, all while making you laugh. Part comedy show, part living gallery, Pins & Needles celebrates the stories behind the ink.

title: Pip Utton's Farewell to Edinburgh Fringe: Bacon
description: After more than 30 Edinburgh Fringes, time to call it a day! Written by myself and Jeremy Towler, one of my three favourites. 'Absolutely unmissable' (Telegraph). 'A gem' (Independent). 'Masterpiece' (ScotsGay.co.uk).

title: Pip Utton's Farewell to Edinburgh Fringe: Before I Forget I Love You, I Love You
description: After more than 30 Edinburgh Fringes, time to call it a day! One of my three favourites. 'Laugh out loud funny, dab your eyes moving' (TheWeeReview.com). 'Nothing I can say about this show will do it enough justice.' (BroadwayBaby.com).

title: Pip Utton's Farewell to Edinburgh Fringe: Hunchback of Notre Dames
description: After more than 30 Edinburgh Fringes, time to call it a day! One of my three favourites. 'Rare and beautiful' (Three Weeks). 'Achieves beauty in its simplicity' (Stage). 'Beautifully crafted, absolutely compelling' (EdinburghGuide.com).

title: Places I Go from My Bed
presented_by: Katherine McGerr and Erica Murphy / Syracuse University
description: Ordinary objects from a child's hospital room are transformed into fantastical adventures in this original work created especially for young audiences with specific mobility or sensory needs, but enjoyable to all.  Part performance, part (optional) hands-on interaction, Places I Go from My Bed empowers audiences of all ages and abilities to transport themselves on their own imaginative journeys.
content_warnings: Audience participation: performances include an optional hands-on invitation at the end for children to make and operate their own shadow puppets.

title: Planetarium Lates: Pink Floyd’s Dark Side of the Moon
description: Pink Floyd's The Dark Side of the Moon planetarium experience is back! Experience a mesmeric and immersive show with breathtaking views of the Solar System, set to the official 1973 album in spectacular surround sound. Over half a century after its launch in a planetarium, this truly is a unique way to experience this iconic album.

title: Plano
description: Three sisters sit on a porch as time hurtles forward and everything happens to them. Marriages bloom and wither. Children grow. Husbands vanish to Plano or sink into a widening hole in the yard. A relentless slug infestation creeps across the lawn. In suburban Texas, the sisters confront the strange plagues of domestic life, recounting memories that feel more like nightmares. Plano is a horror comedy about sisterly love and the surreal fallout of a mother who shrink-wrapped her daughters and sealed them in a tiny box, while their husbands fill infinite space, living countless versions of themselves.
content_warnings: Contains distressing or potentially triggering themes, Scenes of sexual violence, Descriptions of domestic violence, sexual assault. References to disordered eating and depression.

title: PLASTIC
description: Minyoung Kim is a composer and soloist from Seoul, who combines geomungo - a traditional Korean string instrument – with jeongga – traditional Korean singing based on poetry and electronic music. PLASTIC is her solo project first presented in 2025, in which she explores the contradictions of human beings: their fragility and, at the same time, their immense potential, offering a modern and updated version of traditional Korean music with accompanying psychedelic projection.

title: Playback
description: It's 2013. Euan's got a camcorder, a bowl cut and a dream. Combining live performance with Euan Munro's real childhood YouTube videos, this cringe-filled comedy nostalgia trip spirals into a story of dark ambition, online predators and digital ghosts.
content_warnings: Contains distressing or potentially triggering themes

title: Playlist
description: Music. It surrounds us and invades our homes, cars and work. We exercise and shop to it. Share it, talk about it and even travel to hear it live. Playlist is an exploration of the role of music (and silence) in our lives. How music brings us together, separates us, changes us, defines us and ultimately – why we need it.

title: Poles
description: A performance by Corpo Máquina's artistic director Guilherme Miotto for pole dance virtuoso Yvonne Smink. With a live soundscape from musician/composer Isaac Poels. Pole dancer Yvonne Smink won the Dutch pole dancing championships multiple times and is a rising star internationally. In Poles, Guilherme highlights Yvonne's impressive technical strength and allows for joy to radiate from her no-nonsense appearance. With her down to earth approach and healthy blush, Yvonne makes her way through the steel pipe construction. At the cutting edge of personal and public space, she delivers chilling moments of physicality and intimacy.

title: Police Cops: The Original
description: The multi award-winning comedy blockbuster returns! With 20+ five-star reviews, globally acclaimed Police Cops bring back the show that started it all! Reloaded and supercharged for 2026, expect adrenaline-fuelled physical comedy, 80s bangers and uncompromising facial hair. Winner: Stage Award for Acting Excellence. Winner: Best Show, Toronto Fringe. Winner: Best International Show, Cape Town Fringe. Winner: Brighton Fringe Award For Excellence. ***** (WhatsOnStage.com). ***** (EdFestMag.com). ***** (Stage). ***** (TheatreWeekly.com). 'It's hip, radical, funny as f*ck and a work of towering genius' (Bill Nighy). 'It takes brains to be this dumb!' (Stewart).
content_warnings: Nudity, Scenes of violence, Strobe lighting, Strong language/swearing

title: Portraits of Americana
description: Inspired by iconic American portraits, this devised performance invites audiences into the imagined inner lives of contemporary youth. Young Los Angeles artists transform still images into raw, funny and deeply personal monologues – each a confession, a protest, or a dream. What begins as art on a wall becomes living testimony, capturing the contradictions, urgency, and fragile hope of a generation coming of age in America today. By giving voice to those often unseen, the piece reframes Americana through honesty, vulnerability and wit. This 45-minute ensemble work is intimate, unfiltered and unapologetically human.

title: Positively Bob Dylan
description: Born in Bristol, England, Jimmy Lee is a multi-instrumentalist, singer/songwriter who has written and recorded several albums with various bands and has toured the USA and Japan, as well as Europe and the UK. Jimmy now brings his inimitable style to the songs of Bob Dylan, presenting an unforgettable evening of acoustic music and soulful vocals. An absolute must for fans of Dylan!

title: Possessive! The Musical!
description: A demonic possession pop-punk comedy musical about learning to value the family you have, rather than the ‘perfect’ one you want. When teenage daughter Lisa accidentally summons a demon that possesses her little brother, parents Carl and Hannah decide this demon might actually be better behaved than their hellion son, and let him stay a while. But when the demon's minion reveals to Lisa that they have only one moon cycle to get the demon out or lose their son forever, it's a mad dash to get this hellspawn exorcised!
content_warnings: Strobe lighting, Buy a ticket in advance to guarantee entry or Pay What You Want at the venue.

title: Prana
description: Prana weaves Indian and Japanese classical traditions into a meditative, dynamic soundscape, blending sitar, tabla, bansuri and shakuhachi. Their music bridges cultures, honouring ancient forms while inviting listeners into contemplative journeys of melody and rhythm.

title: Primary School Bangers
description: Viral sensation and Britain's favourite teacher James B Partridge is heading back on the road in 2026 and following extraordinary demand, he's bringing the Primary School Bangers back for an encore at Edinburgh Fringe! Beginning as playful performances for his pupils, the show has grown into a genuine national phenomenon. From viral online fame to a field-closing Glastonbury set (featured on BBC festival highlights) James has become the UK's most beloved musical nostalgia act. This is more than a tour, it's a collective singalong, decades in the making!

title: PRIME: We Are
description: Who are we when we’re together? When we’re alone? When we fight for what we believe in? Dance Base's in-house company for dancers over 60, PRIME explores the ways in which we can support each other to keep going, fighting and overcoming obstacles and also when we choose to surrender and accept. We Are premiers new work from recently appointed Artistic Director Kally Lloyd-Jones and guest choreographer Malcolm Sutherland.

title: Prison Nursing Unlocked: A History of Care and Justice
description: Explore the fascinating history of healthcare in prisons, from the work of early reformers like Elizabeth Fry, to prison care and justice for women through the experience of suffragettes in prisons, to the vital contribution that nurses make to prisoner health today. Featuring archive photographs, historical and contemporary objects, the exhibition invites you to explore the little-known history of prison nursing and health care. Highlights include artwork created by prisoners at HMP Eastwood Park and HMP Warren Hill.
content_warnings: Contains distressing or potentially triggering themes

title: Prophets
description: A researcher from Scotland travels to Saint John, a remote British Overseas Territory in the South Pacific. Upon arrival, she finds the island is under the control of a growing religious cult. This discovery starts to shift her studies from the land to the people as the dangerous theology of the cult is revealed and the day of paradise approaches. Prophets is a brand new two-hander drama from Fringe First-winning writer Jack MacGregor that examines the intersection between faith and cult, an exploration of violent belief at the edge of the world.
content_warnings: Contains distressing or potentially triggering themes, Scenes of violence, Strong language/swearing

title: Punching Judy
description: Punch and Judy: a British entertainment institution famously contained within the confines of a small striped box. But what happens when the chaotic lives of these iconic characters tumbles out of the booth and spills into the real world? This is a one-hour tragicomedy exploring the public and private lives of Punch and Judy alongside the host of characters that have for centuries populated their world. With a blend of slapstick comedy and puppetry vs naturalistic drama, as the two sides begin to blur it makes for a dark and unsettling comedy that is no longer for kids.
content_warnings: Contains distressing or potentially triggering themes, Scenes of violence

title: Punchline Bingo
description: Four top comedians try to beat the punchlines in this comedy gameshow. But YOU can win prizes too by playing the comedy bingo! All you need to do is cross the words off your card as the comics say them to win prizes! It's bingo but comical!
venue_name: Flight Club at Laughing Horse @ West Port Oracle

title: Puttana
description: Puttana is a work that questions the boundary between body and commodity, between desire and power. In a society that normalises consumption, the buying and selling of bodies follows the same rules as any other market: I pay, therefore I can. A single actress gives voice to five characters, through music and words, to tell an uncomfortable and cruel story. Will you be the one be who casts the first stone?

title: Putting the Ass in Brass
description: Soap suds, brass bands and a 1970s sexual awakening. A cornet-playing youth cheerfully derailed by bum notes, feisty women and very questionable choices. From analogue grime to digital chaos, I've stumbled, squeaked and occasionally hit the right note, uncovering embarrassing truths and buried stories along the way. This one-man romp is a noisy, nostalgic revelation of identity and heritage from bigotry to the digital age. Sharp, cheeky and utterly unpolished, it's a blast through the past with all the wrong notes, laughs and just enough courage to blow me right out of the closet.

title: Pyg
description: A place between somewhere and nowhere. Three men. One mannequin. Harrison has been coming here for a year. Or maybe it’s his first time. Or his last. It depends which Harrison you ask. They've all been summoned here for the same reason – if only they could figure out what that is. The mannequin stands at the centre of it all, unravelling Harrison's life before his eyes, as it becomes clear that there are darker truths about his world threatening to break his fantasies. Pyg is tender until it's unnerving, funny until it's horrifying. A wickedly inventive new play.
content_warnings: Contains distressing or potentially triggering themes, Scenes of violence, Strong language/swearing

title: QFWFQ
presented_by: Gregory Nussen, Daniel Segura and Suzanna Rosenthal Productions
description: You are reading about QFWFQ, Best Solo Show at the 2025 Hollywood Fringe. A surrealist labyrinth that stretches time and space. Inspired by Italo Calvino's If On a Winter's Night a Traveller, this razor-sharp, absurdly funny and deeply personal show breaks all genres and has no fourth wall. Join Gregory Nussen as they rummage through the power and peril of storytelling, growing up Jewish and queer, grappling with geopolitics, and art that saves your life. QWFWQ neither begins, nor ends. How does it come together? I can't explain, but it does. Directed by Hannah Pilkes.
content_warnings: Contains distressing or potentially triggering themes, References to suicide and the Holocaust

title: Queen – A Night at the Cabaret Opera
description: Rock on with the greatest Queen piano cabaret tribute singalong show ever! All the hits, fun stories and lots of laughs as you transform from an audience into the world’s greatest Queen cabaret singers... This is a high-energy, interactive show that will have you singing, laughing, dancing and generally having one of the best nights of your life. Award-winning international piano cabaret entertainer, Antony (Dr H) Hubmayer, will lead the celebrations as we sing all the best bits from Bohemian Rhapsody, Somebody to Love, Don’t Stop Me Now and many more.

title: R/evolution(s)
description: A contemporary butoh work, R/evolution(s) reimagines butoh for today while carrying its inheritance forward. It brings together Conan Amok – heir to the lineage of Dairakudakan, one of Japan's leading butoh companies – and contemporary dancers renewing the form from within. Grounded in Amok's 'multi layered body' method, developed through a fusion of butoh and sculptural practice, the work explores revolution as both orbit and radical transformation. Deep bass and wadaiko drums create a club-like ritual atmosphere, inviting audiences to encounter butoh anew. This work is part of Wings: International Dance Project by Dance Base Yokohama for Emerging Creators.

title: Rachel Baker Presents: Gwen – This is Not a Pyramid Scheme
description: Hi, Gwen here, I'm out of prison and, no, I don't have any more bacon and egg flavoured vapes for sale! BUT, this is my next venture, I'll teach you how to become resilient, gorgeous and gregarious through my late night rambunctious extravaganza, with dance music and interaction. Gwen was a finalist in the Sketch Off Awards 2025 and the winner of the Luke Rollason Character Bursary. Rachel Baker is a Big Value Act 2026, Funny Women Finalist and Birmingham Breaking Talent nominee. As heard on BBC Radio 4.

title: Rachel Creeger: "Queen of the Jews!"
description: After the dramatic cancellation of her show at the Edinburgh Fringe last year, multi award-winning comedian, Rachel Creeger, presents her brand-new show, a brutally warm and funny exploration of when it's paranoia, and when they're really out to get you. 'Her show is one of the Fringe's big talking points' **** (Telegraph). 'There is a huge scope for humour around culture and religion. Rachel Creeger is the pinnacle of this.' **** (FunnyWomen.com) 'Clever banter and sharp observation that crosses the religious divide' (EdFringeReview.com). 'Very, very funny' **** (Jewish Chronicle).
content_warnings: This show explores lived experiences of racism

title: Rachel Creeger: Ultimate Jewish Mother 2026
description: Relationship problem? Sensitive work email? Need the best recipe for brisket? This Jewish mother has all the answers you need! The joyous, hilarious, interactive comedy show from Rachel Creeger: multi award-winning stand-up comedian and the only orthodox Jew on the UK comedy circuit, is back. As seen on BBC One, Amazon Prime, NextUp Comedy and heard across the BBC Radio network. 'At the world's largest arts festival, there is a huge scope for humour around culture and religion. Rachel Creeger: Ultimate Jewish Mother is the pinnacle of this' (FunnyWomen.com).

title: Rachel Fairburn: Vexy Beasts
presented_by: Phil McIntyre Live in association with PBJ Management presents
description: Hot on the heels of her critically acclaimed 2025 show Side Eye, Rachel Fairburn is back with new personalities and some old favourites for you to love and hate. Expect biting social commentary and lots of big laughs. Co-host of International smash hit podcast All Killa No Filla and as seen on Live at the Apollo (BBC Two), Alan Davies: As Yet Untitled (Dave), Richard Osman's House of Games (BBC Two) and Russell Howard Hour Life Lesson (Sky) 'Rock'n'roll star of British comedy' (Rolling Stone).
content_warnings: Buy a ticket in advance to guarantee entry or Pay What You Want at the venue
venue_name: Monkey Barrel Comedy at O'Neill's (The Tron)

title: Rachel Morton-Young: Dutch Courage
description: In this hilarious and heartfelt show, Rachel explores the vast cultural chasm between her British roots and her adopted Dutch home. With her witty, warm and engaging style, she dives into the quirks, clashes and absurdities of expat life in the world’s most liberal country. Rachel is a prominent comedian in the Netherlands, has featured in various comedy festivals, and was awarded Best Stand-Up (WorldWideComedyAwards.com). 'Rachel is a warm, engaging performer and a master storyteller. Extremely funny and well worth prioritising in your afternoon Fringe plans' (TheRealChrisparkle.com).

title: Rachmaninoff / Beethoven: Fire and Passion
description: From the ferocious to the heavenly, this piano recital features a dramatic selection of piano music beginning with the preludes of Rachmaninoff and culminating in Beethoven's intense Appassionata sonata. Performed by concert pianist Ailsa Aitkenhead. This recital also features music by Spanish composer Manuel De Falla, Turkish pianist/composer Fazil Say, and Ailsa's own piano compositions.

title: Racists, Recessions and Revolutions
description: In 2016 an unprecedented wave of fake news exploded across our screens. Public trust was devastated as Brexit, Trump and an ever-powerful far right emerged. The masterminds? A few teens in a former socialist republic that even experts struggle to find on a map: Macedonia. Join Nadica, a driven Macedon/Brit on the ground floor of this gold rush who will stop at nothing to build her empire of lies as she defies tech giants, Covid lockdowns and a crumbling economy to champion Britain’s eager and ready supply of Racists, Recessions and Revolutions!

title: Rag: A History of Blood
description: Blood has been studied and analysed for thousands of years. Examined for its ability to give life, to spread disease and to sow division. Bringing together artefacts spanning scientific illustrations, textile art, interviews, early modern rare books and medicines, Rag: A History of Blood highlights the social, medical and cultural impact of blood. It examines blood-based discoveries which have saved countless lives and uncovers the stigma associated with blood myths – from menopause and menstruation to HIV/AIDS and pseudoscientific racism.
venue_name: Royal College of Physicians of Edinburgh

title: Rainbows!
description: Do you remember the excitement in school science lessons when the teacher declared today the class would be doing a practical? Tim the gentleman scientist is bringing a medley of real live chemistry and physics demonstrations on stage, at least four of which will create rainbows in different ways. The price for this is twofold: 1. Money. 2. He will discuss the history and chemistry of various cool rocks he's bringing, like what makes rubies fluoresce and the idiot who got pyrite named fool's gold. There will be no fire or loud bangs. Autism friendly.

title: Raj Poojara: Dice
description: Raj Poojara grew up in a Ugandan-Indian household where career advice was less follow your dreams and more don't embarrass the family. In Dice, he explores what happens when life feels pre-rolled. From identity confusion and hyper-competitive cousins to navigating respectable career paths and cultural expectation, Raj examines the pressure to land on the "right" number. But when the plan starts to feel less like security and more like restriction, something has to give. Sharp, personal and packed with punchlines, Dice is a funny, relatable look at family, ambition and the cost of playing it safe.

title: Rat Candy
description: Rat Candy is the world's most perfect comedy variety show. Brooklyn-based comedians, Anya Ptacek and Bekah Hess perform standup, sketch, digital shorts, musical comedy, and OCCASIONALLY tap dancing each night alongside some of their funniest pals. If you love Broad City, Girls, or PEN15, you will adore this show. Anya and Bekah's endlessly endearing friendship guides this show with sickening sweetness. Here's the thing about Rat Candy... It's GTG (good time guaranteed).
venue_name: Just The Tonic at The Mash House

title: Raul Kohli: Makes It Up As He Goes Along
description: Raul Kohli returns for a sixth year with his sell-out cult hit! No material, no plan, no sad bit at the 45th minute where his pet chinchilla dies... Just one hour of straight improvised comedy based on what the crowd tell him. ***** (Guardian). ***** (AYoungishPerspective.co.uk). ***** (TheWeeReview.com) 'His ability to work the crowd can't be understated' ****½ (Distractify.com). Edinburgh ISH Award Best Show Nominee 2024. The Guardian's Best Joke of the Fringe 2024.

title: Raves R Us
description: As seen at Glastonbury – the show that turns into a rave is back. Toys"R"Us has shut its doors for good. Charlie and his mates are left jobless, skint and spiralling in a crumbling, bigot-led Britain. With nothing left to lose and nowhere left to go, Charlie has a vision. An abandoned warehouse. An abandoned nation. It's time to create a sanctuary. An escape. A rave. After playing Glastonbury Festival five times, sold out London's Vault Festival and sold out at the Edinburgh Fringe 2022. Now... it's coming back to Underbelly Cowgate. ***** (StageDoor.com).
content_warnings: Audience participation, Contains distressing or potentially triggering themes, Nudity, Strobe lighting, Strong language/swearing

title: Ray Fordyce's Not-So-Royal Variety Show
description: Ray Fordyce is back again to host a wide variety of acts from around the comedy and entertainment circuit. Featuring newbies, veterans and Fringe performers previewing their own shows – this is a must for all Fringe goers.

title: Ray Fordyce: The Fordyce Saga
description: The saga of Ray's life is about to be told. Sharing the struggles of a rough upbringing to navigating singledom in middle age, all whilst learning new languages and making fudge.

title: Ray O'Leary: I Can See O'Leary Now The Ray Has Gone
presented_by: Impatient Productions in association with Jubilee Street
description: When Ray O'Leary (Taskmaster NZ, Have You Been Paying Attention?, Best Show nominee Melbourne Comedy Festival) was born, winter changed to spring, a new star formed in the heavens and a double rainbow spontaneously appeared. With this auspicious start, it is no wonder he became leader of North Korea in 1994 until his untimely death in 2011. Despite this minor setback, he found time to bring you a whole new show. 'A very strong comic indeed' **** (Chortle.co.uk), 'A jokesmith of the highest order' **** (Skinny).

title: Raymond Mearns is Looking for Trouble
description: Every time I open my mouth I seem to offend somebody! That's the price we pay for living in a world full of morons! Socrates said if you don't want to be criticized, say nothing, do nothing, be nothing. That's exactly what these fools are: nothing! And they know it! That's the reason why, instead of getting a life, they sit on their arses and tear the rest of us down. If easily offended please come to a show full of righteous indignation and some home truths. 'Exceptionally funny and cathartic' (Scotsman).
content_warnings: Contains distressing or potentially triggering themes, Strong language/swearing
venue_name: Scottish Comedy Festival @ The Beehive Inn

title: Reaching The C
description: A show that explores the way music can be woven through life – using personal experience, a bassoon and a loop pedal. It is a story about living and learning, unexpected paths and places, and about finding your way through. Written and performed by Ursula Leveaux. Original script development and direction by Rosemary Harris. A work-in-progress version of this show was first performed at Open Space at Theatre by the Lake in Keswick in April 2024.

title: Rebellious Women
description: Rebellious Women is a bold, exhilarating production that brings together fierce female voices through the real life Suffragettes. The play explores resistance against patriarchy, power and imposed silence. Sharp humour, raw emotion and moments of intimacy sit alongside physical storytelling, creating a vibrant and inspiring experience. Celebrating solidarity, defiance and the cost of speaking out, Rebellious Women asks what it means to choose freedom in a world determined to control women’s bodies, voices and futures – and why rebellion, joy and collective courage still matter today.
content_warnings: Audience participation, Contains distressing or potentially triggering themes, Scenes of violence

title: Recovery Room
description:
Escape to the peaceful Dr Neils Garden. Situated on the banks of Duddingston Loch and view these three exhibitions being held consecutively within the historic Thomson Tower, situated in the garden, throughout August. They will comprise of artists exploring natural and man-made landscapes and the plant forms that inhabit both. Mixed-media works, ecoprints and cyanotypes exploring illness, healing, memory, renewal through plants, anatomy and archival processes, encouraging reflection on resilience, recovery and restoration.
A group exhibition of drawings, paintings, handwoven tapestry and photography exploring the human condition to place, nature and recovery.
content_warnings: Audience required to walk or move around during the performance

title: Red Hot Roots of Jazz
description: Back for a seventh year with the hottest jazz you'll see this summer, Tenement Jazz Band continue their exploration of the red hot roots of jazz, ragtime and blues. Join them in the speakeasy atmosphere of this world-famous venue as they delve even deeper into the archive, presenting faithful renditions from the earliest pioneers of this great American folk music. Sell-out show 2018, from the winner of Best Band, Scottish Jazz Awards 2022. 'The future of traditional jazz is in good hands' (Bert Thompson, MusicWeb-International.com).

title: REDACTED: The Cover-Up of a Cover-Up of a Cover-Up
description: Fargo meets The Office meets The Matrix in this high-octane, darkly comic thriller. It's 1973. Marnie Makowski arrives in New Mexico, searching for her missing sister. When a butcher, a pilot, and a priest each reveal fragments of a millennium-spanning conspiracy, Marnie faces a choice: walk away, or uncover the truth. What follows will change everything, for everyone, forever. An adrenaline-fuelled odyssey through America's most absurd manhunt, with virtuoso physical theatre, acrobatics, and live music from multi award-winning Voloz Collective. Praise for previous work: ***** (BroadwayWorld.com, BroadwayBaby.co.uk). 'Immaculate' (Scotsman).
content_warnings: This show contains strong language, haze, flashing lights and scenes of mimed comic violence.

title: Reuben Solo: Someone in This Crowd Will Betray Me [Revenge Edition]
description: I came here to tell jokes and figure out who's going to betray me. And I'm all out of jokes. After months spent touring worldwide, Reuben returns with knives in his back and a camera on his head. For glory. For redemption. For revenge. A fully updated rendition of 2025's sold-out show. As booed on America's Got Talent. Nominated ISH Edinburgh Comedy Awards Best Show 2025. 'Offers nothing personal and almost no actual content' **** (Chortle.co.uk). 'Egotistical delusions' **** (Scotsman). 'Indescribable' **** (List). 'Disorderly' **** (IsolatedNation.com).

title: Revelation
description: The four horsemen gather at Mama Ruby’s Restaurant in Nowhere, North Carolina for their annual apocalypse conference, convinced that this is the year that the world will finally crash and burn. Unfortunately for them, humanity seems to have other plans. Created by an ensemble of students from Ithaca College, this world premiere explores humanity’s stubborn dedication to doing good even when the forces (or the horses) that be are trying as hard as they can to make it impossible. Will civilisation finally crumble, or will the horsemen's plans be halted by the power of human connection?
content_warnings: Contains distressing or potentially triggering themes, Strong language/swearing, Includes discussion of abortion and eating disorders.

title: Rhapsody in Chicago Blues
description: Tim plays a new programme each year, this year has an Ellington medley, Chicago blues, Chopin, Brahms, new jazz compositions, ragtime original and Jelly Roll Morton rag. Tim's show gives you a chance to hear different styles in a gentle, informative, elegant setting. The Arthur Conan Doyle Centre and home of Sherlock Holmes is a spiritual 19th-century home. Take a break from the noise and come over for a beautiful piano recital. Thank you!

title: Rhinestone Cowboy: The Glen Campbell Story
description: Back for a third year at the Fringe, Rhinestone Cowboy: The Glen Campbell Story is a live music theatre experience that celebrates the extraordinary life and timeless music of one of country's most beloved legends. This captivating show takes audiences on a journey through Glen Campbell’s remarkable career, from his humble beginnings to his rise as Grammy-winning artist and global superstar. Featuring live performances of Glen's most iconic hits, including Rhinestone Cowboy, Wichita Lineman, By the Time I Get to Phoenix and many more, the show blends heart-warming storytelling and authentic musical arrangements.

title: Rhino Conservation Erotic Novel
description: Rhinos are going extinct and human birth-rates are declining across the West. Two young men have taken it upon themselves to Make Cum Great Again by creating the ultimate erotic experience for rhinos and people alike. Gabriel Madden ('circumcised', Chortle.co.uk) and Daniel Trengove ('uncircumcised', Dr Wong PhD) are grateful for the opportunity to present their work to you and your family.

title: Rhys James: Chop Logic
description: Rhys made a discovery that could fix everything. It's been staring him in the face this whole time, in a mirror held behind his head. If he can somehow ignore his own problems, he might just be able to solve yours. A fast, forensic hour of big ideas and gag-dense overthinking from one of Britain's sharpest stand-ups. Star of Mock the Week, also seen furrowing his brow on QI and Live At The Apollo. 'Scintillating stand-up' **** (Times). 'Pee your pants funny' ***** (EdFestMag.com). 'One of the funniest men in the world' (Richard Osman).

title: Rich Hall: Chin Music
description: Chin Music has two meanings: one is idle talk, the other is a brushback throw in baseball or cricket to intimidate the batter. Both describe Rich Hall's comedy. Idle but intimidating. Sharp, quick, splenetic and sublimely improvisational. If you've never seen him, you need to hustle down and grab a seat because he never disappoints. Ever. 'Blissfully funny' (Guardian).

title: Richard Herring: RHLSTP
description: King of Edinburgh, and non-recipient of a Hollywood handshake on Bake Off, returns for his 28th Fringe and 45th show. Daily chat with big Fringe names. Emergency questions, impertinent questions, hilarity and embarrassment in award-winning podcast. More than 700 episodes, Richard Herring's Leicester Square Theatre Podcast attracts the cream of the comedy world. Previous guests: Sir Michael Palin, Dawn French, Barry Chuckle, Professor Mary Beard, Stephen Fry. The only podcast that dares to ask guests if they’d like a finger that travels through time. 'Thrillingly rude' (Guardian). 'Packed with energy, insight and beautiful splodges of puerility' (Times).

title: Richard Pulsford: Gold Fashioned Jokes
description: Quality one-liners, puns and light-hearted jokes! UK Pun Championships Winner 2022. Scottish Comedian of the Year Runner-up 2021. You Must Be Joke King winner 2024. Nominated Best Stand-Up, Buxton Fringe 2023. Top Ten Jokes of Edinburgh Fringe 2019, 2021 and 2022. As seen on Channel 4’s Steph’s Packed Lunch. ‘A barrage of one liners... exudes confidence and charm’ ***** (Lancaster Guardian, 2023). ‘Quick, original and funny’ **** (BroadwayBaby.com, 2022). 'Immediately establishing himself as a safe pair of hands, reminiscent of a master like Milton Jones, his (justified) confidence in his material shone through' (Scotsman, 2021).
venue_name: Scottish Comedy Festival @ The Beehive Inn

title: Richard Pulsford: Yorkshire Dad, Immigrant Mum
description: Multi award-winning comedian Richard Pulsford has taken a step away from his usual quality one-liners and pun shows to write and perform this new autobiographical show. This show sees Richard taking a nostalgic dive into his parents’ past as he tries to understand what made them who they were, and therefore discover who he is. His parentage is an unusual mix, with a dad from Yorkshire and a "foreign" mum from continental Europe. Perhaps it should be no surprise that with such a heritage, Richard ended up being, by his own admission, funny.
content_warnings: Contains distressing or potentially triggering themes

title: Right before I go.
description: From Stan Zimmerman (writer of Golden Girls and Gilmore Girls), Right before I go. highlights the raw struggles of people that have died by suicide. The play uses real suicide notes of celebrities, veterans, bullied teens, those identifying as LGBTQ+, people who have experienced a range of mental health calamities – as well as those who have survived attempts. The show is followed by a conversation between cast and audience. Featuring a rotating cast of all-stars, including Wendie Malick (Shrinking), Emily Kuroda (Gilmore Girls), Iz Hesketh (Hollyoaks), and more (subject to change).
content_warnings: This show contains strong language, audience participation, and contains distressing or potentially triggering themes surrounding suicide, sexual assault, child abuse, mental illness, bullying, self-harm, homophobia, and transphobia.

title: Rip Her to Shreds
description: After the horror of being dumped by her boyfriend for the shiny new freshmen, wannabe queen bee Beth and her two unruly dorm-mates Mercy and Bo, spiral down a path of competitive obsession. When each of them discover their own unruly magical powers, pressure hits a boiling point, exploding into a surreal and haunting conclusion – a roller coaster ride into the secret world of girlhood: with all its ups and downs, twists and turns: alliances always shifting and personalities revealing themselves more and more each second.
content_warnings: Contains distressing or potentially triggering themes, Scenes of violence, Strong language/swearing

title: Rizal Van Geyzel: Arrested
description: Rizal Van Geyzel (Comedy Central Asia) was jailed for telling jokes about his own Islamic heritage. After a year under fire from right wing extremists, a hostile government and a sedition hearing, Rizal returns to the Fringe to tell his story. How it all happened, what it means for the role of comedy, and the impact it had on freedom of speech in Malaysia. 'An all-round fabulous show!' **** (One4Review.co.uk). 'A terrific comic and a wonderful storyteller!' (Scotsman).

title: Rizal Van Geyzel: Keeping It Together
description: Single fatherhood (the sequel to prison). Lost his business. Lost his wife. Now he's losing his mind – while looking after three kids on his own. This comedian, once jailed for telling jokes about being Muslim in Malaysia, faces his toughest gig yet: single fatherhood. Is he keeping it together? Barely. But the alternative is putting them out on the street. More freedom for him, sure. But not a good story to tell on stage. A stand-up show about survival, single parenthood and trying not to fall apart.

title: Rob Auton: JUPITER
description: Rob Auton performs a story he has written about being an estate agent on the planet Jupiter. 'A genuine original' (Guardian).
content_warnings: Babes in Arms: Babies are not allowed in the venue - Children under 18 months

title: Rob Copland: ONE (More Please)
presented_by: Berk's Nest in association with PARKAS at Independent Talent
description: Once one has one, one wants more please and comedian Rob Copland is back and he's asking for more. Who else is more-ing for one more. More for me, more for you, more for whoever wants to poke their head around the corner with us. Winner: Edinburgh Comedy Awards Victoria Wood Prize 2024. Winner: Comedian's Comedian Award, Chortle Awards 2024. As seen on Channel 4’s Tell Me When You're Bored. 'A virtuoso of silliness and a performer of fantastic energy' ***** (Chortle.co.uk). 'Rarely has an existential scream been this much fun' **** (Guardian). **** (Times).
content_warnings: Strong language/swearing, Buy a ticket in advance to guarantee entry or Pay What You Want at the venue
venue_name: Monkey Barrel Comedy at O'Neill's (The Tron)

title: Rob Duncan: Printer of the Year
description: In 2024, Rob Duncan was named Printer of the Year. After 15 years in the industry, he was finally recognised as a pioneer in his field. This show is an hour of printing, celebrating his awards and debuting a new category of dramatic arts – performance printing. 'Brilliantly, hilariously stupid' (Frankie Boyle). 'Extraordinary' **** (Scotsman). 'Frigging maverick' ***** (ThreeWeeks).

title: Rob Kemp: Beatlesjuice
description: Cult comedy horror movie, Beetlejuice, retold through the songs of not-even-remotely cult band, The Beatles. A multimedia mashup tribute to the Fab Four and the Ghost with the Most by the award-winning creator of The Elvis Dead. So clap your hands or rattle your jewellery, cos it's showtime!

title: Rob Nother: Another Way
description: Dangerously confident, Rob Nother is sure he's living life the right way. Everyone else knows he isn't. From shamelessly pimping out his Irishness, to devising free travel schemes, join Rob as he explores life as a chancer. 'Naturally confident with rock solid material to back it up' (Chortle.co.uk). 'Killed it' (Adam Ray).

title: Rob Preston: Amazing Global Solutions
presented_by: Queenie Miller for Hat Trick Productions
description: Character comedian Rob Preston just wants everything to be perfect again. Join him and his unlikely cadre of alter-egos on their quest to dominate the content space, end mental health and bring lasting international peace to the entirety of the globe globally. A big ask? Sure. But someone's got to pull their finger out. BBC New Comedy Award and Pleasance Reserve Shortlist. Soon to appear in Leo Reich's Channel 4 and A24 sitcom It Gets Worse. Star of Fringe 2025 sell-out comedy play Brainsluts: **** (Guardian). **** (Times). **** (List). 'Crowd favourite' (BroadwayWorld.com).
content_warnings: This show contains audience participation, strong language and may contain thematic referencences to war and death.

title: Robert Louis Stevenson: The Body Snatcher
description: A chilling tale of greed, guilt and the macabre, The Body Snatcher exposes one of the darkest truths in history – the grisly pursuits of the so-called Resurrection Men. When medical student Fettes is recruited to assist the enigmatic scholar Wolfe Macfarlane, a chilling chain of events is set in motion. To what lengths will they go for the advancement of medical knowledge? This stunning adaptation brings to the stage Stevenson’s masterfully weaved story of suspense and morality – exploring the dark depths of human ambition and its terrifying consequences.

title: Robin Grainger: Lemonade
description: Robin Grainger returns to Edinburgh with another hysterical show about happiness. 'A masterclass in comedy... Fully deserves his place amongst the top echelons of current comedians.' ***** (TheRealChrisParkle.com). 'Non-stop energy, we the audience could barely catch our breath' ***** (One4Review.co.uk). 'Hilarious. An hour that's full of heart, delivered by one of the most likeable comics on the circuit' *** (List). Nominated for BEST Show (ISH) Edinburgh Comedy Awards 2025. Nominated for Sir Billy Connolly Spirit of Glasgow Award in 2025 and longlisted in 2026.

title: Robot Vacuum Fight Club
description: Form a team, select a knockoff Roomba, customise it, then clean house in a series of knockout competitions that test balance, agility and suction power. The winning team receives honour, glory and maybe some exclusive RVFC merch. This is an anarchic, fully-interactive game show put together on an extremely tight budget with dodgy home appliances we bought off Temu. If you like Robot Wars... this is nothing like it, but you should come along anyhow. 'The best interactive experience ever...' (Adelaide Fringe Audience Review, 2026). 'A wonderfully daft idea... (Telegraph).
content_warnings: Audience participation, Audience required to walk or move around during the performance, Strong language/swearing

title: Rock Choir
description: Get ready for an unforgettable show-stopping musical experience! Immerse yourself in a spectacular concert of uplifting, feel-good pop, rock, and chart-topping hits performed by award-winning national sensation Rock Choir, who will be spreading some sparkle at the Edinburgh Festival Fringe. Rock Choir is built on an uplifting ethos of fun, friendship and community spirit with members seeing improvements in personal confidence and self-esteem, which in turn leads to positive mental and physical health. As the world’s largest contemporary choir, Rock Choir has redefined the world of singing, offering an inclusive experience for amateur singers of all backgrounds.

title: Rockbeth
description: After a sold-out, head-banging debut, Rockbeth returns to the Fringe: louder, darker, and even more deliriously doomed. A prophecy. A power-hungry frontman. A band teetering between glorious world domination and total backstage collapse. When ambition collides with reverb and blood-red stage lights, the fallout is spectacular. Featuring classic rock anthems from AC/DC, Black Sabbath, Jimi Hendrix, Santana, and The Sex Pistols, this is Shakespeare with riffs, fate with fuzz pedals, and murder most metal. Expect shredded guitar solos, unhinged visions, thunderous drums and tragedy at full volume. Part live gig, part Shakespearean meltdown... all killer, no mercy.

title: Rockpools
description: Rockpools is a darkly funny, one-woman play about hoarding, loss and endometriosis. The Woman is unhappily married and harbouring a huge secret. When her in-laws suddenly die, she struggles to cope with her grieving husband, and begins hoarding seaside-themed objects in Room Number 4. As the room fills with taxidermy seals, shells and quite a lot of sand, her marriage disintegrates and she must come to terms with a loss of her own. Don't miss this hilarious and poignant debut from actor and comedian Molly Windust. ***** (The Student). 'Immensely fruitful... smart writing' (Chortle.co.uk).

title: RODEO!
description: This is RODEO! After three sell-out years, the lawless late-night comedy show rides back into Edinburgh for three nights only at Monkey Barrel. Saddle up for a night of chaos with the best comedians at the Fringe and brace yourself for plenty of surprises (and balloons) – with a brand new line-up every night. Previous acts include Josh Pugh, Sam Campbell, Ayoade Bamgboye, Alison Spittle, Rob Copland, Lara Ricote, Lou Sanders, Josh Glanc, Dan Rath, Kemah Bob, Christopher MacArthur-Boyd, Vidura BR, Celya AB, Amy Gledhill, Frankie Monroe and many more...
content_warnings: Strobe lighting, Strong language/swearing, Buy a ticket in advance to guarantee entry or Pay What You Want at the venue

title: Roger O'Sullivan: Divil May Cry
description: Ambition is a mortal sin – or so Roger O’Sullivan was taught growing up in rural Ireland. But with the Irish identity trending and authenticity all the rage, in 2026, perhaps the real nepotism is being a peasant boy who can tell a few funny stories while he’s at it. We'll find out in Divil May Cry. Nominee: Best Newcomer, Edinburgh Comedy Awards 2025. Winner: Best Newcomer, Comedian's Choice Award 2025. 'No shortcuts: just craft, timing and a deep love of the game' (One4Review.co.uk). 'Talents like O’Sullivan don't come around very often' (Rolling Stone).
content_warnings: Strong language/swearing, Buy a ticket in advance to guarantee entry or Pay What You Want at the venue

title: Roger Prick: Sexopolis
description: It's Roger Prick! The 1970s pornographer, erotic novelist and lecherous Casanova is back for 2026. Now it's time to relaunch his dirtiest novel, revised and edited for the feminist era. Bringing together character comedy, drag, time travel, cardboard props, drawings and all the sex of 70s Soho, this is an alternative comedy extravaganza. Han Whyte is a drag king, character comedian and Leicester Square Theatre Sketch Off finalist 2025. She participated in Soho Comedy Plus Lab in 2025. 'A soft porn Alan Partridge' (MorningStarOnline.co.uk). 'Archetype of puffed up machismo' (Chortle.co.uk).

title: Romantic Comedy
description: Your chance to fall in LOVE with an award-winning couple! Chris and Robyn are newlyweds, but they spend every night on stage, with other people! So, they’ve invited the audience along for a comedy date. Stories about the open mic comedy scene, their biggest fights and so much more! NOMINEE: Best Newcomer at Melbourne International Comedy Festival 2025. WINNER: Comedy New Work Award at Melbourne Fringe 2024. 'Not only does Reynolds have a great voice, but she can also craft a catchy tune' ***** (Time Out). 'Chris absolutely slayed. Smart, sharp writing. A name to remember' **** (One4Review.co.uk).
content_warnings: Audience participation, Scenes of a sexual nature, Strong language/swearing

title: Romeo and I
description: A newly devised piece focusing on the relationship between human beings and artificial intelligence. The performance follows a politician named Jane, whose life crumbles when she becomes the victim of deepfaked porn. This causes Jane to isolate herself from the world, taking comfort in an AI chatbot – who she affectionately names Romeo. The performance focuses on the progression of their relationship as it takes on a more romantic nature, and confronts the risk of replacing human connection with AI. Eventually Jane is forced to chose between her real life and her new, idealised virtual life.
content_warnings: Contains distressing or potentially triggering themes, Scenes of a sexual nature, Strong language/swearing

title: Room 1219
description: Hotel St Francis, San Francisco, September 1921. The principal players – silent movie star Roscoe ‘Fatty’ Arbuckle, actress Virginia Rappe and rabble-rouser Maude Delmont. Room 1219 – a room of secrets. Roscoe Arbuckle – the man who turned slapstick into gold – is at the top of his profession; but a charge of murder sees his world come crashing down. With his future career in tatters, Arbuckle becomes Hollywood’s first fall guy! This is Roscoe Arbuckle’s story – his rise to fame and his shameful downfall at the hands of the public, the press and Hollywood.
content_warnings: This production includes non-graphic references to alleged sexual assault, illness, death and alcohol abuse within a Prohibition-era setting.

title: Rory Marshall: Thank You for the Opportunity
presented_by: Country Mile Productions in association with United Agents
description: After a sell-out, critically-acclaimed Fringe debut, Rory Marshall is back with his most pathetic character yet: Rory Marshall. A character-comedy journey through the life's work of a jack-of-all-trades. Rory once spent two days being paid to put pipes inside other pipes, and in some ways this show is a lot like that. Top Three Debut Comedy Shows 2025 (Times). Edinburgh Fringe 2025's Best-Reviewed Shows (Comedy.co.uk). Chortle Awards 2026 nominee. 'I laughed so loud it was almost embarrassing' ***** (Metro). 'Deliciously good' **** (Times). **** (Scotsman). As seen on Starstruck and Ellie & Natasia.
content_warnings: This show will contain audience participation.

title: Rory o Hanlon: Honestly
description: Having started his career in Dublin, award-winning Irish stand-up comedian Rory O’ Hanlon is a firm favourite at comedy clubs across the UK and Ireland. Described as having 'presence, poise, timing' (Chortle.co.uk), and having 'a joke every 30 seconds' (IrishTimes.com), his rapid fire delivery regularly has audiences crying with laughter. He is also a veteran of stage, performing 16 consecutive solo shows at the Edinburgh Fringe.

title: Rosco McClelland: The Bones
description: Rosco is back at the Fringe following two smash hit shows in 2024 and 2025. A new show about human evolution, brain and body connections and hamsters. Also he’ll be asking the question... what makes him tick? Winner of the Sir Billy Connolly Spirit of Glasgow Award 2025. 'For guaranteed laughter, don't miss Rosco McClelland' (Edinburgh Evening News). 'One of the country’s best acts' (List). 'A real pro, any hour in his company is a guaranteed good time' (Skinny). 'He is, indeed, a successor to the big yin' (Chortle.co.uk). ***** (One4Review.co.uk). ***** (BroadwayWorld.com). **** (Scotsman).
content_warnings: Strong language/swearing, Buy a ticket in advance to guarantee entry or Pay What You Want at the venue

title: Rosie Holt: The Illegal Aliens Have Landed!
presented_by: Impatient Productions in association with Sophie Chapman Talent
description: Rosie and her MP alter-ego are back, fighting their biggest foe yet. Labour are trying to continue the Conservatives' work of stopping the boats while also still appearing "left wing", but they have an even bigger problem when UFOs arrive. Will the government stand strong? Or insist they are "just waiting for the facts" as aliens start to abduct and eat the British public? A sci-fi streaked satire. 'Can Holt's comedy career survive the advent of a Labour government? On this evidence, you'd fancy her chances' **** (Guardian). **** (Time Out).
content_warnings: This show contains strong language and audience participation.

title: Rosie Jones: I Can't Tell What She's Saying
description: The Taskmaster star is back and talking about the big stuff: being single, the pressures of representing huge sections of the population, and gravy. Oh, and boobs. The BAFTA-nominated powerhouse returns with her loveable blend of cheek and charm following a nomination for Most Outstanding Show at Melbourne International Comedy Festival in 2023. As seen on Live at the Apollo, QI, 8 Out of 10 Cats, Cats Does Countdown, Mock the Week and her Channel 4 sitcom, Pushers.

title: Rowan Hackett: Brewed
description: A show about one woman's complicated relationship with alcohol, reality and her family, illustrated through a love of the beautiful game. Full of clever one-liners and bags of self-deprecating wit, Brewed follows Rowan's journey from the carefree vodka and lemonade years through to IPA, parenthood and pizza crunch suppers. Rowan plays a pressing game with great dribbling, fast thinking and moments of genius. Her gung-ho style leaves her vulnerable to the counter-attack and she doesn't cope too well with balls into the box. But when she's on top of her game, she's a match for anyone!
content_warnings: Contains distressing or potentially triggering themes, Strong language/swearing, Buy a ticket in advance to guarantee entry or Pay What You Want at the venue
venue_name: Just The Tonic at The Caves

title: Royal Scottish Pipers' Society and Friends
description: Experience the rich traditions of Scottish piping with the Royal Scottish Pipers' Society and Friends at this special Fringe event. Featuring fine piping with guest performers to showcase the rich heritage and powerful melodies of Scotland's national instrument. Whether you're a lifelong piping fan or experiencing it for the first time, this is a great opportunity to enjoy authentic Scottish music in a welcoming setting. Guest performances will showcase a different range of instruments each show, such as voice, small pipes and fiddle playing.

title: Ruaridh Miller – Autocorrect Thinks My Name is "Rubbish"
description: 2025 ISH Best Show nominee. Come and see a one-of-a-kind at this year's Fringe: a self-loathing middle class person telling jokes. After earning a number of positive reviews from audiences and critics alike in 2025, Ruaridh returns with a brand-new hour covering topics such as gentrification, middle-class pets, hair loss, religion in football and people called Maureen. 'The audience loved him' (One4Review.co.uk). 'Sharp writing and natural charisma' (Comedy.co.uk). **** (One4Review.co.uk, BroadwayBaby.com, TheRealChrisParkle.com).

title: Ruby Carr: Bite Me
description: New silly stand up show from 'enchanting human shaped hurricane' (Edinburgh-Reviews.co.uk) Ruby Carr. Ruby has been promised a Hollywood smile from her dentist in 32 weeks. The NHS only has 12 to fix her OCD. Working on her teeth and her brain all means one thing – there’s a lot going on in her head. The plan is simple: fix her teeth, fix her life, so that she can move up a metaphorical floor in her head and finally fix that pesky mental health. Nominated: Best Show at Leicester Comedy Festival 2026.

title: Ruby Wax: Absolutely Famous
description: It's almost easier to say whom Ruby Wax didn't meet, interview and coax fascinating insights from in her huge TV shows Ruby Wax Meets and Full Wax.
