Donald Trump, OJ Simpson, Pamela Anderson, Madonna and many more. Her provocative, abrasive, incomparable style was – just about – kept in check by lifelong friend and A-list producer, Clive Tulloh. Together live on stage they review clips from the extraordinary shows, tell scandalous stories never before heard – and take the audience along for the ride. 'Fascinating' **** (Telegraph).

title: Ryan Cullen: Cullen Me Softly
description: Cullen Me Softly is a brand-new hour of sharp, pitch-black one-liners from a comic who isn’t afraid to stare directly into the world’s uglier corners. From the rise of racism in the UK to global tensions, cultural absurdities and the chaos unfolding in places like America, the show digs into the darker side of modern life with a grin and a scalpel. Cullen also turns that same uncompromising lens on his own upbringing, picking apart the moments – both grim and ridiculous – that shaped him. No topic is too bleak, no punchline wasted.
content_warnings: Audience participation, Strong language/swearing, Contains distressing or potentially triggering themes, Buy a ticket in advance to guarantee entry or Pay What You Want at the venue

title: Ryan Kenny: Some Words, In an Order, On a Stage
description: A bold alternative comedy show that refuses to sit quietly in any one genre. Blending poetry, props and absurdity, Ryan delivers an act that's inventive, unpredictable and genuinely unlike anything else on the circuit. Described as must-see and incredibly original, his comedy twists clever ideas into big laughs with playful confidence. Winner of Circuit Breaker 2024 and British Comedian of the Year runner-up 2024, Ryan is quickly becoming one of the most exciting new voices in comedy. Expect smart chaos, and unexpected moments.
content_warnings: Strong language/swearing, Buy a ticket in advance to guarantee entry or Pay What You Want at the venue
venue_name: Just The Tonic at The Caves

title: Ryan Mold: Resistant
description: A hilarious look at what happens when life changes faster than you can keep up. Relatable, warm and sharply funny stand-up about surviving the madness of modern times – one reluctant update at a time! 'Absolutely brilliant’ (Nick Helm). ‘Full of very funny and original jokes, a laugh-a-minute’ (LondonTheatre.co.uk). Keeps a room onside being laugh-out-loud funny. He’s a classic.

title: Sacred Arts Festival Church Service at Old Saint Paul’s Orthodox: Vespers
description: The 2026 Edinburgh Festival of the Sacred Arts concludes with Vespers, the Orthodox Church evening service which is traditionally held on Saturday evening as a preparation for Sunday. This beautiful liturgy of hymns, psalms and readings will be sung by the Sacred Arts Festival Singers under their director Calum Robertson. Some of the fine icons that have been gifted to Old Saint Paul’s will be on display, and the service will conclude with a reception to which everyone attending is invited.

title: Sacred Arts Festival Drama at St John’s Princes Street: Doctor Faustus
presented_by: Michael Daviot, Susan Chynoweth, Tim Barrow, Janet de Vigne
description: Christopher Marlowe’s famous tragedy, Doctor Faustus, was first performed around 1595, just a few years after the first translation into English of a medieval legend, about a doctor-turned-necromancer who makes a pact with the devil. Marlowe brilliantly examines Faustus’s grandiose, but ultimately futile, intellectual ambitions. This rehearsed reading featuring Michael Daviot as Faust, Susan Chynoweth as Mephisto, Tim Barrow as Wagner, with Felicity Cullen and Lizz Spence, is directed by Janet de Vigne. Tuesday 6-7pm pre-performance discussion in St John’s hosted by the Scottish Network for Religion and Literature.

title: Sacred Arts Festival Exhibition ‘Bordering on the Sacred’ at St Vincent's Chapel Undercroft
description: Curated by Edinburgh artists David Grossart and Carol Marples, this exhibition draws on specially selected works from artists across Scotland using some of the boundaries of traditional Christian artefacts – church doorways, altarpiece frames, cloisters, prayerbook bindings – as a frame of reference within which to present freshly resonating figurative or abstract visual images. Some works available for sale.

title: Sacred Arts Festival: Exploring Sacred Space at Magdalen Chapel
description: Opened in 1542 as a Catholic chapel for the fashionable area of Edinburgh's Cowgate, the Scottish Reformation of 1560 turned the Magdalen Chapel into the birthplace of Scottish Presbyterianism. Expert guides will relate the story of this fascinating building, explaining the many unusual features it has acquired both as a chapel and as the home of the Hammermen’s Guild. These include the oldest stained glass in Scotland, the famous Deacon’s Chair of 1708 and a spectacular chandelier, the 'essay' of a gifted hammerman apprentice. Organised in conjunction with National Churches Trust.

title: Sacred Arts Festival: Exploring Sacred Space at Old Saint Paul’s Memorial Chapel
description: Hard by Waverley Station, Old Saint Paul’s is home to Edinburgh’s oldest Episcopal congregation. The astonishing War Memorial was completed in 1926 and comprises a broad stone stair that rises to an almost life-size sculpted Calvary of grave beauty, and – over the stair – a chapel. Mark Gibson, author of a history of Old St Paul’s, conducts a tour of the building that inspired Alison Watt’s masterpiece Still, which hangs above the chapel’s stone altar. Exploring Sacred Space is organised in conjunction with the National Churches Trust.

title: Sacred Arts Festival: Exploring Sacred Space at Sacred Heart
description: The Church of the Sacred Heart of Jesus opened in 1860. The building is a relatively simple shape, but its interior is very striking – fourteen large paintings of the Stations of the Cross by the Bavarian artist Peter Rauth, all beautifully restored at the start of this century. In 2025 it gained magnificent new stained glass windows by Sarah Galloway, a contemporary artist renowned for her work in architectural glass. During these tours she will be talking about her work. Organised in conjunction with the National Churches Trust.

title: Sacred Arts Festival: Exploring Sacred Space at St James Goldenacre
presented_by: Dr Peter Burman and Ross Burgess
description: Just ten minutes walk from the Royal Botanic Garden, this beautiful church was designed by Scotland's 'premier architect', Robert Rowand Anderson. The rich interior includes the exceptional mural paintings and altarpiece by William Hole, Arts & Crafts stained glass, richly carved choirstalls and paving. Tour guide: Dr Peter Burman MBE FSA, architectural historian, and Ross Burgess, author of the guide to St James, Goldenacre (2025).

title: Sacred Arts Festival: Exploring Sacred Space at St Michael and All Saints
description: Tollcross is now an expensive place to live. When St Michael and All Saints was built, it was one of the poorest parts of the city. The church was founded for people with very little, yet nothing inside reflects that. Behind plain grey stone lies a lavish, uncompromising interior articulated in colour, gilding, and devotional imagery. On this tour, Rector Fr Oliver Brewer-Lennon invites visitors to discover a church that still startles, still contends, and still rewards close attention. Organised in conjunction with the National Churches Trust.

title: Sacred Arts Festival Film at St Vincent’s Undercroft: The Life of Moses
description: For the third time, join Richard Kendall as he introduces a silent film classic. This year it’s the landmark special effects driven blockbuster The Life of Moses (1909). Coming in at a gargantuan (for the era) 50 minutes, the popularity of this Vitagraph production was a significant milestone in showing that audiences would turn out for longer fare. This episodic account of the prophet’s life was directed by J Stuart Blackton.

title: Sacred Arts Festival Music at Canongate Kirk: Young Composers Competition Recital
presented_by: Cecilia McDowall, Sacred Arts Festival Singers
description: The third annual competition for young composers of sacred music concludes in the historic setting of the royal kirk of Holyrood House. The Sacred Arts Festival Singers under director Calum Robertson perform the winning compositions in the 2026 competition. Principal adjudicator Cecilia McDowall, one of the UK’s leading composers of sacred choral music, will comment on the winning compositions, and the programme will include some of her own compositions. Generously funded by Christian Arts Trust, Royal College of Organists, William Baird Ross Trust and Edinburgh Society of Organists.

title: Sacred Arts Festival Music at Old Saint Paul’s: To be a Pilgrim – Words and Music in Search of God
description: Pilgrimage, both literal and metaphorical, has long been, and still is, an important part of religious and contemplative life. In this event the acclaimed choir of Old Saint Paul's, under its director Dr John Kitchen MBE, performs a selection of hymns and anthems that give musical expression to spiritual pilgrimage. Drawn from works composed and written over the centuries, the music will be interspersed by poetry reflecting the same theme.

title: Sacred Arts Festival Music at Sacred Heart: O For a Thousand Tongues – Celebrating The Musical Wesleys
description: Sacred Arts Festival Singers, director Calum Robertson, organist Max Carsley, with brass ensemble from the Royal Conservatoire of Scotland. Marking 150 years since the death of Samuel Sebastian Wesley (1810-76). This celebration of the musical Wesleys’ rich legacy includes three commissioned pieces newly composed in their honour by the winners of the 2025 young composers’ competition. Generously supported by the Church Hymnary Trust, with commissions funded by the Scops Trust.

title: Sacred Arts Festival Music at St Giles': James Macmillan – Ninian
presented_by: Sir James Macmillan, Calum Robertson and Jack Oades
description: Ninian, a concerto for clarinet and orchestra with Calum Robertson playing clarinet and Jack Oades playing the organ. The three movements of this astonishing but rarely performed work, commissioned in 1997 to mark 1600 years since St Ninian, are based on some of the strange and evocative tales about the saint written many years after his death. Uniquely for this performance, the original orchestral part has been transcribed for organ by Jack Oades. The recital will be introduced by Sir James MacMillan.

title: Sacred Arts Festival Music at St John’s, Princes St: Tango Mass and Magnificat
description: Glasgow’s award-winning Mackintosh Choir (Patron Sir John Rutter) was established in 2011 and is based in St John’s-Renfield Church, Kelvindale, Glasgow. The choir is directed by Au Arias, a Glasgow-based composer originally from Argentina, and currently also musical director of the Anstruther Philharmonic choir. Premiered in Glasgow in 2024 to wide acclaim, Arias’s Tango Mass forms the principal work in this recital, together with the world premier of his newly composed Magnificat.

title: Sacred Arts Festival Music at St Mary’s Metropolitan Cathedral: Music for the Homeless Jesus
description: This recital is inspired by the recent installation outside the Cathedral of Homeless Jesus, a bronze sculpture by Timothy Schmalz depicting Jesus as a homeless person, sleeping on a park bench. Among other works, the programme will include the acclaimed composition Jesus' Blood Never Failed Me Yet, a 1971 composition by Gavin Bryars based on a loop of an unknown homeless man singing a brief improvised stanza.
venue_name: Cathedral Nave at St Mary's Catholic Cathedral

title: Sacred Arts Festival Music at St Vincent’s Chapel: A Hymn on Divine Musick – Britten's Baroque Songs
description: Sam Madden, tenor, and Will Sims, piano, conclude their critically acclaimed trilogy of recitals in the Edinburgh Festival of the Sacred Arts with a concert of baroque song. Featuring works by Henry Purcell, JS Bach, William Croft, Pelham Humfrey, Jeremiah Clarke and John Blow, in their realisations for tenor and piano by Benjamin Britten.

title: Sacred Arts Festival Poetry at Canongate Kirk: Young Religious Poets Competition Final
description: Winning entries in the 2026 Scotland-wide Young Religious Poets Competition with poetry by established poets Robert Crawford and Christine De Luca, and musical interludes by students from the Royal Conservatoire of Scotland. Organised in conjunction with the Scottish Poetry Library. Prizes generously funded by Canonmills Church.

title: Sacred Arts Festival Poetry at Canonmills Church: The Shamrock and the Cross – Spectators Under Heaven
presented_by: Michael Daviot, Claire McDonald and Janet de Vigne
description: The Irish poet John W Sexton’s phrase ‘spectators under heaven’ has inspired Michael Daviot, Claire McDonald and Janet de Vigne to present a wide-ranging selection of Irish poetry, drawing on both ancient and modern expressions of faith and spirituality. The intimacy of Canonmills Church – Robert Louis Stevenson’s schoolroom in times past – provides the perfect space.

title: Salt and Light
description: Lake Galilee, AD 30, and in the little fishing community of Capernaum, rumours of miracles and healings abound. Five members of one family struggle to make sense of the radical new teacher walking their shores. Who is this man? What is he? And what might it mean for them and their lives? Join us around the campfire for shanties, stories and spoken word – the tales of the first disciples. ‘Beautiful collection of stories – each one leading into the next in a way that was seamless and meaningful – outstanding!’ (Audience review, Spring Harvest).

title: Salty Brine: HOW STRANGE IT IS (The Neutral Milk Hotel Show)
presented_by: The Living Record Collection and Soho Theatre
description: Neutral Milk Hotel's indie-rock triumph In the Aeroplane Over the Sea and Anne Frank's stunning and candid The Diary of a Young Girl fuse with confessions from Salty's adolescent longings in this genre-defying cabaret with wit, spectacle and heart. Sparks fly, time bends, and the ghosts of our past return to us in this hilarious and devastating work from Salty's acclaimed and expansive Living Record Collection. 'Astounding' ***** (Stage). ***** (List). 'A storyteller in total command of voice, a cocked eyebrow and his audience' **** (Guardian).
content_warnings: Audience participation, Scenes of a sexual nature, Haze

title: Sam Eley is Basil Crumbwick: Soul Sewage
description: Say hello to a horrid bloke. Award-winning late-night villainy from an uncomfortable mind. 'I was in danger of throwing up from laughing' (Tim Harding, Chortle.co.uk). 'A virtuoso display of comic writing' (Steve Bennett, Chortle.co.uk). Winner of Sketch-Off 2025. Leicester Square New Comedian of the Year finalist.
content_warnings: Audience participation, Strong language/swearing, Buy a ticket in advance to guarantee entry or Pay What You Want at the venue

title: Sam Lake: Drop Zone Three Please, Ben (WIP)
description: Award-winning stand-up Sam Lake brings an hour of new work-in-progress material, which may be inspired by an unhealthy obsession with daytime TV and British gameshows. Or it might not be about that... Tour support for Ed Gamble, Suzi Ruffel, Tom Lucy and Harriet Kemsley. As seen on BBC Scotland, All 4 and U&Dave. Best Reviewed Comedy Show – Fringe 2025 (Comedy.co.uk). 'An absolute delight' (LMAOnaiseComedy.com). 'Sam Lake is a master of his craft' (FringeSider.com). 'Lake deserves a bigger stage these days – I defy you not to laugh' (TheatreAndArtReviews.com).
content_warnings: Buy a ticket in advance to guarantee entry or Pay What You Want at the venue

title: Sam Nicoresti: Baby Doomer
description: A glistening swan-song for the triumphant Edinburgh Comedy Awards Best Show 2025. A swaggering, diamond-sharp hour about being trans (uh-oh) and the hunt for the perfect skirt suit. 'Uproariously funny, life-affirming, angry, dumb, insightful and political all at once' (Chortle.co.uk). Nominated Best Show at Leicester Comedy Festival, Runner Up NextUp's Biggest Award in Comedy ***** (Telegraph). ***** (List). ***** (BingeFringe.com). ***** (One4Review.co.uk). ****½ (Chortle.co.uk). **** (Guardian). **** (Scotsman). **** (TheComicsComic.com).
content_warnings: This show contains distressing or potentially triggering themes, strong language and references to transphobia, mental health, and fire.

title: Same Same but Different
description: The show that’s never the same show twice. Sam Adamson, surreal observationalist comedian, and Stacey Edwards, irrepressible musical comedian, (West End New Act finalists) are looking for a third. But whose keys will they claim from the bowl? Joined by a different hand-selected mystery guest act every night for an hour of riotous frisky fun, raucous frivolity and boisterous banter. There will be music, games and sex jokes galore. Strap in lads – it’s time for a frolic.

title: Sami Abu Wardeh Hates You
description: It seems hate is the sole domain of the far right, and Sami asks – can people who care start hating again? Can hate help us? And most importantly – can hate be funny? Award-winning comedian, clown and very silly man, Sami Abu Wardeh, returns with a chaotic exploration of the value of hate today. 'The rockstar voice of the Palestinian diaspora' (Alexei Sayle). 'Defiantly goofy' ***** (Guardian). 'A virtuoso display' ***** Rolling Stone. 'A rare exception' **** (Chortle.co.uk).
content_warnings: This show will contain strong language and distressing or potentially triggering themes surrounding war and displacement.

title: SAND
description: Set against the dramatic backdrop of Devon’s coastline, SAND follows Dylan and Heather as they navigate the complexities of living with dementia. Together, they uncover profound truths about love, memory and resilience, while coastal erosion symbolises life’s inevitable changes. Created by the acclaimed Kook Ensemble, Sand is a non-verbal circus theatre show that blends acrobatic skill with meticulously crafted storytelling. Through visually striking, emotionally resonant performances, the company brings the experiences of people living with dementia to life, offering audiences a deeply moving experience. A must watch!
content_warnings: Contains distressing or potentially triggering themes: dementia, death and grief

title: Sandy Not Just on Sunday
description: Legendary accordion player and all-round funny guy Sandy Brechin brings his hilarious musical character comedy show back to the Fringe for a fourth year. Featuring ten different characters from his weekly Facebook show Sandy on Sunday, comic songs and amazing tunes, one stuffed dog on wheels and even a free raffle in the interval! Intermission music between costume changes supplied by a disparate group of highly unprofessional assistants. A glorious view over the city and a well-stocked bar in the luxurious surroundings of the Lochrin Rooftop Bar, Moxy Fountainbridge, may help you survive the show!

title: Sarah Bradley: How to Write a Romcom
description: Ever wished life was more like a movie? Join romantic comedy scholar Sarah Bradley as she takes you through a journey of comforting cliches, timeless tropes, falling-in-love montages and predictable endings. We'll attempt to answer the big questions (can enemies really become lovers? Is working in print media the real secret to finding love? Can you choose yourself and still get a happily ever after?), while coming up with a love story all our own. Reality is overrated anyway.

title: Sarah Hester Ross: Serving C*nt
description: Powerhouse vocals. Unfiltered comedy. Cabaret chaos. Sarah Hester Ross brings her viral songs and razor-sharp humour to a one-woman show that's part concert, part confessional and all hilarious. With over 3 million followers online, catch the internet sensation live onstage and find out what it really means to serve c*nt. Sarah Hester Ross is an internationally touring cabaret artist and viral social media creator whose musical comedy blends bold feminist takes with powerhouse vocals and sharp-as-hell satire.

title: Sarah Roberts: Scary Movie 7
description: Do you think we’re ever truly forgiven? Sarah has never gotten over anything. Not because she’s annoying, because she’s cursed. Oh, and she needs your soul for something. Nothing bad OK!! BBC New Comedy Awards regional finalist, One of The Guardian’s funniest comedians of the Fringe 2024, Rolling Stone’s Rising Stars of 2024 and Chortle Award-nominated shitposter. 'Mischievous, playful and very loveable' ***** (EdFringeReview.com). 'Razor-sharp' ***** (TheReviewsHub.com). 'Riotously funny' **** (The Student). 'Phenomenal new talent, destined for stardom' (Catherine Bohart). 'Irresistible fun' (Rolling Stone).
content_warnings: Strong language/swearing, Contains references to mental health, mature themes and distressing or potentially triggering themes, Buy a ticket in advance to guarantee entry or Pay What You Want at the venue

title: Sasha Graham's Ghost Stories and Tarot
description: Tarot cards are a gateway to the supernatural. Best-selling tarot author and horror actress Sasha Graham transports audiences to a haunted loft in 1992 New York City with real life, creepy ghost stories and interactive audience tarot readings in a show that asks, what haunts you?
content_warnings: Audience participation, Contains distressing or potentially triggering themes, Buy a ticket in advance to guarantee entry or Pay What You Want at the venue
venue_name: Just The Tonic at The Caves

title: Sashi Perera – Pear Tree
description: Sashi's surname – Perera – means pear tree in Portuguese. You won't believe how mad Portugal gets if you mention why it's a super common name in Sri Lanka hehe. Pear Tree is a stand up comedy show about pear-shaped events between Sri Lanka and Australia. It's about family, love, homes, knives and cats – spliced with a bit of geopolitics and singing. Sashi is a Sri Lankan Australian comedian, writer and recovering lawyer, one of Australia's fastest rising comedians, known for her sharp wit, unique tales and bizarre insights.
space_name: Just The Tonic at The Subway

title: Saving Britney
description: Millennials like Jean grew up with Britney Spears. Over the course of an hour see how the princess of pop influenced Jean's life and how the connections shared between them lead to an unbelievable moment of self-discovery. Inspired by the #FreeBritney movement, the 2022 WhatsOnStage Award-nominated hit off-Broadway production is back to take an hilarious and heart-breaking look at celebrity obsession, sexuality and growing up in the early noughties: featuring more nostalgia than you can shake a Tamagochi at! 'Roushbaiani delivers a true masterclass' ***** (BroadwayBaby.com).
content_warnings: Contains distressing or potentially triggering themes, Strobe lighting, Strong language/swearing

title: Sax Appeal 2026
description: Enjoy a relaxing hour away from Fringe frenzy with Scotland’s popular Hume Saxophone Quartet. Since their first Fringe appearance in 2004, the Hume have been entertaining audiences around Scotland with their enthusiastic mix of light jazz, classics, ragtime and easy-listening music. With a repertoire that covers music from Miller to Mancini and Bach to The Beatles, there’s bound to be something for everyone.

title: Scallywankers
description: Join Davvy Scabies on our tongue-in-cheek, adult only, panto inspired adventure. With unhelpful heroes, questionable magic and lots of audience engagement, Scallywankers is ready to take you on a riotous adventure you won’t soon forget. Whether you’re here for the nonsense, the naughtiness or the narrative, there’s something for everyone to grab onto (pun intended). With re-written songs and unbelievably crude jokes, you might need a drink (or five). So buckle up, settle in and prepare to set sail.
content_warnings: Audience participation, Scenes of a sexual nature, Strong language/swearing

title: Scary Queen of Scots
description: We have all dreamed about being famous as children. Gill dreamt about being switched at birth and one day her family, a royal family, would come get her... 50 years on, it still hasn't happened. Gill's life, like Mary Queen of Scots, has had some misadventures, terrible failed relationships and near-death experiences. But unlike Mary, Gill won't lose her head. She's ready to claim the throne and pronounce herself the Queen of Scottish Comedy. A fun show that looks at thwarted dreams and failed ambitions.

title: Schalk Bezuidenhout: Hey Hey Divorcè
description: Schalk Bezuidenhout is back with a brand-new show. His first and (hopefully, for the love of all things good) only show post divorce. Schalk hasn't checked in with you all in some time and he wants to talk to you. Actually... he needs to talk to you! Why? Because it's cheaper than therapy. That's why! 'Rapid-fire gags and manic energy. Highly recommended' **** (TheAge.com.au). As seen on Amazon Prime, Netflix and Comedy Central. Arena tour support for Trevor Noah. ***** (EdFringeReview.com). **** (Mervyn Stutter's Pick of the Fringe). **** (BroadwayBaby.com). 'Fast-rising talent' (Guardian).

title: Scotland in Song
description: Robert Sim and Bernie Hewitt of the Terrific Trouble Ceilidh Band return to the Fringe following their 2025 show, Ceilidh in the Speakeasy, with an hour of Scottish songs and the stories behind them. Spanning centuries of tradition, this relaxed, family-friendly show welcomes all ages. Sit back and listen, or join in and sing along, as Scotland’s rich history comes vividly to life through music.
venue_name: The Speakeasy at The Royal Scots Club

title: Scotland’s Songs and Music
description: The Terrific Trouble Ceilidh Band return to the Speakeasy with a lively, fun-filled family show that is guaranteed to get your toes tapping. Sit back and enjoy music from your favourite ceilidh dances, alongside traditional Scottish songs you can join in with. You might even discover why the train ran away, or what really happened with Aunty Mary and a canary!
venue_name: The Speakeasy at The Royal Scots Club

title: Scott Manley Hadley: Bald Personality Disorder
presented_by: Scott Manley Hadley AKA SOLID BALD / PBH's Free Fringe
description: No hair. No worries. Well, some worries... Alternative comedy show on mental health, hair loss, gender, money and parenting. Includes sequins, thighs, an interactive bald-themed quiz, poetry, costumes, original music. Scott Manley Hadley, AKA SOLID BALD, is a poet turned comedian who has been Highly Commended in the Forward Prizes for Poetry and whose blog, TriumphOfTheNow.com, has been quoted in the New Yorker. Scott has appeared as a talking head discussing hair loss on BBC Three. Leicester Square Theatre New Act of the Year 2025 semi-finalist. Bald but not forgotten.
content_warnings: Audience participation, Contains distressing or potentially triggering themes

title: Scottish Family Panto Fun with Mr ButtonZ and The Buttons Show!
presented_by: The Buttons Show starring Mr Buttonz
description: Join legendary Scottish family entertainer Mr ButtonZ for an hour of magical family fun! Returning with a brand-new show after a sell-out 2025 run at the worlds largest arts festival! Featuring amazing puppets, fabulous stories, dazzling magic and live music with catchy Scottish sing-along songs including his big hits Oh Ye Canny Shove Yir Granny Aff The Bus, My Bonnie Lies over the Ocean and The Hokey Kokey! All ages love The Buttons Show Oh yes they will! Mr ButtonZ is hilarious for adults as well as kids!

title: Scottish Food and Drink Walking Tour
description: Enjoy a glamorous gin cocktail with smoked salmon canapes in a stylish pink velvet-seat cocktail bar, ruby, white and tawny port paired with local chocolates in Scotland’s oldest wine shop, gelato from Perthshire, a walk along Edinburgh’s most photographed street and single malt paired with a robust island cheddar from a speakeasy bar. This food safari equals a good lunch – four stops – with architectural and historical amuse-bouches such as 'why are there so many painted windows in the New Town'?
content_warnings: Audience required to walk or move around during the performance

title: Scottish Lieder with Brian Bannatyne-Scott, Jamie MacDougall and Susan Hamilton
description: A delightful afternoon concert in a beautiful venue, the New Town Church in George Street, presenting German Lieder by Schubert, Schumann, Loewe and Strauss – all inspired by Scottish poets including Burns, Scott and Ossian. The distinguished Scottish bass, Brian Bannatyne-Scott, has been performing in the International Festival and the Fringe for many years to packed audiences and is joined this year by two star compatriots in Susan Hamilton (soprano) and Jamie MacDougall (tenor), accompanied by the Scottish-based Polish pianist Michal Gajzler. Not to be missed!

title: Scout Boxall: God's Favourite
description: Melbourne International Comedy Festival 2025 Most Outstanding Show nominee, Pinder Prize winner. Stranded in regional Victoria without medication for the first time in 12 years, Scout pulls out all the psychological stops to survive the worst night of their life. An exquisite, darkly funny retelling of a harrowing mental marathon through manic withdrawal; Scout imagines life in the Middle Ages, trawls the strange crevices of the internet, makes peace with their own mediocrity and (briefly) surrenders to God. Part storytelling, part stand-up, all raw and unflinchingly real. ***** (Time Out). **** (Chortle.co.uk). **** (List).
content_warnings: Contains distressing or potentially triggering themes, Strobe lighting, Strong language/swearing

title: Sean Morley: Backchannel
description: The future has arrived. Mouth wet and eyes hungry. Elusive comedy cherub and fully adult citizen, Sean Morley has reinvented comedy for the slurried minds of broken Britain. You can say anything these days. 'Brilliant, best thing I’ve seen at the fringe' (Chortle.co.uk). 'A one-of-a-kind comedian' **** (Skinny). 'Masterfully executed' **** (TheWeeReview.com). 'Something you will never forget' **** (Scotsman). 'Defies any sort of description... joyful, wonderful fun' (Guardian).
content_warnings: Buy a ticket in advance to guarantee entry or Pay What You Want at the venue

title: Searching for Robert Hennessey
description: A little boy answers every doorbell hoping it's his daddy. Decades later, after surviving sexual abuse, cult indoctrination and a terminal AIDS diagnosis, that boy – now a man – still hasn't stopped searching. Armed with a name his teenage mother gave him and unwavering determination, Michael calls every Robert Hennessey he can find, chases DNA matches, tries Beetlejuicing the guy into existence and never gives up hope. Until Father's Day 2020 brings a Facebook message shattering everything he thought he knew about his identity and his quest. Hollywood Fringe's sold-out sensation comes to Edinburgh.
content_warnings: Audience participation, Contains distressing or potentially triggering themes

title: Seasons
description: In a city not too far from here, there is a park that's been there for years. Welcome to Willow Park! Come and meet Parker the Parkkeeper and his cat Clover as they tell you the story of Maggie and Mylo the magpies. Cardboard Box Theatre Company presents this lively, musical puppet show which explores the importance of community and families in times of grief (specifically miscarriage) in sensitive and age-appropriate ways. Seasons is for audiences and loved ones of all ages; from those who are here, to the ones up above.
content_warnings: Contains distressing or potentially triggering themes, More information

title: SeedHeart
description: Don’t miss this extraordinary one-of-a-kind puppet performance… a small show with big ideas! Meet Grey. Our journey begins as Grey finds themself trapped inside a jar, unable to remember why, and wondering how to be free… Watch Grey’s story unfold (literally!) from a single suitcase, on a journey towards a brighter future, with magical pop-ups, puppetry and shadows. SeedHeart tells the important tale of how Earth changed since humans came along, with interactive chaos in the laboratory on the way!

title: Sekoya
description: Following a sold-out debut at Ronnie Scott’s, Sekoya presents new compositions, crafting flowing, evolving textures where subtle melodies intertwine with soulful grooves. Their dynamic, improvisational interplay combines energy and nuance, creating an immersive, genre-defying musical experience. Two shows only!

title: Self Censored
description: When does self-censorship stop protecting you and start erasing you? Inside a fractured subconscious, a chaotic drag persona and an overprotective childhood plushie battle over buried secrets. Developed at Leeds Conservatoire and premiered at Leeds Theatre Festival 2024, Self Censored blends raw, personal storytelling with live original music to explore autism, masculinity and the exhausting performance of fitting in – offering an unfiltered glimpse into a mind caught between self-protection and self-expression.

title: Selina Mosinski: Puss in Boots – A Working Class Fairy Tale
description: Before she was serving immortal lines as viral icon Charity Shop Sue, Selina Mosinski was Randy Cain: an 18-year-old stripper from Derby with a big personality, bigger ambition and zero intention of staying small-town. Part confessional-memoir, part riotous surreal character-comedy, Puss In Boots is a Working Class Fairy Tale. A darkly-funny, glitter-stained confession about how far we'll go – and how low we'll sink – in the name of fame and fortune.
content_warnings: This show contains strong language, nudity and scenes of a sexual nature.

title: Serious Nonsense
description: Funny, horrible and just a bit naughty, Ben Macpherson brings the perfect gateway to your Fringe afternoon back to Edinburgh, for its fourth year. Serious Nonsense is a free poetry show for all ages, packed with energetic rhymes, masterful storytelling and laugh-out-loud moments. Grab a seat and prepare to meet the awful adults, beastly brats and curious creatures from this verbal tour de force. If you liked Roald Dahl or Spike Milligan growing up, then this is the show for you. 'Full of humour and drive' (Michael Rosen). 'Ben Macpherson is a joy' (Caroline Bird).
venue_name: PBH's Free Fringe @ Greek Gyros Grill

title: Sex, Drugs and Conscious Souls
presented_by: Cognitive Behavioural Theatre / PBH's Free Fringe
description: A pastor and a prostitute walk into a bar... three years later they’ve written a show about their unlikely love story built upon polyamorous throuples, magic truffles and the bursting of religious bubbles. He was a married, conservative, protestant pastor with a tight foreskin. She’s a pansexual, polyamorous performer offering tantric massages on an escort website. Join a pair of ADHD hippies over-sharing a true story of undergoing a cliche spiritual awakening, healing from religious trauma and mental ill health while exploring society's stigmas around sex, drugs and new age consciousness.
content_warnings: Contains distressing or potentially triggering themes, Scenes of a sexual nature, Strong language/swearing

title: Sex! with Becky Fury
description: Late-night cult classic in the making by an award-winning comic, ex dominatrix erotic hypnotist and walking human interest story! Confessional, freaky and outrageously funny stuff about weird, wild and wacky sex. 'A tremendous talent' **** (OnTheMic.co.uk).

title: Sexy Circus Sideshow 3.0
description: If you're after a thrilling, late night alternative circus, you've come to the right place! Sexy Circus Sideshow has been wowing audiences for 25 years globally. Recharged and reloaded for 2026. 3.0 Baby! Exotic acts that connect the underbelly of circus with the dark arts of fetish, burlesque and cabaret performance. A carnival cavalcade of saucy showgirls, sexy circus stunts, neurotic novelty and vaudeville variety at its very best! All-new show. A vibrant, colourful experience showcasing some of the weirdest and most wonderful talent in Edinburgh this year. Sell-out runs. Enough said?
content_warnings: Audience participation, Scenes of a sexual nature

title: Seymour Mace Is Covered In Stickers!
description: The stickers have words on. The words refer to bits. The bits could be anything! Satire, surrealism, stupidity, spangles, spaceships, soups, something in a bag! You say the words, he'll do the bits. That's it. ***** (Times). ***** (One4Review.co.uk). ***** (Entertainment-Now.com). 'A true original' (TheWeeReview.com). 'Bananas!' (Chortle.co.uk). Edinburgh Comedy Award nominee.

title: Seymour Mace's Other Show!
description: It's the last week! We're all f*cked! Join me and whatever mates I can wrangle for an hour of being stupid. With a real last day of term vibe anything could happen! Songs, sketches, jokes (old and new), puppets, paper planes, penguin chat, impressions, implosions, arguments, farguments, fishing weights, fortune telling and fun fun FUN!! Please feel free to bring games in case you get bored but not Kerplunk because I'm bringing that. ***** (Times). ***** (One4Review.co.uk). ***** (Entertainment-Now.com). 'A true original' (TheWeeReview.com). 'Bananas!' (Chortle.co.uk). Edinburgh Comedy Awards nominee.

title: Sh!t-faced Shakespeare®: Hamlet
description: The five-star, multi-sell-out, Fringe phenomenon is back! With its hilarious combination of an entirely serious adaptation of Shakespeare's Hamlet and an absolutely sh!t-faced actor! It just wouldn't be the Fringe without it. With a genuinely inebriated cast member each night, no two shows are ever the same in this raucous, riotous rampage through one of Shakespeare's darkest plays. This show features a rotating cast of the finest classically trained actors, partial nudity, foul language, acts of a sexual nature and actual Shakespeare. Please remember to always #EnjoyShakespeareResponsibly.
content_warnings: Audience participation, Contains distressing or potentially triggering themes, Nudity, Scenes of a sexual nature, Scenes of violence, Strong language/swearing, Please note there is a real live drunken actor in this performance.

title: Shadows, Mirrors, Echoes
description: In seeking to explore how social media defines our reality, this play reimagines the story of Narcissus and Echo for the social media age. Weaving in Plato's allegory of the cave, we ask questions of the nature of the reality we glimpse through the screens of our phones. At what point does reflection become distortion and what is left behind as a digital echo once the screen has been turned off? How easily does the illusion of reality we see projected towards us consume and devour us – are we willing participants or slaves to the algorithm?

title: Shaggers
description: Following more sell-out shows at festivals and theatres worldwide, the popular show returns with a huge variety of comedians of all styles, sexes, and genders doing hilarious material based around sex and relationships. 'The perfect way to close a night at the festival' ***** (Funny Tonne, Melbourne). 'Mischievous and unburdened comedy' ***** (Voicemag.uk). 'Utterly hilarious' ****½ (TheWest.com.au). 'Cannot recommend it enough' **** (Herald Sun).

title: ShakeItUp: The Improvised Shakespeare Show
presented_by: ShakeItUp Theatre in association with Benjamin Alborough
description: Shakespeare hasn't written anything new for an age, so we thought we would give him a hand... Using his language, your audience suggestions and our overactive imaginations, we create a brand new Shakespeare play live on stage, complete with big laughs, high drama, and plenty of Bard-based Bedlam! 'Quick-witted, inexhaustible and absolutely hysterical' ***** (LondonTheatreReviews.co.uk). 'Brilliantly bonkers! One of the best improvised shows at the Fringe' ***** (WestEndBestFriend.co.uk). 'Masters of improv, brilliant fun for all' ***** (TheatreScotland.co.uk). 'This is a must see' ***** (AYoungishPerspective.co.uk).

title: Shakespeare for Breakfast
description: The Bardic Breakfasters are back with a brand-new show, breakfast included! Fringe favourites since 1992, C theatre’s sensational Shakespearience returns for another year of pentameter, puns and pastries. Perfect for hardened fans and blank verse virgins alike. ‘A bouncy and boisterous take on Willie’s work’ (List). ‘Well worth getting out of bed for’ (Independent). ‘No holds Bard ‘(FringeGuru.com). ‘Irreverent humour... clever’ (Stage). ‘Side-splitting... glorious’ (BroadwayBaby.com). ‘Full of fun’ (RemoteGoat.com). ‘Sizzling’ (ScottishDailyExpress.co.uk). Free coffee and croissants! Fringe favourite since 1992. Book early.
venue_name: C ARTS | C venues | C aurora

title: Shakespeare's Dead Dames
description: After their in-performance deaths, six female Shakespearean characters find themselves in a holding area until the play they are a character in gets revived by another Shakespeare company so that they can (re)live their tragedy over (and over) again.

title: Shakespeare x 5
description: Surprised by the audience and completely unprepared, two clowns grab the only story everyone knows: Romeo and Juliet. What begins as a funny mission to be understood soon turns into a wild whirlwind of imagination. You don't just watch, you become part of the chaos. This high-speed scramble is a real display of physical skill. But as the laughter peaks, the fun turns into a fierce rebellion – the one that lives inside us all. It's funny until it's not. A provocative, heart-wrenching finale that asks what remains among the ruins. Fearless, absurd and unforgettable.

title: Shamilton! The Improvised Hip-Hop Musical
description: Baby Wants Candy's 2024-2025 total sell-out hip-hop hit returns! We improvise an epic musical based on a historical figure/celebrity of your choosing (Genghis Khan, Paul Hollywood, Kim Kardashian, anyone!). Just like Hamilton but (ahem) better! Expect the same level of hip hop, storytelling, stunning choreography and powerhouse singing, except made up on the spot. 'An absolute extravaganza, absolute pinnacle of improv. They freestyle lyrics that rival Lin-Manuel himself. Tremendously impressive, side-splittingly funny to the point oxygen becomes a luxury. Shamilton astounded me' ***** (Entertainment-Now.com). 'Brilliant' **** (Guardian). 'Cease and desist!' (Lin-Manuel Miranda).
content_warnings: Audience participation, Scenes of a sexual nature, Strong language/swearing

title: Shane Daniel Byrne: Baby It's Time
description: Shane Daniel Byrne is a fast-rising Irish comedian celebrated for his sharp writing, playful absurdity and effortlessly engaging stage presence. Hailing from Ireland, he has built a strong reputation on the national comedy circuit with a style that blends candid storytelling, observational humour and unexpected punchlines. His material often draws on personal experiences, modern life and social quirks, delivered with warmth and self-awareness. In addition, Byrne is also an accomplished writer and performer whose fresh voice and confident charisma continue to win over audiences at clubs, festivals and comedy showcases throughout Ireland and beyond.

title: Shanghai Encore! No Script, No Net, No Regrets!
description: Direct from the cosmopolitan Magic City, a collective of wildly talented musical improvisers make their UK debut this summer. Each night, audiences experience an unscripted, ever-evolving musical comedy – no two shows are ever the same! This international ensemble – hailing from France, the US, China, Italy and the UK – spins up movie-style musical storylines, singing competitions and full-blown improvised musicals. Backed by live musicians, the music veers from funk, jazz, hip-hop, pop, to R&B. Come laugh at us – or with us! No net! No regrets!

title: Shantify
description: This nautical musical adventure starring a crew of West End wonder boys was the talk of Fringe 2025. Join us as we turn show tunes, rock classics and pop bangers into superb sea shanties and weave them into a joyous story. You will not want to miss the rib-tickling brilliance of the songs that we Shantify – the harmonies these boys produce will knock your socks off! Last year's show sold out and audiences raved about the show, so don't miss out on the hottest, funnest, shanty-est show at the Fringe!

title: Shaolin Clown
description: A non-verbal physical comedy show. A Shaolin monk relives his childish and clownish soul in his Zen practice, discovering a world always full of surprises and finds its meaning in seemingly insignificant little things. Freely inspired by the book Shaolin: You Don't Have to Fight to Win by Bernhard Moestl. Suitable for all ages, nationalities and members of the audience with hearing impairment. Avignon Off 2025, IAPAR (India) 2024, Prague Fringe 2024.

title: Sharon Wanjohi: A Perfect Life
description: If I were born today, I'd play life strategically. No messy dreams. No embarrassing phases. No "finding myself" in Bali. Just a clean, efficient existence with minimal emotional turbulence. So, I designed the perfect life: low-risk career, conflict-free relationships, hobbies that can't humiliate me. But as the plan gets safer, life gets... suspiciously bland. A chaotic, high-energy hour about fear, control and accidentally optimising yourself into irrelevance. Chortle Best Newcomer Nominee 2025, as seen on Off Menu. 'Wickedly delicious' ***** (AYoungishPerspective.co.uk), **** (List), **** (BroadwayWorld.com).

title: Shatter Resistant
description: Shatter Resistant is a darkly comic one-woman show exploring the frustrations of modern life. Thirty-year-old Cassie is having a tough time of it lately; she’s just lost her job to an AI chatbot and her life is imploding from every angle. Cassie is forced on an odyssey of self-discovery and begins to question why she puts up with crappy jobs, terrible dates and psycho flatmates. Why can’t she say no? Knock after knock, the cracks begin to show. Maybe Cassie won’t be able to keep her positive mental attitude after all.
content_warnings: Contains distressing or potentially triggering themes

title: Shaun Guff: Enuff Is Enuff
description: My name is Shaun Guff and I’ve hit rock bottom so you don’t have to. My sensational, self-funded seminar promises* to give you the metaphorical hammer to start nailing your life. (*No promises). Join Clementine Bogg-Hargroves with her 'Yorkshire-based robustness and sunny charm' **** (Scotsman), in this very serious seminar filled with pyrotechnics, PowerPoint presentations and personality. Creator and star of SKANK (The Times Critics Choice Edinburgh Fringe 2021) and the critically acclaimed Please Love Me, 2023. 'Winning humour and infectious irreverence' **** (TheStage.co.uk). 'Infectious wit' **** (List). 'Nothing is perfect' ***** (BroadwayBaby.com).
content_warnings: Audience participation, Strong language/swearing, What You Can in advance from the following prices to guarantee entry or turn up at the venue for free, with the option of donating at the end of the show.

title: Sherlock Holmes: The Death and Life
description: A fantasy based upon fiction, which finds Arthur Conan Doyle tiring of "his" intolerably arrogant Sherlock Holmes and inventing the arch villain, Moriarty, to kill him. But Doyle's dangerous strategy, combined with his passion for raising spirits of the dead, has rather more surreal and dramatic consequences than bargained for. A light-hearted and intriguing investigation of the consequences when fictional characters take on lives and ambitions of their own, against the wishes of the author. In this wryly humorous one-man tale of murder and mystery, the world's greatest detective refuses to leave the stage!

title: Sherlock Holmes: The Speckled Band
description: A dying woman’s mysterious last words and a plea for help from her sister lead Sherlock Holmes and Doctor Watson to a crumbling country house. How did a young woman die there with no obvious cause of death, and why does her sister believe she will be next? With a seemingly locked room mystery on his hands, Holmes must solve one of the darkest and most baffling cases of his career. Adapted from the short story by Arthur Conan Doyle, this is Sherlock Holmes at his finest!

title: Shine
description: Part satire, part existential meltdown, Shine is a high-energy comedy about clawing your way out of the rat race. It follows one woman's wildly overconfident quest to "shine" in a system designed to crush her. At its centre is a hilariously delusional, self-declared genius who is absolutely certain she can do everything better than everyone else. Packed with laughs and sharp social critique, this show takes the toxic girlboss off her pedestal and asks if ambition is even worth the burnout.
content_warnings: Audience participation, Strong language/swearing, Buy a ticket in advance to guarantee entry or Pay What You Want at the venue
venue_name: Just The Tonic at The Hive

title: Shinjuku
description: Abby works three jobs. Her bills keep going up, her car keeps breaking down and her 12 year old, Baxter, keeps growing. When she’s summoned to school to talk about her son’s behaviour, her carefully constructed world topples. Baxter's teacher fears he’s been radicalised by the manosphere. Abby’s astounded – all she’s ever tried to do is equip him to stand up for women’s rights. Headteacher Sam offers support. But Abby and Sam have unfinished business. How far will Abby go to protect what matters most? A darkly funny exploration of women’s choices in a man’s world.
content_warnings: Scenes of a sexual nature, Strong language/swearing

title: Shoot From The Hip
description: The award-winning 3m follower sensation hits Edinburgh Fringe, taking McEwan Hall by storm! With unscripted masterpieces, unhinged performances and unstoppable self-confidence, see the most followed improvisers on Earth, before they make history this October as the first UK improv group to ever headline the Hammersmith Apollo. 'Pitched to perfection' ***** (TheReviewsHub.com). 'Jaw-achingly funny' ***** (BookmarksAndStages.home.blog). 'A hilarious hour... leaving you pleading for more' **** (BroadwayBaby.com). 'Quick-witted and fast on their feet' **** (BroadwayWorld.com). 'Truly incredible' **** (LittleLarkofLondon.com). Recommended by The Herald, Metro, Evening Standard and Time Out.

title: #SHORN by Elsa McTaggart
description: #SHORN presented by the highly talented Elsa McTaggart accompanied by Gary Lister. Celebrating 15 years of touring and five-star Fringe performances, this show features original song, eclectic musical styles and spoken anecdotes. Drawing on a lifetime of shared music-making, the duo perform with warmth, humour and artistry. #SHORN signifies a coming of age, shedding the old and embracing the new. This is a rare opportunity to see Elsa at her most unique and vulnerable state as she invites audiences to share in a captivating celebration of creativity, passion and the transformative power of music.

title: Shotgunned
description: Equal parts hilarious and heartbreaking, Matt Anderson's Shotgunned is a relatable and intimate piece of theatre about how the people we lose can shape who we become. Described by The Stage as 'a cleverly composed, superbly performed, achingly moving two-hander'. ***** (Stage). 'Shotgunned is empathetic, heartfelt, and endearing all at once' (WestEndBestFriend.co.uk). Following a sold-out run in 2024, Shotgunned returns to the Edinburgh Festival Fringe as part of the 2026 Made in Scotland showcase. MadeInScotlandShowcase.com
content_warnings: Contains distressing or potentially triggering themes, Strong language/swearing

title: Showstopper! The Improvised Musical
description: The Olivier Award-winning West End smash hit and Fringe favourite is back! The Showstoppers improvise a hilarious new musical every show, totally inspired by audience suggestions, in ‘the funniest improv on the Fringe’ (BroadwayBaby.com). The mind-blowing, must-see phenomenon where it’s opening night of the hottest musical in town... every night! With over 1,500 hilarious made-up musicals to their name, The Showstoppers never perform the same show twice. 'So polished, it defies belief' ***** (Telegraph). 'A consistent audience favorite for a reason.' ***** (Playbill). 'Achingly funny... worth seeing again and again.' ***** (Time Out).
content_warnings: Due to the improvised nature of this show, there may be occasional strong language.

title: Shrek the Musical Jnr
description: The Talentz Musical Theatre Company proudly returns for its 11th year with the much-loved family musical, Shrek Jnr. Everyone’s favourite ogre is back, joined by a host of unforgettable fairytale characters, in this hilarious and heart-warming stage adaptation of the Oscar-winning smash hit film. Packed with catchy songs, colourful costumes and plenty of laugh-out-loud moments, Shrek Jnr celebrates friendship, bravery and the importance of being yourself. This high-energy production showcases the incredible talent and dedication of our young performers and creative team. Join us for an unforgettable theatrical adventure that promises fun for the whole family.

title: Shrink Wrapped: A Psychologist Analyses Comedians Live
description: Comedy and psychology unite for the most entertaining therapy session you'll ever witness. Ever been deep in a therapy session and gone: I want to know what the hell she's thinking? Well, now's your chance... with comedians in the hot seat. Three comedians and a therapist come together for a live therapy session unlike any other. 'Shrink Wrapped changes the game' ***** (FringeFeed.com.au). 'Some say laughter is the best therapy. Shrink Wrapped gives us both. Don’t miss it' **** (Mix 102.3, Adelaide). 'A perfect blend of comedy and analysis' **** (List).

title: Sid Singh: Love Bombing
description: Award-winning comedian Sid Singh returns to fight the good fight! The only show that makes you laugh and teaches you how to stand up to the Trump administration! Sid will help you lament the world being on fire while also telling you about the only thing more disastrous than the state of the world: his love life. 'This generation's Jon Stewart!' (Madrid Con Comedy).

title: Silent Disco
description: 'What's on your mind?' A musician and a psychologist walk into a disco, one, ever the social butterfly, the other reserved and introspective. These polar opposites attract and a romance develops – two souls at the start of their lives, two neurodivergent lovers living with their respective conditions, whilst the audience, equipped with headphones, witness every private thought and every secret anxiety. Silent Disco is a work of two halves simultaneously: The first, a tender narrative of the lives of neurodivergent young people, and an abstract, pre-recorded stream-of-consciousness, broadcast directly into the ears of its audience.
content_warnings: Contains distressing or potentially triggering themes, Scenes of sexual violence, Scenes of violence, Strong language/swearing

title: Silky in 'No, YOU’RE Poster Syndrome'
description: A comedian since he was a kid, Silky’s doing fine. The luckiest man alive, but he’s still sure it’s a clerical error... Come along for the ride down this winding road, via Iceland, the Falklands, Australia to Aberdeen, China to New York, Glastonbury and Kosovo. It’s not about the destination, it’s about sharing the journey. All aboard! Seen on BBC One, Channel 4, ITV, Paramount and briefly heard on BBC Radio Scotland. ***** (ThreeWeeks). 'A performer I urge you to see for yourself' (Herald). 'Like your funny best friend – only funnier' **** (BroadwayBaby.com).

title: Silly Goose!
description: We're all a bit silly from time to time aren't we? Well, we're on the hunt for the Silliest Goose in town! Join us and three comics as we discuss your silliest stories, whether it's saucy scandals, funny first dates or office outrages. There are prizes to be won for the Silliest Goose. So come down and tell your story! Or don't... and just watch as the best in the business make you honk with laughter over other's misfortune!

title: Simon Evans: Shadow Play
description: Or... Why poets should have listened to their gut. Fresh from a sell-out national tour, Simon brings his ever-evolving exploration of memory, intelligence, creativity and the centaur back to Edinburgh for two weeks only. The lyrical ambition of Coleridge, the autumnal pathos of late period Sinatra and the mystic genius of Plato come together to create a better class of shadow. As seen on Live at the Apollo and heard on BBC Radio 4's News Quiz and Simon Evans Goes to Market. 100 Trillion Neutrinos Per Second Can't be Wrong! 'Masterclass' ***** (Scotsman). 'Jaw-Dropping' ***** (Chortle.co.uk).

title: Simon & Garfunkel and Beyond
description: From their years as the most successful duo of all time and beyond to their solo hits, journey through the careers of two all-time greats. The Sound of Silence, The Boxer, Bright Eyes, 50 Ways, Call Me Al and more. Presented by Dan Clews (endorsed by Sir George Martin) and the award-winning Angus Munro, two artists with spellbinding vocal and instrumental mastery. A perfect match to express the ethereal music of the greatest pop duo of all time and the music they created beyond their celebrated duo years.

title: Sims Holland: Learning to Human
description: Award-winning solo show. Join US comic actor Sims Holland on her Edinburgh debut as she recounts her rollercoaster journey from the depths of addiction to the challenging – and often hilarious – road of sobriety. Speckled with poetry, dotted with dance numbers and doused in honesty, Learning to Human is a heartfelt exploration of what it takes to reclaim your life. Winner: Best Autobiographical Show, United Solo, NYC 2024. Winner: Best of the Fest, Frontera Fest ATX 2024. Nominee: B Iden Payne Award, ATX 2024. 'Searing, soul bearing and completely unforgettable' (BroadwayWorld.com).
content_warnings: Contains distressing or potentially triggering themes

title: Sinatra: One Last Shot
description: Sinatra and the 70s are not a good fit. He hates retirement and his comeback album flops. Concerts prove he can still pull in a crowd but he feels out of step with the times. Will he ever find that one big hit to redefine him? Told as a monologue from his Palm Spring's den, this brand-new show stars Richard Shelton after his critically acclaimed Sinatra: Raw show wowed critics worldwide. Written and directed by Bert Tyler-Moore, creator of The Windsors. 'Shelton is phenomenal. He captures the essence of the man perfectly' (BBC Radio 4).

title: Sing-a-Long Scotland
description: Come and join a relaxing feel-good afternoon show at the family-friendly LifeCare community space in Stockbridge. Johnny plays his guitar and sings a selection of well-loved Scottish sing-a-long songs, including Loch Lomond, Bonnie Wee Jeannie McColl, 500 Miles and many more. The show has been created for those living with dementia, their families, friends and carers. Everyone is encouraged to sing, hum or simply sit back, listen and enjoy. Johnny loves bringing people together for a fun session of Scottish music and songs we all remember. The LifeCare Community Cafe is a fully accessible venue.

title: Sing It!
description: Sing It! A stunning vocal show brought to you by the super singers of the Great Yorkshire Chorus. Including pop/rock favourites with a superb choral twist by this outstanding dynamic choir. Queen, Coldplay, Oasis, Erasure, Fleetwood Mac, Madness and more! Great Yorkshire Chorus hark from the beautiful hills of West Yorkshire and are the friendliest bunch of down-to-earth folk you’ll ever meet. And they love to sing. Yes they do! That’s when the magic happens! It’s their first visit back to the Fringe since their triumphant 2022 appearance. So you’re in luck!

title: Singalonga Pub Quiz
description:
That's right – it’s a singalong and it’s a pub quiz! Test your knowledge whilst you belt favourite tunes with Mister Meredith on piano. With different songs/questions every day you can come again and again. 
The show that’s had them queuing round the block since 2019 is back with brand new quizzes for you to try. Don't worry if you can't sing – everyone else will drown you out... and don't worry if you don't know the answers – you'll learn something! 'Simply magnificent' (Scotsman). 'Electric atmosphere' ***** (BroadwayBaby.com). 'A truly great night out!' ***** (ThreeWeeks).
venue_name: PBH's Free Fringe @ Fingers Piano Bar

title: SINNER. A Musical Tragicomedy About Breaking Up With White Jesus
description: If Fleabag went to Bible college in the North American Bible Belt. SINNER. is an irreverent solo musical tragicomedy about faith, shame, and being raised to shrink. Blending razor-sharp comedy, jaw-dropping vocal virtuosity and original songs, the show interrogates belief, family systems and the cost of becoming "good." Funny, tender and unapologetically honest, audiences have called SINNER. 'the soul healing I didn't know I still needed.' Come for the comedy. Stay for the catharsis.
content_warnings: Contains distressing or potentially triggering themes, Scenes of a sexual nature, Strong language/swearing, Buy a ticket in advance to guarantee entry or Pay What You Want at the venue
venue_name: Just The Tonic at The Caves

title: Siobhan Wilson: Flowercore
description: How a 2cm wildflower changed an artist's life. Through live music and immersive imagery, songwriter Siobhan Wilson celebrates Scotland's often overlooked wildflowers, exploring themes of preservation, belonging and resilience through music and immersive imagery featuring flower videography and flower art by Scottish artists. A show designed by Sufrecs in collaboration with Trench One and Edge Photography, produced in partnership with Gilded Balloon and Unique Events, funded by Made in Scotland, this compelling must-see show is not to be missed.

title: Sip Sparkle Skull
description: From coffee to cocktails, beer to bourbon, juice to gin there's a drink for every occasion. Join internationally acclaimed cabaret performer Melissa Western as she invites you in to her parlour for a cosy tipple. Covering the gamut of music from jazz, blues, cabaret, musicals, pop, rock and even jingles Melissa and her world-class band serve up songs about drinks: think Black Coffee, Peel Me a Grape, Tea for Two, You Go to My Head, Beer Bottle Mama, Red Red Wine, Tequila and many more. Full live band and cellar bar atmosphere. 'Oozes with charisma' ***** (Edinburgh-Reviews.co.uk).

title: Sir Dickie Benson's Midnight / Midday Mania Cabaret
description: Hollywood hellraiser and Free Fringe veteran Sir Dickie Benson returns, joining forces with award-winning burlesque star and producer Scarlett Whispers, to bring you a twice-daily, riotous, eclectic mix of burlesque, magic, music and comedy that features some of the finest and most crowd-pleasing acts from across the Fringe. A fast-paced, upbeat and irresistibly entertaining variety show that blends the traditional speakeasy style of cabaret with an off-the-cuff approach and a chaotic air of 'anything could happen... and probably will!' It’s live, loud and interactive – with a different line-up every time!

title: Sitting on a Cornflake: Lennon and McCartney
description: Irish duo Brothers Broke compare, adapt and perform a unique interpretation of songs by Lennon and McCartney. This alluring acoustic 45-minute show compares the individual styles and personalities that contributed to a unique partnership that saw both composers constantly driven to better themselves and produce groundbreaking and game-changing songs that always kept the world’s greatest band several steps ahead of everyone else. Brothers Broke modify and present the songs in an acoustic folk-blues style, exploring influence, inspiration and the competitiveness of this collaborative, yet often independent, songwriting partnership.

title: Sketchy Comedy: Where Art and Comedy Collide
description: Scottish award-winning stand-up comedian Gill shows that her fine art degree actually wasn't a waste of time. There is nothing quite like watching drawing emerge from a page. Pair that with completely improvised comedy and no show is the same. Gill Cordiner brings a show where art and comedy collide with hilarious results. You might take home an amazing portrait and jokes to tell everyone.

title: SLAY
presented_by: Gilded Balloon and Gobby Girls Productions
description: Following a PTSD diagnosis, Kit escapes the North-East for London, until a text from her ex detonates her recovery, sending her spiralling through therapy, chaos and questionable coping fantasies. In the TikTok trauma-dump era, Kit is determined to stay the main character (because if she doesn't laugh, she'll cry and post it). As symptoms, triggers and disordered eating collide, she must confront her past or keep avoiding it. SLAY is a darkly funny North-East reckoning by Offie nominated writer-performer Lois-Amber Toole (ITV's Vera, Amazon Prime's Killers Anonymous), directed by Fringe First winner Anna Morris, produced by Gina Lyons.
content_warnings:
Contains distressing or potentially triggering themes, Strong language/swearing
Eating disorders, and mention of sexual assault.

title: Sleight of Sound
description: Part concert, part magic show, part storytelling – Sleight of Sound is a solo music-magic experience about wandering, wondering and finding connection in unexpected places. With a passion for close-up magic, the audience isn’t just watching – they’re listening, responding, laughing and sometimes holding their breath together. Every performance is shaped by the room, the audience and the unpredictable beauty of live art. This is not a show about perfection – it’s about presence. About standing in front of a room of strangers and, by the end of the night, feeling like you’ve shared something real.

title: Slim for Life
description: Welcome to Slim for Life. A friendly local slimming group... with a taste for the dramatic – and perhaps something darker. Newcomer(s) welcome. Results guaranteed. Side effects may include eternal damnation. When heartbroken Lily joins her first session, she expects weigh-ins, wellness jargon and forced positivity. Instead, she finds a devoted leader, eccentric regulars and an atmosphere feeling increasingly ritualistic. As mantras become chants and discipline turns to devotion, Lily must decide how far she’s willing to go for transformation. A sharp, fast-paced dark comedy with live-musical flair from the team behind The Caper Trail (Fringe 2023).

title: Slugageddon!
description: Slugs, slugs and more slugs! Can you help Benny defeat the slug army with a piano made of vegetables, some delicious compost and a final showdown with the King Slug? Interactive and multimedia games, plenty of facts about biodiversity and of course, slugs! With some actually really great gardening tips for the grown ups... Best Kids Show Nominee – UK Kids’ Comedy Festival. Winner of Channel 4’s Last Leg Hans Award. Winner of the Disability Champions Award. 'Benny Shakes is a great comic, end of story' **** (StageSideUK.co.uk).

title: Small Town Funny: The Return!!
description: Petty truths, pity laughs! After more than a decade apart, podcast (Small Town Funny) and writing partners, Michelle and John, are together again to bring you the story of Michelle's biggest comeback. She's had all the breaks: a hip, a heart, and now Edinburgh Festival Fringe. Michelle shares her story, John provides support and helps her dig deep into this sometimes tragic, always funny tale. A hip broke. A marriage broke. Michelle didn't.
content_warnings: Buy a ticket to guarantee entry or Pay What You Want at the venue
venue_name: Just The Tonic at The Caves

title: Smashing Shakespeare: Brave Macbeth
description: Primary Times Children's Choice Award winner! A five-star, musical comedy version of Shakespeare's greatest work, Brave Macbeth is back with a brand-new score in the iconic Famous Spiegeltent! A hugely entertaining, fast, smart adaptation that brilliantly weaves the Bard's words with wickedly witty songs and fast-paced storytelling! Perfect for the whole family. 'One of the best children's shows at the Fringe... enjoyable and fun for all ages' (BroadwayBaby.com). 'Smashing Shakespeare has it all: great costumes, clever props and a hilarious script. This, along with the incredibly talented cast, makes it a must see' (ThreeWeeks).

title: Smile, It Might Never Happen
description: A whole new meaning to voicing your anxieties: the improvised comedy-musical based on your worries about the future. From a dreaded work do to an impending birth, the cast will combine your story with all of your favourite musical tropes to create a never-before (and never-again) seen show. Complete with live musical accompaniment, find out what really is the worst that could happen. But remember, after the curtain falls, don't cry because it's over... Smile, it might never happen. **** (TheArtsBusiness.com). 'Their youth and cosmic silliness raised us from our seats' (Metro).
content_warnings: Buy a ticket in advance to guarantee entry or Pay What You Want at the venue
space_name: Just The Tonic at The Subway

title: Smile: The Charlie Chaplin Story
description: After selling out in Edinburgh in 2025, the award-winning Fringe sensation about the life of Charlie Chaplin returns in 2026! Winner of a List festival award for Best Show, this is a physical comedy not to be missed! 'Magnificent' (List). 'A sparkling gem' (GlamAdelaide.com.au). 'Cole has perfected the art of mime' (TheAUReview.com). A one-man physical comedy created and performed by Marcel Cole.

title: Sneaking Into Taylor Swift Cost Me $1989
description: I've been sneaking into the biggest stadiums across North America wearing a hidden camera, then redistributing the ticket value to people in each city that could really benefit. As I released these videos on my Youtube channel (Matt Watson Comedy), security started hunting me, but when I had a shot at Taylor Swift's Eras Tour, I was determined to pull off my biggest heist yet...

title: So You Think You're Funny? Grand Final
description: Finalists battle it out to take the crown in the climactic stage of the UK's most prestigious comedy newcomer competition! Following months of regional showcases around the UK and Ireland, see comedy's rising stars give their best performances in a bid to win So You Think You're Funny? 2025. 'Showcasing the stand-up stars of the future' (Comedy.co.uk). Previous winners and finalists from the competition include Aisling Bea, Tommy Tiernan, Maisie Adam, Peter Kay, Lee Mack, Fern Brady, Rob Beckett, Romesh Ranganathan, Sara Pascoe, Daniel Sloss and more.

title: So You Think You're Funny? Heats
description: The search for comedy's next big star continues as contestants battle for a place in the Grand Final of the UK's biggest newcomer competition! Following months of regional showcases across the UK and Ireland, see the future faces of comedy before they make it big! 'Showcasing the stand-up stars of the future' (Comedy.co.uk). Previous winners and finalists from the competition include Aisling Bea, Tommy Tiernan, Maisie Adam, Peter Kay, Lee Mack, Fern Brady, Rob Beckett, Romesh Ranganathan, Sara Pascoe, Daniel Sloss and more.

title: Soaked
presented_by: La'al Marra Productions, sponsored by Tidy Productions
description: High-flyers Imogen and Rich like wine. It drips into their lives as their love language and helps them to cope with their stressful lives. But after twenty years of excess, Imogen is wavering. She’s tired of waking up with unexplained bruises, tired of the mornings thick with shame, tired of being tired, but is it enough? When life has become so intertwined with the powerful nectar is it easy to break away, or do relationships start to unravel? Perhaps a wake-up call is all she needs? Filled with humour and drama, Soaked seeks to unnerve.
content_warnings: Contains distressing or potentially triggering themes

title: Sofie Hagen – I Think Some of This Is My Fault
description: Sofie won a comedy award in 2015 and she thinks you all stopped talking about it too soon. Anyways, despite being constantly online from 2016-2024, she never saw it coming that the fascists would be taking over. She did so many feminist tweets to prevent it. How can this be happening? 'Eye-catchingly odd and disarmingly honest' (Independent). 'And the winner of the 2015 Best Newcomer Award is Sofie Hagen' (Freddie Flintoff, 2015).
content_warnings: Strong language/swearing, Buy a ticket in advance to guarantee entry or Pay What You Want at the venue

title: Soft Spot
description: Soft Spot is a circus duet for a juggler, a handstand artist, wooden planks and 300 wine glasses. Everyone has held a wine glass. Everyone has broken one. From childhood curiosity to adult caution, we share a relationship with this fragile everyday object. On stage, two artists carefully manipulate, stack and balance a delicate landscape, risking collapse at any moment. The glass becomes partner, obstacle and quiet threat – demanding precision and trust between performers. Each action carries tension; each near-collapse asks what might happen next. Unexpected outcomes reveal a playful, precise exploration of our fragile world.

title: Solea – An Afternoon of Guitar
description: An Afternoon of Guitar. Think Al Di Meola, Jesse Cook and Rodrigo y Gabriela. Gerry Magee and Dave Sim, two Scottish guitarists at the top of their game, bringing their virtuoso playing to the Edinburgh Fringe. Passionate playing and fiery showmanship in an intimate setting, this duo will have you on the edge of your seat. A must for music lovers and guitar aficionados alike. Doors strictly 15:30 for a 45-minute show. Grab your tickets while you still can!

title: Solo From the Pit
description: Elias Faingersh, a virtuoso trombone player, reinterprets famous operas in a musical stand-up comedy show, framed by his personal dramatic story. Grand Prix of the Reykjavik Fringe Festival. Best of the Fest selection (OrlandoSentinel.com). Best Solo Show – Musical (Orlando Fringe). As seen at the SoHo Playhouse Theatre.

title: Solve-Along-A-Murder-She-Wrote
description: The cult hit returns with a new episode! Don't miss this hilarious interactive screening of the classic Murder, She Wrote episode Menace, Anyone? 'It has the BEST host' (Time Out London). 'A complete triumph' (Scotsman). ***** (BroadwayWorld.com). Catch this unique night featuring games, prizes and audience participation, with special permission from NBC Universal Television. See the show that has played to sell-out audiences across the UK, Ireland, the USA and Australia, as well as the Edinburgh Festival Fringe 2023-2025, Adelaide Fringe, and the Murder, She Wrote Festival in Mendocino (Cabot Cove) 2025 and 2026.

title: (Some Guy Called) Dave Joke of the Fringe Showcase
description: It’s the comedy event of the year – the ultimate showcase for every comedian chasing the coveted Joke of the Fringe title, the trophy, and the £500 cash prize. Each show brings together a hand-picked line-up of the Fringe’s sharpest comedic talent, all delivering their absolute best stand-up – including the very jokes they hope will secure them victory at the main event. Expect big laughs, bold punchlines and fierce competition as performers battle it out for glory. One stage. One trophy. Endless laughs.

title: Soness: Sumo Injury Comeback Tour
description: Former English voice of Hello Kitty, Soness went from growing up homeless in a beat-up Datsun, to becoming one of Japan’s most recognisable English voices (until AI tried to replace her). Then she tried sumo wrestling. It didn't go well. Fast-paced storytelling blends voice acting, anime, video games, accidental athleticism, one spectacular injury. What happens when you realise you aren't the main character (and maybe never were?) Burbank Comedy Festival semi-finalist. 'One of the most genial hours on offer' **** (TheQR.co.uk). 'An intimate, fascinating glimpse into a life less ordinary – different, charming' **** (One4Review.co.uk).

title: Sophia Wren: The Best Girl in the World
description: Sophia Wren is an electrifying Irish stand-up whose comedy crackles with intelligence and heart. Drawing on family folklore, modern dating disasters and the beautifully absurd realities of Irish life, she crafts tightly written sets that feel both personal and universal. Her stage presence is warm yet mischievous, inviting audiences to laugh at the chaos of adulthood while finding unexpected tenderness in the punchlines. Whether commanding a packed theatre or an intimate club, she delivers fearless crowd work, sharp social commentary and stories that spiral hilariously before snapping back with precision.

title: Sophie Duker: Hot Beef Injection
presented_by: Berk's Nest in association with Avalon Management
description: Duker’s back on her bullshit. And this time, she’s done with dudes. Promise. The people’s princess of provocation returns with a beefy hour about sex and privilege. Taskmaster Champion and Just For Laughs International New Face. As seen crushing Live at the Apollo, House of Games, Celebrity Mastermind and Celebrity Pointless. Sell-out Fringe runs since 2019. ‘Obscenely good… Charisma to burn’ (Rolling Stone). 'Extremely funny' **** (Scotsman). 'Truly one of the best comedians around' **** (DIVA). 'Laugh-out-loud funny' **** (Telegraph). 'Not scared to push the boundaries' **** (Fest). **** (Skinny). **** (Evening Standard). **** (Times).

title: Sophie Garrad: A Period Drama
description: Sophie's always hated period dramas, until there was one all about her. On December 8th 2025 Sophie went under the knife, not even for a set of new boobs. 'The rising it-girl of the comedy circuit' (Attitude) and Funny Women Finalist, best known for her Private School Mum and London Girlies online sketches generating over 120 million views. 'Garrad is a truly gossipy storyteller... airily witty in her constant asides' **** (Scotsman). 'Highly entertaining' **** (AYoungishPerspective.co.uk). 'Hilarious' **** (The Student) **** (One4Review.co.uk). **** (Mervyn Stutter's Pick of the Fringe).
content_warnings: This show contains strong language and reference to distressing or potentially triggering themes, including fertility and ectopic pregancy.

title: Sophie's Surprise 29th
presented_by: Underbelly and Three Legged Race Productions
description: Get in losers, Sophie is turning 29 (again!). Part circus spectacle, part comedy mayhem, and all-out 90s nostalgia, featuring world-class performers from Cirque du Soleil, La Clique, The 7 Fingers and more. Expect breathtaking acrobatics, outrageous surprises and a soundtrack that takes you straight back to the house parties that you never wanted to end. The twist: each night, one lucky guest is chosen to become Sophie. Grab your Walkman, dust off those scrunchies and act like it's your party because tonight... it might be! ´Funny, sexy and breathtaking' ***** (Scottish Sun). ***** (BroadwayBaby.com).
content_warnings: Audience participation, Nudity, Scenes of a sexual nature, Strong language/swearing
venue_name: Underbelly’s Circus Hub on the Meadows

title: Sound Strokes: A Harmonious Blend of Chinese and Scottish Music
description: Following the success of Waves of Tradition last year, Wan Xing, Gregor Black and Eleanor Dunsdon return with a vibrant intercultural programme. The expressive sound of the Chinese guzheng meets Scottish musical traditions inspired by the painting of Qiu Yangzi.
